Company Description

Software Mind develops solutions that make an impact for companies around the globe. Tech giants & unicorns, transformative projects, emerging technologies and limitless opportunities – these are a few words that describe an average day for us. Building cross-functional engineering teams that take ownership and crave more means we’re always on the lookout for talented people who bring passion and creativity to every project. Our culture embraces openness, acts with respect, shows grit & guts and combines cooperation with enjoyment.

Job Description

Project – the aim you’ll have

We are looking for someone who will support the HR and payroll team in the day-to-day administration of HR and, at the same time, help us organize and improve HR processes in a multi-company organization. This role is for someone who knows “hard” HR inside out, yet enjoys organizing, standardizing, reporting and bringing together the perspectives of different departments. It is a role in a dynamic environment: it requires running several topics in parallel, setting priorities independently and working efficiently with a large number of tasks.

Role – how you’ll contribute

• Supporting the team in comprehensive HR administration across the full lifecycle of employees, individuals engaged under civil-law contracts and B2B contractors (including electronic personnel files).
• Standardizing and supporting HR processes within the team and at the interface with other company departments, including defining the rules of cooperation with those departments.
• Identifying areas for improvement and automation of HR processes, and initiating and leading changes in this area, including through the use of new technologies and AI-based tools – in cooperation with the company’s operational improvement team.
• Cooperating with the external partner supporting us with the HR and payroll system: reporting needs, testing changes and rolling out new functionalities.
• Co-creating and updating the internal policies, procedures and instructions of the HR and payroll team.
• Participating in the preparation, updating and implementation of company regulations in cooperation with the Legal department.
• Preparing HR reports and summaries.
• Running ad hoc HR projects and initiatives (e.g., mass contract amendments and documentation, changes in legislation, organizational changes).
• Tracking changes in labor law and implementing them in HR processes, and participating in HR inspections and audits.

Qualifications

Expectations – the experience you need

• Min. 5 years of experience in an independent HR position in an international company (including 2 years of experience coordinating project work)
• Knowledge of labor law and GDPR, and of the practical rules for maintaining employee records.
• Experience in organizing and documenting processes, instructions and internal policies.
• Experience in coordinating improvement projects and initiatives in HR, including ad hoc ones.
• Proficiency in HR and payroll systems (knowledge of Enova is a plus) and a very good command of Excel that allows for ease in reporting (experience using AI is a plus)
• Very good communication skills and experience working with employees, managers at various levels of the organization and external partners on day-to-day HR operations and HR projects.
• A practical approach to problem-solving and independence in handling topics.
• Ability to work under pressure from workload and deadlines, and to set priorities, including when needs change.
• Fluent English, spoken and written.

Additional Information

What we offer:

• Flexible and remote cooperation options
• International projects with leading global clients
• Travels related to international projects
• Non-corporate atmosphere
• Access* to language classes
• Access* to knowledge-sharing initiatives
• Access* to private healthcare and life insurance
• Access* to multisport card

*The availability and terms of individual benefits may vary depending on the chosen form of cooperation.

description:
About Hilbert

Hilbert is a scalable, data science-first growth engine that gives B2C teams predictive clarity into user behavior, revenue drivers, and the actions that drive sustainable growth. Fully agentic by design, Hilbert shrinks months-long decision cycles to minutes.

From Fortune 10 enterprises to beloved brands like FreshDirect, Blank Street, and Levain Bakery, operators run their growth on Hilbert. We're also co-building alongside leading AI companies.

The Mission: Turn Ground Truth Into Growth

Hilbert has two parts: a data foundation that gives our AI agents a high-fidelity view of each business, and an agentic web app where growth teams find and act on insights. The scores and audiences you build feed both: our agents reason with them, and our activation sends them into paid media and CRM.

The hard problem

Every customer's data is different, their compute may be ClickHouse, Databricks, Snowflake or BigQuery, and their teams want proof, not promises. Your models have to work in that environment and show measured uplift. We want every pod to stay lean and efficient across very different customer environments, delivering quality work at startup speed. You focus on delivery; our sales engineers handle pre-sales. Your work centers on customers in your own region: supporting customers elsewhere is a rare exception, and your global work is mainly staying aligned with Hilbert colleagues in other regions.

What You'll Do

• Feature stores: build customer-specific, point-in-time correct features on the data foundation.
• Models: train, tune and validate propensity, churn, lifetime value, uplift and custom models, starting from our ML templates and building custom models when a customer needs something the templates don't cover. New model types that many customers will need are built first by our product engineering team, and you roll them out to later customers.
• Model analysis: go beyond aggregate metrics to verify what each model has learned, what drives its scores, and how it behaves across segments and on edge cases.
• Deployment: models run in the customer's own environment or on our managed stack. In either case, understand the constraints, pin down the requirements, design the ML system to fit, and write the scores and audiences our agents and activation use.
• Measurement: own the statistical design inside our growth team's measurement plan, from power and holdout setup to uplift analysis.
• Trust: document models for the customer's data science and risk teams, then monitor and retrain them in production.
• Productization: turn repeated features and model patterns into product with our product engineering team.

What Success Looks Like

• Audiences built from your models lift the agreed growth metric, such as conversion or retention, against a holdout group, and that result decides whether the customer takes them to production.

Who You Are

• The translator: you explain a model to a customer's data science team and earn their trust.
• The experimenter: you'd rather prove uplift in a holdout test than show off an offline metric.
• The pilot: you get the most out of AI agents across model iterations, from feature ideas and experiment runs to error analysis, and help build them into how the team works.
• The systems thinker: you build reusable features, pipelines and automation instead of one-off models, so a small team can deliver across very different environments.
• Extensive applied ML experience on tabular customer data, with strong Python and ML libraries.
• Extensive hands-on deep learning experience, from designing architectures and loss functions to training and shipping models in production, with PyTorch or a similar framework.
• Feature engineering in SQL warehouses such as Databricks, Snowflake or BigQuery.
• Working data engineering experience: building and debugging pipelines, data orchestration, data modeling and data quality checks, enough to own your feature pipelines end to end with our data engineers.
• Production ML with tools such as MLflow, Weights & Biases or Vertex AI.
• Solid experiment design and uplift measurement.
• Comfortable working in a distributed team across time zones.
• Fluent Spanish for roles based in Latin America.

Nice to have

• DevOps, software architecture and security knowledge
• Growth-focused data projects experience
• Industry experience such as e-commerce, retail, fintech, telco and media
• Model governance in regulated industries such as banking and telco: model documentation, explainability and PII handling
• Able to travel to the US when necessary

Reporting and location

You report to your pod's Lead Delivery Engineer and work alongside our data delivery engineers and product engineering team. The role is based in EMEA. Delivery runs remotely, with occasional visits to our largest customers.

Why join us

At Hilbert, we move fast, work collaboratively, and give people real ownership over their impact. As a fast-growing company, there's no shortage of room to grow — you'll take on new challenges quickly and shape the path as you go.

Hilbert is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to building a diverse team and an inclusive culture, and we welcome applicants of all backgrounds. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable law.

title: Waiter - Full time
description:
With over 20 Hospitality experiences worldwide, RH Hospitality continues to expand our distinguished portfolio of Restaurants within our Design Galleries globally. The ideal candidate is passionate about creating exceptional guest experiences through intention, consistency, and an unwavering attention to detail, while providing polished, anticipatory service in an upscale dining environment. As a Server, you will play a vital role in shaping memorable moments for our guests, guiding each step of their dining journey with a genuine desire to serve, while continuing to grow your own professional expertise.

title: SAP BTP Developer
description:
The role

The Role

The SAP BTP Developer is responsible for the design, development and support of cloud-based integrations, extensions and applications on SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP).

This role plays a key part in Shoosmiths’ SAP modernisation journey which starts with a move to SAP Rise and Integration Suite. This role will look to use the clean core extensibility capabilities from SAP, to reduce customisation of the SAP environment.

Main Responsibilities

• Analyse business requirements, functional specifications and technical designs to produce robust BTP based solutions.
• Design, build and maintain integrations using SAP Integration Suite (CPI), including REST, SOAP, SFTP, JDBC and event driven patterns.
• Develop side by side extensions and applications on SAP BTP using CAP/RAP, Node.js, Java and SAP Business Application Studio.
• Build and extend SAP Fiori/UI5 applications, improving user experience while adhering to clean core principles.
• Configure and manage secure connectivity using Cloud Connector, destinations, certificates and OAuth based authentication.
• Work closely with functional consultants to support SAP processes such as Finance, HR and core master data.
• Support integration migration activities from legacy platforms to SAP BTP.
• Produce high quality technical documentation, including design specifications, mappings and operational runbooks.
• Conduct code reviews, unit testing and debugging to ensure solutions are scalable, secure and maintainable.
• Support testing, deployment and post go live activities.
• Work with project managers to estimate effort, plan development work and deliver solutions within agreed timelines.

Essential Skills

• Strong experience developing on SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP).
• Hands-on experience with SAP Integration Suite (CPI) and enterprise integration patterns.
• Experience building cloud applications or extensions using CAP and/or RAP.
• SAP Fiori/UI5 development experience.
• Understanding of clean-core principles and side-by-side extensibility.
• Experience integrating SAP S/4HANA with internal and third-party systems.
• Knowledge of secure connectivity, authentication and authorisation in SAP BTP.
• Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to translate business needs into technical solutions.
• Ability to work collaboratively within multi-disciplinary teams.

Desirable Skills

• Background in ABAP development and SAP extensibility.
• Experience with SAP Event Mesh or event-driven architectures.
• Exposure to SAP Build Process Automation or workflow tooling.
• Familiarity with SAP Analytics Cloud or Datasphere.
• Experience working in regulated or professional services environments.

The Team

The IS team at Shoosmiths plays a pivotal role in enabling the firm’s digital transformation and operational excellence. With a team of 76 professionals, the department is structured into two core functions: Technical and Applications. The Technical team covers Service Desk, 3rd Line Support, Business Systems Training, Compliance, Networks, and Security, while the Applications team manages platforms such as SAP, iManage and other core legal systems. The team is committed to collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement, with a strong focus on wellbeing, development opportunities, and delivering secure, scalable, and user-centric solutions that support the firm’s strategic goals

The firm

Shoosmiths is the law firm clients choose for excellent service, incisive thinking and above all for our ability to focus on what matters. From offices across the UK and Brussels, we support some of the world’s most exciting and ambitious businesses; amazing clients making an impact. We empower our people to be their authentic selves and deliver together in supportive teams committed to excellence and innovation. The first top 50 law firm to achieve ‘Platinum Standard’ Investors in People, our values and culture are not just words on our website but are the heartbeat of the firm.

We have an outstanding benefits package to complement our competitive remuneration system. In addition to the competitive salaries, great working environment and high-quality work, we believe that all staff should be rewarded for their commitment to the continued success of the firm through a comprehensive and flexible range of benefits.

To discover more about our benefits, please visit: Benefits Package

Equal opportunities

Shoosmiths is proud to be a Disability Confident Employer. Disability Confident is a government scheme designed to encourage employers to recruit and retain disabled people and those with long term conditions. As part of our accreditation, we commit to interviewing any applicants with a disability who meet the essential criteria for each vacancy. In some circumstances we may only be able to interview those that best meet the essential criteria due to the volume of applications received.

Further information on the Disability Confident scheme is available at https://www.gov.uk/government/collections/disability-confident-campaign

We are committed to ensuring our recruitment process is inclusive and accessible to and usable by everyone. If you have a disability or long-term condition and would like to receive information in a different way, or need us to make any adjustments, changes or do anything differently during the recruitment process, please get in touch with the Talent Acquisition team on Experienced.Hire@shoosmiths.com. We can consider your needs and requirements, and how we can assist you to apply for our roles. For example we can provide a copy of our application via email so that you can complete it using your own accessibility software.

title: Technical Success
description:
About the Role

Help customers put AI to work. Our technical customer-facing teams connect business goals with practical solutions, helping organizations evaluate, build, deploy, and adopt OpenAI technology.

We welcome technical pre-sales and post-sales professionals, whatever your current title or team. If your work combines technical expertise with helping customers evaluate, implement, or adopt technology, we would like to hear from you. You do not need to decide which role is the right fit before applying.



In this role, you will:

Depending on the opportunity and your strengths, your work may include:

 - Work with customers to understand their goals, identify useful AI applications, and define measurable outcomes.

 - Design technical approaches across architecture, integrations, data, security, governance, and evaluation.

 - Build demonstrations, prototypes, or production solutions, and helping customers navigate technical trade-offs.

 - Support deployment and adoption through technical guidance, workshops, enablement, and delivery coordination.

 - Partner with Sales, Product, Research, Engineering, and other customer-facing teams to resolve challenges and turn customer feedback into better products and practices.



You might thrive in this role if you:

 - Have helped customers evaluate, implement, or adopt complex technology and can connect technical work to business outcomes.

 - Bring a strong technical foundation in areas such as software, APIs, cloud infrastructure, data, or AI systems.

 - Can explain technical concepts clearly, build trust with different audiences, and work through ambiguous problems.

 - Learn quickly, collaborate across disciplines, and care about the safe and effective use of AI.



We value different kinds of technical depth. Engineering-focused opportunities may call for substantial hands-on coding, integration, debugging, and production delivery. Other opportunities emphasize architecture, technical strategy, customer enablement, or delivery leadership. You do not need to cover every area listed here.



How the Talent Pool Works

Tell us about your technical strengths, customer-facing work, and the kinds of problems you enjoy solving. Our recruiting team reviews this pool to identify potential matches across relevant teams and may contact you to explore a suitable opportunity. title: Aiuto cuoco lavpiatti
description:
Descrizione dell'azienda Ristorante Mater Modena è una realtà della ristorazione con sede di lavoro a Greater Modena Metropolitan Area, orientata alla qualità del servizio e alla cura dell’esperienza gastronomica. L’ambiente di lavoro è dinamico e collaborativo, con particolare attenzione al rispetto delle persone e alla crescita professionale del personale di cucina e di sala. Il ristorante punta su ingredienti selezionati e su una cucina attenta ai dettagli, valorizzando il lavoro di squadra in tutte le fasi del servizio. Entrare in squadra significa contribuire in modo concreto alla soddisfazione di una clientela varia, in un contesto organizzato e professionale.
Descrizione del ruolo Aiuto cuoco lavapiatti supporterà la brigata di cucina nelle attività quotidiane con sede di lavoro a Greater Modena Metropolitan Area, in un ruolo full time e completamente in presenza. La persona si occuperà della preparazione di base degli ingredienti (pulizia, taglio, porzionamento), del supporto nella mise en place e nella preparazione dei piatti secondo le indicazioni del cuoco. Sarà responsabile del lavaggio di stoviglie, attrezzature e utensili, del riordino degli spazi di lavoro e del mantenimento degli standard di igiene e sicurezza alimentare. Parteciperà alla gestione delle scorte, allo smaltimento corretto dei rifiuti e collaborerà con il team per garantire tempi di servizio efficienti. Il ruolo richiede attenzione ai dettagli, capacità di lavorare in squadra e disponibilità a turni, inclusi weekend e festivi.
Qualifiche

• Il candidato dovrebbe possedere competenze di base in cucina, inclusa la preparazione degli ingredienti, la gestione della mise en place e la collaborazione con il cuoco nelle fasi di servizio.
• È richiesta una buona capacità di mantenere elevati standard di igiene, ordine e pulizia, in particolare nella gestione di lavaggio stoviglie, sanificazione delle superfici e corretta organizzazione degli spazi.
• Sono apprezzate abilità nell’organizzazione del lavoro, nella gestione dei tempi e nella capacità di operare sotto pressione durante i momenti di maggiore affluenza.
• Costituiscono titolo preferenziale precedente esperienza in cucina o come aiuto cuoco lavapiatti, conoscenza di base delle norme HACCP, affidabilità, flessibilità oraria e capacità di lavorare in team in modo rispettoso e collaborativo.

title: Sous Chef
description:
Sous Chef, Prezzo Italian

The Head Chef's right hand, and the steady pair of hands every kitchen needs.

You can't miss Prezzo Italian right now. Our refurbished restaurants look stunning, with more on the way, and the food has never been better. Guests are noticing and the momentum is real. Now we need Sous Chefs who lead by example and are ready to grow into Head Chefs.

Who We Are

Brava Hospitality Group is the home of great restaurant brands. We're the group behind Prezzo Italian, in towns and cities right across the UK, and a collection of much-loved central London restaurants: Jamie's Italian, Riding House Café, Nessa, Yasmin, Mortimer House Kitchen and, most recently, Bolo by Gennaro. And we're growing the footprint of every one of our brands. We're restaurant people at heart, and we believe every guest deserves brilliant food and exceptional hospitality from teams who love what they do.

Prezzo Italian has been bringing the Italian classics to towns and cities across the UK since 2000. For our 25th birthday we gave it a fresh start: a brand-new look, beautifully redesigned restaurants, and a menu built around the dishes people love, made fresh and cooked properly. Prezzo Italian is the home of the Italian classics.

We're a business on the way up, and the people who join us now will shape where it goes next.

The role

As Sous Chef at Prezzo Italian, you're your Head Chef's right hand. You run shifts in the kitchen, keep standards high on every section, and take charge when your Head Chef isn't there.

At Prezzo Italian, it all comes down to two things: the impression we make and the connections we build. Every guest should leave feeling genuinely looked after, not just served. That starts with how we treat each other. Teams who look out for one another, have fun together and take pride in what they do create the moments guests remember and come back for. As Sous Chef, you help set that tone on every shift.

Food is one of our key pillars, so you'll have the right tools to get it right every time. Our dedicated chefs website shows exactly what every dish should look like and the right ingredients that go into it, and some of our restaurants use QSR kitchen technology to keep every order flowing.

With your Head Chef and our central team of chefs behind you, this is the place to learn what it takes to run your own kitchen.

What You'll Be Responsible For

Leading the kitchen

• Run the pass and lead shifts with confidence.
• Train and coach the team, helping develop the chefs of tomorrow.
• Step up and run the kitchen in your Head Chef's absence.

Cooking the Italian classics properly

• Make sure every dish is made fresh, cooked properly and plated to spec.
• Jump on any section when it's needed.
• Work closely with front of house so every guest gets the same great impression.

Keeping standards high

• Help manage ordering, stock and waste.
• Lead on food safety, allergens and health and safety, every shift.
• Keep the kitchen clean, organised and audit-ready.

What We're Looking For

Are you a Prezzo person? You're warm, genuine and generous with your time. You love great food and you love people even more. You make every guest feel welcome from the moment they walk in, you lift the team around you, and you take pride in getting the little things right. You bring energy, a sense of fun, and the confidence to make the call.

You're a Sous Chef already, or an experienced chef who is ready for the next step.

• Experience in a busy, high-volume kitchen, including leading shifts.
• Pride in food and consistency, on every plate.
• Calm under pressure, with a people-first approach.
• Good knowledge of food safety, allergens and health and safety.
• Ambition to run your own kitchen one day.

What's In It For You

You'll give a lot to this role. Here's what we give back.

Reward

• Tronc, so you share in the success of a busy restaurant
• Company pension scheme, if you're eligible
• Life assurance at 2x your annual pay
• Paid holiday allowance
• Refer a friend and earn up to £1,000

Time and wellbeing

• Your birthday off, every year
• Free or heavily subsidised meals on shift
• 24/7 GP helpline and Employee Assistance Programme (EAP)
• Stream (formerly Wagestream), our financial wellbeing app: access pay you've already earned, save straight from your pay, and get tools and guidance to manage your money
• Free regulated mortgage advice

Perks

• 50% off at Prezzo Italian
• 25% off at every other Brava restaurant
• Share 25% off with up to 5 friends and family, even when you're not there
• Free Tastecard and the Hospitality Rewards app for retail discounts
• Electric car scheme after one year's service

Your future

• Ongoing development and coaching
• A clear path to Head Chef
• Opportunities across our other brands

Ready for the next step?

This is an exciting time for Prezzo Italian, and where we go next will be shaped by the people who join us now.

If you want to lead, learn and grow with a kitchen team that's proud of every plate, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply today. It takes a few minutes to start a conversation that could change your next five years.

Brava Hospitality Group is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone, and we'll make reasonable adjustments at any stage of the process.

title: C# & Azure Developer - 12 Months FTC
description:
C# & Azure Developer - 12 Months FTC

Reports to: Head of Development

Location: Remote

Package: Competitive salary + annual bonus

About the role:

The C# & Azure Developer is responsible for the development, support, maintenance and continuous improvement of Healthxchange's business-critical applications and digital platforms.

This role will primarily focus on the continued development and support of the Healthxchange e-Pharmacy platform, CourierBridge courier integration platform, corporate Intranet, Azure-hosted services and associated backend systems. The successful candidate will work across application development, systems integration, database development and cloud technologies to deliver reliable, scalable and secure solutions that support business operations, customer experience and future growth.

The role requires a strong backend developer with excellent C#, Azure and SQL Server skills who is comfortable working across multiple applications and supporting business-critical systems. The successful candidate will work closely with technical and business stakeholders to deliver new functionality, resolve issues and identify opportunities for continuous improvement.

About Healthxchange:

Founded in 2000, Healthxchange is the leading supplier of medical aesthetic products and services to professionals across the UK & Ireland. We are the exclusive UK & Ireland distributor for brands including Obagi Medical and Epicutis, the exclusive professional channel partner for Medik8, and a long-standing partner to the leading injectables manufacturers. We supply over 10,000 clinics with a full range of products (skincare, injectables, energy-based devices) and services (software and education) to support their business needs. We are the #1 medical aesthetics distributor in the UK & Ireland and were named Distributor of the Year at the Aesthetics Awards in 2022, 2023, 2024 and 2026.

Responsibilities:

Application Development

• Develop, maintain and enhance applications using C# and .NET technologies.
• Deliver new functionality, enhancements and bug fixes across multiple business systems.
• Develop secure, scalable and maintainable backend services and APIs.
• Participate in technical design and solution development activities.
• Produce high-quality, well-tested and well-documented code.
• Participate in peer code reviews and contribute to development standards and best practices.

e-Pharmacy Platform

• Develop, support and maintain the Healthxchange e-Pharmacy platform.
• Deliver enhancements to prescribing, ordering, fulfilment and operational workflows.
• Resolve defects, incidents and performance issues.
• Work with business stakeholders to translate requirements into technical solutions.
• Support initiatives to modernise the platform and reduce technical debt.

CourierBridge Platform

• Develop and support CourierBridge, Healthxchange's bespoke Azure-based courier management and integration platform.
• Maintain integrations with courier providers and shipping services.
• Develop functionality to support shipment processing, label generation and fulfilment operations.
• Improve automation, monitoring and operational visibility within the platform.
• Support onboarding of new courier services and logistics partners.

Intranet Development

• Develop and maintain the company's Blazor-based Intranet platform.
• Deliver enhancements that improve internal business processes and employee experience.
• Support integration with internal systems and services.
• Ensure security, performance and usability standards are maintained.

Azure Development & Cloud Services

• Develop and support Azure-hosted applications and services.
• Maintain Azure App Services, Azure Functions, Azure SQL databases and related cloud services.
• Support cloud-native application development and platform improvements.
• Monitor application health and performance using Azure tooling.
• Contribute to platform resilience, security and performance optimisation initiatives

Database Development

• Design, develop and optimise SQL Server database solutions.
• Create and maintain stored procedures, views, functions and database objects.
• Develop and optimise complex SQL queries.
• Troubleshoot and resolve database performance issues.
• Support database deployment, migration and maintenance activities.
• Ensure data integrity, security and performance across all platforms.

Systems Integration

• Design, develop and maintain integrations between internal and external systems.
• Support integrations with warehouse, ERP, courier, supplier and partner platforms.
• Develop REST APIs and integration services.
• Support event-driven and API-based communication between business systems.
• Ensure reliable and secure exchange of data across platforms.

DevOps & Continuous Delivery

• Support and improve CI/CD deployment pipelines.
• Participate in software release planning and deployment activities.
• Assist with environment management and troubleshooting.
• Contribute to automation and continuous improvement initiatives.
• Support production systems and out-of-hours deployments where required.

Technical Collaboration

• Work closely with business stakeholders, project teams and third-party suppliers.
• Contribute to solution design and technology decisions.
• Maintain technical documentation and knowledge-sharing processes.
• Identify opportunities for process improvement, automation and innovation.
• Support the ongoing evolution of Healthxchange's digital platforms and technology estate.

What we need from you:

• Strong commercial experience developing applications using C# and .NET.
• Experience with .NET Framework and modern .NET (.NET Core/.NET 8).
• Strong SQL Server development experience.
• Experience designing and optimising complex SQL queries, stored procedures and database solutions.
• Experience developing and consuming RESTful APIs.
• Experience with Microsoft Azure services including:
• Azure App Services
• Azure Function
• Azure SQL
• Azure Storage
• Azure Monitoring and Application Insights
• Experience with Azure DevOps and CI/CD pipelines.
• Experience working with Git source control.
• Strong debugging, troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
• Ability to support and enhance business-critical applications.
• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
• Ability to work independently and manage competing priorities.

Desirable:

• Experience with Azure Service Bus and messaging technologies.
• Experience with Azure SQL Managed Instance.
• Experience of e-commerce, pharmacy or healthcare systems.
• Experience with warehouse, fulfilment or logistics integrations.
• Experience integrating with courier and shipping platforms.
• Experience working within regulated environments.
• Knowledge of cloud security and secure development practices.
• Microsoft Azure certifications.
• Blazor development experience.
• Experience mentoring junior developers.

Benefits:

Company pension, annual performance bonus, 25 days holiday plus bank holidays (and increasing with length of service), staff discount, staff social events, access to Health Assured EAP, Birthday off perk.

Healthxchange is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive work environment. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and we welcome and encourage applications from all qualified individuals regardless of race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability status, marital status, or any other legally protected status. All employment decisions are based on merit, qualifications, and business needs.

title: Software Engineer - QuantumBlack, AI by McKinsey
description:
Who You'll Work With

Driving lasting impact and building long-term capabilities with our clients is not easy work. You are the kind of person who thrives in a high performance/high reward culture - doing hard things, picking yourself up when you stumble, and having the resilience to try another way forward.

In return for your drive, determination, and curiosity, we'll provide the resources, mentorship, and opportunities you need to become a stronger leader faster than you ever thought possible. Your colleagues—at all levels—will invest deeply in your development, just as much as they invest in delivering exceptional results for clients. Every day, you'll receive apprenticeship, coaching, and exposure that will accelerate your growth in ways you won’t find anywhere else.

When you join us, you will have:

• Continuous learning: Our learning and apprenticeship culture, backed by structured programs, is all about helping you grow while creating an environment where feedback is clear, actionable, and focused on your development. The real magic happens when you take the input from others to heart and embrace the fast-paced learning experience, owning your journey.
• A voice that matters: From day one, we value your ideas and contributions. You’ll make a tangible impact by offering innovative ideas and practical solutions, all while upholding our unwavering commitment to ethics and integrity. We not only encourage diverse perspectives, but they are critical in driving us toward the best possible outcomes.
• Global community: With colleagues across 65+ countries and over 100 different nationalities, our firm’s diversity fuels creativity and helps us come up with the best solutions for our clients. Plus, you’ll have the opportunity to learn from exceptional colleagues with diverse backgrounds and experiences.
• World-class benefits: On top of a competitive salary (based on your location, experience, and skills), we provide a comprehensive benefits package to enable holistic well-being for you and your family.

Your Impact

You will collaborate with a global network of technologists, designers, and strategists to help clients transform their businesses through innovative digital solutions.

You’ll develop cutting-edge products, mentor client teams, and shape engineering cultures while growing your expertise across diverse industries and technologies.

You will work hands-on with clients across industries to bring their digital ambitions to life. You will develop software products and services from the ground up while coaching and mentoring client teams on engineering best practices, user-centric design, and Agile values. By co-creating with clients and their leadership, you’ll help build not only cutting-edge products but also the technical capabilities and cultures needed to sustain them.

Your work will drive meaningful change for clients and their industries. You will participate in cross-functional problem-solving sessions with client leaders, shaping their digital strategies and delivering solutions that go beyond the product itself. Your efforts will help clients build scalable teams and engineering cultures that enable long-term success.

You will collaborate with clients across industries to turn their digital ambitions into reality through hands-on technical expertise. Based in one of our global locations, you will be part of QuantumBlack, AI by McKinsey, a multidisciplinary group of software engineers, AI engineers, data scientists, and technology consultants passionate about creating industry-shaping products and tools.

You’ll grow as a technologist and leader. You’ll work across diverse industries and technologies, learning something new with every project. With opportunities to contribute to digital strategies, build impactful products, and mentor others, you’ll have the freedom to chart your own path and grow in the areas that excite you most.

Your Qualifications and Skills

• Undergraduate or master’s degree; or equivalent experience
• 2+ years of experience developing full-stack applications by writing code that is readable, testable, maintainable, and scalable
• Demonstrated experience working collaboratively with other developers, as well as technical and non-technical people within software teams
• Hands-on experience and willingness to learn across frontend (TypeScript, React, Angular, Vue, Next.js, Tailwind), backend (Python, Node.js, Java/Spring, C#/.NET), and databases (SQL, NoSQL, vector databases, ETL)
• Experience with LLM frameworks, prompt orchestration, agent frameworks, MCPs, evaluation frameworks, and cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP), including Docker and CI/CD
• Strong focus on automated testing, logging, monitoring, and overall system reliability
• Experience working in Agile teams, including active participation in sprint ceremonies
• Experience pair programming collaboratively with other developers
• Exceptional time management to meet your responsibilities in a complex and largely autonomous work environment
• Business level language fluency skills, both verbal and written in English, with the ability to adjust your style to suit different perspectives and seniority levels

title: Senior Python Engineer

As a Senior Engineer, you will create, enhance, and implement scalable, secure solutions utilizing Python and modern cloud platforms. Collaboration with cross-functional teams will be essential to deliver innovative software systems addressing complex business challenges and driving digital transformation.

This role follows a hybrid work model, requiring three days per week in-office at one of our locations in Krakow, Wroclaw, Gdansk, Warsaw, Poznan, Katowice, or Lodz.

title: Strategic Account Executive
description:
Ocho People are proud to be partnering with their client on this search.

Ocho People are proud to be partnering with our client, a leading global commerce technology provider, to recruit a Strategic Account Executive for their UK Sales team.

Our client’s cloud-based POS, payments and operational platforms power thousands of hospitality businesses worldwide, from fine dining restaurants and boutique hotels to multi-site chains. This is a new business role at the heart of their UK growth, where you’ll identify, pursue and close strategic deals with high-value hospitality clients.

They’re looking for a proactive, results-driven sales professional with a proven record of exceeding targets in a direct sales environment. You’ll act as a trusted advisor, getting to know each prospect’s complex business needs and delivering tailored solutions that create real value.

What you’ll be doing

• Proactively identifying high-potential hospitality prospects and showing how the platform improves operations and the guest experience
• Developing and executing sales strategies to win key accounts across POS, online ordering and inventory management solutions
• Maintaining a consistent pipeline of qualified opportunities, promoting a next-generation platform built for restaurants, bars and hotels
• Delivering compelling product demonstrations that bring the solution to life
• Managing complex sales cycles from first outreach through negotiation and close, highlighting the value of integrated payments and operational efficiency
• Consistently exceeding quarterly and annual targets
• Building trusted relationships with owners, managers and senior decision-makers
• Understanding customers’ goals and challenges, using analytics and reporting insight to support smooth onboarding and long-term success
• Supporting wider sales and marketing initiatives that grow Monthly Recurring Revenue (MRR)
• Keeping accurate records of activity and prospect interactions in the CRM

What you’ll bring

• 4+ years’ experience in direct outbound sales, managing the full sales cycle and consistently exceeding targets
• Experience selling software, SaaS, POS, cloud, e-commerce or other technology solutions, ideally into hospitality, retail or related sectors
• A track record of leading high-value negotiations and closing strategic deals
• Strong critical thinking, with the ability to assess complex situations and build effective solutions
• Excellent verbal, written and presentation skills, with the confidence to influence senior stakeholders
• A relationship-led approach, with strong emotional intelligence and active listening skills
• Experience using Salesforce or a similar CRM for pipeline management and forecasting
• Resilience, persistence and the drive to thrive in a fast-paced, evolving environment

Why apply?

You’ll join a business with inclusion at its core, a strong product in a growing market, and real scope to make an impact on UK growth. Our client is an equal opportunity employer committed to an inclusive, barrier-free workplace, and welcomes applications from people of all backgrounds, including people with disabilities. Adjustments are available throughout the selection process on request.

description:
Instytut Genetyki Sądowej poszukuje osób do pracy w obszarze logistyki, administracji, obsługi klienta oraz wsparcia działań marketingowych. Stanowisko łączy pracę biurową z zadaniami realizowanymi w terenie, w tym bezpośrednia obsługa Zleceniodawców oraz organizacja i realizacja odbiorów materiałów do badań.

Poszukujemy osób, które dobrze odnajdują się zarówno w zadaniach organizacyjnych, jak i w bezpośrednim kontakcie z klientami. Proporcje obowiązków biurowych i terenowych mogą być zróżnicowane w zależności od potrzeb organizacyjnych laboratorium oraz kompetencji i predyspozycji pracownika.

Zakres obowiązków:

• Realizacja bieżących zadań administracyjno-finansowych.
• Bezpośrednia, telefoniczna i mailowa obsługa Zleceniodawców.
• Obsługa zamówień w sklepie internetowym genetico.pl.
• Bieżąca obsługa zleceń, weryfikacja poprawności ich realizacji oraz wyjaśnianie niezgodności.
• Budowanie i utrzymywanie dobrych relacji z obecnymi oraz potencjalnymi Zleceniodawcami.
• Organizacja i realizacja odbioru/zwrotu materiału do badań.
• Planowanie tras kierowców oraz koordynowanie ich realizacji.
• Bezpośrednie wizyty u Zleceniodawców, w tym instytucji i podmiotów współpracujących z laboratorium.
• Przedstawianie oferty oraz przekazywanie informacji dotyczących usług świadczonych przez laboratorium.
• Współpraca z firmami kurierskimi oraz koordynowanie transportu przesyłek.
• Prowadzenie dokumentacji związanej z obsługą zleceń i realizacją działań logistycznych.
• Dbanie o sprawny przepływ informacji oraz prawidłowy obieg spraw i dokumentów.
• Ścisła współpraca z laboratorium i wsparcie jego bieżącej działalności organizacyjnej.
• Wsparcie działań marketingowych, w tym przygotowywanie i publikowanie treści informacyjnych.

Nasze wymagania:

• Bardzo dobra organizacja pracy własnej, samodzielność i odpowiedzialność.
• Terminowość, dokładność oraz umiejętność ustalania priorytetów.
• Komunikatywność, wysoka kultura osobista i umiejętność budowania pozytywnych relacji z klientami.
• Umiejętność pracy zespołowej oraz samodzielnej realizacji powierzonych zadań.
• Umiejętność planowania i organizacji pracy oraz szybkiego reagowania na zmieniające się sytuacje.
• Umiejętność efektywnego działania pod presją czasu i rozwiązywania nietypowych sytuacji.
• Dobra znajomość pakietu Microsoft Office oraz obsługi komputera i urządzeń biurowych.
• Prawo jazdy kat. B oraz praktyczna umiejętność prowadzenia samochodu.
• Gotowość do wykonywania obowiązków zarówno w biurze, jak i w terenie.
• Rzetelność oraz przestrzeganie zasad poufności informacji i dokumentacji.
• Zaświadczenie o niekaralności (przy zatrudnieniu).

Mile widziane:

• Wykształcenie wyższe, szczególnie na kierunkach: administracja, marketing, biologia, biotechnologia lub pokrewnych.
• Doświadczenie w obsłudze klienta, administracji, logistyce lub pracy terenowej.
• Doświadczenie w bezpośrednich kontaktach z klientami oraz budowaniu relacji biznesowych.
• Znajomość języka angielskiego.
• Doświadczenie w prowadzeniu profili w mediach społecznościowych (Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn), tworzeniu i publikowaniu treści.
• Umiejętności w zakresie tworzenia prostych materiałów graficznych i promocyjnych (np. Canva), edycji krótkich materiałów wideo (np. CapCut).

Oferujemy:

• Możliwość pracy w nowocześnie zarządzanym laboratorium, w zaangażowanym, doświadczonym zespole.
• Ciekawą i odpowiedzialną pracę pełną wyzwań.
• Udział w szkoleniach wewnętrznych i zewnętrznych, podnoszenie kwalifikacji.
• Możliwość stałego zatrudnienia po odbyciu okresu próbnego.
• Ubezpieczenie na życie.

title: Multi-skill Trades - Operative/ Plumber
description:
Have you got the right tools for the job?

Platform Property Care are looking for an experienced Multi Skill Trades Plumber to join our talented Responsive Repairs team covering Skegness, Boston and the surrounding areas, to help us ensure our customer's homes are maintained to a high-quality standard.

You will be a Multi Skill Trades Operative and plumbing will be your focus, but experience in other trades is essential, as you will be delivering Multi Trade repairs within a responsive repairs environment.

The role is varied. No two days will be the same and you will meet a wide range of customers along the way. It's a tough task and our expectations are high. In return, you'll have the support of a great team.

Working for Platform Property Care you will benefit from

• Basic salary of up to £39,359 per annum - depending upon experience and qualifications (additional can be earned from voluntary overtime and out of hours)
• 25 days holiday plus opportunity to buy additional 5 days leave.
• Pension contribution scheme with employer contributions of up to 12% (inclusive of life assurance and dependent on employee contributions)
• PPC Van + Fuel Card
• Mobile phone, iPad & lone worker device provided.
• Access to free healthcare and dental plan through Medicash

We Want Somebody Who Can

A team player, you'll be hard working and keen to learn with a can-do attitude. You'll be working in people's homes, so you'll need to be friendly and approachable with good communication and customer service skills. You'll also need to be organised and recognise the importance of delivering work right first time.

We are looking for someone who has:

• NVQ L2 Plumbing is essential
• Experience of working as a Plumber in the building trade either as a Plumber or as a multi-skilled Plumber
• Experience of working for a Social Landlord, housing association or council, delivering multi trade repairs and maintenance
• Associated trade skills, and or qualifications in carpentry, plaster patching, decorating and wall tiling would also be desirable.
• Experience of delivering multi-trade work
• Good organisational skills
• Experience of keeping jobs on track
• The drive to ensure works are completed quickly and efficiently.
• Good IT Skills. Experienced using a PDA. Experience of using Microsoft and Outlook email.
• Full current valid driving Licence essential as this is a mobile role.
• As you will be working within Customer's homes this role requires a DBS check.

There is also the opportunity to earn additional from being on the out of hours rota, which is required.

This role is for a team covering repairs in Skegness, Boston and the surrounding areas so you will need to live here.

Part of Platform Housing Group, Platform Property Care is a well-established property maintenance business. Working with us is more than just a job. We value the contribution that our colleagues make to our business; our vision is clear – we are growing fast, and we aim to achieve our plan through an engaged and highly skilled team.

If this sounds like the place for you then we'd love to hear from you! To find out more about this role please contact Tammy Curry, Localities Area Manager, at tamara.curry@platformhg.com for a chat.

This role is mobile, so it is essential you have a current valid driving licence. Unfortunately, we cannot progress applications from applicants who do not hold this.

We do not require recruitment agency support at this time - all speculative CV's will be treated as a direct application.

title: Lead Engineer - Plumbing
description:
Are you a highly skilled Plumber who takes pride in delivering excellent repairs and maintenance and supporting others to succeed?

At Platform Property Care, we're looking for a Lead Engineer – Plumbing to join our team in the Nottingham and Newark areas. This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced multi skilled Plumber to combine hands-on trade expertise supporting colleagues, driving quality standards and helping improve our service delivery.

Acting as the subject matter expert for plumbing, you'll spend around 70-80% of your time delivering repairs and maintenance work, while dedicating the remainder to coaching colleagues, assessing competence, supporting apprentices, and promoting best practice across our Property Care teams.

What could you be doing?

You'll be ensuring our customers' homes are maintained and repaired to a high standard while also helping to drive consistency, quality and best practice across our Property Care teams.

As a Lead Engineer - Plumbing, You Will

• Carry out a wide range of plumbing repairs and maintenance work within customers' homes and communal areas.
• Manage jobs from inspection through to completion, ensuring excellent customer service throughout.
• Support colleagues through coaching, mentoring and skills development
• Assess and sign off colleagues against our multi-skill framework and support apprentices through their End Point Assessments (EPA).
• Promote consistent trade standards and best practice across Platform Property Care.
• Work alongside Learning & Development teams to support trade training and upskilling initiatives.
• Conduct trade audits, reviews and quality assessments to ensure compliance and high standards.
• Act as a technical expert and escalation point for trade-related queries.
• Monitor industry developments, legislation and emerging technologies to support continuous improvement and enhance service delivery.

No two days are the same. It's a challenging and rewarding role that offers the opportunity to combine practical trade expertise with developing others and improving services for our customers.

Who are we looking for?

You'll be a highly motivated and customer-focused professional who takes pride in delivering quality workmanship and supporting others to succeed.

You Will Be

• A strong team player with a positive, can-do attitude.
• Comfortable working independently and taking ownership of your workload.
• Passionate about developing others and sharing your knowledge.
• Organised and focused on delivering right-first-time outcomes.
• Able to communicate effectively with customers, colleagues and apprentices.
• Committed to maintaining excellent health and safety standards.

Some Things We Need From You

• NVQ Level 2 in Plumbing, completed apprenticeship or equivalent qualification.
• Additional Trade qualifications.
• Unvented Hot Water qualification is essential
• Significant experience working as a Plumber within the building trade.
• Experience working within occupied domestic properties.
• Strong knowledge of health and safety requirements.
• Experience of recording accurate job and repair information using mobile devices.
• Good IT and digital skills
• The ability to coach, support and develop colleagues.
• A commitment to delivering excellent customer service
• Experience working within social housing, a local authority or housing association.
• Previous coaching, mentoring or assessor experience.
• A full valid driving licence is essential as this is a mobile role.
• As you will be working within customers' homes this role requires a DBS check.
• This role is for a team covering the Nottingham and Newark areas. Ideally you will only have a maximum of an hour's commute to this area.

Working for Platform Property Care, you will benefit from

• Competitive salary of £41,800 plus opportunities for overtime and out-of-hours payments.
• 25 days annual leave, with the option to purchase up to 5 additional days.
• Pension scheme with employer contributions of up to 12% (inclusive of life assurance).
• Company van and fuel card for business use.
• Mobile phone, tablet, and lone worker device.
• Access to healthcare and wellbeing benefits through Medicash.
• Ongoing learning and development opportunities.
• The chance to play a key role in shaping trade excellence across our Property Care teams.

Why apply?

This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced multi skilled Plumber looking to take the next step in their career. As a Lead Engineer - Plumbing, you'll play a key role in driving technical excellence, developing colleagues, improving service quality, and delivering outstanding outcomes for customers.

Part of Platform Housing Group, Platform Property Care is a well-established property maintenance business. We value the contribution our colleagues make and are committed to developing a highly skilled and engaged workforce that delivers excellent services for our customers.

If this sounds like the place for you then we'd love to hear from you! To find out more about this role, please contact recruitment@platformhg.com.

This role is mobile, so it is essential that you hold a valid UK driving licence. Unfortunately, we cannot progress applications from candidates who do not hold this.

We do not require recruitment agency support at this time. All speculative CVs will be treated as direct applications.

title: Data Scientist
description:
Position: Data Scientist

Department: AI Growth

Reporting to: Data Science Manager

Location: London or Amsterdam

Hybrid role: 3 days a week from our office & 2 days working from home

Full time / Part time role: Full time

Ready for a challenge?

Then Just Eat Takeaway.com might be the place for you. We're a leading global online delivery platform, and our vision is to empower everyday convenience.

Whether it's a Friday-night feast, a post-gym poke bowl, or grabbing some groceries, our tech platform connects tens of millions of customers with hundreds of thousands of restaurant, grocery and convenience partners across the globe.

About This Role

Join our AI Growth team and help build the intelligence behind Just Eat's marketplace, powering personalised experiences for tens of millions of customers across 14 countries. This is your opportunity to deliver end-to-end machine learning solutions that directly impact customer engagement and order growth.

We're building JET's foundation model platform, developing embedding models for search and recommendations, and creating intelligent targeting systems for personalised offers and notifications. We're looking for someone who can live our behaviours of lead, deliver and care while bringing technical excellence and innovation.

This role sits at the intersection of cutting-edge AI and real-world business impact. You'll work on everything from fine-tuning large language models to designing sophisticated recommender systems, all while collaborating with ML engineers, product teams, and commercial stakeholders.

We need someone who can challenge assumptions, translate ambiguous business problems into elegant technical solutions, and ship production-quality ML systems that make a measurable difference to our customers and partners.

These are some of the key components to the position:

• Lead the development and deployment of ML/AI solutions including embedding models, fine-tuned LLMs, and ranking systems that drive engagement and orders while raising the bar for technical excellence.
• Apply generative AI and LLM techniques to personalisation challenges, generating customer and partner representations that improve search relevance and app experiences.
• Own your results by designing, running and interpreting A/B experiments with statistical rigour, measuring real impact on business metrics and holding yourself accountable.
• Collaborate with ML engineers to productionise models, implementing MLOps best practices and maintaining monitored pipelines that deliver consistent value.
• Break down silos by translating complex business questions into clear modelling approaches and communicating results effectively to product and commercial stakeholders.
• Be determined to take end-to-end ownership of well-scoped workstreams, independently framing problems, choosing approaches, running experiments and presenting findings.
• Move fast by writing production-quality Python code and efficient SQL for data pipelines and analyses that can scale across our marketplace.
• Contribute to JET's foundation model platform and personalised targeting systems, pushing boundaries to create lasting impact across millions of customer interactions.
• Set clear goals by designing experiments that influence commercial decisions while ensuring statistical validity and actionable insights.
• Aim higher by staying current with advances in search, retrieval, recommendations and LLM applications, bringing fresh ideas to drive the AI Growth vision forward.

What will you bring to the team?

• Proven track record delivering end-to-end ML solutions from problem framing through data exploration to production deployment and experiment measurement, demonstrating your commitment to achieving goals.
• Hands-on expertise in search, retrieval and recommendation techniques including embedding-based approaches, learning-to-rank, and vector similarity search with measurable business impact.
• Practical experience applying LLMs in production environments, including prompt engineering, fine-tuning, structured output validation and assessing generative output quality.
• Strong experimentation skills with ability to design and interpret A/B tests, reason about statistical significance, and understand the gap between offline and online performance.
• Production-grade Python coding abilities that go beyond notebooks, writing clean, testable code suitable for engineering workflows and collaboration with technical teams.
• Proficient SQL
• skills across complex data warehouses, including partitioning, window functions, and large-table joins, with focus on query efficiency and data quality.
• Excellent problem-framing and communication skills to translate ambiguous business questions into modelling approaches and explain technical results to non-technical stakeholders based on respect and mutual support.
• Self-starter attitude comfortable with autonomy and ambiguity, thriving in fast-paced environments where you can build rapidly, test rigorously and roll out successes at scale.
• Strong collaboration skills to work effectively with senior data scientists, ML engineers, product partners and commercial teams across different levels and functions.
• Results-driven mindset with attention to detail, able to balance speed of execution with technical rigour while making data-informed decisions that create lasting impact.

Bonus Skills That Will Help You Excel

• Experience with causal inference or uplift modelling relevant to promotions and growth initiatives.
• Knowledge of sequential or session-based recommendation modelling techniques.
• Familiarity with real-time data pipelines and streaming infrastructure.
• Experience working across multiple languages or markets in a data science context.

At JET, This Is How We Play

Our teams forge connections internally and work with some of the best-known brands on the planet, giving us truly international impact in a dynamic environment.

Being the best at what we do isn't just about delivering on our strategy. It's a competition for something incredibly valuable – our customers' choice. Every time a customer decides where to order, they're picking a side.

At the heart of the JET Customer League are our values and behaviours. They guide every interaction, every decision, every innovation. These are the actions we need to perform consistently and brilliantly, to surpass the competition and earn our customers' loyalty, again and again.

Fun, fast-paced and supportive, the JET culture is about movement, growth, helping one another to succeed and celebrating wins. By truly living our values and embodying our behaviours, we're building a customer-first culture which enables us to stay one step ahead of the competition.

Inclusion, Diversity & Belonging

No matter who you are, what you look like, who you love, or where you are from, you can find your place at Just Eat Takeaway.com. We're committed to creating an inclusive culture, encouraging diversity of people and thinking, in which all employees feel they truly belong and can bring their most colourful selves to work every day.

What else are we delivering?

Want to know more about our JETers, culture or company? Have a look at our career site where you can find people's stories, blogs, podcasts and more JET journeys.

Are you ready to join the team? Apply now!

title: Fleet Process Excellence Insights Manager (Fixed-term Contract), Global Fleet and Products
description:
Description

Have you ever wondered what it takes to keep tens of thousands of delivery vans moving across Europe, every single day? Behind every Amazon delivery is a fleet of vehicles that needs to be sourced, maintained, and optimised across nine countries. If solving that puzzle with data sounds exciting, this role is for you.

The Fleet Process Excellence (FPE) team sits within EU Fleet Operations and is focused on one thing: making our branded delivery fleet more cost-efficient. We work across multiple European countries, partnering with Delivery Service Providers (DSPs), Fleet Management Companies (FMCs), and internal teams across Last Mile operations.

We're looking for an Insights Manager to own how we use data to find and drive fleet cost savings. You'll build the pipelines, dashboards, and analyses that help leadership understand where the money goes and where the opportunities are. Think of it as being the team's data engine: you surface the insights, quantify the impact, and help turn numbers into action.

To be successful in this role, you'll need to be comfortable working independently, communicating clearly with both technical and non-technical audiences, and solving problems where the path isn't always obvious. You don't need to know everything on day one, but you do need curiosity, initiative, and a bias for getting things done.

Please note that this a 12 months Fixed-term contract.

Key job responsibilities

• Build and maintain automated data pipelines that provide a single source of truth for fleet cost performance (cost-per-package, vehicle off-road rates, cost-by-station)
• Create dashboards and visualisations that surface cost trends, anomalies, and optimisation opportunities for Directors and senior leadership
• Proactively identify savings levers using data analysis, quantify the impact, and present clear recommendations
• Work with Finance, Regional Fleet Managers, and Operations leaders to align on cost data and support business cases
• Develop and own the data models and warehouse structures that underpin fleet cost reporting
• Drive automation that reduces manual effort and improves data quality across the team
• Communicate the "so what" behind the numbers, not just the numbers themselves

Basic Qualifications

• Experience in scripting for automation (e.g. Python) and advanced SQL skills.
• Experience with one or more analytics visualization tools (e.g., Excel, Tableau, QuickSight, MicroStrategy, PowerBI)
• Experience with data modeling, warehousing and building ETL pipelines
• Experience in design and execution of analytics projects
• Experience interpreting data and making business recommendations
• Experience analysing and interpreting large-scale datasets using SQL and a cloud data warehouse (Redshift, Snowflake, BigQuery, or similar)

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with financial or business analysis
• Experience with database, data warehouse or data lake solutions
• Experience working within a global company, with multi-country responsibilities
• Experience in fleet management, logistics, transportation, or last mile operations
• Track record of building reporting or data products from scratch

description:
Job Description

Position Details

School of Psychology

Location: University of Birmingham, Edgbaston, Birmingham UK

Full time starting salary is normally in the range £36,636 to £46,049 with potential progression once in post to £48,822

Grade: 7

Full Time, Fixed Term contract up to November 2028

Closing date: 8 th November 2026

Background

Applications are invited for a full-time Postdoctoral Research Fellow to join the research programme of Professor Ron Mangun in the Centre for Human Brain Health at the University of Birmingham. The Centre provides a multidisciplinary environment for human cognitive neuroscience research and access to advanced neuroimaging, electrophysiological and brain stimulation methods. The post-holder will contribute to ongoing and planned research investigating visual processing and attention, reading and language processing, and/or predictive coding mechanisms. The successful candidate will have a strong record of high-quality research outputs appropriate to career stage and experience in cognitive neuroscience research. The position is research dedicated, and the successful candidate will be involved in all stages of developing and conducting experiments, analysing data, preparing results, and presenting findings. This will include the preparation of high-quality academic publications and the presentation of results at national and international academic conferences. The successful candidate will be expected to contribute intellectually to the development of research questions, experimental designs and analytical approaches, play a role in the supervision of trainees, and broadly support the research goals of Centre for Human Brain Health.

Role Summary

• Conduct research within the scope of ongoing and planned research projects in collaboration with Professor Ron Mangun and other members of the research team
• Contribute intellectually to the development of research questions and proposals; design experiments, collect and analyse data, present findings, and publish results in peer-reviewed journals
• Contribute to the supervision and training of undergraduate and postgraduate students and other researchers
• Contribute to funding applications
• Contribute to the planning, management and administration of research projects

Main Duties

The responsibilities may include some, but not all of the responsibilities outlined below.

• Address the research objectives of ongoing and planned projects and contribute to the development of new research objectives and proposals
• Contribute to the training of others in the research group in relevant experimental, analytical and research methods
• Conduct experimental research, collect data directly, and supervise or support data collection by others
• Analyse and interpret data and use the results to develop new intellectual understanding, methods and research questions
• Disseminate research findings through peer-reviewed publications, research seminars, and national and international conferences
• Provide day-to-day supervision and guidance for student research projects, potentially at BSc, MSc, or PhD level
• Contribute to the development and writing of bids for research funding
• Participate actively in group meetings, journal clubs, CHBH activities, and related scientific discussions
• Contribute, where appropriate, to public engagement and research impact activities
• Exercise initiative in resolving methodological, analytical and practical problems that may affect research objectives and deadlines
• Work collaboratively with the PI, research staff, students, CHBH colleagues and external collaborators, coordinating own work with others as required
• Contribute to developing new models, techniques, methods and analytical approaches relevant to the research programme
• Fosters a fair and equitable workplace for all staff
• Identify and respond to equality and diversity issues in line with relevant university policies and procedures
• Other relevant criteria from our equality and diversity duties document.

Person Specification

The following are essential qualifications:

• A PhD (or near to completion) equivalent in an area relevant to cognitive neuroscience, including but not limited to psychology, neuroscience, biology, computer science, or engineering at the start of the position.
• A strong record of high-quality research outputs appropriate to career stage in cognitive neuroscience.
• Experience in the design, conduct and quantitative analysis of human cognitive neuroscience experiments.
• Experience with one or more of EEG, MEG, fMRI, and/or non-invasive brain stimulation; experience in acquisition and analysis of concurrent EEG-fMRI data is particularly useful.
• Strong programming skills relevant to cognitive neuroscience research, ideally in Python and/or MATLAB.
• Strong quantitative and statistical analysis skills.
• Knowledge relevant to one or more areas of the research programme, such as visual perception and attention, reading and language processing, and/or predictive coding.
• Strong academic writing and presentation skills.
• Ability and willingness to work collaboratively and contribute to the local research community.
• Ability to assess resource requirements and use resources effectively.
• Ability to contribute to the planning, management and administration of research projects.
• Knowledge of the protected characteristics and duties under the Equality Act 2010. Including fostering good relations and advancing the universities Public Sector Equality Duty (PSED)
• Other relevant criteria from our equality and diversity knowledge, skills and experience document.

title: Senior FP&A Analyst
description:
Our client is a successful consumer-focussed tech scale‑up, a cash‑generative SME currently at c.£12m turnover and c.80 staff, looking to double in size in the next five years under the guidance of its experienced, highly charismatic and driven owner, supported by a first‑class senior leadership team.

Find out more about this role by reading the information below, then apply to be considered.

Its CFO is looking to strengthen the company’s close-knit, growing finance department to best manage the increasing volume and complexity of business generated by c.120,000 product and service customers, increasing presence and advertising spend, plus a constantly developing product range, by appointing to an exciting, new Senior FP&A Analyst role.

Working closely with CFO and Financial Controller, building the commercial models, pulling data, finding the insight and explaining it in plain English, you'll support the company in scaling from a subscription business into a multi-product, regulated one.

Your Key Responsibilities As Senior FP&A Analyst Will Include

Subscription and growth

• Own subscription metrics: new customers, MRR, churn and retention by cohort, ARPU, LTV:CAC and payback
• Work hand-in-hand with marketing on paid social, creators, influencers, affiliates and other channels: CAC, ROAS and payback by channel, including where the next pound should go
• Model pricing, offers, upgrades and add-ons before launch, tracking them after
• Track affiliate programmes — marketing affiliates and partners who sell products: sales, commission accruals and payouts, margin after commission and return by affiliate

Products, inventory and raw materials

• Build the P&L, margin and cash models for physical products and services, including new partners
• Own inventory and raw-material budgets: forecast usage from sales plans, set purchase plans and track actual use against budget
• Build product costings (bill of materials, packaging, fulfilment) to show true unit margin
• Track stock levels, stock days, wastage, write-offs and slow-moving lines; run regular stock reconciliations with Ops
• Join up Sales, Marketing and Stock plans so campaigns don't outrun supply or leave cash tied up in stock
• Model supplier, fulfilment and partner costs, terms and settlements

Planning and reporting

• Build and run a lean budget and rolling 12–18 month forecast, plus a 13-week cash flow
• Produce a weekly flash and a monthly KPI pack with clear, short commentary
• Prepare board numbers with the CFO

Governance and compliance

• Put in place strong controls, reconciliations and documentation that fit a fast-moving business
• Support governance of supplier and affiliate partnerships: clear contracts, settlements, audit trails and reporting, so responsibilities stay with the right party and partner's regulatory requirements are met
• Get revenue recognition and VAT right across subscriptions, bundles and physical products, working with the CFO and advisers

Systems and data

• Pull reliable data from the company’s proprietary app, payments (e.g. Stripe), ad platforms and accounting system
• Automate reporting with Excel, Power BI or similar so the numbers update themselves

As Senior FP&A Analyst, You’ll Need

• Strong, hands-on commercial experience gained in a similar Financial Planning and Analysis (FP&A), Commercial Finance or Management Accounting role - you build models and dashboards yourself and enjoy being hands-on every day
• Strong understanding of subscription or SaaS economics (MRR, churn, cohorts, LTV:CAC), ideally gained in a scaling, marketing-led, social-first or D2C businesses, including physical products, inventory, raw-material costing, e-commerce or affiliate programmes
• Exposure to health or other regulated consumer products also beneficial
• Qualified (ACA, ACCA or CIMA) or qualified by experience
• Proven knowledge of Power BI, SQL and/or similar data, analytics and tech tools
• High emotional intelligence: you read the room, build trust quickly and can challenge founders and marketers without friction
• Strong grip on governance, controls and compliance
• Advanced Excel and financial modelling; comfortable with messy data

Rewards And Benefits

• Basic salary between £60,000 and £80,000, plus benefits including pension and health/wellbeing programme
• Maximum pay/rewards, dependent on possessing all outlined experience, skills, knowledge and qualifications
• Full‑time, permanent, office-based in Gateshead
• Free parking
• On‑site health facilities, staff events and discounts, training/development and more
• Casual dress
• Pet friendly

Please note: we review applications on receipt and aim to respond to shortlisted candidates within 5 working days. You must have permanent eligibility to work in the UK - no visa opportunities available.

Senior FP&A Analyst, Gateshead

“Everyone wants your feedback and opinion; it feels like a place of study where nurturing and encouragement are the standard. • Assisting in the safe start-up and shutdown of all plants and ancillary equipment

• Cycle Counts

• Supporting the delivery and deployment of a lean culture and behaviour in the organisation.
• Contribute to a ‘Continuous Improvement’ process to improve, optimise and make safer processes and operations. Lead a ‘Continuous Improvement’ process within shift to improve, optimise and make safer processes and operations
• Maintaining high standards of GMP & BRC compliance in all aspects of production
• Exhibiting a good awareness of COSHH, risk assessment, HAZOP and general process safety and ensure this is communicated to all staff. Take the lead in introducing an excellent safety culture in general and specifically with regard to manual handling, Vehicle / Pedestrian safety, PPE and Accident / incident reporting

We have a preferred supplier list and high volumes of speculative calls from agencies negatively impact upon the efficiency of our business.
