description:
Contract Type: Fixed-Term Apprenticeship, Full-time for 24 months

Department: BBC Radio Orkney

Location: Kirkwall - Radio Orkney

Salary: £24,650

COULD A BBC APPRENTICESHIP BE THE NEXT ROLE FOR YOU?

Join us as an apprentice at the BBC to give yourself the opportunity to kick-start your career in a job you'll love. We’re committed to your skills and talent development. You’ll learn on-the-job, developing your knowledge and skills in an area that interests you, whilst working towards your apprenticeship qualification with one of our learning providers.

WHY JOIN THIS SCHEME?

The Junior Journalist Apprenticeship (JRA27) is perfect for curious and creative individuals with a passion for storytelling. Whether you're finishing school, college, or exploring an alternative to university, this programme offers an exciting opportunity to kick-start your journalism career with the world's leading public service media organisation.

You'll gain hands-on experience covering stories that matter to audiences, learning from experienced journalists and developing the skills needed to create trusted journalism.

Alongside this, you’ll work towards a SCQF7 apprenticeship qualification.

Want to find out more? Watch recordings from our webinar series on our Life at the BBC YouTube playlist to learn more about this scheme and other opportunities we offer, and hear from current apprentices about their experiences.

Your Key Responsibilities And Impact

As a Junior Journalist apprentice, this is a brilliant opportunity to learn, grow and contribute. On this team you can expect to:

• Work alongside experienced journalists developing your skills while creating high-quality content.
• Get hands on experience including researching stories, booking guests and writing briefs.
• Discover and develop compelling stories, assisting with interviews that bring important issues to life for diverse audiences.
• Learn from industry experts at the world's largest public service broadcaster.

You’ll study for your industry-recognised apprenticeship qualification, learning both on and off the job.

This involves weekly in-person classes at Glasgow Clyde College. For apprentices who aren’t based in Glasgow these sessions will be virtual.

You’ll Cover a Range Of Modules Including

• Media Law
• Essential Journalism
• Broadcast Journalism
• Journalism for a Digital Audience
• Video Journalism

Modules will be assessed through exams, coursework and a portfolio of work.

For more information on what you will study during the scheme, please see the SCQF 7 Standard.

Your Skills And Eligibility

We’re interested in your passion for working at the BBC and your enthusiasm for delivering world-class content and operational excellence to our audiences. We’re not focused on your qualifications; instead, we look for potential and offer you the opportunity to apply your transferable strengths and experience to work in different ways.

Skills

If you can bring some of these skills and experiences, along with transferable strengths, we’d love to hear from you and encourage you to apply:

• You're naturally curious about people and what’s happening in the world around you, with a keen interest in news.
• You’re full of creative ideas and enjoy finding innovative ways to tell engaging stories.
• You love finding things out, asking questions and getting to the heart of a story.
• You have a real enthusiasm for writing and enjoy communicating complex ideas in a clear, compelling way.
• You thrive in a fast-paced environment, bringing flexibility, motivation and a willingness to adapt as priorities change.

This scheme is aimed at non-graduates. If you have a degree and you’re interested in similar roles at the BBC, we recommend applying for jobs at the BBC careers site or having a look at our other apprenticeship schemes.

ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA

To be eligible for an apprenticeship at the BBC, you must:

• Be 18 years old or over by the time the apprenticeship begins in September 2027.
• Have lived in the UK continuously for the last three years prior to the start of the apprenticeship.
• Be legally eligible to work full-time in the UK for the entire duration of the apprenticeship.
• Not currently be enrolled in another apprenticeship programme, whether with the BBC or another organisation.
• Not already hold a qualification in the same subject area at the same or a higher level than this apprenticeship.

To Apply For This Scheme, You Must Also

• Not have completed or be studying for the NCTJ diploma or a journalism qualification at the same level or higher.
• Have achieved English GCSE at Grade 4/C or above, or National 5 (Scotland) at C or Functional Skills Level 2 or equivalent qualification.

For candidates under the age of 19 years at the start of the apprenticeship: To complete the apprenticeship, you must have achieved Maths and English GCSE at Grade 4/C or above or National 5 (Scotland) at C or Functional Skills Level 2 or equivalent qualification to pass the apprenticeship.

READY TO APPLY?

Don’t leave yourself wondering “what if?” This could be your chance to be part of something exciting. See yourself thriving in this role? Just click ‘Apply Now’!

You’ll create a candidate profile and answer a few questions - no CV or cover letter needed.

If you're eligible, we’ll guide you through the next steps of the process and what to expect.

You’ll need to live within a commutable distance of where this role is based. Interested in a different location? Check out our other adverts - but please only apply to one.

The BBC recognises that you may need to relocate to a new location to take up a BBC Apprenticeship scheme. The cost of relocating can be a barrier for some applicants and where that is a barrier to participation, we want to help where we can. To help ensure our apprenticeship opportunities are accessible to people from a wide range of backgrounds, a limited number of relocation support awards are available each year for those who meet our financial eligibility criteria. Relocation financial support is available for this role, subject to meeting the financial eligibility criteria. Further information will be shared with applicants during the recruitment process. Details on the wider support, initiatives and networks available at the BBC can be found on our careers site.

This is a fixed-term apprenticeship - your contract lasts for the duration of the scheme. Once you have completed your apprenticeship, you will be able to apply for any suitable open vacancies at the BBC or outside in the wider creative industry. You’ll be supported with career development, employability training, and networking opportunities to help you take your next step.

For apprenticeship opportunities, disabled applicants who choose to apply under the Disability Confident Scheme and who meet the minimum criteria for the role will normally be progressed to the next stage of the recruitment process. For most of our campaigns, this would be an online assessment designed to assess your skills, motivations and suitability for the role. Further details can be found in the FAQs section of our careers site.

Disclaimer

This job description is a written statement of the essential characteristics of the job, with its principal accountabilities, incorporating a note of the skills, knowledge and experience required for a satisfactory level of performance. This is not intended to be a complete, detailed account of all aspects of the duties involved.

Our apprenticeship roles are also subject to you having the require qualifications that we have deemed to be necessary for your role and the requirement of the training provider for your scheme. The offer would be subject to you undergoing and meeting the requirements of a skill scan process with the BBC nominated training provider to determine your eligibility.

Please note: If you were to be offered this role, the BBC will conduct Employment screening checks which include Reference checks; Eligibility to work checks; and if applicable to the role, Safeguarding and Adverse media/Social media checks. Any offer made is conditional on these checks being satisfactory.

Before your start date, you may need to disclose any unspent convictions or police charges, in line with our Recruitment policy. This allows us to discuss any support you may need and assess any risks. Failure to disclose may result in the withdrawal of your offer.

description:
Our Mission

Human time and effort is the rarest thing in the universe. The fact that so many people hate what they do for work is a disaster on so many levels. How many people live quiet lives of misery? How many generational talents do we miss due to circumstance?

Dex’s mission is to close the gap between Talent & Opportunity, we believe that work, and being productive, is part of the human condition, that regardless of AI, human passion, ingenuity and a desire to do things means that work will always exist.

We are building Dex to create a future where technology helps every individual to understand their strengths, interests and unique abilities, and to connect with opportunities where they can thrive, because more people doing things they love leads to a better, happier and more productive world.

We are starting by connecting the world's most ambitious software engineers with the companies that deserve them.

The role

Paid acquisition is one of the biggest levers we have on growth, and it's about to get a lot bigger. We run Google Search, LinkedIn and Meta today, we're adding new formats and channels, and over the next year we'll be running paid across more markets and across both sides of Dex: the engineers who use it and the companies who hire through it.

You'll own our paid channels day to day. You'll decide where the money goes, launch and test campaigns quickly, and judge every channel on the quality of the people it brings in, not on clicks or cheap signups. Creative comes from our in-house creative lead, writers and UGC creators; your job is to brief them well, test what they make and scale what works.

This isn't a role where you sit in the ad accounts all week. Once the channels are running well, we want you to take on more: client-side acquisition, new channels, and building your own tools with AI to do the job faster.

What you'll do

• Own Google Search, LinkedIn and Meta: structure, budgets, bidding, audiences and day-to-day optimisation.
• Launch new campaigns in days, not weeks. Run a steady programme of tests across audiences, formats and landing pages.
• Judge channels on what matters to Dex: good candidates and the ones who get put forward to clients. Work with our data to make sure conversion tracking and attribution are right, and push quality signals back into the platforms.
• Brief creative. Work with our creative lead, writers and UGC creators on what to make, tell them what's working and kill what isn't.
• Open up new channels as we grow, such as YouTube, Performance Max, retargeting and new markets.
• Help take paid into client acquisition: getting Dex in front of heads of talent, engineering leaders and founders.
• Manage our paid media agency and any contractors, and bring more of the work in-house over time.
• Report clearly on spend and results each week, and say plainly what you'd change.

Who we're looking for

• Hands on in performance marketing, managing real budgets yourself across paid search and paid social. Meta and LinkedIn experience matters most.
• You've worked at a tech company, or you're ready for your first in-house role after a couple of years at a strong agency.
• You care about what happens after the click. You've optimised for downstream quality, not just cost per lead, and you know how to set up tracking that you trust.
• Comfortable with data. You can pull your own numbers, spot when something looks wrong, and explain what's going on without a dashboard doing it for you.
• You move fast and like owning things. You'd rather ship a test today than plan it for a week.
• You use AI tools daily, and you're happy building small tools, scripts or agents to do your job better. You don't need to be an engineer.

Strong nice-to-haves

• You've run performance marketing for both consumer (B2C) and business (B2B) audiences, ideally at more than one tech company.
• You've worked closely with a creative studio or run UGC at volume, so you know what a good brief looks like.

If you don't tick every box but this sounds like you, apply anyway.

Why join now

• You'll own a channel mix that's growing fast, with the budget and freedom to try things.
• You'll work on a product people care about. Changing jobs is one of the biggest decisions engineers make, and we want them to trust us with it.
• You'll work closely with the founders and the Head of Growth, with a lot of room to grow your scope.
• Everyone here builds with AI. You'll have the tools and the time to work that way.

What we offer

• Above-market salary
• Significant equity
• Private healthcare and dental
• Fertility benefits and enhanced parental support
• Gym membership and wellness benefits
• Claude tokens
• Regular socials, offsites and an annual team trip
• MacBook Pro and team equipment
• A "whatever you need" approach to tools and support

The process

• Talent screen with Becca, Head of Talent (30 min)
• Hiring manager interview with Rob, Head of Growth (45 min)
• Practical task: a short paid acquisition audit and plan, done at home
• In person: task review with Rob and the growth team (60 min), culture and values (45 min), final interview with Paddy, CEO and founder (30 min)

title: Configuration Analyst
description:
Configuration Analyst

Ampthill, Bedfordshire, UK

£44,000 - £54,500 p/a + BUPA, bonus, benefits

37.5 hours per week with 4 day work week option.

About the Role

We are looking for a Configuration Analyst to complement our team based from our Ampthill, Bedfordshire offices. This role benefits from our 4xFlex working pattern, offering a 4 day working week Monday - Thursday.

The successful candidate will be responsible for applying Configuration Management principles and practices, working closely with experienced engineers to maintain the integrity of our complex engineering projects.

This role will also provide an opportunity to develop skills and knowledge to progress into more senior Configuration Management / Digital Engineering roles, contributing to the implementation of our Digital Engineering strategy.

Work place deployments could consist of (but not limited to) the following Business Areas:

• Configuration Management
• Digital Engineering

Typical duties could include:

• Applying Configuration Management principles, processes, and tools.
• Key responsibilities include analysing proposed product design changes for their impact on the overall product and system, supporting the establishment and maintenance of configuration baselines, contributing to change control processes.
• The role involves preparing reports detailing the effect of changes on the overall product, reviewing and analysing released engineering change data, and ensuring compliance with configuration management policies, collaborating with various teams working closely with experienced engineers.
• In addition to these traditional duties, the role is expected to evolve to incorporate digital transformation, development of digital twins, digital engineering, and model-based systems engineering.

This implies that the candidate will likely be involved in:

• Digital Transformation: Contributing to the digital transformation initiatives of the company, which may involve modernising processes, adopting new technologies, or improving digital capabilities.
• Development of Digital Twin: Assisting in the creation and maintenance of digital replicas of physical products or systems, which can be used for simulation, testing, and optimisation.
• Digital Engineering: Utilising digital tools and methodologies to design, analyse, and manage engineering projects, potentially including the use of virtual reality, augmented reality, or other advanced digital technologies.
• Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE): Employing graphical models to represent, specify, analyse, verify, and validate systems, which can improve communication, collaboration, and efficiency across the engineering lifecycle.
• These additional responsibilities reflect the growing importance of digital technologies in modern engineering practices and Lockheed Martin's commitment to staying at the forefront of technological advancements.

The successful candidate must achieve the appropriate level (SC) of security clearance.

Required skills, qualifications and experience

• Bachelor's degree in an engineering or related discipline.
• Experience as a Configuration Management Engineer or similar role in an engineering environment.
• Knowledge of Configuration Management principles, processes, and standards.
• Familiarity with Configuration Management tools and Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) system.
• Good communication and interpersonal skills.
• Ability to work effectively in a team environment.
• Strong attention to detail and a commitment to quality.

Desired Skills

• Configuration Management within the defence industry.
• Working knowledge of DEF-STAN 05-57.
• Windchill PLM.
• Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE) tools and methodologies.
• Data integration concepts and technologies.
• Digital Thread concepts and applications.
• Product Development Lifecycle awareness, understanding of concept, design, prototyping, testing, and production phases.
• Systems Engineering exposure, knowledge of SysML and systems thinking principles.
• Appreciation of how complex systems are designed, integrated, and verified, especially with regards to SysML.

Lockheed Martin is committed to upholding principles of equal opportunity, fostering a work environment that is aligned with our core values of integrity, respect, and exceptional performance. We recognize the importance of leveraging the unique talents and experiences of all our employees to drive innovation, deliver superior solutions, and maximize value for our customers. Our focus is on identifying the most qualified candidate for each role, regardless of their background. If you are interested in a position, we invite you to share how your skills and perspectives could bolster our team and encourage you to apply, even if you feel your qualifications do not fully meet all the job criteria outlined in our advertisement. Furthermore, Lockheed Martin is dedicated to ensuring our recruitment process is inclusive for all individuals. We are prepared to accommodate reasonable adjustments for applicants as needed. If you require assistance or adjustments to participate in the job application or interview process, please contact recruitment@global.lmco.com or call 02392 415270.

title: IT Solution Architect (Software Development)
description:
IT Solution Architect (Software Development)

Twój zakres obowiązków:

• Odpowiedzialność za architekturę end-to-end rozwiązań ICT wspierających finansowe produkty konsumenckie - od pozyskania klienta, KYC/AML i scoringu, przez decyzję i uruchomienie finansowania, po obsługę umowy, spłatę, windykację i raportowanie.
• Opracowanie i utrzymywanie architektury AS-IS: katalogu systemów, integracji, interfejsów, danych, właścicieli i zależności.
• Definiowanie architektury TO-BE i roadmapy modernizacji ekosystemu, w tym ograniczanie długu architektonicznego, zależności punkt-punkt i duplikacji logiki bez zakłócania bieżącej sprzedaży oraz obsługi klientów.
• Projektowanie granic domen, obszarów odpowiedzialności systemów, systemów referencyjnych (system of record) i właścicielstwa danych; porządkowanie przepływów między CRM, scoringiem, bazami danych, hurtowniami danych, systemami partnerów i kanałami klienta.
• Ustanawianie i egzekwowanie standardów integracyjnych: API-first, REST/OpenAPI, OAuth 2.0/OIDC, wersjonowanie, idempotencję, webhooks, kontrakty danych, AsyncAPI/event-driven.
• Standaryzowanie integracji batch i transferów CSV/SFTP: schematy i wersjonowanie plików, walidacja, szyfrowanie, sumy kontrolne, rekonsyliacja, obsługa błędów, monitoring, SLA i pełna audytowalność.
• Przygotowywanie dokumentacji architektonicznej: Solution Architecture Document/High Level Design wg. modeli C4/UML/ArchiMate/BPMN, diagramów przepływu danych, ADR, wymagań niefunkcjonalnych (NFR) oraz planów migracji, wdrożenia, wycofania wdrożenia (rollback) i zakończenia eksploatacji rozwiązania.
• Zapewnianie, że rozwiązania spełniają wymagania dotyczące bezpieczeństwa, prywatności, dostępności, wydajności, skalowalności, integralności danych, obserwowalności, ciągłości działania, RTO/RPO, audytowalności i optymalizacji kosztu utrzymania.
• Projektowanie rozwiązań dla środowiska cloud-native i hybrydowego obejmującego m.in. GCP/Azure, Kubernetes, Docker, Argo CD, PostgreSQL, RabbitMQ, Linux, Zabbix i Graylog.
• Udział w discovery, refinementach, estymacji i planowaniu delivery; identyfikowanie zależności, ryzyk, enablerów architektonicznych i kryteriów akceptacji od koncepcji do produkcji.
• Prowadzenie przeglądów architektonicznych i lekkiego procesu governance, zarządzanie odstępstwami od standardów, analiza build vs buy oraz techniczna ocena dostawców, SLA, ryzyka vendor lock-in i planów wyjścia.

Nasze wymagania:

• Co najmniej pięcioletnie doświadczenie w roli Solution Architect, Software Architect, Integration Architect lub zbliżonej, obejmujące odpowiedzialność za rozwiązania end-to-end z punktu widzenia tworzenia oprogramowania wg. indywidualnych potrzeb biznesowych (na miarę).
• Doświadczenie w modernizacji złożonych ekosystemów opartych na systemach inhouse/legacy oraz wielu integracjach zewnętrznych, przy zachowaniu ciągłości działania i etapowym ograniczaniu długu technicznego.
• Doświadczenie w consumer finance, bankowości, płatnościach, fintechu lub systemach scoringowych i decyzyjnych będzie istotnym atutem.
• Bardzo dobra znajomość metodyk, standardów, notacji i praktyk architektonicznych: TOGAF, ArchiMate, C4, UML, BPMN 2.0, ADR oraz zasad ISO/IEC/IEEE 42010. Dodatkowym atutem będą certyfikaty TOGAF/ArchiMate.
• Bardzo dobra znajomość wzorców i standardów integracyjnych: REST, OpenAPI, OAuth 2.0/OIDC, webhooks, messaging/event-driven, AsyncAPI, broker wiadomości oraz bezpieczne integracje plikowe CSV/SFTP.
• Umiejętność definiowania i weryfikowania wymagań niefunkcjonalnych NFR oraz projektowania rozwiązań odpornych na awarie, obserwowalnych, skalowalnych i możliwych do bezpiecznego utrzymania, z uwzględnieniem RTO/RPO i zasad ISO 22301.
• Znajomość zasad secure by design i privacy by design oraz standardów ISO/IEC 27001, OWASP ASVS i OWASP API Security Top 10. Umiejętność współpracy z zespołami cyberbezpieczeństwa i ochrony danych.
• Umiejętność jasnego przedstawiania wariantów, kompromisów, ryzyk, kosztów i konsekwencji decyzji architektonicznych interesariuszom technicznym i biznesowym.
• Dobre umiejętności analityczne, myślenie krytyczne i rozwiązywania problemów.
• Bardzo dobra znajomość języka angielskiego (C1) – konieczna z uwagi na pracę w międzynarodowym zespole.

To oferujemy:

• Rolę w dynamicznie rozwijającej się Krajowej Instytucji Płatniczej
• Stabilne zatrudnienie na Umowę o Pracę lub współpraca na B2B.
• Dużą samodzielność, ciekawe zadania, rozwój osobisty
• Realny wpływ na decyzje techniczne i biznesowe

• Możliwość pracy w systemie hybrydowym (2 dni pracy z biura)
• Atmosferę współpracy, otwartości, wzajemnego wsparcia i... dobrego humoru
• Pakiet socjalny - opiekę medyczną, multisport, ubezpieczenie na życie, karta ZTM
• Dodatkowy dzień wolny z okazji urodzin

description:

This remote opportunity is ideal for an identity and access management professional who combines technical expertise with customer engagement.

You will work with customers, sales teams, and solution architects to design secure, scalable identity solutions.

The role involves supporting the sales process from technical discovery through demonstrations, proof of concepts, and solution proposals.

You’ll help enterprise organizations address complex digital identity challenges and achieve their security and business objectives.

As a trusted technical advisor, you’ll influence solution strategy and help customers understand the value of Okta technologies.

You’ll collaborate closely with delivery teams to ensure smooth transitions from pre-sales to implementation.

The position offers exposure to enterprise transformation projects and a collaborative, remote consulting environment across Europe.

Accountabilities

• Partner with sales teams to qualify opportunities and provide technical guidance throughout the sales cycle.
• Lead customer-facing technical workshops, product demonstrations, and proof of concepts across the Okta platform.
• Conduct technical discovery to understand business goals, requirements, and existing identity environments.
• Design high-level identity solution architectures tailored to customer needs.
• Support proposals, tenders, and RFP responses with technical documentation and solution design.
• Advise customers on Identity & Access Management best practices and enterprise security.
• Coordinate with delivery consultants to support seamless project handovers and implementation.

We are a global collective of innovators applying the New every day to improve the way the world works and lives. Connected Solutions sits at the crux of Supply Chain & Engineering and Technology as its Reinvention Engine helping clients adopt the functional capabilities they need to differentiate in their industry with agility and speed. Join Accenture and help transform leading organizations and communities around the world. The sheer scale of our capabilities and client engagements and the way we collaborate, operate and deliver value provides an unparalleled opportunity to grow and advance. Choose Accenture and make delivering innovative work part of your extraordinary career.

Edge is a Growth Driver for Accenture

The Accenture Edge business is a core growth driver within Accenture, focused on helping Mid-market companies reinvent, scale, and compete with the agility required in today’s market. Mid-market organizations share the same bold ambitions as large enterprises, they are undergoing a significant transformation, driven by the need to modernize operations, accelerate growth, and respond to evolving industry demands. Accenture brings the full strength of our global capabilities—deep industry expertise, ecosystem partnerships, and proven innovation—to make enterprise grade solutions accessible, scalable, and simplified for midmarket needs.

Powered by curated offerings, preconfigured solutions, accelerators, and AI enabled delivery models, Accenture Edge brings together teams across our global network to help clients drive real ROI, innovate faster, and transform with confidence. The Edge portfolio spans repeatable, industrialized solutions across technology, operations, security, cloud, and industry-specific needs to meet clients where they are on their reinvention journey.

We are looking to expand our Edge team with the best talent, who have experience in the mid-market, across the business suite, and across functions, that will enable us to continue to drive transformations at scale.

THE WORK:

As Edge Connected Solutions Practice Lead, you will oversee the Edge practice growth and delivery execution across multiple programs/engagements, ensuring quality outcomes, client satisfaction, and strong team performance. You will also partner with Sales and Solution teams to standardize and accelerate delivery by building reusable solution and Agentic assets and templatized solution offers that improve speed to value. Additionally, you will contribute to proposal development and support/lead client Orals for Edge pursuits.

Key Responsibilities

A) Practice Leadership Across Multiple Programs

• Lead end-to-end EDGE Planning practice ac ross multiple programs or engagements (EDGE Supply chain portfolio involving Kinaxis, o9, BlueYonder, Manhattan Associates, Anaplan, Coupa and others), ensuring growth, delivery excellence and measurable outcomes.
• Manage planning, delivery governance, escalations, and delivery risk across programs.
• Ensure consistent delivery standards, operational discipline, and continuous improvement.
• Develop and grow talent by coaching teams, reinforcing delivery best practices, and partnering with HR/leadership on capability building.
• Partner with client stakeholders and internal functions to drive adoption of change and stabilize delivery performance.

B) Drive Innovation, Standardization & Speed-to-Value

• Identify repeatable delivery patterns and convert them into solution assets, including:
• delivery accelerators, reusable components, playbooks, reference architectures, and tooling approaches
• Build and maintain templatized solution offers (where applicable), enabling faster proposal responses and reduced time-to-start for new engagements.
• Promote standardization across delivery methods to improve predictability, cost, and quality.
• Support innovation initiatives that improve delivery throughput while maintaining risk controls.

C) Solutioning & Sales Collaboration (Proposals)

• Collaborate with Sales, Solution Architecture, and other bid teams to shape delivery strategy during pursuits.
• Support proposal development by contributing:
• delivery approach, governance model, staffing logic, and implementation plan
• differentiators tied to reusable assets/accelerators and known delivery methods
• Create or review proposal content to ensure it aligns with feasible delivery execution, commercial expectations, and client requirements.

D) Support and Lead Orals

• Participate in bid Orals and executive discussions to present delivery strategy and execution confidence.
• Lead oral sessions where required—aligning storytelling across delivery, solution, and commercial commitments.
• Support Q&A responses by coordinating with SMEs and ensuring consistent messaging across stakeholders.
• Travel may be required for role. 0-100% depending on client and business needs.

Job Qualifications

• Minimum 12 years experience leading delivery for small and large-scale transformation programs (or multiple concurrent programs) including demonstrated success in multi-functional stakeholder management, including client executives and internal leadership.
• Minimum 12 years previous experience with delivery governance, risk management, and program planning.
• Minimum 12 years experience supporting bids (RFP/RFI), proposals, and/or Orals in enterprise environments.
• Minimum 12 years experience leading people and teams; proven ability to improve overall delivery performance (onshore and offshore teams).
• Minimum 5 years experience building reusable assets, accelerators, or offerings that improve speed and predictability
• Bachelor's degree or equivalent (minimum 12 years) work experience. (If Associate Degree, must have minimum 6 years work experience).

Preferred Qualifications:

• Technical Background in any of the Supply Chain solutions (Kinaxis, o9, Manhattan) is preferred.
• Strong experience with solution architecture concepts (end-to-end, multi-service solution design).
• Experience in operations mobilization / transition setups for new outsourcing or transformation engagements.
• Demonstrated metrics-driven improvement (quality, delivery predictability, cost efficiency, etc.
• Experience positioning Managed Services

What’s in it for you

At Accenture in addition to a competitive basic salary, you will also have an extensive benefits package which includes 30 days’ vacation per year, private medical insurance and 3 extra days leave per year for charitable work of your choice!

Flexibility and mobility are required to deliver this role as there will be requirements to spend time onsite with our clients and partners to enable delivery of the first-class services we are known for.

About Accenture

Accenture is a leading global professional services company that helps the world’s leading businesses, governments and other organizations build their digital core, optimize their operations, accelerate revenue growth and enhance citizen services—creating tangible value at speed and scale. We are a talent- and innovation-led company with approximately 791,000 people serving clients in more than 120 countries. Technology is at the core of change today, and we are one of the world’s leaders in helping drive that change, with strong ecosystem relationships. We combine our strength in technology and leadership in cloud, data and AI with unmatched industry experience, functional expertise and global delivery capability. Our broad range of services, solutions and assets across Strategy & Consulting, Technology, Operations, Industry X and Song, together with our culture of shared success and commitment to creating 360° value, enable us to help our clients reinvent and build trusted, lasting relationships. We measure our success by the 360° value we create for our clients, each other, our shareholders, partners and communities.

title: Superflex Roadside Patrol - Shepherds Bush
description:
Join the RAC as a Superflex Roadside Patrol and use your expertise when our members need it most.

Flexibility deserves recognition - and we deliver. As a Superflex Roadside Patrol, you'll benefit from:

• £55,869.82 with a realistic OTE of £63,200 (inclusive of London Weighting Allowance, if applicable), with opportunities to earn more through enhanced rates and additional shifts.
• A role built for flexible technicians - averaging 40 hours per week across days, evenings, weekends and peak demand periods. Shifts are driven by member demand and can fall between 6am and 2am, with rostered days confirmed 7 days in advance and working hours confirmed 3 days ahead.
• A structured development programme with hands-on learning, ongoing support and the opportunity to achieve accreditation through the motor industry's professional body, the IMI.

What You’ll Need...

Either:

NVQ Level 2 qualification in Light Vehicle Maintenance (or equivalent) with 2+ years’ experience

or

5+ years’ experience as a Vehicle Technician/Mechanic

and

A full UK driving licence with fewer than 6 points

Investing in your technical developmentAt the RAC, we're committed to helping our technicians grow their skills and build long-term careers.

Through a structured technical development pathway, you'll have access to ongoing learning, specialist roadside training and opportunities to achieve industry-recognised IMI accreditation. Whether you're looking to broaden your expertise or continue developing your diagnostic capability, we'll support you every step of the way.

About The Role

As a Superflex Roadside Patrol within our Patrol division, you'll deliver expert mechanical roadside repair, vehicle diagnostics and emergency breakdown support across the UK. Whether it's a flat battery, tyre change or complex fault-finding, you'll provide quick, confident solutions and reassurance when our members need it most.

You'll work independently to diagnose faults, solve problems and help members continue their journeys safely. Every shift brings different challenges, new locations and the opportunity to make an immediate impact when people need the RAC most.

This role is designed for technicians who can offer flexibility in support of member demand. You'll work a varied shift pattern that includes evenings, weekends and peak demand periods, helping us provide market-leading service when and where members need us most.

You'll combine technical expertise with exceptional customer service, using the latest diagnostic technology to identify faults and get members back on the road quickly and safely.You'll be trusted to make decisions, supported to develop your skills and equipped with everything you need to succeed.

If you're looking for greater variety, more autonomy and the opportunity to use your skills beyond the workshop, this is the role for you.

No CV required when you apply - it's easier than ever to start your journey with us.

As a Superflex Roadside Mechanic at RAC, you’ll get benefits that go the extra mile

• Strong base pay - £55,869.82 with a realistic OTE of £63,200 (inclusive of London Weighting Allowance, if applicable)
• Share in our success - Join our colleague share scheme for free to benefit from the future growth of the business
• Free RAC Ultimate breakdown cover - From your very first day.
• Car salary sacrifice scheme - Includes electric vehicle options (after 12 months) to help you save on tax.
• Generous holidays - 23 days plus bank holidays (rising to 25 with service).
• Pension & life cover - Up to 6.5% matched pension contributions and life cover up to 4x your salary (10x with flex benefits).
• Wellbeing support - 24/7 confidential support helpline for you and your family.
• Exclusive discounts - Save on tools, tech, holidays, and more through our Orange Savings portal.

Why RAC?

For more than 128 years, we’ve been keeping drivers moving, and today we’re trusted by over 15 million members. We’re also trusted by our people, with a 4.5-star Glassdoor rating showing that RAC is a place where support, ambition, and opportunity go hand in hand.

We welcome people from every background, value every voice, and back your growth every step of the way. At the RAC, you can bring your full self to work and we’ll be with you every step of the way to help you grow and develop your career.

description:
Music is Universal

It’s the passionate and dedicated team at Universal Music who help make us the world’s leading music company. From A&R to finance, legal to digital, sales to marketing, Universal Music is the place to grow and develop your career within a truly commercial and innovative business that leads in everything it does.

Everyone is welcome to apply for our roles, and we are determined to ensure that no applicant or employee receives less favourable treatment because of gender, race, disability, sexual orientation, religion, belief, age, marital status, background, pregnancy, or caring responsibilities. We also recognise the importance of diversity of thought within our teams and are fully committed to embracing the talents of people with autism, dyslexia, ADHD, and other forms of neurocognitive variation.

We will always seek to make appropriate adjustments to recruitment, workplaces, and work processes to be fully inclusive to people with different needs and working styles. If you need us to make any reasonable adjustments for you from application onwards, including alternatives to the online form or to disclose a neurocognitive condition, please email UniversalMusicCareers@umusic.com.

Job Summary

We are UMG, the Universal Music Group. We are the world’s leading music company. In everything we do, we are committed to artistry, innovation and entrepreneurship. We own and operate a broad array of businesses engaged in recorded music, music publishing, merchandising, and audiovisual content in more than 60 countries. We identify and develop recording artists and songwriters, and we produce, distribute and promote the most critically acclaimed and commercially successful music to delight and entertain fans around the world.

We are currently seeking a highly skilled vulnerability engineer to join our Vulnerability Management program. They will drive resolution of all identified IT vulnerabilities in a global enterprise to ensure the smooth and efficient ongoing operation of the UMG Global infrastructure. A high level of diverse technical skills for troubleshooting and problem analysis is required, along with the ability to clearly communicate the results of problem analysis to business stakeholders, IT support teams, and network providers to resolve operational issues quickly and effectively. This position requires established and proven experience in a global environment. In addition to having strong technical skills, you must be comfortable in effectively communicating with business end users, technical IT teams, business partners, network providers, and business process outsourced vendors, all while being sensitive to a wide diversity of cultural and technical backgrounds in a global business environment.

Job Functions

• Demonstrate ability to anticipate security issues, identify emerging risks, and take initiative in vulnerability remediation without constant supervision. A track record of proactively addressing vulnerabilities and improving security processes is essential.
• Prioritize and classify vulnerabilities based on risk impact, system criticality, and business context.
• Drive resolution of identified vulnerabilities within 60 days of identification.
• Administer and maintain the Veritas eDiscovery platform, ensuring its availability, security and proper configuration.
• Administer and maintain Cortex XDR for endpoint detection and response.
• Ensure compliance with data retention policies and assist legal and compliance teams with data retrieval and analysis requests.
• Work with internal customers, teammates and 3rd party providers to ensure operational security of the cloud and server infrastructure.
• Maintain high quality process and procedure documentation.
• Maintain & enhance knowledge of key technologies and risks.
• Communicate risk and remediation requirements clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, including leadership and external auditors.
• Automate the vulnerability reporting and remediation processes to improve efficiency and reduce manual intervention.
• Participate in incident response activities related to vulnerability exploitation and provide remediation guidance.
• Participate in on-call rotation to respond to critical security alerts and events. Work out of standard business hours will occasionally be required.

Job Requirements

• 3+ years of hands-on experience in vulnerability management, remediation, or related cybersecurity roles.
• 1-2 years of experience administering and maintaining Veritas eDiscovery platforms, including troubleshooting, upgrades and ensuring compliance with data retention requirements.
• Experience with common vulnerability assessment tools (e.g., Nessus, Qualys, Tenable, OpenVAS).
• Knowledge of patch management processes and tools.
• Must possess strong people skills and the ability to be both diplomatic and firm.
• Experience in highly available 24x7x365 production environment.
• Fluency in operating system administration and tools including: Microsoft, Mac OS X, Linux, Python, Powershell, etc.
• Proven experience with Amazon AWS and Microsoft Azure (Google Compute a plus) in an enterprise setting.
• Manage time well in a high-interrupt operational environment. Handle the details of several technical tasks simultaneously.
• Familiarity with VMware Tanzu CloudHealth.
• Appropriate professional certifications.

Education

• Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science or Engineering or closely related field or comparable education and experience.
• Certifications such as CISSP, CISA, Security+
• ITIL Foundation Certification strongly desired.

Just So You Know…

The company presents this job description as a guide to the major areas and duties for which the jobholder is accountable. However, the business operates in an environment that demands change and the jobholder's specific responsibilities and activities will vary and develop. Therefore, the job description should be seen as indicative and not as a permanent, definitive, and exhaustive statement.

title: Software Development Engineer – Health & Care (w/m/d)
description:
Du möchtest Software entwickeln, die klinische und administrative Prozesse in Krankenhäusern und Kliniken wirklich verbessert, und dabei moderne KI-Technologien nicht nur aktiv in der Entwicklung einsetzen, sondern auch als Produkt in die Versorgung bringen? Dann werde Teil unseres Health-&-Care-Teams und entwickle zukunftsfähige Softwareprodukte für genau diesen Bereich.

Was diesen Job so besonders macht?

• Du entwickelst und pflegst unsere Health-&-Care-Lösungen sowohl für unsere mandantenfähige Cloud Umgebung als auch für On-Premises-Systeme auf Basis modernster Technologien. Dabei arbeitest Du über den gesamten Softwarelebenszyklus hinweg, von der technischen Konzeption und Releaseplanung bis zur Bereitstellung und kontinuierlichen Weiterentwicklung.
• Gemeinsam mit Kliniken, Produktmanagement und Consulting analysierst Du fachliche Anforderungen und übersetzt klinische sowie administrative Prozesse in tragfähige technische Konzepte – hierbei ist uns wichtig, dass Du eine hohe Motivation mitbringst, fachliche Anforderungen zu durchdringen, um die bestmögliche Lösung für Anwendende zu implementieren.
• Du arbeitest mit uns an der Krankenhaus-Content-Plattform von morgen: KI steht nicht nur drauf, sondern Du beschäftigst Dich auch mit der Implementierung von LLM-basierten Funktionen, MCP und weiteren Technologien.
• Die Entwicklung und Pflege von Schnittstellen zu Krankenhausinformationssystemen, PACS und weiteren Anwendungen gehört ebenfalls zu Deinen Aufgaben. Im Rahmen dessen arbeitest Du mit Standards wie HL7 FHIR, HL7 v2, IHE und DICOM.
• KI-gestützte Entwicklungswerkzeuge wie Claude Code setzt Du gezielt für die Codegenerierung ein. Du gestaltest Prompts und agentische Workflows, prüfst und testest den generierten Code und integrierst ihn sauber in unsere bestehenden Architekturen.
• Im Rahmen von Technologiepartnerschaften unterstützt Du die technische Konzeption und integrierst externe Komponenten in unsere Produkte. Gleichzeitig etablierst Du Best Practices für die KI-unterstützte Softwareentwicklung und gibst Dein Wissen im Team weiter.
• Auch die Unterstützung im 3rd-Level-Support sowie die technische Dokumentation gehören zu Deinem Verantwortungsbereich. In dem Zusammenhang stellst Du gemeinsam mit dem Produktmanagement und der technischen Redaktion sicher, dass Datenschutz-, Sicherheits- und Compliance-Anforderungen eingehalten werden.

Warum ausgerechnet Du zu diesem Job passt?

• Du verbindest fundierte Erfahrung in der nachhaltigen Entwicklung und kontinuierlichen Pflege von Softwareprodukten mit einem guten Verständnis klinischer und/oder administrativer Prozesse, beispielsweise in der Patientenaufnahme, Dokumentation, Abrechnung oder im Medizincontrolling.
• Als Full-Stack-Entwickler:in bewegst Du Dich sicher in Java und Spring Boot sowie JavaScript und Vue.js. Ergänzt wird Dein technisches Profil durch SQL, REST-APIs, OAuth beziehungsweise SMART on FHIR sowie Kenntnisse in Backend-Frameworks und Microservice-Architekturen.
• Mit Git, idealerweise GitLab, CI-Pipelines, Test-driven Development und einer Issue-Verwaltung wie Jira bist Du vertraut. Auch Docker sowie Datenbanken wie MongoDB und/oder MySQL gehören zu Deinem technischen Werkzeugkasten.
• KI-generierten Code kannst Du kritisch bewerten, umfassend testen und qualitätsgesichert in bestehende Architekturen integrieren. Idealerweise hast Du bereits mit agentischen Workflows, Prompt-Design oder der KI-gestützten Automatisierung von Entwicklungsprozessen gearbeitet.
• Die Kommunikation mit klinischem und administrativem Fachpersonal fällt Dir leicht. Du kannst komplexe Anforderungen strukturiert erfassen, verständlich übersetzen und mit unterschiedlichen Ansprechpartner:innen auf Augenhöhe zusammenarbeiten.
• Kenntnisse in Grafana und Prometheus sowie im skalierbaren Cloud-Betrieb mit Kubernetes, Terraform oder GitOps sind von Vorteil. Gleiches gilt für Erfahrung mit DSGVO, KHZG-Anforderungen und IT-Sicherheit im Klinikumfeld sowie ein Studium oder eine Ausbildung mit Bezug zu Medizininformatik, Gesundheitsökonomie oder vergleichbare Praxiserfahrung im Health-IT-Umfeld.

Wir leben Diversität

Unabhängig von Alter, Geschlecht, geschlechtlicher und sexueller Identität, Herkunft, Kultur oder einer Behinderung. Es ist der Mensch in seiner Vielfalt, der uns überzeugt und begeistert. Sei Du selbst, dann passen wir am besten zusammen. Wir freuen uns auf Deine Bewerbung.

title: Senior Security Innovation Engineer
description:
About the role
As a Senior Security Engineer in Tesco’s Innovation Engineering team, you will pioneer next generation security capabilities that proactively protect a retail ecosystem serving millions of customers. You will combine deep engineering expertise with an innovation mindset to build production-grade solutions that leverage applied Artificial Intelligence (AI), automation, and modern development practices to strengthen Tesco’s cyber defence.
This role sits at the point where ideas become real: you will design, build, test, and operationalise capabilities that measurably reduce risk and improve resilience. You will also act as a technical leader, setting engineering direction, raising standards, and influencing across diverse security and technology teams with a customer-first focus. In the immediate term, you will focus on the needs of our Cyber Threat Intelligence and Detection Engineering teams.
This team operates as an innovation incubator for cyber defence capabilities: rapidly exploring ideas, validating them through prototypes and experiments, and ensuring the strongest concepts graduate into secure, reliable production services. Depending on the nature of the capability, ownership may either remain within this team or transition to the most appropriate long-term service owner once the solution is proven and operationally ready.
You will work closely with our Security Automation Engineering team to build a shared roadmap of opportunities to deliver across Cyber Defence, ensuring we build and/or buy the best technologies to deliver our vision.

You will be responsible for
• Architect and deliver innovative security capabilities: Design and build high impact security solutions that improve Tesco’s defensive posture, from concept through to production operation, with measurable outcomes.
• Embed AI augmented security engineering: Apply AI and automation to accelerate and improve security outcomes (e.g., enrichment, reasoning support, detection ideation and improvement, general engineering productivity), ensuring solutions remain safe, explainable, and fit for operational use.
• Lead modern engineering approaches for cyber defence: Use contemporary software development practices to turn ideas into secure, production-ready capabilities, with a focus on automation, experimentation, maintainability, and scale.
• Champion engineering excellence: Establish secure, test-driven approaches, code quality standards, automated testing, version control discipline, and repeatable release patterns to ensure innovation is reliable and maintainable.
• Share knowledge and inspire others: Showcase your work, build understanding, and foster excitement around the solutions you develop so innovation can scale beyond the team.
• Validate effectiveness and resilience: Design evaluation strategies and functionality testing so controls work as intended, regressions are prevented, and defensive improvements are demonstrable over time.
• Influence and enable change across teams: Collaborate with security and technology stakeholders to drive adoption of new capabilities, communicate trade offs clearly, and create inclusive ways of working that help teams succeed.

You will need
Essential Skills• Demonstrable expertise in applied AI for cyber defence, including identifying high value use cases, translating them into engineering work, and delivering outcomes safely with human accountability and appropriate guardrails.
• Exposure to technical AI architecture & implementation, with the ability to design, review, and refine AI enabled systems (data flows, model/tool selection, orchestration patterns, controls) without sacrificing security or operability.
• Demonstrable understanding of technical security architecture, including producing and defending design decisions, selecting appropriate patterns, and anticipating operational and threat-driven failure modes and designing against them.
• Strong programming capability, evidenced by building production grade tools, automations, or services with clear structure, maintainability, and secure engineering hygiene.
• Demonstrable understanding of secure & test driven engineering, applying automated testing, secure design principles, and disciplined change control to protect reliability whilst enabling speed.
• Strong capability in evaluating security solutions, including setting clear technical requirements and success criteria, assessing control effectiveness, and validating solutions against realistic operational and threat-informed conditions.
• Demonstrable understanding of core cyber defence technology, including how telemetry, detection/response tooling, and automation ecosystems fit together to deliver measurable defensive outcomes.
• Strong data analytics & insights capability, including selecting meaningful measures, analysing trends, and using evidence to prioritise work and communicate impact.
• Strategic thinking & problem solving, balancing innovation with operational reality, and making sound decisions in ambiguous or fast moving contexts.
• Communication & influencing, able to explain complex technical concepts to varied audiences, align stakeholders, and drive decisions and adoption.
• Embracing and enabling change, demonstrating leadership through change, helping teams modernise practices and adopt new capabilities without destabilising delivery.
• Curiosity, learning, and research mindset, actively exploring emerging technologies and adversary trends, then translating learning into practical, scalable engineering improvements.
• Commitment to inclusion & belonging, with evidence of fostering supportive, psychologically safe engineering environments.
Desirable Skills• Awareness of AI governance, compliance, and responsible AI principles, including privacy, data protection, and risk management considerations.
• Evidence of contributions to the profession (community involvement, publications, talks, mentoring, open-source work, or recognised learning achievements).
• Familiarity with Tesco’s core technology landscape and retail technology context, connecting technical risk to customer experience and operational continuity.
• Demonstrable understanding of development lifecycle practices (planning → build → test → deploy → operate), especially in environments with CI/CD and automation.
• Exposure to technical interviewing, supporting hiring through practical assessments and structured evaluation.
• Experience managing backlogs and delivering iteratively using Jira and product delivery practices, with the ability to shape work around clear outcomes and evolving priorities.
• Familiarity with and experience using operational collaboration tooling such as Zendesk & xMatters in the context of incident workflows and on call engagement.

Whats in it for you?
We’re all about the little helps. That’s why we make sure our Tesco colleague benefits package takes care of you – both in and out of work. Click Here to find out more!

• Annual bonus scheme of up to 20% of base salary.

• Holiday starting at 25 days plus a personal day (plus Bank holidays).

• Private medical insurance.

• 26 weeks maternity and adoption leave (12 months service required at the qualifying date) at full pay, followed by 13 weeks of Statutory Maternity Pay or Statutory Adoption Pay, we also offer 6 weeks fully paid paternity leave.

• Free 24/7 virtual GP service, Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) for you and your family, free access to a range of experts to support your mental wellbeing.

The above information is a shortened summary, refer to our policies for full details
About Us
You might know us as a supermarket, technology company or even for our award-winning mobile network. Truth is, we’re all of those things, and much more. Our colleagues work with one goal in mind, helping to make every day a little better for our customers, colleagues and communities all over the world. No two customers are the same, neither are our colleagues.

At Tesco, we champion a balance that lets you thrive both in and out of work. Spend 60% of your week collaborating with colleagues at our office locations or local sites and the rest remotely. Whether you're just kicking off your career, juggling passions, or navigating big life events, we're here to support you. We always welcome a conversation about flexible working, so talk to us throughout your application about how we can support.

We're proud to be an accredited Disability Confident Leader, where everyone’s welcome. That’s why we commit to providing a fully inclusive and accessible recruitment process. If you need support with your application, click here for more information. And if you're interested in joining our team but don't tick every box, don't let that hold you back from applying.

When you join us in this role, you'll be employed by Tesco Stores Limited, the Tesco legal entity responsible for your employment.

title: Principal Backend Engineer
description:
Waracle are looking for a Principal Backend Engineer to join our world-class digital technology consultancy and home to a diverse, smart, curious, and ambitious community of specialists in technology-driven transformation.

We work with ambitious clients to help them solve their biggest business and customer challenges. We help our clients to innovate and create intelligent digital products and services. We thrive on complex challenges and deliver business-critical IT transformation projects, moving seamlessly from strategy, design, and delivery to operations.

This is a Hybrid role, offering the flexibility to balance your professional and personal life, with 2 days a week spent connecting with colleagues in our London office or on client site.

The Role

As a Principal Backend Developer, you will act as a strategic technical leader, guiding and shaping robust architectures, data strategies, and cloud-native environments across multiple squads and collaborative programmes. In this role, you will champion technical excellence, making thoughtful choices that balance cost, security, performance, and user experience to help Waracle scale and deliver high-performance, world-class products.

If you are a collaborative leader who thrives on mentoring talent, fostering inclusive engineering communities, and navigating complex technical landscapes with empathy and pragmatism, we would love to welcome you to our team!

Duties of This Role

Reporting to the Head of Engineering, your role will cover:

• Solving Complex Technical Challenges: Partner closely with client technical and business stakeholders at all levels, gaining a deep understanding of their technology estates to advise on impactful, world-class digital solutions.
• Technical Excellence & Delivery: Shape architectures across multiple squads; select tools and frameworks to scale across clients while optimising for cost, security, performance, and scalability.
• Collaboration & Stakeholder Management: Act as a trusted advisor to clients on technical strategy and roadmaps, translating complex technical concepts into clear, accessible communication for senior stakeholders.
• Leadership & Community Cultivation: Mentor Lead and Senior Engineers, foster and grow our engineering community of practice, and ensure cross-team alignment on technical standards.
• Culture & Knowledge Sharing: Define and evolve Waracle’s technical standards while contributing to our shared body of knowledge through lessons learned, thought leadership, and good practices.

What You'll Bring

Research shows that women and underrepresented groups often apply to jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. At Waracle, we hire for potential, passion, and a collaborative mindset just as much as current experience. If you share our values and believe you can excel in this role, we strongly encourage you to apply—even if you don't tick every single box.

• Architectural Leadership: Proven experience designing, documenting, and scaling complex back-end architectures, distributed systems, microservices, and database designs (SQL and other technologies) within cloud-native environments—particularly Azure (with a focus on API management, maintenance, and scaling).
• Technical Direction & Delivery Ownership: Strong leadership capability to set clear technical direction, maintain a dedicated ownership mindset, and foster high-standard outcomes across complex enterprise projects.
• Consultative Communication: Excellent communication and influencing skills, with a demonstrated ability to navigate complex client organisations, support diverse stakeholders, and pragmatically balance commercial constraints with high technical standards.
• Team Mentorship & Growth: A proven track record of mentoring, developing, and aligning senior engineers and technical leaders to foster a collaborative culture of continuous learning and psychological safety.
• Modern SDLC Innovation: A pragmatic, forward-thinking approach with a strong interest and enthusiasm for applying AI across the Software Development Life Cycle to enhance engineering practices and advise clients on effective adoption.

What to expect from our hiring process

• 1. First Hello: An informal chat with your dedicated Talent Attraction Partner to talk about Waracle, what you want out of your next move, salary, benefits, and office hybrid working model.
• 3. Talking Impact: A collaborative deep dive into how you solve problems, work with others, and raise the bar, guided by our core values and competency framework.
• 3. Craft Showcase: A chance to demonstrate your real-world expertise through a practical presentation.

Your Talent Attraction Partner will be in your corner through every step right up to your Welcome Ritual on day one

Our Benefits

We believe in supporting our team, inside and outside of work. Here's a glimpse of what you can expect:

• Rest & Recharge: You'll receive 27 days of annual leave, plus 8 bank holidays, totaling 35 days of holiday to unwind and pursue your passions.
• Financial Future & Security: Plan for retirement with our company-matched 5% pension contribution. For added peace of mind, we also offer a Death in Service benefit, providing 2 x your annual salary for your loved ones.
• Health & Wellness: Our Medicash Health Cash Plans help cover everyday healthcare costs, complemented by an Employee Assistance Programme for confidential support, and Group Sickness Cover for peace of mind.
• Flexible Working: We champion hybrid working, providing a home office setup budget to ensure you're comfortable and productive wherever you are.
• Learning & Development: Invest in yourself with access to Udemy Business and a dedicated learning and development budget for continuous growth.
• Lifestyle Perks: Make the most of our Cycle to Work Scheme, and enjoy exclusive gym and retail discounts.
• Family First: Our enhanced parental leave policies include support for fertility journeys, recognising diverse family needs.
• Community & Connection: We foster a vibrant culture with regular fun meet-ups and lunch on us in the office once a month. You'll also have the opportunity to make a local impact through Spirit of Waracle, our initiative for getting involved in charitable causes locally, building strong team bonds and giving back.

We are an equal opportunities employer and welcome applications from all suitably qualified persons regardless of their race, gender, disability, religion/belief, sexual orientation or age.

title: Commerciale - Ex-Cuoca/o
description:
Descrizione dell'azienda

RATIONAL è leader mondiale nel mercato e nella tecnologia per la fornitura di soluzioni innovative per i sistemi di cottura. Con la missione di creare continuamente valore per i clienti e la priorità di soddisfarli, RATIONAL è diventata uno standard nelle cucine professionali di tutto il mondo. Ciò che ci spinge è dare ai nostri clienti il massimo dei benefici.

Siamo alla ricerca di una persona con un background culinario che voglia entrare a far parte della nostra rete di vendita consulenziale per la Sicilia sud-orientale, preferibilmente basata su Siracusa.

title: Store Manager
description:
We’re looking for leaders at Starbucks. Join us for coffee, stay for the community, connections and opportunities.

We’ve got an exciting opportunity for you to join us as a store manager. Find your place as a leader at Starbucks and help us build the brand’s future. Here your voice is brewed into everything we do. As a leader at Starbucks you will be empowered to treat the store as if it is your own business.

To be successful in the role, you’ll have previous experience in leading a team in a dynamic retail or hospitality environment. You’ll champion our mission and values to create our Starbucks experience for our customers and partners. You’ll understand your market, getting to know the competition and can identify opportunities to drive store profitability and your business forward. You’ll be an ambassador for our partner networks, making sure our partners know, here they belong.

About

The best part about this role is that no two days are ever the same! As a store leader, working in one of our dynamic stores, you’ll be setting the example and leading from the front on shift. A typical day could include:

• Executing the store operations through your team, on your scheduled shifts and on your days off making sure opening, close and weekends are covered by yourself and your team of partners
• Analysing data and leveraging observations in store to inform decision making that improves both the customer and overall store performance
• Working with your store leaders to use forecasting and scheduling tools to manage labour within the required budgets as well as recruitment of world class and diverse talent that meets the store needs
• Cascading and rolling out of new initiatives to enable operational excellence and drive business results
• Supporting the growth of your partners through performance and development, coaching and developing your team and building positive relationships to understand partner challenges, needs and aspirations
• Setting challenging and realistic goals to drive engagement and improve partner performance

Given the nature of our stores, our working hours could include early mornings, evenings, weekends, nights and/or holidays.

All our retail store partners begin their careers with us by undertaking an introductory training programme which are led by our amazing in store trainers and coaches and are designed to immerse you in the Starbucks culture and set you up for success. These training programmes are delivered in our stores and provide partners with the opportunity to learn on the job supported by their manager.

Benefits

In return, we’ll offer you a competitive starting salary (in line with the national living wage) and benefits that include:

• 28 days holiday a year (including Bank Holidays) + an additional special day for you to take to celebrate a special moment in your life each year
• Free drinks and food when you’re on shift
• Our store bonus program
• Bean stock options for all partners (own part of Starbucks!)
• Comprehensive training (including coffee knowledge!) and access to Starbucks Global Academy (our online learning platform to help continuously develop yourself)
• A free bag of coffee each week and a 30% partner discounts on food, beverages, and merchandise
• Discounts with local and national retailers (cell phones, gym memberships, entertainment tickets, hotels, etc.) through Perks at Work platform
• Life assurance
• Home Sweet Loan (Interest-free loans that can be paid back over 12 months to help pay your rental deposit)
• A free 24/7 Employee Assistance Programme available to you and your family
• Recognition schemes and monetary awards for long service, WOWing customers and your fellow Partners
• Great long-term career opportunities in store and support center

So, if you’re looking for a new opportunity, with us you’ll be welcomed, you’ll be challenged, you’ll be inspired. Here you’ll be heard. Because here, you’re a part of it all. Here you belong.

What is our process?

Application > CV review > first stage interview > second stage interview > offer and onboarding

Starbucks is committed to building an inclusive and diverse workforce. All applicants and partners will be treated fairly, without regard to race, religion, sex, nationality, age, physical or mental disability, sexual orientation, marital status, gender identity and expression.

Know someone who would be a perfect fit? Share this opportunity with them! At Starbucks, there’s always room for one more.

title: Senior Recruitment Consultant
description:

Edinburgh | £35,000–£40,000 DOE + commission | Hybrid working

Are you an experienced 360 recruiter who enjoys winning business, developing client relationships and managing the full recruitment process?

A well-established specialist recruitment business is looking for an experienced Recruitment Consultant to join its Edinburgh team. This is an opportunity to work within the food, drink and FMCG market, supporting an established UK client base while continuing to develop new business.

The business recruits across a broad range of functions within food, drink and FMCG, including:

• Engineering and operations
• Quality and technical
• Sales and marketing
• Supply chain and procurement
• New product development
• Finance and HR
• Interim and contract appointments

You don’t necessarily need previous FMCG experience. The business is open to experienced recruiters from other professional sectors who can demonstrate strong 360 capability, commercial confidence and a genuine ability to win new business.

What they’re looking for

This opportunity would suit someone who:

• Has proven experience within agency recruitment
• Is confident running a full 360 desk
• Can demonstrate success in business development and client acquisition
• Is comfortable picking up the phone and creating new opportunities
• Builds credible, long-term relationships with clients and candidates
• Has a stable career history and is looking for a long-term move
• Is reliable, committed and genuinely passionate about recruitment
• Can work independently while contributing positively to a wider team

This isn’t a graduate or trainee opportunity, so previous recruitment experience is essential.

Salary and benefits

• Basic salary of £35,000–£40,000, with flexibility for the right person
• Quarterly commission scheme
• Commission of up to 30% at the higher billing level
• Hybrid working, with up to two days from home once you’re established within the business

• Supportive, experienced leadership team
• Edinburgh city-centre office close to excellent transport links, bars and restaurants

If you’re an experienced recruiter who enjoys the commercial side of the role and wants to join an established specialist business with genuine earning potential, please apply for a confidential conversation.

title: Data Scientist
description:
Data Scientist

Ontwikkel geavanceerde modellen en algoritmes die écht waarde leveren.

Als Data Scientist bij Beyonder Enschede ga je verder dan alleen prototypen of dashboards. Met geavanceerde machine learning, forecasting, LLM-architecturen en predictive analytics los je kernproblemen op voor toonaangevende organisaties. Je combineert wiskundige en technische diepgang met een nuchtere en pragmatische aanpak: modellen bouwen die niet op de plank blijven liggen, maar dagelijks in productie draaien en waarde leveren.

Enschede I 32-40 uur I Afgeronde WO-opleiding I Minimaal 3 jaar ervaring.

---

Wat ga je doen?

Als Data Scientist ben jij verantwoordelijk voor het analyseren van complexe datasets en het ontwikkelen van intelligente modellen die organisaties slimmer maken. Je bedenkt innovatieve oplossingen voor uitdagende klantvraagstukken, van de maakindustrie en logistiek tot de publieke sector.

Je werkt intensief met tools als Python, R en SQL en bent thuis in moderne machine learning frameworks en geavanceerde AI-tools. Samen met een multidisciplinair team van Data Engineers, AI-Engineers en Software Developers zorg je dat data niet alleen waardevol is, maar dat jouw modellen naadloos integreren in schaalbare, veilige en betrouwbare data-architecturen.

Jouw verantwoordelijkheden

• Modellen & Algoritmes ontwikkelen: Je ontwerpt, bouwt en traint geavanceerde machine learning modellen, predictive analytics en forecastingalgoritmes.
• AI & LLM-integratie: Je omarmt de nieuwste AI-tools en LLM-frameworks om je ontwikkelproces te versnellen, code te optimaliseren en slimme agents te bouwen.
• Van analyse naar productie: Je bent pas tevreden als een model niet alleen werkt in een notebook, maar aantoonbaar waarde oplevert in de productieomgeving van de klant.
• Heldere communicatie: Je vertaalt ingewikkelde wiskundige en technische modellen naar begrijpelijke, inzichten voor collega’s en klanten.

Wie jij bent?

• Analytisch: Jij haalt energie uit het ontrafelen van complexe datasets en zet wiskundige diepgang om in strategische impact.
• Samenwerkingsgericht: Je bent een echte teamspeler die graag schouder aan schouder werkt met Data Engineers, AI-Engineers en Software Developers.
• Innovatief: Je volgt de nieuwste ontwikkelingen in Data & AI op de voet en bent nieuwsgierig naar hoe nieuwe tools en LLM's je werk nog scherper maken.

Competenties

Opleiding

Een afgeronde WO-opleiding met een sterke kwantitatieve component (bijv. Data Science, Computer Science, Econometrie, Wiskunde of BIT).

Werkervaring

Minimaal 3 jaar relevante ervaring als Data Scientist. Bij voorkeur in een consultancy omgeving of bij complexe organisaties.

Techstack & Tooling

Diepgaande ervaring met Python, R en SQL. Kennis van ML-frameworks zoals PyTorch, TensorFlow of scikit-learn, predictive analytics en het finetunen van LLM’s.

Communicatie

Communicatief sterk. Je hebt Nederlands als moedertaal, spreekt uitstekend Engels en kunt complexe modellen begrijpelijk uitleggen.

Ben jij onze Nieuwe data Scientist? We spreken je graag!
