title: ABM Campaign Manager
description:
Thank you for considering Tailscale. If this job description resonates with you, please apply. Frequently cited statistics show that people who identify with historically marginalized groups are likely to apply to jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. We encourage you to help us break that statistic!

About Tailscale

Tailscale is making safe connection effortless by delivering software that makes it easy to securely interconnect people and their devices, no matter where they are. From hobbyists to multinational corporations, teams of every size use Tailscale each day to protect their networks, share access to internal tools, and more. We're building a future for the Internet that's easy, sensible, and safe, like it used to be. Founded in 2019 and fully distributed, we're backed by Accel, CRV, Insight, Heavybit, and Uncork Capital.

About the Role

We're looking for an Integrated ABM Campaign Manager to develop and scale creative, targeted campaigns that engage priority accounts and drive pipeline across our Enterprise and Mid-Market segments.

You'll own the strategy and execution of 1:1 and 1:few ABM campaigns, bringing together paid advertising, personalized content, direct mail, gifting, and coordinated Sales outreach to reach the right people at the right accounts.

This is a hands-on role where you'll have the freedom to test new ideas, build integrated programs, and use data to understand what's working. You'll also partner closely with our wider ABM, Sales, and Partner Marketing team to connect campaigns with account priorities, strategic experiences, and partner-led opportunities.

Key Responsibilities

• Own the strategy, planning, execution, and optimization of integrated ABM campaigns across Enterprise and Mid-Market audiences.
• Develop campaign audiences, messaging, channel plans, budgets, and success metrics based on Sales priorities and account insights.
• Manage targeted paid advertising, particularly LinkedIn, alongside personalized landing pages and other digital ABM experiences.
• Own direct mail, gifting, and scalable prospect engagement programs, including gifting program workflows.
• Partner with Sales and GTM Operations to identify target accounts, build contact lists, and activate campaigns.
• Develop coordinated Sales outreach plays and sequences with the Sales Enablement Lead to support campaign engagement and follow-up.
• Work with Product Marketing and Content to develop relevant messaging and creative for priority audiences.
• Collaborate with our wider Enterprise ABM, Events, and Partner Marketing teams on account-specific activations, event invitations, and joint campaigns.
• Proactively identify new campaign opportunities based on engagement signals, account intelligence, and business priorities.
• Track performance, test new approaches, and optimize for account engagement, meetings, pipeline creation, and progression.

What We Are Looking For

• 5+ years of B2B marketing experience, with a background in building ABM campaigns for both net-new acquisition and customer expansion.
• Experience independently developing and executing multi-channel campaigns from strategy through measurement.
• Hands-on experience with LinkedIn advertising, audience segmentation, and marketing automation.
• Hands-on experience with personalized landing page platforms like Userled or Mutiny.
• Experience with direct mail, gifting, personalization, or other creative account engagement tactics and platforms like Reachdesk or Sendoso.
• Strong understanding of how marketing campaigns support Sales engagement and pipeline generation.
• Comfortable working with data, testing new ideas, and using performance insights to improve results.
• Organized, creative, and comfortable managing multiple campaigns and stakeholders at once.

Nice to Have

• Experience marketing to technical or Enterprise B2B audiences.
• Familiarity with Salesforce, HubSpot, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, Clay, or Common Room.
• Experience with partner or co-marketing campaigns.

As a company, we strive to maintain fair and equitable compensation practices within our team across all roles and all levels. Tailscale's compensation package includes base salary, equity, and comprehensive benefits. The salary range displayed on each job posting represents the target range for a new hire's base salary. Individual offers may vary based on experience and skill set.

UK Pay Range

£93,220—£116,920 GBP

What We Offer

• An inclusive, flexible environment where you can be your authentic self. We recognize the impact of diverse voices and backgrounds on the growth of our people, product, and company. And that flexibility in how and when you work empowers our team to integrate work and life.
• A competitive total compensation package. This includes a base salary, an equity incentive plan and variable commission (for quota-based roles).
• Comprehensive group benefits with no waiting period. Take advantage of coverage for health, vision, dental, and more for you and your family!
• Remote first company—most of our teams work fully remotely. Enjoy a change of scenery wherever you can get wifi, participate in virtual and in-person social events, and leverage our corporate co-working program to visit WeWork (or other similar spaces near you). Some roles require in-office collaboration depending on team needs, which will be clearly noted in the job description.
• Employer-funded retirement contributions. Tailscale will match your retirement contributions dollar-for-dollar, up to a maximum annual employer contribution equal to 0.75% of your eligible compensation.
• Connect with other Tailscalars IRL. Attend our annual company retreat, participate in team off-sites, and collaborate in person with teammates across Canada, the United States, the United Kingdom, and Singapore. We support intentional in-person connection through team travel and distributed collaboration.

• Support for your personal and professional development. Grow your career thoughtfully with $1500 USD annually for professional development, or take advantage of mentorship, coaching, and internal promotion opportunities.
• Paid time off and a healthy work-life integration. Our flexible, paid time off program supports you for any situation life throws your way, whether moving homes or travelling the world!
• A build-your-own home office setup. You choose your own company-owned laptop (Mac or PC), receive a monthly home internet reimbursement, and $500 USD to customize your workstation to make it your own.
• Paid parental leave program. We care about your life outside of work and encourage new parents to take advantage of parental leave top-ups (20 weeks for birthing parents, 16 weeks for non-birthing parents).

Tailscale is committed to providing an accessible and inclusive hiring process. If you require an accommodation at any stage of the recruitment process or related to any aspect of this role, please contact your recruiter.

Our hiring process uses AI-assisted tools to help screen and assess candidates. All hiring decisions are made by people.

Please be aware that legitimate emails from Tailscale's talent team will only originate from @tailscale.com, @greenhouse.io, and @interviews.modernloop.io email addresses. For more information about protecting yourself from impersonators and scams, please visit https://tailscale.com/scam-awareness.

title: Clinical Lead Psychiatrist
description:
About RTN Mental Health

At RTN Mental Health Solutions we believe in taking care of our people just as well as we take care of our patients. We are on a mission to make ADHD and ASD diagnosis and support clear, compassionate, and truly life-changing. We’re a growing network of passionate professionals, but our core purpose remains the same: putting the people we support at the heart of everything we do.

Whether you’re working directly with our clients or behind the scenes, you’ll be part of a warm, neuro-affirming team that lives by three simple values: Respect for every individual's unique story, Transformation through curiosity and innovation, and Nurture by supporting one another to grow.

The Role

What are we looking for?

Reporting to the Medical Director, our Medical team is looking for a Clinical Lead Psychiatrist. You will provide high-quality psychiatric care across our ADHD assessment and treatment pathway, for clients of all ages, with the flexibility to shape your caseload around your specialist strengths and interests.

Role Responsibilities

You will be:

• Reviewing the information gathered by our psychologists and wider clinical team before you meet each client
• Carrying out structured psychiatric assessments to confirm ADHD diagnoses, and sharing the outcome with clients and families clearly and kindly
• Starting and managing ADHD medication in line with national guidelines, including follow-up appointments to adjust doses and check for side effects
• Working with our nurse prescribers, and joining monthly team meetings to finalise diagnoses and plan care for complex cases
• Providing ongoing psychiatric input for clients with complex needs, and keeping care joined up with their general practitioners and other professionals
• Supervising and supporting psychologists, nurses and colleagues, and joining learning and reflective practice sessions
• Keeping accurate, timely clinical records that explain the reasons behind your decisions
• Contributing to audits, service reviews and the development of clinical tools

About You

• Experience in a multidisciplinary clinical team, in National Health Service or private neurodevelopmental services
• Able to carry out thorough ADHD assessments, explain your diagnoses clearly in speech and in writing, medication management and manage and escalate psychiatric risk
• Proficiency in recognised ADHD diagnostic tools (e.g. DIVA, ACE, Conners).
• In-depth knowledge of national clinical guidelines, professional standards and ADHD care pathways
• A compassionate, ethical and person-centred approach, with the confidence to supervise and mentor colleagues
• Organised, reliable and able to work independently, with a commitment to continuous learning, audit and service improvement
• Have a DBS on update service or willingness to undertake a DBS check
• You are based in the UK and have the right to work here (we are unable to offer sponsorship)
• Comfortable being the Registered Manager for CQC compliance.
• General Medical Council registered with a licence to practise in the UK, a Certificate of Completion of Training in General Adult Psychiatry and Section 12 approval under the Mental Health Act

Our Values In Action

We actively encourage applications from neurodivergent individuals, people with lived experience, and candidates from all backgrounds. We are committed to promoting equality, diversity, and inclusion across our workforce.

As a provider supporting children, young people, and adults at risk, RTN is dedicated to safeguarding. All appointments are subject to standard pre-employment checks.

We want everyone to have an equal chance to show their strengths. If you require any reasonable adjustments or extra support during the application or interview process, please let us know at recruitment@rtnmentalhealthsolutions.com.

Why us?

• Permanent role, full time or part time (the full-time working week is 9am to 5:30pm)
• £150,000 salary
• 100% remote working
• 22 days annual leave + 8 bank holidays
• Inclusive and supportive culture where individuality and neurodiversity are celebrated
• Employer pension
• Private Medical Insurance with Vitality
• Tools for the job, and investment in your professional learning and development

About Us

At RTN Mental Health, we’re on a mission to transform the way neurodevelopmental and primary care mental health services are delivered across the UK. As a dynamic and rapidly expanding organisation, we combine clinical excellence with operational innovation to deliver high-quality, person-centred care. From NHS partnerships to private services, we’re redefining what accessible and effective support can look like.

Our work focuses particularly on improving access to ADHD and autism services, ensuring individuals receive timely, compassionate and evidence-based support across their diagnostic and post-diagnostic journey.

title: Fraud Support Analyst
description:
Fraud Support Analyst (FTC, 18-months)

About Indra Group UK & Ireland

Indra is a leading global technology and consulting company, and a trusted technological partner for the core business operations of its clients worldwide. It stands at the forefront of key sectors including Transport, Defence, Air Traffic Management and Space, alongside advanced Information Technology services delivered through Minsait, and cutting-edge capabilities in Sovereign AI, Cybersecurity, and Cyberdefence via IndraMind.

The company's business model is built around a comprehensive portfolio of proprietary products, combining strong innovation with a high-value focus for customers.

With more than 2,500 projects implemented across 50 countries and over 100 cities, Indra is a global benchmark in innovative transportation and mobility solutions. It is recognised as one of the world's top three companies in public transportation management systems. Indra's technology supports the daily journeys of over 78 million people, helping to reduce more than 10 million tonnes of CO₂ emissions annually, and helping save nearly 3,000 lives through improved traffic management and road safety.

Indra Group is paving the way to a more secure and better-connected future through innovative solutions, trusted relationships and the very best talent. Sustainability sits at the heart of its strategy and culture, driving efforts to address current and future social and environmental challenges.

In the 2024 financial year, Indra achieved revenues of €5.5 billion, over 60,000 professionals, maintained a local presence in 46 countries, and operated across more than 140 countries worldwide.

As the technological partner for its customers' key operations, Indra is at the core of their business, and Indra's four values guide everything we do:

Innovation - Our capacity for innovation, cutting-edge solutions, and specialised team of professionals enables us to drive a safer, more connected future through technology.

Trust - We work with strength, commitment, and reliability, delivering quality solutions to build trust with customers, employees, partners, investors, and society.

Connection - We harness the power of collaboration, connect ideas and solutions, and adapt to our customers' needs, supporting them on the path to a better future.

Foresight - We anticipate future needs to make the world safer and more connected, transforming our experience and knowledge into solutions for a better tomorrow.

About The Project

Transport for London (TfL) has awarded Indra a long-term contract to operate, develop, enhance and expand ticketing and access control systems across London's transport network through to 2034, with extension options to 2039.

This programme covers the maintenance, operation and evolution of a large-scale, complex ecosystem, including turnstiles, validators, ticket machines, sales terminals, back-office systems, payment gateways, IT infrastructure and cybersecurity that supports over 8.6 million daily journeys.

Therefore, Indra will become TfL's strategic technology partner to guarantee the operation and evolution of the world's largest and most sophisticated ticketing system. Following a transition period of approximately two years, Indra will serve as the sole provider across the network that includes more than 8,500 buses, nearly 400 Underground stations, around 300 rail stations (Overground, DLR, Elizabeth Line and suburban services), 4,000 Oyster Card outlets, seven customer service centres, and 24 river boat boarding points.

Drawing on over 30 years of experience in urban public transport solutions, Indra will manage and evolve all aspects of the system. The project also envisages, in partnership with TfL, the implementation of new technologies to develop the system, make it more efficient and automate key processes; in short, to jointly create the next generation of the ticketing system for London.

Role Overview

We are seekinga Fraud Support Analyst to work initially during the transition phase of a large project. Post transition the role will comprise of providing ongoing support to critical back-office applications and fraud management services. The successful candidate will combine strong application operations and support capabilities, data analysis and operational documentation experience gained from working in a payment processing environment in relation to fraud prevention, fraud analysis, hotlist administration or payment-processing support.

The role will initially focus on preparing for operational readiness. It will form part of the Fraud Reduction team, working with customer stakeholders, incumbent supplier SMEs, technical resolver groups and service management functions to capture knowledge, validate procedures and prepare the service for continued operation. After transition, the role will be an integral part of the Fraud Reduction Team and will help in creating & monitoring reports as well as suggesting improvements in order to reduce fraud across the clients' network.

The role is a UK based Hybrid role and requires the successful applicant to work in Redhill 3 days a week, applicants will also be required to pass baseline security / background checks and right to work as Indra are unable to sponsor any work visas.

Key duties include

• Monitoring system activity, transaction data and operational reports to identify suspicious behaviour, anomalies, fraud patterns and emerging risks
• Performing initial and detailed analysis of potential fraud events, validating findings across relevant data sources and documenting the evidence and rationale
• Supporting fraud investigations by gathering and analysing transaction records, system logs, case information and other relevant data
• Producing daily, weekly, periodic and ad hoc fraud reports, dashboards and trend analysis, with clear findings and recommended follow-up actions
• Maintaining accurate case records and supporting updates to the Fraud Risk Register, action logs and supporting documentation
• Assessing whether existing mitigation measures, detection rules, reports, hotlists and operational controls are functioning effectively, and highlighting gaps or unintended impacts
• Escalating suspected or confirmed fraud in accordance with agreed procedures, priorities and reporting timelines
• Working with Back Office Support, IT, cybersecurity, payments, retail, Service Desk, incident management and other operational teams to investigate and resolve fraud-related issues
• Supporting the review, testing and refinement of fraud detection rules, monitoring scripts, dashboards, automated alerts and analytical tools
• Contributing to the identification of new fraud typologies across open-loop payments, closed-loop ticketing, retail agents, staff activity and third parties
• Keeping up to date with fraud trends in public transport, contactless payments, digital wallets and ticketing systems, and sharing relevant insights with the wider team
• Contributing to lessons learned, knowledge articles, operational procedures, training materials and fraud awareness activities
• Handling fraud-related information securely and in line with applicable information security, confidentiality and data protection requirements

Requirements

Skills knowledge and experience

Essential

• Experience in fraud analysis, fraud prevention, revenue protection, risk analysis, payments operations, transaction monitoring or a comparable analytical role
• Strong analytical skills and the ability to interpret large or complex datasets, identify anomalies, test hypotheses and communicate evidence-based conclusions
• Experience using reporting, dashboarding or data-analysis tools. Practical knowledge of SQL, Power BI, Excel or similar tools is advantageous
• Ability to investigate issues systematically, correlate information from multiple sources and maintain clear, auditable records
• Understanding of transactional systems, back-office processes, incident management or the payment and ticketing lifecycle
• Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical or analytical findings to operational and non-technical stakeholders
• Ability to prioritise competing cases, work accurately to reporting deadlines and operate effectively in a complex, high-volume environment
• Strong collaboration skills and confidence working across technical, operational, cybersecurity and customer-facing teams
• High standards of integrity, confidentiality, judgement and attention to detail

Desirable

• Experience in transport ticketing, account-based ticketing, contactless payments, retail-agent schemes or digital platforms
• Familiarity with EMV payments, digital wallets, tokenisation, hotlists or deny lists, chargebacks, card-not-present fraud, fare evasion or concessionary travel products
• Exposure to rule-based fraud detection, anomaly detection, machine-learning outputs or fraud case-management tools
• Experience supporting fraud risk registers, investigations, control testing, operational reporting or governance meetings
• Knowledge of data protection, information security and evidence-handling requirements in regulated or critical operational environments

Essential

Education and qualifications

BA/BSc in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.

Desirable

• ITIL Foundation or equivalent practical Service Management experience
• Oracle, SQL Server, PowerShell, BMC Helix, security, PCI DSS or relevant transport/payments certification
• Formal Fraud qualification

Personal qualities

• Analytical, structured and attentive to detail, with sound judgement when handling sensitive information and operational risk
• Collaborative and service-oriented, able to communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders
• Self-motivated, resilient and comfortable working under pressure while prioritising competing demands
• Curious and improvement-focused, with a practical approach to documentation quality, knowledge sharing and service continuity
• Able to interpret and adhere to any existing procedures

Benefits

• Holidays: 25 days per annum + 8 days bank holidays (options to buy/sell days)
• Pension - 4% employee and 4% employer
• Private medical insurance (including dental & optical)
• Life assurance
• Income protection
• Employee assistance programs
• Flexible/remote working options
• Charitable initiatives
• Social events (formal & informal)
• Learning and development programs
• Innovative & collaborative work environment

Indra is an equal employment opportunity employer. Applicants are considered without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, origin, disability or other characteristics protected by law.

We source this information through establishing and maintaining strong relationships with fund houses globally, and other content partners in the funds industry. Your focus will be on EMEA, where you will be responsible for a list of accounts, covering all fund types from Mutual Funds to ETPs.

You will engage with fund houses, regulators and various other parties to ensure high visibility over their portfolio holdings. You will also work closely with our Sales, Product, and Engineering departments to support the development of new/enhanced holdings-based terminal functionality, assess the different quality dimensions of the product, and make Bloomberg the platform of choice for data dissemination.

• Establish and manage relationships with major fund houses to work closely with them in disclosing their proprietary portfolio holdings

• Work with other data and core business groups, such as Product, Sales, News and Engineering to help develop and improve the holdings product and portfolios functionality across the terminal
• Come up with innovative ideas and project proposals on Portfolio Holdings functionality
• Create and lead on roundtables and seminars around the themes of Funds and Portfolio Holdings Analytics to engage with your accounts in their respective markets
• Participate actively in new projects that drive departmental initiatives and goals
• Attend industry events and conferences around Funds and Holdings

• A bachelor's degree or higher in relevant data technology or financial field, or equivalent professional work experience
• Minimum of 5+ years of experience* working as a data analyst or in the asset management and/or finance industry
• Strong understanding of the Funds Market and the Buy Side
• Proficiency in Spanish
• Excellent written communication and presentation skills
• Ability to build strong relationships
• Ability to think critically in improving and developing products
• Strong organization skills with ability to balance multiple projects simultaneously
• A curiosity about data management and the asset management industry
• Please note we use years of experience as a guide, but we certainly will consider applications from all candidates who are able to demonstrate the skills necessary for the role.

We'd Love To See

• Experience with the Funds Market
• Proficiency in additional languages (German, French)
• Understanding of fund investment strategies and an understanding of different fund types
• Chartered Financial Analyst (CFA) designation or working towards it
• Good knowledge of Python or a desire to learn

Apply if you think we're a good match. We'll get in touch to let you know what the next steps are!

title: Lead Applied AI Engineer - Banking Technology, Senior Vice President
description:
Role Overview

We are seeking an AI‑first Lead AI Engineer to define, architect, and deliver enterprise‑scale AI solutions for Investment, Corporate, and Commercial Banking.

This role combines deep hands‑on technical leadership with architectural ownership, driving the adoption of LLMs, agentic workflows, and generative AI platforms to improve efficiency, automation, simplification, and risk reduction. The Lead AI Engineer will shape both technical delivery and AI-first engineering culture, partnering closely with multiple technology and business teams.

Key Responsibilities

• End‑to‑End AI Leadership: Lead the design, hands‑on implementation, and deployment of scalable agentic AI and generative AI solutions for high‑impact business use cases.
• Agentic Architecture: Architect advanced agent‑based systems (perception, reasoning, planning, execution), integrating multiple LLM providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google).
• Full‑Stack AI Engineering: Build and deliver production‑grade, full‑stack AI applications using modern ML/LLM platforms and AI coding tools (e.g., Devin, GitHub Copilot).
• Rapid Value Delivery: Champion MVP‑driven delivery, rapid iteration, hypothesis testing, and experimentation (A/B testing) to achieve fast time‑to‑value.
• Evaluation & Optimization: Define rigorous evaluation frameworks and metrics for AI and agent performance, ensuring continuous optimization and alignment with business goals.
• Technology Foresight: Proactively evaluate and integrate emerging AI technologies, particularly in agent‑based and autonomous AI systems, while acting as a thought leader and coach.
• Technical Leadership & Mentorship: Provide front‑line technical leadership, guide architectural decisions, and mentor engineers across AI, data, and application teams to build an AI‑first engineering culture.
• Strategic Domain Alignment: Ensure all AI solutions are grounded in deep banking domain understanding and clearly articulate business and risk impact beyond pure technical implementation.

Qualifications

• Programming: Expert‑level proficiency in Python and/or Java (Spring Boot); solid experience with JavaScript/TypeScript (Angular, Node.js).
• AI/ML Expertise:
• Deep knowledge of AI fundamentals (knowledge representation, automated planning, decision‑making under uncertainty, multi‑agent systems).
• Extensive hands‑on experience with LLM platforms (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google), RAG pipelines, MCPs, and agent frameworks (Google ADK).
• Demonstrated effectiveness with AI coding tools (Devin, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Antigravity).
• Strong experience with ML frameworks (TensorFlow, PyTorch) and data science libraries.
• Proven ability to design and expose robust, scalable APIs for AI services.
• Engineering Excellence: Deep expertise in software engineering best practices, including system design, CI/CD, testing strategies, resiliency, security, and operational stability for AI‑driven platforms.
• Architecture & Data: Strong experience designing API‑first, microservices‑based, and event‑driven systems, including AI‑focused data pipelines and lifecycle management.
• Platforms: Hands‑on experience with Docker and Kubernetes.
• Leadership & Communication: Exceptional ability to articulate complex technical concepts, influence senior stakeholders, and lead high‑impact technical discussions.
• Domain Expertise: Strong understanding of banking and regulated financial environments, with the ability to connect AI capabilities to measurable business outcomes.

Nice to Have

• Advanced data science expertise (statistical modeling, experimentation).
• Demonstrated experience mentoring and scaling AI‑first engineering talent in rapidly evolving toolchains.

Experience:

• Progressive software engineering experience with sustained hands‑on contributions.
• Advanced level of expertise in Python language
• Dedicated experience in AI, LLM‑based systems, and agentic architectures.
• Proven success architecting and delivering multiple enterprise‑scale AI solutions into production.

Education:

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, AI, Robotics, or a related quantitative discipline.

title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description:
Company Description

We believe in the power of ingenuity to build a positive human future.

As strategies, technologies, and innovation collide, we create opportunity from complexity.

Our teams of interdisciplinary experts combine innovative thinking and breakthrough technologies to progress further, faster. Our clients adapt and transform, and together we achieve enduring results.

We are over 4,000 strategists, innovators, designers, consultants, digital experts, scientists, engineers, and technologists. And we have deep expertise in consumer and manufacturing, defence and security, energy and utilities, financial services, government and public services, health and life sciences, and transport.

Our teams operate globally from offices across the UK, Ireland, US, Nordics, and Netherlands.

PA. Bringing Ingenuity to Life.

Job Description

We believe in the power of ingenuity to build a positive human future. We challenge where it matters and own the outcome. We combine strategic thinking, customer-centric service design, and agile engineering practices to accelerate innovation in a tech-driven world.

Why consider joining our Digital & Data community? 🤔

• Join our Digital & Data team working alongside product, design and a wide range of other experts and cross-disciplinary teams to bring ideas to life through innovative software solutions.
• Grow a flexible and unique career within a trust-based, inclusive environment that values excellence, innovation, and curiosity. You have the option to progress with us on a technical career track. No need to go onto the Partner career track if this doesn’t align with what you want to do.
• Hybrid working - our approach is to be in the office or on client site a minimum of 2 days per week.
• Work on a broad variety of projects and tech stacks for clients across seven sectors - no project is ever the same
• Join other experts within our supportive and collaborative tech community through knowledge-sharing and peer-level support, coaching and mentoring
• Deepen your expertise through our culture of learning and growth – you’ll have budget to take courses (technical and non-technical training), plus gain certifications

Our tech stack 🚀

While we advocate for using the right tech for the right task, you can expect to work with the following technologies to ensure scalable, high-performance applications:

• Experience with AWS, Azure or GCP
• Building and implementing CI/CD Pipelines, experience working with repos, build automation tools, build orchestration and environment automation is very interesting E.g. Jenkins, GIT, SVN, CVS, Cloud-Formation, Terraform, Chef, Ansible, Puppet, Code Pipeline, Azure Stack
• Implementing microservices and containers E.g. Kubernetes, Docker, OpenShift
• Implementing tools for logging, monitoring and alerting. E.g. TICK Stack, ELK Stack, Splunk, CloudWatch
• Creating and automating virtual machines in the cloud deployed on compute instances
• Implementing other cloud infrastructure and networking required to host a digital service, including storage, firewall and network configuration
• High availability, business continuity and disaster recovery solutions in the cloud
• Deploying serverless functions E.g. AWS Lambda, GCP Cloud Functions, Azure Cloud Functions

What You Can Expect 🌱

• Work to agile best practices and cross-functionally with multiple teams and stakeholders. You’ll be using your technical skills to problem solve with our clients, as well as working on internal projects
• Live in-person whiteboarding sessions to problem solve as a team, alongside asynchronous communication on Teams
• Hybrid working with the team on client site or in our office a minimum of two days per week. However, the actual time you spend and where you spend it will vary by role or assignment, including up to 5 days per week on a client site.
• An environment that deeply cares about its values Values | PA Consulting

Qualifications

Essential requirements ✅

Even if you don’t meet every requirement below, feel free to still apply as we are often hiring for similar roles which your background might be better suited to.

• 8-10 years + of experience in DevOps
• You thrive in problem-solving and analytical thinking
• You enjoy collaborating with multiple stakeholders in a fast-paced environment
• Expertise in architecture
• Knowledge of the development process, perhaps being responsible for the overall process across a pod, or multiple pods, creating strong values and putting robust methods and patterns in place
• Maintaining communication with the client regularly, being one of the key points of engagement between the client and the project
• Coaching and mentoring the team
• Help shaping and contributing to bids, working with a bid team on the approach or proposal and perhaps even presenting to clients in a formal selection process
• Playing a role in account management and strong consulting skills

Please be aware that some of our UK roles at PA Consulting require a UK security clearance.

All PA people are required to undergo background checks and to achieve the Baseline Personnel Security Standard however, some UK roles also require higher levels of National Security Vetting, where applicants must have at least 5 years of continuous residency in the UK.

We therefore ask that you only apply if you meet the residency requirements (i.e. you are a British citizen or have been resident in the UK for the past 5 years), as this is the prerequisite for a security clearance. If you're unsure about your eligibility, we encourage you to review the UK Government’s guidance on security vetting before applying.

Additional Information

Assessment process ⚖️

Please note that the interview stages may be subject to change based on the specific requirements of the role.

• Quick call with one of our Tech Recruiters – to discuss your application, the role and PA
• Round 1: Either a competency or technical interview (60 mins)
• Round 2: Either a competency or technical interview, whichever you didn’t do at first round (60 mins)
• Final round 🎉: Meeting with a PA leader - a mini case study and discussion around your client-centricity (60 mins)

Life At PA encompasses our peoples' experience at PA. It's about how we enrich peoples’ working lives by giving them access to unique people and growth opportunities and purpose led meaningful work.

Our purpose guides how we work with our clients and our teams, and support our communities, to deliver insight and impact, solving the world’s most complex challenges. We're focused on building a workplace that values human difference and diverse mindsets, and a culture of inclusion and equality that unlocks the potential in our people so everyone can be their best self.

Find out more about Life at PA here.

We are dedicated to supporting the physical, emotional, social and financial well-being of our people. Check out some of our extensive benefits:

• Health and lifestyle perks accompanying private healthcare for you and your family
• 25 days annual leave (plus a bonus half day on Christmas Eve) with the opportunity to buy 5 additional days
• Generous company pension scheme
• Opportunity to get involved with community and charity-based initiatives
• Annual performance-based bonus
• PA share ownership
• Tax efficient benefits (cycle to work, give as you earn)

We’re committed to advancing equality. We recruit, retain, reward and develop our people based solely on their abilities and contributions and without reference to their age, background, disability, genetic information, parental or family status, religion or belief, race, ethnicity, nationality, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity (or expression), political belief, veteran status, any other range of human difference brought about by identity and experience. We welcome applications from underrepresented groups.

title: Principal Engineer - Retail
description:
In Short

As Principal Engineer - Retail, you will chart the architectural vision and technical strategy for On’s global physical and omnichannel retail systems. Reporting to the Senior Director of Commercial Technology, you will lead the evolution of high-scale, resilient platforms across Point of Sale (POS), digital payments, fiscalization, and omnichannel store operations. You will champion modern software engineering principles, moving beyond off-the-shelf configurations to engineer scalable, distributed systems that power seamless athlete and runner experiences worldwide across our expanding footprint.

Your Mission

• Architect Global Retail Systems – Define and drive the multi-year architecture north star for On's global retail ecosystem, designing decoupled, event-driven architectures that span next-generation POS, payment gateways, omnichannel services, and store operational platforms.
• Master Core Domain Capabilities – Act as On's foremost authority in retail engineering, establishing resilient technical solutions for real-time payments, international fiscalization compliance, offline-first reliability, inventory replenishment, and clienteling touchpoints.
• Elevate Software Engineering Excellence – Set high standards for distributed systems design, data consistency, and code quality across teams, prioritizing bespoke, cloud-native engineering and decoupled services over monolithic or configuration-only enterprise tools.
• Ensure Operational Resilience – Champion an operational excellence mindset across global retail infrastructure, defining robust SLOs, observability standards (distributed tracing, telemetry), disaster recovery, and peak-trading launch preparedness.
• Drive Cross-Domain Strategic Alignment – Partner with senior engineering leadership, Product Managers, and Retail Operations to translate commercial roadmaps into modular, scalable technical milestones that minimize future technical debt.
• Mentor & Foster Technical Culture – Guide and mentor Senior and Staff Engineers across multiple squads, leading consequential technical decision-making and building an open, high-velocity engineering culture across the Oniverse.

Your Story

• Extensive Technical Leadership Experience – 10+ years of software engineering experience designing, scaling, and operating distributed systems, with significant tenure operating as a Principal Engineer or Staff+ technical leader in modern retail tech environments.
• Deep Retail Domain Mastery – Proven track record architecting core retail domain platforms, specifically high-throughput POS solutions, global payment processor integrations, multi-country fiscalization frameworks, and store replenishment flows.
• Software Engineering & Architectural Craft – Mastery of modern cloud-native architectures (microservices, event-driven designs with Kafka or similar, REST/GraphQL APIs, distributed storage) and strong proficiency in modern languages, emphasizing resilient system design over vendor package configuration.
• Decoupled Integration & Composable Commerce – Demonstrated success integrating distributed retail touchpoints with enterprise backbones (ERP, OMS, CRM) via resilient asynchronous integration layers, deprecating legacy monoliths without business disruption.
• Pragmatic, High-Impact Decision Making – Demonstrated ability to drive complex, consequential architectural trade-offs across multiple cross-functional teams, balancing long-term technical vision with immediate business outcomes.
• Inspiring Mentorship & Influence – Strong communicator who articulates complex technical concepts to technical and non-technical stakeholders alike, with a passionate track record of mentoring senior engineers and raising the hiring bar.

Your Team

We power the in-store experience. The Technology team supports On’s stores with cutting-edge digital tools. For us, a personalized shopping experience goes hand-in-hand with efficiency. Tech makes it happen. So, we’re after innovative solutions — from point-of-sale systems to customer engagement platforms — all for the wow.

On is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating a work environment that is fair and inclusive, where all decisions related to recruitment, advancement, and retention are free of discrimination.

title: Project Engineer - Mechanical
description:
About The Role

RSE is seeking a motivated, mechanically biased Project Engineer to join our Asset Operations & Maintenance (AO&M) team, supporting mechanical and electrical works at operational hydroelectric generating stations. This is an excellent opportunity for an engineer who enjoys taking ownership of projects involving the replacement, refurbishment and life extension of turbines, pumps, valves and associated balance-of-plant systems, from initial site investigation and solution development through outage delivery, installation, commissioning and handover.

The AO&M team delivers maintenance, refurbishment, upgrade and optimisation projects across operational hydro assets, bridging the gap between engineering design, construction, maintenance, and operational performance. Working closely with generating station owners, operators, OEMs, suppliers, site teams and internal engineering disciplines, we provide practical solutions that improve plant safety, availability, reliability, maintainability and operational performance.

As a Project Engineer, you will play a key role in the successful delivery of projects, ensuring technical, commercial, programme, quality, and health & safety objectives are achieved.

What We Do

The AO&M team specialises in the delivery of projects involving:

• Mechanical, electrical and control system upgrades for hydroelectric generating stations
• Replacement and refurbishment of turbines, pumps, valves, penstock and waterway equipment, pipework and mechanical balance-of-plant systems
• Inspection, overhaul, repair and life extension of rotating and static plant
• Planned maintenance, condition-led interventions and lifecycle replacement schemes
• Plant performance, availability, efficiency and reliability improvements
• Planned outage support, breakdown response and reactive works
• Design and build solutions for existing operational hydro assets

Our projects are often delivered within live hydroelectric generating stations and brownfield operational environments. They require a practical and collaborative approach to engineering, outage planning, safe isolation, lifting and access, temporary works, installation sequencing, commissioning and return to service.

Key Responsibilities

As a Project Engineer, your responsibilities will include:

• Supporting mechanical and multidisciplinary engineering projects at UK hydroelectric generating stations from concept through to completion.
• Developing practical technical solutions for brownfield hydro assets, including replacement, refurbishment, overhaul and life-extension works for turbines, pumps, valves, pipework and associated mechanical plant.
• Coordinating mechanical, electrical, control, civil and structural interfaces, including foundations, embedded items, lifting arrangements, access platforms, drainage and station services.
• Undertaking site surveys and asset inspections, defining condition and scope, and preparing specifications, technical submissions, construction work packs, procurement packages, inspection and test plans, and commissioning plans.
• Managing turbine, pump and valve OEMs, specialist repairers, suppliers, subcontractors and installation contractors to achieve technical, safety, programme, quality and commercial requirements.
• Supporting outage definition and planning, including access, plant shutdown, mechanical and electrical isolations, dewatering and drainage, permits, lifting operations, temporary works, sequencing, scheduling and resource allocation.
• Ensuring compliance with client engineering standards, applicable UK legislation, CDM requirements, site safety rules, environmental controls and approved safe systems of work.
• Monitoring project costs, progress, risks, opportunities, technical queries, and change control.
• Participating in design reviews, constructability assessments, HAZID activities, lifting and temporary works reviews, maintainability assessments and technical risk reviews.
• Supporting strip-down, inspection, dimensional checks, repair, installation, alignment, testing, commissioning, wet testing, return-to-service and handover activities.
• Producing and reviewing calculations, drawings, survey and condition reports, inspection records, test documentation, commissioning records, operation and maintenance information and asset technical records.

What We Are Looking For

The ideal candidate will possess:

Essential

• Degree, HND, or equivalent qualification in Mechanical Engineering or a related discipline.
• Experience delivering mechanical engineering projects within hydroelectric generation, rotating equipment, water or wastewater, heavy process plant, or comparable regulated operational environments.
• Understanding of hydro-mechanical systems and equipment such as turbines, governors and actuators, main inlet and isolation valves, pumps, pipework, penstocks, cooling water, drainage and dewatering systems, lubrication systems, compressed air, lifting equipment and station auxiliary plant.
• Experience coordinating multidisciplinary engineering activities and interfaces on live operational, outage-led or brownfield sites.
• Awareness of outage delivery, mechanical and electrical isolations, permit-to-work arrangements, dewatering, confined spaces, lifting operations, commissioning and safe return to service.
• Commercial awareness and understanding of project controls, procurement, risk, change, and contract delivery.
• Ability to manage multiple workstreams and priorities across geographically dispersed UK sites.
• Full UK driving licence and willingness to travel to operational sites as required.

What Success Looks Like

The successful candidate will:

• Deliver hydro station mechanical and multidisciplinary projects safely, efficiently and to a high technical standard, including work during constrained outage and dewatering windows.
• Take ownership of project activities and drive technical, site, supplier, and interface issues through to resolution.
• Develop positive and lasting relationships with generating station owners, operators, OEMs, delivery partners and site teams.
• Improve asset availability, reliability, maintainability, resilience, and safe operational performance.
• Demonstrate a proactive and solutions-focused approach to engineering challenges in live hydro stations and brownfield operational environments.
• Contribute to the growth of RSE's AO&M hydro capability and continuous improvement across project delivery, safety, quality and asset performance.

What RSE Offer

To build successful teams and drive the level of quality that RSE is renowned for, we know we need the best people in the industry. Not only do we require the relevant skillsets, but we also need people with the right attitude and mentality to thrive and grow in an innovative and fast-paced environment. At RSE, you’ll be given every opportunity to set the path of your own career through our Business Streams and work within dynamic teams that will require you to rise to the challenge of working for a market leader.

• Industry-leading salary based on your experience.
• Hybrid Working (where applicable)
• Private Healthcare (Personal)
• Holiday Allowance of 31 days per year, rising to 33 days per year after 2 years’ service.
• Holiday Buy / Sell Scheme
• Company Pension Scheme
• Cycle to Work
• Discounted National Gym Membership
• Professional Fees Paid
• Employee Discount Platform
• EV/Hybrid Car Lease Scheme
• Access to our network of health professionals including mental health champions and Occupational Health Nurse.

title: Oracle Cloud Procure-to-Pay Manager
description:
Career level: Manager (CL7) | Location: London / Manchester / Edinburgh | Practice: Finance Reinvention Partner (Oracle)

Why this role

This role owns the Procure-to-Pay workstream end to end on large-scale Oracle Cloud finance transformation programmes, in front of the client — the full cycle from sourcing and requisitioning through to how suppliers are paid. It's a role to become the finance design authority clients rely on across P2P, and to grow into the practice's go-to for getting procurement and payables design right on Oracle Cloud.

Accenture is a leading solutions and services company. Our strategy is to be the reinvention partner of choice for our clients and to lead in the safe, widespread adoption of AI. We bring together our people, deep industry expertise and technology to deliver end-to-end outcomes for clients — and Finance is one of seven Reinvention Partners at the centre of that. Finance RP brings the CFO agenda to life for clients — stronger performance, sharper insight, and better control.

"Our clients want a partner that can help them reinvent—boldly, continuously and at speed… while continuously building the most client-focused, AI-enabled great place to work for our people—our Reinventors." — Julie Sweet, Chair and CEO

What You'll Bring

Procure-to-Pay expertise. Deep command of the Procure-to-Pay cycle in Oracle Cloud, from the finance lens: Oracle Cloud Procurement, Sourcing and Payables — requisition-to-receipt and invoice-to-pay, sourcing and procurement contracts, supplier and spend management, three-way match, and payables through to payment run. You know how P2P design flows through to accruals, working capital, cash and the close, and where the controls have to sit.

Procurement and payables process design. You design the P2P process end to end — how requisitions, purchase orders, receipts and invoices move, how exceptions and holds are handled, and how approvals and controls are set so finance can stand behind the numbers. You bring a clear view of procurement and sourcing processes and the challenges they throw up in a large organisation.

Procurement data structures. A strong grasp of the data underneath P2P — supplier and item master, spend categories and classification, and how those structures shape reporting and control. You've handled data migration and integration into Oracle Cloud, and the functional data conversion, transformation and reconciliation that make a cutover hold together.

Finance process context. A clear view of how P2P connects to financial close and controls — accruals, reconciliations, working capital — and to the adjacent finance processes it depends on.

Leading delivery. You lead the P2P workstream end to end — fit-to-standard, business process design, testing and deployment — as the primary finance design authority for the domain. You bring a clear view of the functional, application and technical implementation elements of an Oracle Cloud ERP programme, manage dependencies with adjacent finance processes, and work closely with Oracle delivery and integration teams while keeping ownership of the finance outcome. You lead functional teams across onshore and offshore delivery, facilitate design forums with senior procurement, finance and operational stakeholders, and keep programme leadership clear through structured status, issue management and decision recommendations.

Growing the practice. You contribute to how the practice grows — supporting proposals and bids, shaping P2P and procurement-transformation approaches, and building reusable assets and points of view.

Ways of working. We're increasingly an AI-first delivery team — bringing agentic tooling and orchestration into how we design, analyse and deliver, with our people owning the judgement and the outcome. An understanding of Oracle Cloud's own AI capabilities and agents, and of persona- and journey-led design, is a real plus.

Who You Are

You take ownership and lead from the front. You build trusted relationships with senior client stakeholders and coordinate procurement, finance and operational perspectives with confidence. You bring a collaborative leadership style and a value-led mindset — you can link P2P changes to better cash and working capital, fewer invoice exceptions and stronger spend control — and you develop the people around you. Running workshops, managing stakeholders and expectations, good judgement, critical thinking and clear decisions under pressure are second nature.

Things that set strong candidates apart: a track record (typically 7+ years) delivering Oracle Cloud P2P and procurement transformation on large-scale programmes; experience across complex, multi-entity or multi-country work; the confidence to lead senior client design discussions; and a professional finance or accounting qualification (ACA, ACCA, CIMA or equivalent industry experience).

If you have most of this and the drive to build the rest, we want to hear from you — tell us what you'd bring.

About Finance RP

Within Accenture, the Finance Reinvention Partner helps clients improve financial performance around the CFO agenda — driving best-in-class performance, and sharper insight and benchmarking across the enterprise. In the UK and Ireland, our Finance RP practice brings together finance strategy and the platforms it runs on, including SAP, Oracle, Workday and EPM.

You'd join our Platforms transformation offering within the practice: a growing team delivering large-scale, business-led finance transformations on Oracle Cloud, and building AI into how we deliver. It's a place to go deep on Procure-to-Pay and procurement transformation while staying close to the CFO agenda the work serves.

What's In It For You

Alongside a competitive salary and package (dependent on experience), you'll have an extensive benefits package including 30 days' holiday a year, private medical insurance, and 3 additional days' leave a year for charitable work of your choice.

Accenture is an equal opportunities employer and welcomes applications from all sections of society. Accenture reserves the right to close the role earlier should a suitable applicant be found.

Location- London

Level- Manager

Accenture Song accelerates growth and value for our clients by combining creativity, technology, and data-driven intelligence. Within Song, our Digital Commerce delivery practice helps organisations design, build, and scale modern digital commerce ecosystems — embedding Generative AI and Agentic AI into commerce to enable real-time personalisation, autonomous merchandising, and intelligent customer engagement at scale.

We are entering an exciting era of agentic commerce — where AI agents, conversational interfaces, and intelligent systems are reshaping how people discover, evaluate, and buy online. We are looking for experienced delivery leaders who are energised by this shift and want to lead the programmes that make it real for our clients.

You are an experienced commerce delivery manager with a track record of leading end-to-end implementation programmes — from platform selection and architecture through to go-live and value realisation. You have hands-on experience delivering major commerce platform programmes (e.g. Commercetools, Salesforce Commerce Cloud, Adobe Commerce) and are building a growing capability in agentic AI — whether through delivering agentic features on top of commerce platforms, or through implementing AI-native capabilities on cloud platforms such as Google Cloud or AWS.

You are as comfortable owning a delivery programme as you are shaping the approach with a client. You lead multi-disciplinary teams, manage risk and pace, and hold yourself accountable for quality outcomes. You bring strong client relationships and the credibility to operate at senior stakeholder level — and you are excited about what the next era of commerce will demand of you and your clients.

Key Responsibilities

• Owning end-to-end delivery of commerce transformation programmes — from discovery and architecture through build, testing, and go-live — ensuring programmes are on time, on budget, and delivering against agreed outcomes

• Leading the technical and functional delivery of major commerce platform implementations, including composable and headless architectures built on platforms such as Commercetools, Salesforce Commerce Cloud, Adobe Commerce, or MACH-aligned stacks

• Defining delivery approaches, programme structures, and workstream plans that are executable, well-governed, and appropriately resourced across engineering, solution architecture, QA, and integration

• Leading multi-disciplinary delivery teams — including engineers, architects, QA, and third-party partners — creating the conditions for high performance and clear accountability

• Managing client relationships at programme and senior stakeholder level, providing transparency on progress, risks, and decisions, and building trust through consistent delivery

• Overseeing the integration of commerce platforms with surrounding enterprise systems — including CRM, CDP, OMS, payments, PIM, and search — and ensuring architecture decisions are sound, scalable, and fit for purpose

• Leading the delivery of agentic commerce capabilities — including AI-powered personalisation, conversational commerce, intelligent search, and autonomous merchandising — integrated into commerce platforms or built on cloud AI services (e.g. Google Vertex AI, AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI)

• Driving build vs. buy decisions across commerce platforms, AI orchestration frameworks, and supporting infrastructure, bringing a point of view grounded in delivery experience

• Embedding responsible AI and governance principles into agentic delivery programmes — including auditability, explainability, and human-in-the-loop mechanisms

• Contributing to Accenture Song's commerce delivery capability — including shaping accelerators, reusable assets, delivery standards, and points of view that advance our market position

• Supporting the growth and development of delivery talent within the team, providing hands-on coaching and creating development opportunities for consultants and engineers

Required Experience

• :8 years of professional experience in technology delivery, with a track record of leading end-to-end implementation programmes at pace and scale

• Deep, hands-on experience delivering at least one major enterprise commerce platform — such as Commercetools, Salesforce Commerce Cloud, Adobe Commerce, SAP Commerce, or a composable / MACH-aligned architecture

• Strong understanding of commerce platform architecture — including API-led and microservices-based design, headless and composable patterns, and integration with enterprise systems

• Proven ability to lead multi-disciplinary delivery teams — including engineers, architects, QA, and third-party partners — across complex, multi-workstream programmes

• Experience managing senior client stakeholders — able to build trust, communicate delivery status with clarity, and navigate competing priorities and risks

• Working knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure) as deployment and infrastructure environments for commerce and AI systems

• Demonstrable interest in agentic commerce and AI — through delivery of AI-powered features, proof of concepts, or a developed understanding of how agentic capabilities integrate with commerce platforms

• Strong communication and leadership skills — able to set direction, hold teams accountable, and represent delivery credibly at C-suite level

Preferred Experience

• Hands-on experience delivering agentic AI capabilities on cloud platforms — such as Google Vertex AI Agent Builder, AWS Bedrock, or Azure OpenAI

• Familiarity with agentic AI frameworks and tooling — such as LangGraph, LangChain, LlamaIndex, or CrewAI — and how they are applied

• Experience with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) architectures, vector databases, and LLM-powered applications as part of a commerce or customer technology programme

• Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, containerisation, and cloud-native deployment practices for production commerce and AI systems

What’s in it for you:

Our Total Rewards consist of a competitive basic salary, annual performance bonus, opportunities to acquire equity and a wide range of health and wellbeing benefits. These include perks such as:

• Up to 30 days of leave to spend each year plus 3 extra volunteering days per year for charitable work of choice.

• Family-friendly and flexible work policies.

• Attractive pension plan with financial wellbeing support and resources.

• Private healthcare insurance plan and Mental Wellbeing support.

• Employee Assistance Programme, Career Development and Counselling.

• A range of generous Parental Leave offerings.

Flexibility and mobility are required to deliver this role as there will be requirements to spend time onsite with our clients and partners to enable delivery of the outstanding services we are known for.

Please note that with all our roles, you should expect some in-person time for collaboration, learning and building rapport with clients, peers, leaders and communities. As an employer, we will be as flexible as possible to support your specific work/life needs.

title: Information Security Advisor
description:
On behalf of the MOD DSTL, we are looking for a Information Security Advisor (Inside IR35) for a 12 Months contract based Hybrid/ in Salisbury.

The Ministry of Defence (MOD) is a central government department with a mission to protect our country and provide the ultimate guarantee of its security and independence, as well as helping to protect its values and interests abroad.

The MOD is one of the biggest public procurement organisations in Europe and the single largest customer for UK industry. It currently manages approximately £20 billion of spend on capital investments in equipment and infrastructure every year. Over the next decade the MOD is committed to spending over £190 billion on equipment and support. The MOD’s customers include both the armed forces and national security agencies, and it has a diverse range of requirements, including military fighting vehicles, education services, nuclear submarines and facilities management.

The MOD’s aim is to provide its armed forces with the best capabilities to enable them to protect the UK’s security and advance national interests, both now and in the long term.

To do this the MOD has an annual budget of almost £53 billion and a workforce comprising 197,000 people. of which 54,000 are civilians working for the UK MOD.

The work really matters; the MOD offers a range of engaging roles which have a direct impact on the quality of services they provide, in many locations across the UK. We support teams working in HR, Primary Health Care, Corporate Services, and many others.

As a Information Security Advisor, your main responsibilities will be:
* This role will provide support to the CISO largely working to the Deputy CISO. Duties will include leading network and application testing and subsequent remediation activity working with Dstl’s IT suppliers and Dstl’s assurance leads. Supporting policy / process generation and review. Provision of cyber security advice and best practice to the wider security community. Support to security practitioners within the Operations area, interpreting CISO strategic direction and intents into pragmatic risk balanced decisions. Advising on Cyber Risk Assessments and Cyber Improvement Plans

PLEASE NOTE: DV Clearance is an essential requirement for this role, as a minimum you must be willing & eligible to undergo checks. Please note, due to the exceptional requirements of this position (short-term nature of this role and speed at which we require a postholder in situ) preference may be given to candidates who meet all of the essential criteria and hold active security clearance.

Essential:
* Knowledge and experience of multi-site IP based networks, their operation, protection and monitoring.
* Experience of securing public cloud infrastructure and / or operational technology is extremely desirable.
* An ability to communicate complex ideas succinctly and clearly in writing and verbally is required.
* Experience in making sound decisions based on business risk is essential. Exposure to operating in a secure / defence environment is highly desirable.
* Experience in Cyber Risk Assessments and Cyber Improvement Plans is highly desirable.
* Active DV Clearance

Please be aware that this role can only be worked within the UK and not Overseas.

Disability Confident

As a Disability Confident employer, the MOD encourage applications from disabled and neurodivergent candidates. Applications from candidates who identify as having a disability and meet the essential criteria for the role will be prioritised for review. Where application volumes are high, additional role-specific and desirable criteria may be applied as part of the shortlisting process which may include holding active security clearance.

Armed Forces Covenant

As a signatory of the Armed Forces Covenant, the MOD welcome applications from veterans, service leavers, reservists and military spouses or partners. Applications from eligible candidates who meet the essential criteria for the role will be prioritised for review. Where application volumes are high, additional role-specific and desirable criteria may be applied as part of the shortlisting process which may include holding active security clearance.

In applying for this role, you acknowledge the following "this role falls in scope of the Off Payroll Working in the Public Sector legislation. Any rates of payment quoted will reflect the gross rate per day for the assignment and will be subject to appropriate taxes and statutory costs. As such the payment to the intermediary and your income resulting from this contract will be different.

title: Delivery Manager
description:
Scrum Master

Day Rate Negotiable (DoE) - Inside IR35

Reading / Remote (Occasional Office Requirement)

Initial 3 Months, view to extend

Your New Role

We are working with a fast growing SaaS organisation, who are looking to implement Agile working practices. As Scrum Master, you’ll work closely with Product, Business Analysis, C++ Development and QA teams to plan, manage and report on the delivery of upcoming releases. You’ll run the Scrum cadence, including sprint planning, reviews and retrospectives, while managing Jira workflows, capacity planning, dependencies, risks and blockers. This is a hands-on role where you’ll support the immediate delivery of the next release while also implementing tangible improvements to processes, tools and ways of working.

Ensuring Your Success

You’ll have strong experience working as a Scrum Master within an Agile software delivery environment, with a solid understanding of Scrum events, backlog refinement, estimation, forecasting and capacity planning. You’ll be confident using Jira for workflow configuration, boards, dashboards and reporting, and comfortable working with senior technical stakeholders, including engineers. You’ll also be a pragmatic Agile coach, able to improve processes within a lower-maturity environment without creating unnecessary bureaucracy, while providing clear reporting to CTO and SLT level.

In Return

You’ll join an established and successful software business where you’ll have the opportunity to make a genuine impact on how products are delivered. This is a hands-on Scrum Master position where you’ll be able to influence Agile maturity, improve release processes and work closely with Product, Engineering, QA and Business Analysis teams. Experience across SaaS or compliance software would be advantageous, alongside PSM, CSM, SAFe or equivalent certification, although proven delivery experience will be valued most highly.

title: Sales Manager, UK
description:
Location: Hybrid, Sunderland

Reporting to: Head of Sales and Commercial, UK

About Us

Curaleaf International is shaping the future of cannabis through its commitment to research and product excellence. Powered by a strong presence at all stages of the supply chain, its unique distribution network throughout Europe, Canada and Australasia brings together pioneering research with cutting-edge cultivation, extraction, and production. Amidst a rapid growth trajectory, the emphasis on quality and expertise aims to ensure the delivery of safe and legal cannabis.

Curaleaf International's network includes a clinic, pharmacy, and laboratory in the UK; cultivation and EU-GMP processing facilities in Portugal; an EU-GMP processing, quality assurance and research site in Spain; Four 20 Pharma wholesaler and distributor in Germany; a Polish wholesaler and clinic; and the EU-GMP producer Northern Green Canada.

Curaleaf International is part of Curaleaf Holdings, Inc., a leading international producer and distributor of consumer cannabis products.

The Opportunity

We're looking for a Sales Manager to lead commercial relationships across our B2B customer base- pharmacies, wholesalers and healthcare partners. You'll manage a sales team, own the B2B commercial pipeline, and join our Management Leadership Team to help shape strategy and priorities across the business.

This is a genuinely commercial role but one that sits inside a healthcare and regulatory framework. We're looking for someone who can combine strong sales instincts with the discipline and credibility needed to operate responsibly in a controlled-medicines environment.

What You'll Do

• Own and grow a portfolio of B2B accounts, building long-term, trust-based relationships
• Lead, coach and develop a small sales team, setting objectives and supporting their growth
• Deliver against agreed sales, margin and retention targets, with accurate pipeline forecasting
• Identify new commercial opportunities within approved customer segments and territory
• Act as the primary point of contact for key accounts, working cross-functionally with supply, quality and customer service
• Monitor market and competitor dynamics, feeding insight back into the business
• Represent Curaleaf professionally at trade and industry events, within the bounds of applicable codes of practice
• Maintain accurate CRM records and reporting against KPIs

Essential

What We're Looking For

• Demonstrable B2B sales and account-management experience, ideally in pharmaceutical, healthcare, life sciences or another regulated sector
• Experience managing a remote sales team
• A track record of meeting or exceeding commercial targets
• Strong relationship-building, negotiation and communication skills
• Comfortable working within a compliance-led environment
• Well organised, with strong commercial numeracy and CRM discipline
• Full UK driving licence and willingness to travel within the territory

Desirable

• Experience selling into pharmacies, clinics or wholesalers
• Understanding of the UK medical cannabis or controlled-drugs landscape
• Experience coaching or mentoring others

Operating in a Regulated Environment

This isn't a typical sales role, and we're not looking for a typical sales background. You'll be trusted to build commercial relationships with pharmacies, clinics and wholesalers while working confidently within the UK regulatory framework that governs medical cannabis and controlled drugs - think MHRA requirements, GPhC-registered pharmacy context, Home Office considerations, and the codes of practice that shape how we engage with healthcare professionals.

You'll also be the kind of person who speaks up: if something doesn't look right from a compliance, quality or regulatory perspective, you'll raise it quickly and through the right channels.

What We Offer

• Competitive base salary plus performance related bonus
• Generous holiday allowance
• Private medical insurance
• Group Life Assurance

Curaleaf International is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. We value individuals from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives, and we embrace the unique qualities each person brings. When you apply, please let us know of any reasonable adjustments you may need during the interview process.

title: Lead Mechanical Engineer
description:
Build Something From the Ground Up.

Hybrid Asset Solutions is expanding and we're looking for an experienced Mechanical Engineer to become the first mechanical hire in our growing Southern Hub.

This is an opportunity to join at the start of an exciting growth journey. You'll provide technical expertise across commercial gas, plumbing and mechanical systems while helping shape the future of our southern operation.

You'll work closely with our Engineering Manager and leadership team, supporting contract mobilisation, developing standards, and playing a key role in the future growth of the engineering team.

If you're looking for more responsibility, greater influence and the chance to help build something from the ground up, we'd love to hear from you!

The Role

As our Lead Mechanical Engineer, you'll be responsible for delivering high-quality mechanical maintenance and compliance services across London and the South East. Initially, you'll be a hands-on engineer working directly with clients and contracts, whilst helping establish the foundations for future growth in the region.

Key Responsibilities

Technical Delivery

• Deliver maintenance, fault finding and repair works across commercial gas, plumbing and mechanical systems.
• Support clients across London and the South East.
• Act as a technical point of contact for engineers and operational teams.
• Carry out site surveys, inspections and asset condition reviews.
• Support the mobilisation of new maintenance contracts.

Supporting Growth

• Work alongside the Engineering Manager to identify future resource requirements.
• Support recruitment activities, including technical interviews and trade assessments.
• Assist with onboarding and mentoring new engineers as the southern team grows.
• Help establish standards, processes and best practice within the region.

Quality & Compliance

• Ensure all works are completed safely and in line with industry standards.
• Deliver excellent customer service and maintain strong client relationships.
• Support toolbox talks, technical coaching and continuous improvement initiatives.
• Help maintain consistency with the quality standards delivered across the wider business.

What We're Looking For

Essential

• 5-10 years' experience within commercial gas, plumbing and mechanical maintenance environments.
• Experience working on commercial plant room systems.
• CCN1, CENWAT, CKR1 and HTR1 qualifications.
• A recognised NVQ Level 3 (or equivalent) in Gas, Plumbing or Mechanical Engineering.
• Strong fault-finding and problem-solving skills.
• Good knowledge of working across London and the South East.
• Full UK driving licence.
• Experience mentoring, supporting or supervising engineers would be advantageous.

Desirable

• COCN1, CODNCO1, ICPN1, TPCP1/TPCP1A, CDGA1 and CORT1.
• Experience supporting contract mobilisation or business growth.
• Experience within residential, build-to-rent or commercial maintenance environments.
• Experience using CAFM or job management systems.

What You'll Bring

• Pride in delivering high-quality work.
• Strong communication skills and a collaborative approach.
• The confidence to support and develop less experienced engineers.
• A proactive mindset and willingness to take ownership.
• A desire to grow into a more senior leadership role over time.

Why Join Hybrid Asset Solutions?

• £55,000 - £60,000 per annum
• 25 days holiday + 8 bank holidays
• Company van.
• Company pension.
• Ongoing training and professional development.
• Company events and team socials.
• Referral programme.
• Opportunity to play a key role in the growth of our southern operation.
• Clear progression opportunities as the business expands.

What Success Looks Like

First 3 Months

• Familiar with key contracts, sites and client requirements.
• Delivering high-quality maintenance and reactive works.
• Building strong relationships with clients and colleagues.

By 6 Months

• Supporting contract growth and mobilisation activities.
• Acting as a trusted technical representative for the southern region.
• Helping onboard and support additional engineering resource where required.

By 12 Months

• Established as a key member of the southern operation.
• Supporting a growing engineering team.
• Playing an active role in shaping the future direction of mechanical services within the region.

Inclusive recruitment

We’re committed to an inclusive process. If there’s anything we can adjust to help you perform at your best, such as extra time or questions in advance or a different interview format, Nora,

our Talent Partner, know at careers@hybridsolutionsgroup.co.uk. You don’t need to explain why, and it won’t affect your application.
