description:
Job Application for Senior Marketing Manager, Commercial Marketing (Grocery & Retail) at Deliveroo

Back to jobs

tags.new

Senior Marketing Manager, Commercial Marketing (Grocery & Retail)

London, United Kingdom - Deliveroo

Apply

Our Global Structure

Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

About the team

Deliveroo connects millions of consumers with the restaurants and brands they love. Our Integrated Marketing team sits at the heart of how we bring those relationships to life — combining customer insight, commercial opportunity and creativity to drive growth for Deliveroo and our partners.

Within Central Integrated Marketing, the Merchant & Ads team sets the global strategy for how we partner with merchants to help them grow on our marketplace and create compelling reasons for consumers to choose Deliveroo. This is an opportunity to shape Deliveroo’s global approach to merchant partnerships, building high-impact collaborations with some of the world’s most recognised and loved brands. This will be a hybrid role - working 3 days a week from our London HQ.

About the role

• Owns the New Verticals merchant and ads marketing strategy end to end, reporting into the Merchant & Ads Integrated Marketing Director.
• Responsible for the creation and deployment of New Verticals merchant marketing playbooks across co marketing, promotions, and ads.
• Responsible for the creation and deployment of the New Verticals sell in strategy and associated sell in materials for adoption by local teams.
• Supports local marketing teams with key enterprise merchant relationships at the global level, and supports local New Verticals marketing initiatives.

What you'll be doing

Ads & Monetization Strategy

• Own the New Verticals specific ads and monetization strategy across owned and external surfaces, feeding into the global monetization strategy.
• Lead pricing, packaging, and investment decisions for merchant advertising in your category, in partnership with Commercial and Finance.

Category Playbook: New Verticals

• Own and evolve the New Verticals merchant marketing playbook, setting how co marketing, promotions, and advertising work for grocery and retail merchants globally.
• Lead change initiatives that improve how New Verticals merchant marketing works, bringing Local Integrated Marketing and Functional Marketing along with you.

Key Merchant Relationship Management

• Support local marketing teams with key enterprise merchant relationships at the global level, and support delivery of priority New Verticals marketing initiatives with those merchants.
• Act as the senior escalation point for merchant issues that cross multiple markets or functions.

Cross Functional Stakeholder Management

• Serve as the primary marketing partner to Merchant S&O and Commercial for New Verticals, translating category priorities into marketing and ads strategy.
• Represent New Verticals in cross functional forums, shaping the roadmap for merchant facing and ads facing surfaces.

Sell In Strategy & Sales Enablement

• Own the sell-in strategy for New Verticals merchant and ads programmes, defining how Commercial and Local teams pitch these programmes to merchants.
• Oversee the sell in materials, case studies, and proof points for New Verticals, using performance data to continuously refine them.

Central Strategy & Market Coordination

• Own delivery of the New Verticals merchant marketing goals, coordinating a consistent strategy across all Deliveroo markets.
• Report on New Verticals merchant and ads marketing performance to senior stakeholders, own specific business metrics, and lead course correction when needed.

Requirements

• 7+ years of marketing experience, ideally including merchant marketing, retail media, ads, or category marketing in a consumer or marketplace business.
• Track record of owning the marketing strategy for an entire team or category, and resolving complex delivery challenges that span multiple teams or functions.
• Experience managing people, and comfortable managing other people managers as your team grows.
• Strong commercial acumen, seen as a go to expert for merchant or ads marketing, using business and financial data to make sound decisions in ambiguous situations.
• Confident communicator, able to present complex ideas to large groups and flex your style for directors and department leadership.
• Skilled at establishing and owning cross functional partnerships, using relationships and creative thinking to work through conflict.
• Proven ability to lead change initiatives that improve how a team or category works, bringing others along with you.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to synthesise complex, cross functional inputs into a clear plan and narrative.

Why Join Us?

At Deliveroo, you’ll do work that matters, solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that’s constantly evolving. We’re food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to:

🔧 Make a visible impact every day

Your work directly improves experiences for customers, partners and riders.

🌱 Learn fast in an entrepreneurial environment

Work close to the market with autonomy, pace and real responsibility.

🧠 Build a career, not just a role

Stretch yourself, develop new skills and grow as the business evolves.

🌎 Deliver together in an inclusive culture

Collaborative, values-driven teams that support how you work best.

We aim to create a fair process that lets your skills shine—our interview typically includes 3-4 stages. Find more about how we hire here.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We’re committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you’ll have the opportunity to let us know once you’ve submitted your application. We’ll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

If you’re excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we’d love to hear from you!

Beware of recruitment scams: DASH Brands will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about DASH Brands' legitimate recruiting process at careersatdoordash.com/recruitment-scam-awareness.

title: Java Backend Developer
description:
Kim jesteśmy?

Cześć, nazywamy się Bee Talents i od 2015 roku zajmujemy się budowaniem zespołów w branży IT na całym świecie. Dziś zapraszamy Cię do procesu rekrutacyjnego dla ITFS - firmy specjalizującej się w outsourcingu i rekrutacji IT, tworzeniu centrów kompetencyjnych oraz usługach HR i payroll.

ITFS buduje zespoły Java dla swojego klienta - międzynarodowej instytucji z sektora bankowego. W ramach tej współpracy otwartych jest obecnie ponad 20 ról Java, a ITFS ma już w tym projekcie osoby, które z powodzeniem dołączyły do zespołów klienta.

Projekt obejmuje wysokowydajne platformy czasu rzeczywistego oparte na streamingu i danych szeregów czasowych, procesy biznesowe budowane na silnikach BPM (Flowable) oraz obszar Client Lifecycle. Masz okazję pracować w międzynarodowych zespołach, z nowoczesnym stackiem (m.in. Kafka, Kubernetes, Azure). Współpraca jest długofalowa: pierwsza umowa zawierana jest na rok, z możliwością przedłużenia.

Dlatego dziś zapraszamy do współpracy kilka osób na rolę Senior Java Developer, które wzmocnią zespoły projektowe w Krakowie.

Warunki współpracy:

🎯 Oferowane stanowisko: Senior Java Developer (Flowable / BPM)
💰 Oferta: 140 - 170 PLN/h netto + VAT (B2B z ITFS)
⏱ Wymiar pracy: pełen etat, standardowe godziny biznesowe (start elastycznie między 8:00 a 9:00)
👩‍💻 Tryb pracy: hybrydowy, 3 dni w tygodniu z biura w Krakowie
📍 Lokalizacja biura: Kraków
📅 Umowa: na rok, z możliwością przedłużenia
🇬🇧 Język pracy: angielski (min. B2), polski mile widziany.

Codzienne zadania:

• projektowanie i rozwój rozwiązań w oparciu o Javę, Spring Boot i architekturę mikroserwisową,
• tworzenie wysokowydajnych, wysokoprzepustowych platform czasu rzeczywistego, opartych na streamingu i danych szeregów czasowych,
• budowanie rozwiązań z wykorzystaniem Kafki i usług Azure,
• zabezpieczanie rozwiązań z użyciem Azure AD i OAuth,
• praca z silnikiem procesów Flowable (lub podobnym),
• współpraca z międzynarodowymi zespołami technologicznymi i przekładanie wymagań biznesowych na rozwiązania wdrażane globalnie.

Co będzie Ci potrzebne?

• Doświadczenie komercyjne w Javie - minimum 10 lat pracy jako Java Developer
• Mikroserwisy i Spring Boot - bardzo dobra znajomość Javy, Spring Boot i architektury mikroserwisowej
• Kafka, Kubernetes i Maven - praktyczne, codzienne doświadczenie z tymi narzędziami
• Chmura i bezpieczeństwo - znajomość Azure (w tym Azure AD i OAuth), a także REST i Dockera
• Bazy danych i ORM - doświadczenie z JPA lub iBatis oraz bazami takimi jak PostgreSQL, CosmosDB czy Redis
• Systemy czasu rzeczywistego - doświadczenie w budowie rozwiązań opartych na streamingu danych
• Nowoczesne praktyki wytwarzania oprogramowania - doświadczenie w AI-assisted software development i dobra znajomość SDLC
• Komunikatywny angielski - poziom min. B2, który pozwala swobodnie rozmawiać o kwestiach technicznych w międzynarodowym zespole
• Współpraca B2B - prowadzenie działalności gospodarczej w Polsce lub możliwość jej założenia.

Mile widziane: doświadczenie z Flowable lub podobnym silnikiem BPM (np. Camunda, Activiti, jBPM, Appian), Gradle, doświadczenie w bankowości lub obszarze Client Lifecycle, znajomość języka polskiego.

Co dostaniesz w zamian?

• Stawkę 140 - 170 PLN/h netto + VAT w modelu B2B z ITFS
• Długofalową współpracę - pierwszą umowę na rok, z możliwością przedłużenia
• Stabilnego klienta z sektora bankowego
• Pracę przy dużych, wymagających systemach czasu rzeczywistego
• Nowoczesny stack technologiczny (Kafka, Kubernetes, Azure)
• Pracę w międzynarodowych zespołach
• Elastyczny start dnia pracy (między 8:00 a 9:00)
• Pakiet medyczny i sportowy

title: Controls Engineer
description:
Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.

We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.

Here’s what this particular role covers.

🛠️ About our Robotics Team

The Robotics team is responsible for bridging the gap from our model to our vehicle platforms, in order to let the model focus on making driving decisions. We aim to provide high quality data to the model for making such decisions, whilst abstracting away platform-specific aspects. We combine specialisms across the robotics domain, blending strong theoretical foundations with solid engineering practice to span the spectrum from research to production.

🧠 Your day-to-day

• Develop, integrate, tune, and validate control, trajectory-generation, and action-processing algorithms across different vehicle platforms, operating modes, and challenging driving conditions, ensuring robust real-world performance
• Maintain and evolve our controls software architecture that connects AI Driver outputs to real-time vehicle actuation and feedback
• Own requirements, release readiness, and in-field performance and issue triage
• Implement and maintain production-quality, latency-sensitive control software in C++ for deployment to prototype, reference and production vehicles
• Use simulation, closed-loop evaluation and on-road testing to characterize controller behaviour, diagnose performance issues and validate improvements
• Work with teams across Wayve to define controller interfaces, integrate with adjacent systems and enable new vehicle platforms and product features (Ownership through the full lifecycle)
• Define and track quality metrics (e.g., comfort, tracking error, and safety margin KPIs, and regressions against them)
• Contribute to safety artefacts: provide evidence for safety cases, work with the safety team to ensure compliance with required standards

🧩 What you’ll be working on:

In this role you will develop and improve the vehicle trajectory and motion controllers that translate the Wayve AI Driver outputs into safe, smooth and robust vehicle motion across different vehicle platforms and applications (both ADAS and AV). You’ll tackle cutting-edge challenges: developing principled controls approaches, implementing real time systems, testing in complex scenarios and refining our evaluation pipelines. This is a great chance to make an impact on the AV industry and grow alongside a focused team of passionate experts at the forefront of autonomous driving technology.

🙌 You should apply if you have:

Required Skills/Experience

• Strong fundamentals in control theory, with applied experience in one or more of optimization, model-predictive control, numerical methods or dynamical systems
• Practical experience developing, tuning and validating motion control on complex real world physical systems (e.g., direct experience with mobile robotics and/or autonomous vehicles)
• Experience with test and validation discipline: unit and integration tests, simulation regression suites, closed-loop metrics.
• Strong software engineering skills, with experience building reliable production-quality systems in C++
• Experience with latency-sensitive or real-time software
• Ability to reason about and debug system-level behaviour in complex robotic systems across software and hardware

Desired Skills/Experience

• Applied machine learning experience, or experience developing systems that integrate with ML components
• Vehicle dynamics and actuation. Steering, braking and powertrain interfaces, actuator delay models, and CAN or similar vehicle bus experience
• Experience in the automotive industry, including ADAS or vehicle controls
• Experience with safety-critical systems, validation, and relevant industry standards (e.g. ISO 26262)
• Experience with monitoring and diagnostics: Logging, fault detection, and on-platform debugging tools, ideally with experience investigating field issues
• Experience across multiple platforms or vehicles. The team supports vehicle-to-vehicle variation, such as accounting for parameter identification, calibration, and keeping one software stack across hardware variants

🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement.

More about Wayve:

🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once in a generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human driven vehicles to intelligent machines.

Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve’s mapless and hardware agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution and unlocking advanced levels of automation from L2 plus through to L4 as our core AI model scales. In a race increasingly defined by intelligence and real world learning, Wayve is taking a distinct approach, building a generalisable driving intelligence that can power any vehicle, anywhere. By combining embodied AI with scalable deployment, we are creating technology that can be shaped to each OEM brand and driver experience, accelerating the transition to a safer, more intelligent future of mobility.

How we work 💻- Locations & Flexible Working:

Our main hubs are in London, Sunnyvale, Yokohama, Herzliya, Vancouver and Leonberg. We operate a hybrid working model that combines in-person collaboration in our dedicated office spaces with focused time working remotely. This gives our teams the connection and energy of working together, alongside the flexibility to do their best work in a way that fits their lives.

🔍 The Interview Process:

Our process is clear and respectful of your time:

• Initial call / recruiter screen: general background, current situation, interests and Wayve company information & hiring context.
• Competency Interviews: programming and code review.
• Deep-dive technical interviews: domain knowledge & system design.
• Final interview: mission & values alignment.

We’ll always explain the format and work around your availability.

What’s in it for you (Location dependant):

💰 Salaries benchmarked against the market annually
📈 Meaningful equity, sharing in the ownership and long term success of Wayve
✈️ Relocation support and visa sponsorship where applicable
✅ Hybrid working, core hours and the chance to work hands on in vehicle workshops and labs
📚 Learning and development budgets with support for training, conferences and growth
🩺 Comprehensive benefits including health insurance, dental, enhanced maternity and paternity leave, retirement or pension where applicable, access to therapists, wellbeing partnerships, team socials and more

A quick, honest note before you apply.

Wayve is not a mature, fully-structured place with the playbook already written. Much of how we work is still being written, and if you join, you’ll help write it. That suits people who want real ownership more than people who need a settled structure from day one.

If that sounds like the kind of problem you want to spend your time on, we’d really like to hear from you.

At Wayve we're committed to creating a diverse, fair and respectful culture that is inclusive of everyone based on their unique skills and perspectives, and regardless of sex, race, religion or belief, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, citizenship, marital, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding) or any other basis as protected by applicable law.

For more information visit Careers at Wayve. To learn more about what drives us, visit Values at Wayve

DISCLAIMER: We will not ask about marriage or pregnancy, care responsibilities or disabilities in any of our job adverts or interviews. However, we do look to capture information about care responsibilities, and disabilities among other diversity information as part of an optional DEI Monitoring form to help us identify areas of improvement in our hiring process and ensure that the process is inclusive and non-discriminatory.

title: Development Chef
description:
Development Chef (NPD)

📍 London | 🥗 Food-to-Go Industry

Who We Are

Simply Lunch is a rapidly growing, private family-owned food-to-go manufacturer based in London. Our commitment to delicious food and our local communities has been central to our South London business since it was founded in 1979. Today, we are as committed as ever to creating high-quality hand-crafted products, made to improve lives and protect our beautiful planet. All our food is handmade at our facility in South London with the same care, love and admiration that we’ve shown since day one. Our talented team fuels the success at Simply Lunch, combining expertise and passion to craft products that improve lives through delicious food.

The Role

This is an exciting, hands-on role where you’ll support the development of innovative food-to-go products, helping bring new ideas to life from concept through to launch.

You’ll work closely with the NPD team, chefs, and cross-functional departments to ensure products are not only delicious and on-trend, but also commercially viable and scalable for production. If you thrive in a fast-paced environment and have a passion for food innovation, this could be the perfect opportunity.

Key Responsibilities

• Support the development of new and innovative food-to-go products from concept through to launch
• Assist in recipe creation, refinement, and costings to meet quality and commercial targets
• Prepare and present samples for internal reviews, customer presentations, and product submissions
• Conduct kitchen trials and support factory trials to ensure successful scale-up into production
• Maintain accurate documentation including recipes, specifications, and trial records
• Work closely with Technical, Production, and Procurement teams to ensure feasibility and compliance
• Ensure all development work meets food safety, quality, and technical standards
• Monitor food trends, competitor products, and market insights to inspire innovation
• Support continuous improvement of existing products and processes
• Maintain a clean, organised, and efficient development kitchen

What We’re Looking For

Experience & Qualifications:

• Experience in a professional kitchen or food manufacturing environment
• Exposure to product development or strong interest in NPD
• Understanding of food safety, quality standards, and kitchen best practices
• Experience working in high-volume or fast-paced environments

Key Skills:

• Passion for food and innovation
• Strong organisational and time management skills
• Good communication and teamwork skills
• Attention to detail and a quality-focused mindset
• Ability to adapt and work in a fast-moving environment
• Creative approach to food development
• Problem-solving mindset and willingness to learn

What You’ll Get in Return

At Simply Lunch, we believe our people are at the heart of our success. We’re committed to creating an environment where you can thrive, grow, and genuinely enjoy coming to work.

✨ Great perks & culture

• Free lunch and beverages every day
• Regular social events – from summer & Christmas parties to BBQs, pizza days, sweet treats, and even ice cream vans

📈 Career development & growth

• Ongoing training and development opportunities

• Pension scheme

• Discounted car repairs and MOT

🚴 Health & wellbeing

• Gym scheme
• Cycle to Work scheme
• Access to mental health champions
• Wellbeing and support services

🌍 Time & giving back

• Long service awards to celebrate your commitment

Why Join Us?

This is more than just a role, it’s an opportunity to be part of a growing, ambitious business where you can develop your skills, contribute to exciting product innovation, and build a long-term career within food manufacturing.

Diversity and Inclusion

Like many other organisations, we are considering with renewed focus what Diversity means to us. What may have been acceptable a short time ago is not sufficient for the future, so we are dedicating a lot of time and resources to creating a workplace where everyone feels valued and respected, especially those who are often excluded or underrepresented. If you feel that you do not see yourself represented either in this sector or in this professional area because of any part of your identity that makes you unique, we would especially like to hear from you.

• No weekends

title: Oracle Cloud ERP Finance Technical Consultant
description:
Career level: Consultant / Associate Manager (CL9–CL8) | Location: London / Manchester / Edinburgh | Practice: Finance Reinvention Partner (Oracle)

Why this role

This role builds the Oracle Cloud finance solutions our clients run their books on. You'll take a finance design and turn it into a working, tested, migrated system that stands up at go-live and holds together afterwards. That means the configuration, the build specifications, the integrations and the data conversion behind them, and the evidence that it all works. You'll do it on large-scale Oracle Cloud ERP finance transformations, with real ownership of your own scope: a workstream lead sets the direction and owns the design authority, while you own the build within it and the technical decisions that come with it.

You'll do that work from inside the client's finance function, in their design sessions, alongside their controllers and their IT team. You'll explain why the system behaves the way it does to people who will never open a configuration screen, hold a design decision when it is challenged, and become the person a client comes back to when the answer has to be right. We're hiring for both halves of that: the technical depth, and the judgement to carry it in front of a client.

Accenture is a leading solutions and services company. Our strategy is to be the reinvention partner of choice for our clients and lead in the safe, widespread adoption of AI. We bring together our people, deep industry expertise and technology to deliver end-to-end outcomes for clients — and Finance is one of seven Reinvention Partners at the centre of that. Finance RP brings the CFO agenda to life for clients — stronger performance, sharper insight, and better control.

"Our clients want a partner that can help them reinvent—boldly, continuously and at speed… while continuously building the most client-focused, AI-enabled great place to work for our people—our Reinventors." — Julie Sweet, Chair and CEO

What You'll Bring

Oracle Cloud configuration depth. Hands-on configuration of Oracle Cloud ERP Financials (Oracle Fusion Cloud Financials) across the core finance modules: General Ledger, Payables, Receivables, Fixed Assets, Cash Management, Tax and Intercompany, plus the enterprise and ledger structures underneath them. You configure it, you test it, and you can stand behind why it is set up the way it is. That extends into Oracle Subledger Accounting, where you understand how transactions are accounted and how to configure the rules that decide it; consolidation and close in FCCS; and enterprise data and chart-of-accounts structures in EDMCS. You stay on standard, extending Oracle the way it is designed to be extended rather than modifying it, and you can explain to a client why that boundary is worth holding. Experience across the wider Oracle finance estate, including the EPM suite and planning in EPBCS, broadens where you can work. The platform matters less than the rigour you bring, so comparable cloud finance platforms are worth talking to us about.

Design, build and integration. You translate finance requirements into functional designs and into build specifications a developer can work from, covering reports, interfaces, data conversions, extensions, workflow and integrations. You build the reporting yourself in BI Publisher, OTBI and Smart View, and you have worked hands-on with Oracle's integration patterns across Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC) and REST and SOAP web services. Data migration and conversion sits with you, using FBDI and ADFdi, so a cutover holds. Where the standard product doesn't reach, you extend it properly, in a sandbox and through Visual Builder. You take the solution through testing and into deployment, and you know what evidence a client needs before they will sign it off.

Finance process knowledge. Genuine Record-to-Report depth, with a feel for how your configuration choices show up for the CFO: a faster close, numbers people trust, stronger control. You understand enterprise structures and chart-of-accounts design and the finance master data underneath them, how finance controls are built into the configuration rather than bolted on afterwards, and how those choices shape reporting downstream. Exposure to a second finance process area broadens your range.

Delivery and client skills. You own your scope and see it through. You make the configuration and design calls within it, document them, and explain them to the client and to the workstream lead without either needing to check your working line by line. You're at ease in front of a client: running a working session with finance and IT stakeholders, walking them through what you've built, taking the questions it raises, and turning a technical constraint into what it means for their close, their controls and their reporting. You are straight with people about what the system will and won't do, and you say so early, not late. You bring structured, analytical problem-solving and communicate clearly under pressure, and you support the people around you by reviewing a colleague's configuration, bringing someone newer through a build, and passing on what is worth reusing on the next programme.

Ways of working. We're increasingly an AI-first delivery team, bringing agentic tooling and orchestration into how we design, build, test and validate, with our people owning the judgement and the outcome. An appreciation of Oracle's own embedded Fusion AI and agents, and how they augment a finance solution, is a real plus, and we're keen to hear from people bringing that experience.

Who You Are

You take ownership and follow through without being chased. You work well in a delivery team and build straightforward, trusted working relationships with client counterparts. You can explain a technical decision to someone who isn't technical: plainly, without talking down and without hiding behind the detail. You bring good judgement to ambiguous problems and you're careful and clear in how you make and explain technical decisions. You know which calls are yours and which belong to the workstream lead, and you raise the second kind early. You're precise about detail and thorough about proof. You test your own configuration and satisfy yourself it holds before you report it as complete.

Things that set strong candidates apart: Oracle certification; hands-on configuration experience on end-to-end Oracle Cloud ERP finance implementations, from early design through to go-live; depth in the Oracle finance suite, whether subledger accounting, consolidation (FCCS) or enterprise data (EDMCS); reporting build in BI Publisher or OTBI; integration and data-conversion experience on Oracle Cloud across Oracle Integration Cloud, REST and SOAP services and FBDI; an awareness of how controls, master data and staying on standard shape a finance solution; and a professional finance or accounting qualification (ACA, ACCA, CIMA or equivalent industry experience).

If you have most of this and the drive to build the rest, we want to hear from you — tell us what you'd bring.

About Finance RP

Within Accenture, the Finance Reinvention Partner helps clients improve financial performance around the CFO agenda — driving best-in-class performance, and sharper insight and benchmarking across the enterprise. In the UK and Ireland, our Finance RP practice brings together finance strategy and the platforms it runs on, including SAP, Oracle, Workday and EPM.

You'd join our Platforms transformation offering within the practice: a growing team delivering Oracle Cloud finance transformations for finance functions, and building AI into how we deliver. It's a place to go deep on the Oracle build while staying close to the CFO agenda the work serves. We're a close team that enjoys working together and keeps asking whether there's a better way to do the work than last time. We deliberately put platform, process, data, AI and advisory backgrounds on the same team, because the mix gives a client a better-informed answer than any one of them does alone.

description:
Who We Are

Since 1843, The Economist Group has championed independence, excellence and openness, helping people understand and tackle the critical challenges shaping the world. Today, we are building on that legacy as a global media and information-services company powered by digital innovation, analytical rigour and evidence-based insight.

Across our three businesses -The Economist, Economist Enterprise and Economist Education - we deliver trusted analysis and insights to individuals and organisations in more than 170 countries. United by a shared purpose to drive progress, we empower decision-makers to make sense of change and chart a course through an increasingly complex world.

As a colleague, you will be part of a culture that values ideas, encourages ownership and holds itself to high standards. We invest in people who are curious, thoughtful and adaptable, whether they are launching new products, reporting on global events or harnessing emerging technologies such as AI to improve how we work. Here, fresh thinking is taken seriously, ambition is matched by integrity, and great work is recognised. Working across disciplines, geographies and perspectives, we are united by a commitment to innovation, excellence and creating meaningful impact.

Want to discover more about life at The Economist Group? Follow @EconomistCareers on Instagram to discover the people, stories and opportunities that make TEG unique.

Technology, Product & Data

Our team of 450 colleagues across Technology, Product and Data is at the heart of The Economist Group’s digital-first agenda. Together, we design, build and optimise the digital products, platforms and data capabilities that power our business and reach millions of people around the world. Whether you're an engineer, product manager, designer, data scientist or analyst, you'll work on products that have real-world impact. From enhancing economist.com and developing new products for Economist Intelligence to creating personalised experiences and applying AI to solve complex challenges, you'll help shape how consumers, businesses and government leaders access trusted insights. Working in cross-functional teams, we combine engineering excellence, product thinking and data expertise to solve meaningful problems, experiment with new technologies and continuously improve the experiences we create. It's an opportunity to do challenging, purposeful work alongside curious, collaborative colleagues, while helping drive sustainable growth for one of the world's most trusted brands.

The Role

Our AI Platform team builds the technology that powers AI-enabled products and services, for internal users and external customers. We design, build and operate the infrastructure, patterns and reusable capabilities that enable generative and agentic AI, natural language processing, predictive analytics and machine learning across the Group, from customer-facing features in our digital products to the internal tools used by colleagues across our four businesses.

Scope

We are seeking an Engineering Manager to lead our Applied AI and Data Science team: a multidisciplinary group of AI Engineers, ML Engineers, NLP Engineers and Data Scientists. This is a player-coach role. You will own the health, delivery and growth of the team while remaining a hands-on contributor to its work, writing and reviewing code, shaping architecture and stepping into implementation when it matters.

The team’s work spans generative and agentic AI systems built on large language models, alongside the NLP and predictive models that sit behind our products and internal tools. You will turn the Group’s AI ambitions into well-architected, production-grade systems, working in close partnership with the Head of AI and Data Engineering, product managers, data engineers and business stakeholders to decide what we build, why we build it, and how we know it is working. You will also champion the team’s move to AI-native engineering, with coding agents used across the whole software development lifecycle.

Accountabilities

• Lead and manage the team. Provide day-to-day management, mentorship and career development, and build one team across engineering and data science disciplines.
• Own delivery. Own planning, resourcing, prioritisation and delivery with product management, balancing exploratory work against production commitments.
• Communicate progress. Keep leadership and stakeholders informed on progress, risks and trade-offs, and set realistic expectations of what AI can deliver.
• Stay hands on. Contribute directly to the team’s deliverables: build, prototype, review code and models, and step into implementation when it matters.
• Contribute to technical and architectural decisions. Shape the architecture of our agentic AI, RAG, NLP and ML systems, covering agent design, model selection and build-versus-buy.
• Oversee the development of safe and reliable agents. Ensure our agents have well-scoped tool permissions, guardrails and human-in-the-loop controls, and are evaluated end to end before and after release.
• Ensure quality, security and compliance. Set standards for code quality, testing, evaluation, observability and cost, and keep AI systems secure, well-architected and compliant.
• Champion AI-native engineering. Embed AI coding agents across the SDLC of the team, from specification and design to code, tests and review, with clear standards for AI-generated code.
• Partner with others. Work with Product, Data Engineering, Security, Legal and the business units, challenging requirements and using metrics to define what “done” looks like.
• Hire and grow the team. Recruit, interview and onboard engineers and data scientists, shaping the team’s skills mix to match the AI roadmap.
• Drive best practices and ways of working. Improve CI/CD, experiment tracking and the path to production, and promote the team’s capabilities across the Group.

Selection criteria

Essential

• A track record as an engineering manager or tech lead with direct people-management responsibility for AI/ML engineers, NLP engineers and/or data scientists.
• Experience balancing hands-on technical contribution with people leadership and delivery ownership.
• Strong hands-on AI/ML engineering background, with extensive Python experience and confidence reviewing code across LLM, agentic, NLP and classical ML systems.
• Hands-on experience with modern agent frameworks such as Strands Agents, LangGraph or the Claude Agent SDK, and with interoperability standards such as MCP and A2A.
• Strong cloud-native expertise on AWS, especially Amazon Bedrock and Bedrock AgentCore, alongside SageMaker, Lambda and Step Functions, with CDK or equivalent IaC.
• Hands-on LLMOps and MLOps experience, including agent and trajectory evaluation, tracing (e.g. OpenTelemetry), guardrails, cost monitoring and automated model pipelines.
• A clear understanding of agent security risks, such as prompt injection, data leakage and over-permissioned tools, and how to mitigate them.
• Day-to-day experience of AI-native software delivery, using coding agents such as Claude Code, Cursor or GitHub Copilot across planning, coding, testing and review.
• Able to set team standards for AI-assisted development, including context engineering for coding agents, review of AI-generated code and measuring its impact on delivery.
• A solid grounding in applied data science, enough to lead data scientists and constructively challenge their work.
• Excellent communication skills, able to work closely with product, design and engineering, and explain technical trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders.
• Strong product sense: comfortable interrogating and refining requirements rather than taking them as given, and able to spot when one doesn’t hold up.

Desirable

• Direct experience applying AI within a media, publishing, entertainment or other content-led industry.
• Proven experience building and operating agentic AI systems in production, including multi-agent orchestration, tool use via MCP, agent memory and agentic RAG.Depth in NLP, such as information extraction, classification, summarisation and semantic search, or fine-tuning LLMs.
• Experience building shared AI platforms or reusable capabilities consumed by multiple product teams, such as internal MCP servers or agent tooling.
• Experience with vector search at scale, using tools such as OpenSearch, Amazon S3 Vectors or pgvector.
• Familiarity with AI governance and regulation, and with putting responsible AI practices into day-to-day engineering.
• An advanced degree in computer science, data science, linguistics or a related quantitative field, or equivalent work experience.

Please note: this role is open to internal applicants only until Tuesday, 13 October 2026, after which it may be advertised externally.

Enterprise Sales, B2C and central functions - to identify high-impact opportunities, redesign workflows and embed new, AI-enabled ways of working at scale.

As part of this AI Transformation Programme, we are hiring an AI Transformation Lead for Editorial to help turn that ambition into measurable results in The Economist’s newsroom. title: Project Manager
description:
At Too Good To Go, we have an ambitious goal: to inspire and empower everyone to fight food waste together.

40% of all food produced in the world is wasted. And that has a huge impact on the health of our planet, with 10% of greenhouse gas emissions coming from food waste.

Our app connects businesses with consumers to save unsold food. Since 2016, we’ve grown to become the largest food-saving marketplace in Europe, with over 120 million users and more than 453 million meals saved.

We’re now looking for a Project Manager to support a large-scale technical transformation programme across our global Commercial organisation, including the implementation of VOIP technology and operational tools across multiple markets.

Working closely with the Senior Programme Manager, Commercial teams, Tech, Product, Operations and external vendors, you’ll take ownership of defined workstreams and drive them from planning through to implementation and adoption.

This is a hands-on role for someone who combines strong project delivery skills, technical understanding and a proactive, independent approach.

Please note: This is a 12 month fixed term contract.

Your Mission

You’ll turn programme objectives into clear delivery plans, coordinate stakeholders, manage dependencies and risks, and ensure implementations are delivered successfully.

The Senior Programme Manager will set the overall programme direction. You’ll independently drive your workstreams forward, bring structure to ambiguity, solve problems proactively and escalate decisions when needed.

Your Role

Project Delivery

• Own workstreams from planning through to implementation and adoption, managing milestones, timelines, dependencies and risks.
• Bring structure to complex or ambiguous situations, proactively identifying solutions and driving decisions and actions.
• Maintain delivery momentum, adapting plans as priorities and requirements evolve.

Technology Implementation

• Work with Tech, Product and external vendors to understand system requirements, integrations, dependencies and technical constraints.
• Coordinate testing, UAT, issue resolution and go-live readiness.
• Translate between technical and commercial stakeholders, ensuring solutions support business needs and operational processes.

Stakeholder Management & Adoption

• Build strong relationships across Commercial, Tech, Product, Operations and external partners.
• Lead working sessions, align stakeholders and communicate progress, risks and decisions clearly.
• Coordinate rollouts across markets, ensuring processes, training and ways of working are ready for implementation.

What We're Looking For

• Project delivery experience: A track record of independently managing projects, workstreams or implementations, ideally involving technology or operational transformation.
• Technical understanding: Confidence working with technical teams and vendors, understanding systems, integrations and dependencies, and learning new platforms quickly. You don’t need to be a developer, but you must be comfortable engaging with technical detail.
• Stakeholder management: Ability to bring business and technical teams together, manage competing priorities and drive decisions.
• Ownership and problem-solving: A proactive, structured and pragmatic approach, with the ability to navigate ambiguity, anticipate risks and drive outcomes independently.
• Relevant experience: Experience with commercial or customer-facing teams is beneficial. Familiarity with VOIP, telephony, CRM or contact centre platforms is a plus.

We’re looking for someone who takes ownership, communicates confidently, adapts quickly and follows through to ensure things get delivered.

Our values:

• We Win Together
• We Raise the Bar
• We Keep It Simple
• We Build A Legacy
• We Care

What we offer:

• A rare opportunity to work in a social impact company where you can use your commercial skills to drive positive change
• An open company culture where you have the independence and room to unleash your creativity
• A strong team culture where learning together is encouraged and successes are celebrated together
• Inclusive benefits with flexible working hours and generous vacation and wellness policies
• The experience of being part of an international company with over 1350 enthusiastic and highly talented teammates across 20 countries – always ready to share knowledge and support!
• Strong personal as well as professional development in a thriving, high-growth scale-up environment.
• UK Remote with monthly visits to our London office.

How to apply

• We take recruitment very seriously, so please carefully read everything we have written above. Please also check our website and international media in order to get a good overview of Too Good To Go.
• Submit your CV in English.
• Please note that we only accept applications coming through our platform. No CV will be accepted by email or LinkedIn direct messaging.

title: Manager – Insurance Architect
description:
Role: Manager – Insurance Architect

Location: Bath, Bristol, London, Hybrid

Mobility: Up to 100%

Career Level: Manager (CL7)

Accenture is a leading global professional services company, providing a broad range of services in strategy and consulting, interactive, technology and operations, with digital capabilities across all of these services. With our thought leadership and culture of innovation, we apply industry expertise, diverse skill sets and next-generation technology to each business challenge.

We are recruiting for talented technologists to join the Insurance Architecture team within Accenture’s UK Insurance & Financial Services Industry and Enterprise practice, helping us shape and deliver digital change for our clients.

“Across the globe, one thing is universally true of the people of Accenture: We care deeply about what we do and the impact we have with our clients and with the communities in which we work and live. It is personal to all of us.” – Julie Sweet, Accenture CEO

As a team:

Insurance Architecture is the dedicated digital architecture and technology team within Accenture’s UK Insurance & Financial Services Industry and Enterprise practice. We are a small, high-impact team of senior architects and technologists who shape and assure complex digital change for some of the UK’s leading insurers, life offices, wealth managers and platform providers, and advising CIOs, CTOs and Chief Architects on major investment plans and technology and platform decisions.

Our work spans General Insurance, Life, Pensions & Investments, London Markets, Capital Markets and the wider Financial Services market, supporting clients in areas such as journey to cloud, digital transformation in underwriting and claims, applications of AI and GenAI, and large-scale platform re-platforming.

Our operating model is built around six functional pillars – Solution Architecture; Enterprise Architecture & System Design; ML, AI & GenAI; Data Architecture; Cyber Security; and Cloud & Infrastructure. Each team member develops deep expertise in one or more pillars and helps us build capability across the team, enabling us to deploy rapidly onto client engagements with both depth and resilience.

We were recently recognised by the Financial Times as one of the UK’s leading Management Consultants in Insurance.

In our team you will have the opportunity to:

• Invent and provide solutions to real-world problems across our Insurance and Financial Services clients, including solutions leveraging the latest technologies including GenAI and agentic AI.

• Build on and develop your understanding of the Financial Services sector using our industry-proven models and reference architectures.

• Act as the communication bridge between business and technology teams, helping ensure that solutions are aligned to true business needs.

• Build trusted advisor relationships with CIO, CTO, Chief Architect and senior business stakeholders.

• Collaborate with colleagues from across the wider Accenture business – including Industry and Enterprise, Technology, Song, Operations – to create differentiated offerings and enable the best outcomes for our clients.

• Deliver tangible, transformational change for clients, helping to shape the insurance and financial services industries of the future.

As an Enterprise & Solution Architect Manager within Insurance Architecture, you will:

• Contribute across all six of our functional pillars on client engagements – with a particular focus on Applications, Integration and Data as well as AI, Cloud and Cyber Security – and developing your skills as an SME in one or more areas.

• Lead technology advisory engagements and architecture workstreams within larger programmes, shaping technology solutions for our clients, leading and working on client engagements that range from architecture assessments and product selections through to major business and technology transformation programmes.

• Define, shape and deliver enterprise and solution architecture artefacts (current-state, target-state, roadmaps and transition states, integration patterns, capability maps) for clients across Insurance and Financial Services.

• Become familiar with and help to enhance our industry specific reference architecture frameworks, which form a core part of our proposition to our clients.

• Shape and lead client engagements – from cloud strategy and solution architecture designs for major programmes to IT strategy roadmaps for an entire business – and lead teams in the delivery of quality outputs and client outcomes.

• Partner with and demonstrate credibility to CIOs, CTOs, Chief Architects and other senior client stakeholders through clear, well-structured and insightful analysis and evidence-based advice, acting as a trusted technology adviser and helping to shape clients’ investment decisions and strategic thinking.

• Support sales, proposals and business development activities, including client presentations, solution shaping, effort estimation and commercial input.

• Build and maintain relationships across client organisations and Accenture account teams and contribute to account growth by identifying follow-on opportunities and helping clients develop investment cases and transformation strategies.

• Contribute to and lead thought leadership on the application of technology in financial services, developing distinctive points of view on emerging technologies and trends and representing Accenture at industry forums, conferences and client events.

• Actively contribute to growing and diversifying the Insurance Architecture team, managing, mentoring and coaching colleagues and helping us continuously raise the bar and to develop consulting, architecture and industry/domain skills.

We are looking for candidates with experience and skills such as:

• 7+ years of experience in technology roles – ideally with exposure to Financial Services, Insurance or another regulated industry – covering some combination of data, application, cloud, integration and security.

• A strong working knowledge of architecture concepts particularly with regard to the Application and Data Domains.

• Experience of integrating multiple systems within an enterprise estate and a broad familiarity with Enterprise Application Integration patterns.

• An appreciation of how technology can solve complex business problems, and comfortable operating at the intersection of business and technology.

• Excelled written and verbal communication skills, with a proven ability to engage and influence senior business and technology stakeholders and to present complex technology concepts clearly to executive and non-technical audiences

• Familiarity with at least one major industry platform (e.g. FNZ, SS&C, Pershing, Guidewire, Sapiens, Duck Creek, Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics) is highly desirable.

• A genuine desire to improve outcomes for clients and consumers, and willingness to travel within the UK and occasionally internationally.

Set yourself apart:

• Experience leading technology consulting architecture or transformation engagements within Financial Services or other regulated industries, including supporting business development, proposals and client relationship management activities.

• Experience shaping technology strategies, architecture roadmaps or large-scale transformation programmes, and of leading teams and managing workstreams within complex client environments.

• Passion and enthusiasm for innovating in the insurance and financial services industries, especially through automation, AI/GenAI and modern data platforms.

• Curiosity about the wider Insurance Architecture pillars – Solution Architecture, Enterprise Architecture & System Design, Cyber Security – and a desire to develop your existing expertise in one or more.

• Experience of how AI/GenAI can be used within architecture and the wider change process to improve delivery quality and efficiency, as well as where it could fit within our clients’ propositions.

• Ability to engage with stakeholders across business, technology and delivery teams, suppliers and clients, explaining the business rationale for architectural and technology choices as well as the delivery impacts.

• A distinctive emerging point of view that you can bring to internal forums and external events.

Successful candidates will demonstrate a consulting mindset, combining deep technology expertise with commercial awareness, client relationship management and a passion for helping organisations navigate complex transformation challenges. They will be comfortable operating as trusted advisors to senior stakeholders while leading teams and contributing to the growth of both client accounts and the wider Insurance Architecture practice.

What’s In It For You

At Accenture, in addition to a competitive basic salary, you will also have an extensive benefits package which includes 30 days’ vacation per year, private medical insurance and 3 extra days’ leave per year for charitable work of your choice.

Flexibility and mobility are required to deliver this role as there will be requirements to spend time onsite with our clients and partners to enable delivery of the services we are known for.

title: Data Engineer
description:
Title: Data Engineer

Location: Manchester (Hybrid – 2-3 days per week in the office)

Salary: £65,000 - £85,000 DOE

Industry: Financial Services

The Opportunity

I'm currently working with an established financial services business in Manchester that is looking to hire a Data Engineer to join its growing data and technology team.

The organisation operates within the financial services sector, working with complex financial datasets and business-critical information to support its operations, reporting and wider commercial objectives. As the business continues to invest in its technology and data capabilities, it's looking to strengthen its data infrastructure and improve how information is collected, processed, managed and utilised across the organisation.

This is a hands-on Data Engineering opportunity where you'll play an important role in designing, building and maintaining data pipelines, developing scalable data solutions and ensuring the quality, accuracy and reliability of business-critical data.

You'll work closely with Data Analysts, BI Developers, software engineers and wider business stakeholders, helping transform complex datasets into accessible, reliable information that supports financial reporting, operational efficiency and better business decision-making.

The role will involve working with modern cloud technologies, improving existing data processes and contributing to the development of a robust data platform. You'll also have the opportunity to influence engineering standards, improve data architecture and support the organisation's longer-term data strategy.

The ideal candidate will have strong SQL and Python skills, experience building production-grade data pipelines and a good understanding of modern cloud data platforms and data warehousing. Experience within financial services, banking, insurance, investment management or another regulated environment would be particularly valuable.

If you're a Data Engineer looking for an opportunity to work with complex financial datasets, modernise data infrastructure and make a tangible impact within an established financial services organisation, this could be an excellent opportunity.

Key Responsibilities

• Design, build and maintain scalable data pipelines to ingest, transform and process large volumes of financial and operational data.
• Develop and optimise ETL/ELT processes, ensuring data is accurate, consistent and readily accessible.
• Build and maintain data models and warehouse solutions to support financial reporting, business intelligence and wider analytical requirements.
• Work with cloud-based data platforms and infrastructure to improve scalability, performance and cost efficiency.
• Develop data integration solutions, connecting internal financial systems, databases, APIs and third-party data providers.
• Implement data quality checks, validation processes and monitoring to maintain the integrity of critical financial datasets.
• Optimise SQL queries, data transformations and pipeline performance.
• Collaborate with Data Analysts, BI Developers, Software Engineers and stakeholders to understand requirements and deliver effective data solutions.
• Ensure data pipelines and infrastructure meet relevant security, governance and regulatory requirements.
• Contribute to data architecture decisions, engineering standards and best practices.
• Implement automated testing, version control, CI/CD and deployment processes across data workflows.
• Identify opportunities to improve existing data infrastructure, automate manual processes and increase engineering efficiency.
• Support the development of a scalable data platform as the organisation's data requirements evolve.

Essential Skills and Experience

• Proven experience working as a Data Engineer or in a closely related data engineering role.
• Strong SQL skills, including query optimisation, complex transformations and working with large datasets.
• Strong Python development skills for data processing, automation and pipeline development.
• Experience designing, building and maintaining production-grade ETL/ELT pipelines.
• Experience with cloud data platforms, ideally Azure, AWS or Google Cloud.
• Knowledge of data warehousing principles, dimensional modelling and database design.
• Experience integrating data from multiple sources, including APIs, databases and third-party systems.
• Understanding of data quality, validation, monitoring and pipeline reliability.
• Experience using Git and version control, alongside collaborative development practices.
• Familiarity with automated testing, CI/CD and deployment best practices.
• Understanding of data security, governance and access management.
• Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to investigate complex data issues.
• Excellent communication skills and the ability to work effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Desirable Skills and Experience

• Experience working within financial services, banking, insurance, investment management, fintech or another regulated industry.
• Familiarity with financial datasets, including transaction data, customer information, investment data or financial reporting.
• Experience working with modern data platforms such as Snowflake, Databricks or Microsoft Fabric.
• Experience with orchestration tools such as Apache Airflow, Dagster or Azure Data Factory.
• Familiarity with transformation frameworks such as dbt.
• Experience with cloud services including Azure Data Lake, AWS S3, Azure Functions or equivalent technologies.
• Knowledge of Spark, distributed processing or other big data technologies.
• Experience working with streaming data, event-driven architectures or near-real-time processing.
• Understanding of regulatory data requirements, auditability, data lineage and data governance.
• Familiarity with financial services regulations and reporting requirements.
• Experience building data infrastructure to support business intelligence, advanced analytics or AI-driven applications.

Package and Benefits

• Salary of £65,000 - £85,000, depending on experience.
• Hybrid working, with 2-3 days per week in the Manchester office.
• Opportunity to join an established financial services organisation investing in its data capabilities.
• Hands-on involvement in developing and improving modern data infrastructure.
• Exposure to complex financial datasets and business-critical data projects.
• Opportunity to influence technical decisions and contribute to the evolution of the data platform.
• Close collaboration with Data, Technology and wider business teams.
• A role offering technical ownership, ongoing development and the chance to make a measurable business impact.

title: Hospitality and Events Manager
description:
Reports to: Senior Manager, Hospitality & Events

About Relevent Football Partners

Relevent Football Partners is a wholly owned subsidiary of Relevent, purpose-built to commercialise the UEFA men’s club competitions globally. An independent entity, Relevent Football Partners is tasked with providing UC3 — the joint venture between UEFA and European Football Clubs (EFC) — strategic and sales support in the worldwide marketing and sale of media, sponsorship, and licensing rights for the UEFA Champions League, UEFA Europa League, UEFA Conference League, UEFA Super Cup, UEFA Youth League, and the UEFA Futsal Champions League.

Following the UC3 tender process, Relevent Football Partners was awarded the commercial rights to the UEFA men’s club competitions (Champions League, Europa League and Conference League) on a global basis for the 2027 to 2033 cycle.

As such, Relevent Football Partners is now seeking to build a truly world class business focused on the monetisation of these commercial rights.

Position Summary

The Hospitality & Event Operations Manager will support the Relevent Football Partners Events & Hospitality team in delivering world-class commercial partner hospitality, with a primary focus on the UEFA Champions League (UCL) Final and support across the wider UEFA Men's Club Competitions (UMCC) Finals and other partner events. Acting as the key link between UEFA stakeholders, Partners and their agencies, the role manages day-to-day liaison between Partners and the UEFA Hospitality Production team, ensuring Partner Hospitality is delivered to the highest standard. Responsibilities include project management, partner documentation, supplier and agency management, and stakeholder engagement.

Key Responsibilities

Pre Event Project Management

• Primary contact for the UEFA Hospitality Production team and commercial Partners on Partner Hospitality at the UCL Final, including the ‘Champions Village’ and other Relevent events.
• Lead project documentation (plans, trackers, status and briefing documents) to ensure all deadlines are met.
• Manage concise, co-ordinated Partner communications on hospitality orders, operations and experience.
• Coordinate and approve Partner Hospitality concepts with UEFA Hospitality, including brand visibility and activation plans.
• Maintain Partner-facing documents and platforms, including the Partner Options Catalogue (POC) for ordering hospitality items.
• Work with departments to manage Sponsor Hospitality online tools and systems, streamlining processes for Sponsors and agencies.

Site Visits

• Lead Partner Site Visits, co-creating presentations with UEFA Hospitality Production.
• Manage all Partner topics, including 1:1 meetings, agendas and logistics.
• Lead post site visit follow ups and actions. Foster collaboration with UC3, UEFA and Relevent Football Partners teams, Partners, agencies and suppliers.
• Plan and attend other venue or city visits as required.

Onsite Delivery

• Oversee Partner Hospitality delivery at the UCL Final, including the Champions Village and UEFA Club, and support delivery at other UMCC Finals.
• Primary on-site contact for Partners and agencies from set-up onwards, resolving queries and issues.
• Manage clear, efficient communication channels with Partner operational contacts and agencies.
• Lead daily Partner meetings and tours to track implementation against agreed timelines and plans.
• Monitor and sign off Partner creative concept implementation.
• Full involvement in match-day operations, including guest flow, VIP escorting and real-time issue resolution.

General

• Proactively identify and implement improvements to team processes, workflow and productivity.
• Collaborate with the wider events, hospitality and ticketing team, agencies and suppliers to deliver consistent, high-quality partner experiences.
• Build strong relationships with UC3, UEFA and Relevent Football Partners Sponsorship and Media teams, acting as the single point of truth for UMCC Finals Partner Hospitality.
• Support the wider team across other partner events, including the UEL and UECL Finals, UCL Draw, UEFA Super Cup, season hospitality, partner workshops and Relevent corporate events.

Experience Required

Extensive experience delivering large-scale Partner hospitality at global live sports events.

UEFA Event Experience Desirable But Not Essential.

Strong understanding of hospitality delivery requirements and commercial partner contractual rights.

Proven track record in client servicing, operational planning and end-to-end hospitality delivery.

Proven ability to manage budgets, contracts and suppliers.

Familiarity with online ticketing tools and guest management systems.

Skilled at coordinating multiple stakeholders in complex, high-pressure environments.

Skills Required

• Exceptional project management, attention to detail and organisational skills.
• Strong relationship-building and stakeholder management skills.
• Ability to manage multiple projects in a fast-paced environment.
• Excellent written and verbal communication, confident, engaging senior leadership and VIP Partners.
• Creative problem-solving and a strong sense of proactivity and ownership.
• Proficient in PowerPoint and Excel; familiarity with AI, CRM, guest management and project management tools is a plus.

Personal Attributes

• A passion for the difference sport makes around the world
• The ability to build trusted, long-term relationships
• A collaborative, low-ego approach and a willingness to help
• High personal standards, with resourcefulness and tenacity
• Clear, proactive communicator
• A strong sense of ownership and urgency, with high levels of honesty and integrity
• Willingness to travel and work occasional evenings/weekends for events.

Why Join Us

At Relevent Football Partners, you’ll be part of a passionate, global team committed to shaping the future of football in innovative and impactful ways. We offer a collaborative culture, exciting growth opportunities, and the chance to make a real difference in one of the world’s most beloved sports.

title: Network Planning Technical Project Manager
description:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

#LI-IV1

The role

We are seeking a highly technical and experienced Network Planning Technical Project Manager to join our infrastructure team. In this pivotal role, you will be the bridge between internal data center development teams and external telecommunications partners.

You will own the connectivity lifecycle—from initial site opportunity assessment through to the final Outside Plant infrastructure delivery—ensuring our facilities are seamlessly integrated into the global network.

The ideal candidate possesses a deep understanding of fiber optics, ISP commercial structures, and geospatial data management, coupled with the project management discipline to drive complex, multi-stakeholder builds across the region.

You’re welcome to work in our Amsterdam office or remotely from Europe.

Your responsibilities will include:

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Strategy

• Integrated Project Delivery: Work in lock-step with other Network TPMs, DWDM engineers, ITDC (Infrastructure Technical Data Center) teams, Network Procurement, and Construction departments to ensure cohesive project execution.
• Datacenters PoP Selection: Partner with the site selection team to evaluate connectivity feasibility. Lead the technical validation of long-haul wave proposals and dark fiber options to inform Datacenter and PoP selections.
• Infrastructure Design: Act as the technical lead for fiber pathway architecture from the "0 manhole" to the internal access panels. Oversee the design of manhole placements, conduit systems, and site entry points to ensure optimal route diversity.
• MMR/POE Integration: Collaborate with engineering teams on the layout of Point of Entry (POE) and Meet-Me Rooms (MMR), ensuring space, power, and structural readiness for high-capacity, multi-carrier fiber and MOFN (Managed Optical Fiber Network) arrivals.

Carrier Relations & Commercial Management

• Strategic Partnerships: Build and maintain strategic relationships with regional/ Continental ISPs, private dark fiber owners, and utility providers.
• Procurement & Negotiation: Collaborate with Network Procurement on RFx process for last-mile, middle-mile, and long-haul capacity. Lead negotiations for IRU (Indefeasible Right of Use) agreements, long-term leases, and MOFN service structures.
• Colocation: Coordinate with fiber owners to secure necessary rack space, power, and environmental resources within ILA (Inline Amplification) sites.

Network Data & Geospatial Management

• Documentation: Maintain internal databases of fiber/connectivity routes, including rigorous management of KMZ/KML files.
• AutoCAD: Utilize AutoCAD to review, modify, and create site infrastructure and conduit design plans, ensuring accurate documentation of physical plant deployments.

We expect you to have:

• Education: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Telecommunications, or a related field (or equivalent professional experience).
• Industry Expertise: 5+ years of experience in network infrastructure, OSP planning, or data center connectivity project management.
• Technical Proficiency:
AutoCAD: Proficiency in creating and reviewing site infrastructure/conduit designs.
• GIS: Advanced ability to work with geospatial tools and KMZ/KML files.
• Optical Networking: Strong grasp of DWDM technology, ILA requirements, and the technical lifecycle of MOFN deployments.
• Commercial Acumen: Demonstrated success in negotiating complex fiber leases, IRUs, and construction contracts.
• Relationship Management: Proven ability to influence stakeholders and external vendors to meet aggressive regional deployment timelines.

Preferred technical stack:

• Deep knowledge of the regional fiber landscape, including utility right-of-way and regional infrastructure challenges.
• Experience with large-scale 100Tbps+ capacity planning and deployment.
• Ability to read and create code in Python or Go that is relevant to the position.
• Knowledge of service provider or datacenter IP Networking is preferred.

Benefits & Perks:

• Competitive compensation
• Career growth and learning opportunities
• Flexibility and ownership
• Collaborative and innovative culture
• Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects
• International environment and talented teams

What's it like to work at Nebius:

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI

description:

We serve approximately 9,000 clients and generated approximately $70 billion in FY25 revenue. Visit us at accenture.com.
