description:
Join Kainos and Shape the Future

At Kainos, we’re problem solvers, innovators, and collaborators - driven by a shared mission to create real impact. Whether we’re transforming digital services for millions, delivering cutting-edge Workday solutions, or pushing the boundaries of technology, we do it together.

We believe in a people-first culture, where your ideas are valued, your growth is supported, and your contributions truly make a difference. Here, you’ll be part of a diverse, ambitious team that celebrates creativity and collaboration.

Ready to make your mark? Join us and be part of something bigger.

As a Delivery Manager at Kainos, you'll help shape and deliver innovative digital services that make a real difference to our customers and the people who use their services. You will lead the successful delivery across in one of our Sector client portfolio: Public/Healthcare/Defence/Commercial. Working closely with multidisciplinary teams and clients, you'll create the environment for successful delivery, helping teams solve complex problems, deliver value and continuously improve. You'll build trusted relationships, support business growth and play an important role in developing our people and culture. At Kainos, we put people first, and you'll be empowered to help teams thrive while delivering great outcomes for our customers.

You Will Be Responsible For

Delivery

• Understand critical success factors for the project (beyond the traditional measures: on time, on budget and to agreed scope) and ensure each work stream has a plan in place to achieve the success factors.
• Manage project finances effectively, supporting delivery against agreed commercial and profitability objectives while maintaining accurate forecasting and reporting.
• Identify opportunities to add value for clients, ensuring expectations are proactively managed and issues are addressed appropriately.

Team

• Foster an environment where teams can do their best work, learn, develop and contribute to a positive and inclusive culture.
• Put people first & develop others – You’ll manage, coach and develop a small number of staff, with a focus on managing employee performance
• Ensure all team members have clear goals, receive regular feedback and have timely and constructive appraisals.
• Ensure team members have learning and development objectives to acquire and maintain the skills necessary for the project.
• Have responsibility for staffing teams and on-boarding of new team members.
• Build and maintain constructive and collaborative relationships with the client, other suppliers and third-party stakeholders.

Governance

• Ensure appropriate project governance arrangements and technical quality standards are developed and followed throughout the project lifecycle.
• Effectively manage project risks and issues, escalating where appropriate.
• Comply, and ensure team members comply, with all confidentiality and non-disclosure policies and agreements and ensure the security of information, at all times.

Business Development & Account Management

• Support the growth of existing and future customer relationships by working closely with Sales, Account Leads and Account Management teams, contributing to proposals, procurement activities and customer engagement opportunities.
• Share and celebrate successes across Kainos, with our customers and through external industry channels.
• Understand the contracts and commercial terms applying to our projects and ensure that Kainos is not compromised by non-compliance.
• Professional Development and Growth.
• Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives within the Management Capability.
• Understand current thinking from the Technology, Experience Design and Consulting capabilities and support alignment accordingly.
• Encourage innovation in technology and process both within the project and outside the project.
• Proactively assist with recruitment activities to enable stable organisational growth.

Minimum Requirements

• Active SC clearance.
• Minimum 3 years of experience in a similar role with UK defence sector organizations is mandatory.
• Experience delivering complex digital programmes within a consultancy, professional services or comparable environment.
• Digital delivery experience and stakeholder management in a complex environment.
• Experience working within Agile delivery environments.
• Eligible to achieve SC clearance (lived in the UK continuously for 5 years, background checks) – applies to Public & Defence sector.
• Experience balancing delivery outcomes, customer needs and commercial considerations, including financial reporting and budget management.
• Experience leading, coaching and developing individuals & teams.
• The ability to be on customer site, which may include travel, when required.
• Experience planning capacity and building multidisciplinary teams to deliver complex digital programmes.

Desirable

• Experience delivering programmes within government, healthcare, defence or another highly regulated environment.
• Curiosity about emerging technologies, including AI, and a willingness to explore how they can improve delivery effectiveness, team experience and customer outcomes.
• Business development experience, ideally including evidence of securing follow on business with existing clients.
• Experience of project delivery aimed at digital transformation. Evidence of innovating or leading initiatives to improve management and leadership practices within a team or an organisation.

Embracing our differences

At Kainos, we believe in the power of diversity, equity and inclusion. We are committed to building a team that is as diverse as the world we live in, where everyone is valued, respected, and given an equal chance to thrive. We actively seek out talented people from all backgrounds, regardless of age, race, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, religion, disability, or any other characteristic that makes them who they are. We also believe every candidate deserves a level playing field.

Our friendly talent acquisition team is here to support you every step of the way, so if you require any accommodations or adjustments, we encourage you to reach out.

We understand that everyone's journey is different, and by having a private conversation we can ensure that our recruitment process is tailored to your needs.

title: Legal Director
description:
VCCP is the global challenger network for challenger brands. With more than 1,500 people across 13 offices in North America, EMEA and APAC, we challenge convention to create value for the world’s most ambitious organisations.

Our founding belief is It Only Works If It All Works. That’s why we bring specialists from every discipline - strategy, AI, data, media, digital, experience, branding, creativity, production, PR, CX, CRM, employee engagement and beyond - into one fully integrated challenger network.

We were founded on the principles of simplicity, collaboration and un-preciousness, and we’ve grown by staying true to them. Today, our clients include some of the world’s most recognisable and progressive brands, such as Virgin Media O2, Barclays, Cadbury, Compare the Market, Domino’s, White Claw, easyJet, Primark and Co-op.

VCCP has topped the AAR’s annual new business ranking in 13 of the last 14 years and holds multiple Agency of the Year titles. Across every company and every capability, we share the same ambition: to challenge ourselves, challenge our clients and challenge the industry for the better.

THE ROLE

We are looking for an experienced, ambitious and highly organised individual who is articulate, curious, proactive and thrives in a fast-paced environment across a range of projects.

Whilst the successful candidate needs to be a natural self-starter, it is also important that the candidate can work as part of a team across a range of disciplines.

We are a busy in-house legal team who work across all VCCP Group companies globally. Our team is made up of five people: General Counsel, Head of Legal, Senior Legal Counsel, Legal Counsel and Paralegal with a separate UK and US Business Affairs team. The role reports directly to the General Counsel.

We are looking for a commercially-minded 5+ PQE lawyer, preferably already with some great in-house experience or a secondment, ready to throw themselves into this busy but fun team. Previous experience in advertising law - whether obtained in private practice, in an agency or within an in-house team supporting a marketing department - is essential, as is a strong background in commercial contracts and IP. Data privacy experience would be welcome. The role reports directly to the General Counsel. This is a hybrid role, working in the Central London office Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday.

Duties And Responsibilities

• Drafting and negotiating a variety of commercial contracts, including: creative advertising master services agreements (e.g. the IPA/ISBA Creative Services Framework Agreement), agreements for media planning and buying, branding services, production agreements and supplier contracts.
• Work closely with the General Counsel and assist them with the day to day running and organisation of the legal team.
• Advising the business on developments in AI and negotiating and reviewing terms of use with AI vendors and clients.
• Researching advertising regulations and reviewing and advising on copy and scripts for compliance with regulations such as CAP/BCAP, HFSS and DMCCA.
• Reviewing industry production agreements, such as PIBS and covid tripartite addendum.
• Reviewing and supporting the RFI pitch process and conflict checks.
• Researching and advising on contentious and non-contentious intellectual property issues (trademarks, copyrights and passing off), including potential issues surrounding advertisements before publication and our own brand portfolio.
• Managing relationships and instructions to external counsel, advisors and vendors to the Legal Team, where appropriate.
• Delivering training and updates to the legal team and wider business.
• Providing guidance and assistance to junior members of the team.
• Assisting in reviewing and updating precedent agreements and policies.
• Reviewing, amending and negotiating synchronisation, talent and influencer agreements and celebrity partnerships.
• Providing general legal support to the agency across all global offices.

Role Specific Skills Required

• Qualified lawyer, 5+ year PQE*
• Advertising, Commercial and IP experience gained in either private practice an agency setting or within an in-house team supporting a marketing department;
• Advertising/media background essential.
• Embracing of new technology - particularly the use of AI and legal tech.
• A proven ability to improve processes - whether through technology or training.
• Solid understanding of commercial contracts and ability to negotiate independently is vital.
• Good understanding of copyright and trade mark infringement.
• Pragmatic and commercially minded.
• Proactive and takes initiative.
• Ability to communicate legal concepts clearly and concisely to non-lawyers.
• Proven ability to prioritise workload and to work to tight deadlines.
• Candidates with less PQE who can demonstrate the requisite experience will also be considered.

About You

• Strive for excellence - be proud of your work and have meticulous attention to detail
• Be proactive with a can-do attitude - be eager to get your sleeves rolled up and learn
• Thrive on working in a high energy and fast paced environment, where no two days are the same
• Resilience to keep going in a fast paced environment
• Build rapport and able to quickly establish excellent working relationships
• Friendly and approachable
• Live and breathe the agency’s values
• Can do attitude

VCCP DE&I STATEMENT

We believe that DE&I is about creating a strong culture of inclusion within our agency, where everyone can thrive and be their authentic self. VCCP is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of gender, age, disability, religion, belief, sexual orientation, marital status, or ethnicity. If you require any adjustments during the application or interview process, please let us know via joinus@vccp.com.

CRIMINAL RECORDS INFORMATION

As part of our onboarding process, you will be required to complete a Criminal Records Declaration regarding any unspent convictions. For roles in finance, HR, Legal, IT or senior management, we may be required to verify your declaration with a basic DBS check, as well as an Adverse Finance and ID check.

title: Mechanical Design Engineer
description:
This role is based at our head office at NETPark in Sedgefield TS21 3FR. Skilled Worker Visa support and Relocation assistance is available, if required.

About Us

Filtronic is looking for a Mechanical Design Engineer to join our engineering team to work on a range of exciting RF and microwave products from concept through to volume production.

With experienced engineers, advanced design tools and in-house RF/mmWave manufacturing capability, you will be able to develop your skills and experience designing high-frequency products as part of the Filtronic team.

Our products range from low volume niche opportunity devices to high volume telecommunications, aerospace, defence and space-related applications.

Purpose of Role

To provide end-to-end mechanical engineering support and leadership for advanced high-frequency RF systems, modules and amplifiers, ensuring that mechanical performance, thermal efficiency, reliability, manufacturability, quality and cost requirements are achieved.

The role will involve the design of mechanically robust, lightweight and thermally efficient assemblies for demanding industrial, payload and high-reliability environments, including space-related applications.

Summary Of Responsibilities

Mechanical Design and Development

• Design precision mechanical components and assemblies for RF modules and systems, including lightweight structural enclosures, heatsinks, liquid cooling solutions and waveguide-based architectures.
• Develop modular mechanical architectures suitable for integration into larger payload or system-level assemblies, considering mass, volume, mounting interfaces and serviceability.
• Ensure designs meet RF, thermal, mechanical and environmental requirements, including EMI shielding, structural stiffness, tolerance control, CTE compatibility, vibration, shock and ingress protection.
• Create detailed 3D CAD models and engineering drawings using SolidWorks.
• Select appropriate materials, finishes and manufacturing processes to support product performance, reliability and manufacturability.

Thermal and Structural Analysis

• Perform thermal analysis and simulation, including CFD and conjugate heat transfer, to validate cooling strategies for high-power RF amplifiers and electronic assemblies.
• Conduct structural and dynamic analysis using FEA for vibration, shock, fatigue and other load-case conditions typical of high-reliability payload deployment.
• Review mechanical properties of parts and assemblies, including thermal performance, mechanical stress and environmental robustness.
• Validate simulation models through physical testing and correlation with measured data.

RF-Aware Mechanical Engineering

• Work closely with RF, electronics and systems engineers to optimise mechanical features that influence RF performance, including cavity geometry, surface finish, plating, tolerances and material selection.
• Design mechanical solutions with consideration for waveguide structures, micro-machined geometry, PCB integration and precision alignment.
• Support electromechanical product concept design in collaboration with RF, electronics and PCB design teams.

Manufacturing Support

• Develop designs for manufacturability, assembly and cost reduction using processes including CNC machining, die-casting, additive manufacturing and sheet metal manufacture.
• Generate manufacturing documentation including bills of materials, GD&T drawings and assembly instructions.
• Manage and control engineering drawings and documentation in accordance with Drawing Office standards and company processes.
• Support suppliers and production teams during prototype build, first article approval and continuous improvement activity.
• Contribute to design reviews as part of the company's ISO and NPI processes.
• Support engineering change activity through ECN/ECO processes.

Prototyping and Testing

• Support the build and test of mechanical prototypes and development hardware.
• Support environmental and reliability testing including thermal cycling, humidity, vibration, thermal shock and drop testing.
• Work with test and process engineering to develop production hardware, jigs and fixtures to optimise build and test efficiency.
• Provide technical support to internal stakeholders, customers and external partners throughout the product lifecycle.

Requirements

Skills, Experience and Qualifications

• Degree or equivalent qualification in Mechanical Engineering.
• Strong 2D and 3D CAD skills, with SolidWorks preferred.
• Experience designing high-precision mechanical assemblies, ideally for constrained, high-reliability or technically demanding environments.
• Understanding of PCB integration, RF shielding and EMI/EMC considerations.
• Strong understanding of materials and manufacturing processes, preferably including CNC machining of aluminium alloys and lightweight structures.
• Excellent understanding of GD&T and engineering drawing standards.
• Experience developing drawings for machined, cast, moulded, punched or sheet metal parts.
• Ability to work effectively within cross-functional engineering teams.
• Experience with PDM/PLM systems and engineering change processes.
• Must be a highly motivated individual able to interface effectively with internal and external customers.

Desirable Skills and Experience

• Experience with payload systems or deployment environments such as space, aerospace, defence or telecoms infrastructure.
• Experience with industrial system design.
• Hands-on experience with FEA and thermal simulation tools, preferably SolidWorks Simulation or SolidWorks Flow.
• Familiarity with RF/mmWave product development, including waveguides, filters, amplifiers and high-frequency assemblies.
• Knowledge of lightweighting techniques and structural optimisation for mass-constrained designs.
• Experience with high-reliability and qualification-driven design standards, such as MIL-STD or ECSS.
• Familiarity with environmental testing such as thermal vacuum or vibration qualification.
• Knowledge of RoHS and WEEE compliance.
• Experience supporting supplier development, first article inspection or production readiness activity.

Personal Attributes

• Strong problem-solving ability with excellent attention to detail.
• Positive, proactive and hands-on approach.
• Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities in parallel.
• Clear and effective communicator across multidisciplinary teams, suppliers and customers.
• Self-motivated, adaptable and eager to learn new tools, processes and technologies.
• Team player with a strong customer focus.

The successful candidate must meet the criteria for UK Government Security Clearance vetting.

Benefits

• Salary benchmarked to attract the strongest candidates
• 37.5 hour working week
• 25 days' holiday plus public holidays, with the option to buy up to 5 additional days
• Contributory pension scheme with up to 8% company contribution
• Life Assurance
• Income Protection Insurance
• Save As You Earn (SAYE) share scheme
• Electric Vehicle (EV) scheme
• Cycle to Work scheme
• Volunteering day
• Learning and development opportunities

Want to Know More?

This advert provides an overview of the role and its key responsibilities. If you would like details of the salary and benefits package on offer - please note that some benefits become available following successful completion of your probationary period - before investing your time in applying, or would simply like to have an informal conversation about the opportunity, we would be delighted to hear from you. Please contact our Talent Team on 01740 618828.

We are always happy to answer any questions you may have about the role, what we do, our culture or what it is like to work at Filtronic.

Diversity & Inclusion

At Filtronic, we believe diverse perspectives drive innovation. We're committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone is treated with respect and has the opportunity to succeed. We welcome applications from all suitably qualified candidates regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage or civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief, sex or sexual orientation. If you require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, please let us know. We'll be happy to support you throughout your application journey.

title: Senior Study Delivery Lead
description:
Global Project Manager

At ICON Strategic Solutions, you will work in a sponsor-dedicated model, supported by ICON’s global expertise.

As the world’s largest FSP organisation, with over 90 sponsor partnerships, we offer stability, career development and a collaborative environment where your work contributes to the development of treatments that benefit patients worldwide.

We are currently seeking a Project Manager to join our diverse and dynamic team. As a Project Manager at ICON, you will be responsible for leading and coordinating project activities. Your role will involve overseeing all aspects of project execution, from planning and resource management to stakeholder communication and risk mitigation.

What You Will Do

Ideally, you will be a Project Manager or experienced Senior Clinical Trial Manager with retrospective and prospective designs, post authorization safety studies, real world evidence, and epidemiology experience. This is a leadership role, and you need to demonstrate global clinical study management experience in leading and driving cross-functional teams.

• This position combines end-to-end design, execution, and reporting of clinical studies and trials including:
• Non-interventional studies using primary data collection, including prospective studies enrolling patients and / or HCPs, de novo registries, discrete choice experiments, creation of new datasets with secondary data (e.g. with EMRs / chart abstraction), patient reported outcomes development and validation.
• Global clinical study management experience across different countries and regions is essential to succeed in the role.
• Non-interventional comparative and descriptive studies using secondary data sources, including retrospective studies, burden of illness and drug utilisation studies, prevalence / incidence studies of exposure, risk factors and outcomes.
• Studies utilizing a mixture of existing medical data and the collection of new data via sites or directly via patients.
• Economic modelling studies and supplemental analyses of clinical trials / meta-analyses.
• Interventional and low-interventional studies.

This Includes Responsibility And / Or Accountability For The Set-up, Coordination, Execution And Delivery Of Studies In Partnership With The Science Lead

• Planning and leading the delivery of NIS to time, quality, budget, company standards and scientific requirements from concept protocol to final study report.
• Accountable for coordination and delivery of a fully feasible Study Protocol, Informed Consent Forms, operationally robust study documents and Clinical Study Reports.
• Accountable for the study delivery strategy (e.g. country selection, diversity, patient identification and engagement strategy, recruitment plan, digital platforms / tools etc).
• With the majority of NIS fully outsourced this role includes responsibility and/or accountability to drive assessment, selection, engagement, and management of appropriate vendors.
• Ensure compliance with ICH / GCP & ENCePP guidelines and/or applicable guidelines for studies
• Make decisions which balance risk / benefit. Mitigate risk where appropriate.
• Work with matrix partners, Study Delivery Director and/or manager to develop and manage study level budget within project budget allocation.
• Requires active partnership building for their portfolios and collaboration with therapy aligned staff in other functions. Interact effectively across boundaries with other global functions using influencing and relationship-building skills.

The Position May Include

• Leadership of a study team with single point accountability for delivery of the study
• Have primary responsibility and be a focal point of contact for interactions with key stakeholder groups including lead scientists (epidemiologists, health economists, health outcomes, etc.) data management, biostatistics, legal, compliance and project management.

Your Profile

• Proven expertise in the proactive identification of issues which may impact clinical programmes coupled with the ability to contribute to solutions affecting cross-functional matrix teams.
• Advanced degree (e.g. MS, PhD, PharmD) or equivalent experience.
• Demonstrated experience leading in matrix environment to deliver projects, develop clinical plans, and manage change.
• Ability to work independently and proactively and to take on leadership roles on cross-functional study teams.
• Excellent leadership, influencing and negotiation skills.
• Ability to lead and drive change, continuous improvement and learning, effectiveness at building networks of partners and stakeholders. A track record of applying experience and judgement towards project decision-making, effective peer review, and shared learning is essential.

Required Qualifications And Experience

• A minimum ideally of 6+ years of experience in a Clinical Trial Management position at a CRO or Pharmaceutical Organization.
• Bachelor's degree in health, life sciences, or Advanced degree (e.g. MS, PhD, PharmD)
• Ideally, at least 10+ years of relevant experience in clinical trial management.
• Experience in managing complex or global trials is advantageous.
• Preferred: Experience in managing all trial components from start-up to database lock.
• Preferred: Experience in leading and driving cross-functional teams including oversight of external CROs, etc.
• Proven expertise in the proactive identification of issues which may impact clinical programmes coupled with the ability to contribute to solutions affecting cross-functional matrix teams.

What ICON Can Offer You

Our success depends on the quality of our people. That’s why we’ve made it a priority to build a diverse culture that rewards high performance and nurtures talent.

In addition to your competitive salary, ICON offers a range of additional benefits. Our benefits are designed to be competitive within each country and are focused on well-being and work life balance opportunities for you and your family.

Our Benefits Examples Include

• Various annual leave entitlements
• A range of health insurance offerings to suit you and your family’s needs.
• Competitive retirement planning offerings to maximize savings and plan with confidence for the years ahead.
• Global Employee Assistance Programme, LifeWorks, offering 24-hour access to a global network of over 80,000 independent specialized professionals who are there to support you and your family’s well-being.
• Life assurance
• Flexible country-specific optional benefits, including childcare vouchers, bike purchase schemes, discounted gym memberships, subsidized travel passes, health assessments, among others.

Visit our careers site to read more about the benefits ICON offers.

All qualified applicants will receive equal consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status.

Description & Requirements

Bloomberg's Engineering AI department has 400+ AI practitioners building highly sought after products and features that often require novel innovations. We are investing in AI to build better search, discovery, and workflow solutions using technologies such as transformers, gradient boosted decision trees, large language models, and dense vector databases. We are expanding our group and seeking highly skilled individuals who will be responsible for contributing to the team (or teams) of Machine Learning (ML) and Software Engineers that are bringing innovative solutions to AI-driven customer-facing products. At Bloomberg, we believe in fostering a transparent and efficient financial marketplace. Our business is built on technology that makes news, research, financial data, and analytics on over 35 million financial instruments searchable, discoverable, and actionable across the global capital markets.

Bloomberg has been building Artificial Intelligence applications that offer solutions to these problems with high accuracy and low latency since 2009. We build AI systems to help process and organize the ever-increasing volume of structured and unstructured information needed to make informed decisions.

Our use of AI uncovers signals, helps us produce analytics about financial instruments in all asset classes, and delivers clarity when our clients need it most. As an ML Research Engineer on the AI Sustainable Finance team, you will be working on exciting initiatives such as real-time controversies detection from news, greenhouse gas emissions estimation for global equities, financial materiality assessment of corporate conduct, and ML explainability for our sustainability solutions.

Bloomberg's sustainable finance solutions are built on comprehensive, reliable, and contextualized environmental, social, and governance data, helping investors see clearly and act with confidence. Our team powers the ML systems behind these solutions, enabling clients to surface opportunities in a shifting landscape, integrate sustainability signals into their models, manage risk exposure, and measure the impact of their strategies.

Join us as a Senior ML Research Engineer and you will have the opportunity to:

• Collaborate with sustainable finance domain experts to develop systems that identify, categorize, and assess sustainability risks
• Own cross-team projects end-to-end, from research and experimentation through production deployment
• Research and train ML models that help investors assess and manage sustainability risks
• Design and build real-time NLP pipelines using large language models
• Develop evaluation frameworks and annotation tooling that drives continuous model improvement
• Stay current with the latest research in NLP, LLMs, and estimation techniques, and incorporate new findings into our models and methodologies
• Represent Bloomberg at scientific and industry conferences and in open-source communities
• Publish product and research findings in documentation, whitepapers or publications to leading academic venues

We are looking for a Senior ML Research Engineer with the following experience:

• Experience building production ML systems, with exposure to sustainability and responsible investment problems
• Practical experience with Machine Learning problems and Large Language Models
• Ph.D. in ML, NLP or a relevant field or MSc in CS, ML, Math, Statistics, Engineering, or related fields and previous relevant work experience
• Proficiency in software engineering with Python, including experience with production ML infrastructure (model serving, data pipelines, evaluation frameworks)
• Familiarity with LLM-based systems for structured information extraction from unstructured text
• An understanding of Computer Science fundamentals such as data structures and algorithms and a data oriented approach to problem-solving
• Excellent communication skills and the ability to collaborate with engineering peers as well as non-engineering stakeholders such as sustainable finance analysts, product managers, and domain experts
• Interest in sustainability or climate finance is a strong plus
• A track record of authoring publications in top conferences and journals is a strong plus

If indicated, please note that years of experience are a guide; we will consider applications from all candidates who can demonstrate the skills necessary for the role.

Discover what makes Bloomberg unique - watch our for an inside look at our culture, values, and the people behind our success.

title: Supply Chain Director
description:
LeMieux is the UK’s fastest-growing equestrian and lifestyle brand, with a global community and big ambitions. Our success is driven by talented people who share our passion for innovation, collaboration, and excellence. We’re seeking a Supply Chain Director to join our team and help shape the future of our brand.

What You’ll Do

This role is currently being filled by an interim Operations Director who has improved our own UK warehouse processes and efficiency, opened a US 3PL, and onboarded a new freight forwarder that has stock consolidation hubs for more efficient shipping to distribution warehouses. We want to bring in a permanent replacement, with a broader remit than the current role, particularly incorporating supply chain planning and inventory management to build on these foundations that have been established. This will involve a realignment in responsibilities across the business.

The Supply Chain Director will report into the Chief Financial Officer (CFO). The role will be part of the Senior Leadership Team (SLT) with regular engagement and interaction with the CEO.

As the business has grown, we now have a large range (c13,000 SKU’s) mainly being sourced from many suppliers across Asia that is being consolidated into Asian hubs before being shipped to our own warehouse in the UK, and 3PL’s in the USA & EU. From these warehouses we then service wholesale customers and our D2C channels (owned e-comm site and Amazon). The business has seasonal ranges that create a large volume and value of orders for wholesale customers and then separately has a peak sales period in Q4 via D2C.

With the strength and depth of our consumer proposition, we have an ambitious growth plan. At the heart of this role will be drive OTIF for key product launches and a ‘never out of stock’ programme whilst also reducing the cost-to-serve from the supplier through to the customer.

The Supply Chain Director will be responsible for the design, planning, and execution of our global supply chain owning the integrated demand & supply plan, translating these forecasts into executable purchasing (with merchandising & buying), freight, warehousing, fulfilment, and capacity plans to ensure that we have the right inventory, in the right place, at the right time, and at the best cost, to ensure our customers (and our employees and suppliers) have a great experience. A big part of the role will be balancing availability / cost-to-serve / resilience / working capital requirements - this must always be through the lens of supporting the customer proposition, profitably.

There are c65 people across the supply chain team, of which c55 are warehouse operatives. Determining the right capabilities and structure across the team, and in particular ensuring that key roles are filled by great talent, will be fundamental.

The principal responsibilities of the role are:

Build & lead a capable supply-chain team

• Assess, build, and lead the supply-chain team, with the capabilities required to support growing the business, profitably, whilst driving a culture of continuous improvement.
• Create an environment of data-led decision making anchored in customer service and profitability, ensuring the team understand the commercial & financial impact of decisions.
• Work collaboratively with other teams across the business to drive the right outcomes.
• Promote health & safety across our operations.

Develop the supply chain strategy and operating model aligned to the regional growth plans

• Design the optimum global network for purchasing, consolidation, freight, inventory management, warehousing, and fulfilment.
• Develop policies in relation to; where inventory is held (regional v regional v central); inbound and intra-warehouse freight; warehouse capacity and utilisation.
• Develop a business continuity programme for the supply chain, with a documented supply-chain risk register and clear responses to material risks.
• Develop a clear plan for inventory & supply response should there be a material change in demand

Own the S&OP process & plan

• Develop the demand forecast process, including the rolling 12-month demand forecast (owned by the regional commercial leads) and the mechanism by which it translates into a supply plan and hence a financial forecast (in conjunction with the finance team).
• Convert the demand plan into a supply & inventory plan i.e. the intake plan from factories; despatch plan from the freight forwarder warehouses to receiving warehouses; stock cover required for different classification of products; deals with the variability in the forecast & shipping times; ensures cost efficiency v working capital requirement and storage costs.
• Identify supply constraints with recommendations to resolve challenges

Drive the inventory management plan

• Recommend the inventory management plan to the CFO & CEO, based on achieving OTIF targets and reduced cost-to-serve.
• Actively participate in the product lifecycle management process (new ranges / SKU’s; seasonal collections; dealing with slow moving, obsolete, or discontinued stock) and drive stock health and efficiency.

Manage key supplier chain partnerships to achieve our objectives

• Own the strategic relationship with the freight forwarder, negotiating and validating rates (including surcharges) & service levels and ensuring sufficient capacity at the necessary times.
• Set the warehouse operating strategy for wholesale & D2C fulfilment across the UK owned warehouse and the US & EU 3PL’s. For the UK, ensure clear accountability for safety, service, productivity, accuracy & cost. For the 3PL’s, ensure we have the right partners and contracts in place to drive high standards and performance, at the right cost.
• Ensure that we have the right logistics providers in place for deliveries (service & cost) and that they have the capacity to scale during peak & seasonal spikes.
• Establish, with the customer service team, an efficient and effective process for dealing with shortages, delivery failures, returns, and refunds.

Drive effectiveness and efficiency through systems and data

• Own the supply-chain systems road map, in partnership with IT & finance, and ensure effective use of systems such as; ERP; forecasting and planning; WMS; freight management systems; 3PL interfaces; etc.
• Establish a single view of inventory (from orders through to projected availability).
• Ensure ownership of master data across the supply chain.
• Take accountability for and drive financial performance across the supply chain
• Own and prepare budgets & forecasts and understand variances to a flexed plan (supported by finance).
• Identify how to drive productivity and cost-saving programmes without compromising service.
• Ensure accurate landed cost information per SKU and an understanding of cost-to-serve.
• Put in place controls for airfreight; overtime; exceptional distribution charges; and any other material costs.
• Work with the CFO to understand and manage working capital requirements

Measures of success:

• High customer service levels (OTIF), particularly during seasonal peaks and for the ‘never out of stock’ products whilst managing working capital requirements.
• Clear understanding of landed costs to enable better decision making, and the development and execution of a plan to improve cost-to-serve.
• Credible strategic and operational plans agreed and executed with merchandising, buying, commercial, supply chain, and finance.
• A resilient supply chain with practical contingency plans

What You’ll Bring

• Proven experience building and running a consumer goods supply chain, ideally in an apparel business, from purchasing inventory in Asia through to selling in multiple regions and multiple channels, ideally wholesale and digital B2C. This would ideally include running a warehouse and fulfilment operations.
• Customer first mindset – experience, quality, service.
• Demonstrable ability to lead and develop a supply chain team
• Continuous improvement / kaizen mindset and experience, driving down the cost-to-serve.
• Experience of running S&OP, driving forecasting & supply chain planning and working cross-functionally with buying, merchandising, supply chain and finance.
• Experience of designing & develop new processes and ways-of-working and confident challenging existing practice
• Strong strategic and analytical skills
• Commercially astute, driving better financial outcomes

Why Join LeMieux?

Founded in 2006, LeMieux is the UK’s fastest-growing equestrian and lifestyle brand with a global presence. Driven by innovation and passion for horses and riders, we’re expanding our team based in our Romsey HQ and looking for exceptional people to join us on our journey.

We’re on a mission to be the most exciting equestrian brand on the planet. To get there, we need exceptional people who thrive in a fast-paced, creative environment and a culture that values innovation, collaboration, and problem-solving. Whether you ride or not, you’ll share our energy, determination, and obsession with delivering excellence for our community.

From financial security to time with your loved ones (on two legs or four), we continually invest in our employees.

We are committed to creating a diverse, inclusive, and equitable workplace where everyone feels valued and empowered to thrive. We believe that varied perspectives drive innovation and strengthen our team. We welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds, experiences, and identities - including but not limited to race, ethnicity, gender, age, disability, sexual orientation, and neurodiversity. We are an equal opportunity employer and actively promote an environment of respect, support, and opportunity for all. Please let us know if you require any reasonable adjustments throughout the application process.

At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Samsara is on a mission to power the connected operations that keep the world moving. As our Senior Early Talent & G&A Recruiter in EMEA, you will lead Engineering Early Talent (New Grads and Interns) and G&A hiring across multiple businesses. You will partner with regional and global leaders, build sourcing strategies that work, and give every candidate a standout experience.

You should apply if these excite you:

• You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your work helps keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores and workers home safely, as we digitize large sectors of the global economy.
• High-Impact Role: Direct visibility and influence with regional and global business leaders in a fast-growing organisation.
• You are the architect of your own career: Put in the work and this role won’t be your last at Samsara, with countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft.
• You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together and support each other, surrounded by a high-calibre team that pushes you to do your best.
• Cutting-Edge Tools: Work with best-in-class, AI-forward recruiting technologies and data-driven strategies.

In this role, you will:

• Lead G&A hiring across EMEA: partner with a very diverse group of business leaders, plan hiring by function (Finance, People, Legal, IT), and switch context fast to keep every business moving.
• Build our Early Talent programs in EMEA: lead local New Grad and Intern hiring, grow university relations and campus pipelines, and work with HQ on planning and execution and with local engineering leaders to hire early-career talent who meet our high bar.
• Build creative sourcing strategies across LinkedIn, referrals and other channels, tailored to each function and market and backed by EMEA market intelligence.
• Manage the pipeline from sourcing to onboarding, with an exceptional candidate experience.
• Use data to refine recruiting strategy and influence hiring decisions.
• Champion diversity, equity and inclusion through impactful hiring programs.
• Work with People, Legal, Finance and Mobility to streamline hiring, including country-specific requirements.
• Mentor peers and foster a culture of learning in the recruitment team.
• Embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale.

Minimum requirements for the role:

• You have 6+ years of proven full-cycle recruiting experience, preferably in a tech organisation with a very high hiring bar.
• You have proven experience building Early Talent programs, hiring for Engineering New Grads and Interns in UK (mandatory) and G&A roles (e.g. Finance, People, Legal, IT) in EMEA.
• You communicate with key partners in a concise, professional and pro-active way.
• You have exceptional stakeholder management abilities and executive presence, experienced working with a very diverse population of business leaders and switching context rapidly and comfortably.
• Innovation mindset: you’re comfortable implementing new tools, technologies, and methodologies.
• AI - forward: we would like to see strong analytical skills when looking into hiring data and forecasting hiring needs.
• Optimising the use of the AI tools available to create a better candidate experience and efficient workflows. No AI slop.

An ideal candidate also has:

• Deep understanding of EMEA talent market trends, turned into actionable strategies for each function.
• Proven outbound sourcing for technical and specialist talent in a competitive market.

What's in it for you?

• The chance to shape and build Samsara’s teams across EMEA.
• A high-visibility role: build connections and influence with Samsara’s regional & global business leaders.
• A passionate, innovative & AI-Forward team committed to excellence

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email accessibleinterviewing@samsara.com or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

title: Afstudeeropdracht Dynamic Cable Rating
description:
Real-time schatten van bodemcondities rondom hoogspanningskabels

De energietransitie vraagt om slimme manieren om het elektriciteitsnet beter te benutten. Bij TenneT onderzoeken we daarom hoe we ondergrondse hoogspanningskabels dynamisch kunnen belasten op basis van de actuele omstandigheden. Een belangrijke factor hierbij zijn de thermische eigenschappen van de bodem rondom de kabel. Deze bepalen hoeveel warmte een kabel kan afvoeren en daarmee hoeveel transportcapaciteit beschikbaar is.

Binnen het Dynamic Cable Rating (DCR) programma zoeken wij een afstudeerder die onderzoekt hoe Distributed Temperature Sensing (DTS) metingen kunnen worden gebruikt om bodemcondities in real-time te schatten. Het doel is een betrouwbare methode te ontwikkelen waarmee de maximale belasting van ondergrondse kabels nauwkeuriger bepaald kan worden.

Jouw bijdrage aan TenneT

Je komt terecht binnen Digital & Technology Transformation - Operate - Data & Analytics. Dit team ontwikkelt geavanceerde data-gedreven oplossingen voor de operatie van het hoogspanningsnet. Voorbeelden zijn Dynamic Asset Rating voor kabels, lijnen en transformatoren, en het voorspellen van vermogenstromen op het elektriciteitsnet.

Met deze oplossingen ondersteunen we de netbeheeroperatie bij het efficiënter benutten van het bestaande net en het verminderen van netcongestie.

Je werkt samen met data scientists, data engineers, asset specialisten en experts op het gebied van Dynamic Cable Rating.Tijdens deze afstudeeropdracht onderzoek je hoe state estimation technieken toegepast kunnen worden binnen Dynamic Cable Rating. Je werkt hierbij met data van een bestaande hoogspanningsverbinding en krijgt de mogelijkheid om theorie direct toe te passen op een praktijkcase.

Tijdens deze opdracht ga je onder andere aan de slag met:

• Uitvoeren van literatuuronderzoek naar state estimation binnen Real-Time Thermal Rating en Dynamic Cable Rating.
• Verdiepen in thermische modellen van ondergrondse hoogspanningskabels.
• Ontwikkelen en testen van een methode om bodemcondities te schatten op basis van DTS-metingen, bijvoorbeeld met Kalman filtering of andere state estimation technieken.
• Valideren van de methode op historische meetdata voor een bestaande kabelverbinding.
• Presenteren van resultaten en aanbevelingen aan stakeholders binnen het DCR-programma.
• Optioneel: implementeren van de ontwikkelde methode binnen de bestaande softwareomgeving.

Het eindresultaat is een onderbouwde en gevalideerde aanpak voor het schatten van bodemcondities rondom hoogspanningskabels. Wanneer de resultaten succesvol zijn, kan de oplossing worden opgeschaald naar andere verbindingen binnen het Nederlandse hoogspanningsnet.

Jouw profiel en achtergrond

Jij

• volgt een WO-masteropleiding in Informatica, Wiskunde, Elektrotechniek, Econometrie, Kunstmatige Intelligentie of een vergelijkbare richting.
• bent vanaf februari 2027 beschikbaar voor een afstudeeropdracht van circa vijf maanden (32-40 uur per week).
• hebt ervaring met Python en data-analyse, specifiek met Pandas of Polars.
• hebt sterke analytische vaardigheden en interesse in modelleren, statistiek en algoritmes.
• bent nieuwsgierig, proactief en zelfstandig in het uitvoeren van onderzoek.
• weet complexe technische vraagstukken terug te brengen tot praktische oplossingen.
• bent bereid ten minste één dag per week aanwezig te zijn op ons kantoor in Arnhem.

Ons recruitment process

Ons aanbod

Flexibility

Flexibiliteit voor een goede balans

We begrijpen dat je stage of afstudeeropdracht slechts één onderdeel is van je studentenleven. Daarom krijg je bij TenneT de ruimte om je werkzaamheden flexibel in te delen en waar mogelijk deels vanuit huis te werken. Zo combineer je jouw studie, sociale leven en stage op een manier die voor jou werkt.

Details

Payment & more

Aantrekkelijke stagevoorwaarden

Wij vinden het belangrijk dat jouw inzet wordt gewaardeerd. Daarom ontvang je een marktconforme stagevergoeding die afhankelijk van je opleidingsniveau varieert van €300 tot €500 bruto per maand op fulltime basis. Deze vergoeding geldt zowel voor meewerkstagiairs als voor afstudeerders.

Details

Wellness

Balance &

Personal Growth

Gezondheid – jouw basis

Goed in je vel zitten helpt je om het beste uit jezelf te halen. Daarom kun je gebruikmaken van ons vitaliteitsprogramma Always Energy, deelnemen aan sportieve activiteiten en workshops volgen over onderwerpen zoals veerkracht en mindfulness. Ook kun je in ons bedrijfsrestaurant terecht voor een gezonde en gevarieerde lunch.

Details

Technology &

Innovation

Inspirerende werkomgeving

Bij TenneT werk je in een moderne, professionele omgeving waar leren en samenwerken centraal staan. Je beschikt over goede digitale middelen, ergonomische werkplekken en moderne kantoorruimtes. Of je nu wilt sparren met collega's, nieuwe mensen wilt ontmoeten of juist geconcentreerd wilt werken: er is altijd een plek die past bij wat jij nodig hebt.

Details

Onze uitdaging

Digital & Technology Transformation (DTT) is de digitale ruggengraat van TenneT. Deze divisie maakt slim gebruik van data, technologie en AI om het net optimaal te benutten en besluitvorming te versterken.

DTT levert geïntegreerde en veilige digitale-, technologie- en dataservices die bijdragen aan efficiëntie, innovatie, veiligheid en compliance. De divisie ondersteunt bedrijfsprocessen en werkplekken met IT, ontwikkelt data- en integratieplatformen en beheert de IT-infrastructuur en cybersecurity. Zo versnelt DTT de transformatie van TenneT naar een digitale TSO.

Extra informatie

Wat bieden wij jou?

• Een reiskosten en thuiswerkvergoeding
• Hybride werken: we werken graag samen op kantoor, maar thuiswerken is ook mogelijk
• Je krijgt een laptop van TenneT gedurende je stageperiode

Salaris

500 € - 500 €

Bij TenneT willen we ons wervingsproces zo efficiënt en eerlijk mogelijk maken. Daarom gebruiken we AI-technologie als hulpmiddel. Onze AI-tool helpt ons sollicitanten te matchen op basis van relevante functietitels en vaardigheden. Het is belangrijk om te weten dat er nooit volledig geautomatiseerde beslissingen worden genomen; elke sollicitatie wordt uiteindelijk beoordeeld door een menselijke recruiter. Onze AI houdt geen rekening met persoonlijke gegevens zoals geslacht, leeftijd, afkomst of religie, waardoor er geen nadelen of discriminatie op basis van deze factoren zijn. Voor vragen of bezwaren kun je mailen naar sollicitatie@tennet.eu.

_______

TenneT houdt Nederland aan. We vervoeren 24/7 elektriciteit over het hoogspanningsnet, sluiten klanten aan en maken de energietransitie mogelijk door het net uit te breiden en slimmer te gebruiken. Samen met partners werken we aan een betrouwbaar, betaalbaar en weerbaar energiesysteem. Zo verbinden we Nederland met een duurzame toekomst.

Connecting everyone to a brighter energy future.

title: Marine Mechanical Engineer II
description:

Marine Mechanical Engineer Level 2

Business unit:

Position summary: Leidos Gibbs & Cox is seeking a Marine Mechanical Engineer Level 2 to support the design, analysis, and integration of marine mechanical systems for naval and maritime platforms. This mid-level role is suited for an engineer with experience applying technical knowledge, strong analytical skills, and interest in supporting ship design, system development, and lifecycle engineering efforts.

Primary responsibilities:

• Works independently (with moderate supervision), or on project teams
• Performs calculations applying mechanical engineering principles, procedures, and criteria.
• Develops analyses and prepares technical reports and other engineering documentation.
• Develops ship propulsion and auxiliary system calculations and designs and prepares technical purchase specifications for major equipment.

Basic qualifications:

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent education in Marine Engineering or Mechanical Engineering and 2+ years of relevant experience.
• Functional understanding of mechanical systems, thermodynamics, fluid systems, or shipboard systems
• Strong written and verbal communication skills
• Ability to work effectively in a team environment
• Proficiency with CAD and Microsoft Office applications

description:

About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Available Locations: Austin, Texas

About the role

Our centralized Developer Go-to-Market (GTM) organization functions as a "speedboat" to maintain focus, control direction, and iterate quickly. Our mission is to build long-term relationships with developers by addressing their unique needs and challenges with specialized attention and resources across Marketing, Developer Relations, Growth Programs, and Sales.

Within Developer GTM, the Revenue Engineering team exists to build and evolve GTM infrastructure to support Cloudflare’s transition into a major cloud provider and drive Cloudflare’s AI transformation. We operate across data platform development, application platforms, core pipeline evolution, and novel internal product delivery enabling teams across the organization to move fast without accumulating unmaintainable technical debt.

What You'll Do

As a hands-on "player-coach" Engineering Manager on the Revenue Engineering team, you will balance technical leadership with direct execution, actively writing code, building pipelines, prototyping novel GTM applications, and debugging alongside your team. You will lead, coach, and grow a team of high-performing software and data engineers building mission-critical GTM software, data platforms, and internal developer tools on top of Cloudflare's own developer platform (Workers, Kubernetes, Go, TypeScript, SQL, and MCP). You will take ownership of our core platform strategy, balancing fast-paced feature delivery with platform maintainability, data integrity, and operational excellence.

In this role, you will:

• Lead and Grow Engineering Talent (Player-Coach Model): Recruit, mentor, and develop a diverse team of talented software and data engineers while leading by example through active code contributions, hands-on technical guidance, and unblocking engineers directly in the codebase.
• Architect & Build Platform Primitives: Set the technical vision and actively write code for our GTM Data Platform, App Platform, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations in Go and TypeScript, enabling internal teams to build and scale maintainable solutions.
• Prototype & Deliver High-Impact Applications: Directly build and prototype novel GTM applications (Signals, Customer Health, Cost Explorer), evolve core pipelines (Salesforce enrichment, customer contact ingestion, real-time consumption billing visibility), and implement data infrastructure migrations.
• Empower & Advise Business Builders: Act as a technical advisor and partner to non-technical teams, teaching them to self-serve using supported platform primitives rather than creating isolated, unmaintainable silos.
• Drive Operational & Engineering Excellence: Establish best practices for service observability, testing, schema evolution, and deployment while mitigating bus-factor risks and single points of failure across legacy and new systems.
• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with leaders across Sales, Marketing, Developer Relations, BI, Security, and Product to align on business priorities, unblock dependencies, and turn complex business challenges into reliable software solutions.

Examples of Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience

• Hands-on Experience: Minimum 8 years of relevant software engineering experience, including at least 3 years in a formal engineering management or technical leadership role with a strong track record of remaining hands-on in the code.
• Technical Depth & Contribution: Strong background writing production code and debugging distributed systems, data pipelines, and web APIs across Go, TypeScript, Workers, Kubernetes, SQL, and MCP.
• Leadership & Team Building: Proven track record of recruiting, coaching, and developing senior technical talent while fostering an inclusive, high-trust engineering culture.
• Platform & Systems Ownership: Experience owning end-to-end service lifecycles, operational monitoring, incident management, and architectural strategy for complex internal or external platforms.
• Pragmatic Business Execution: Ability to navigate ambiguous problem spaces, balance rapid prototyping ("learning mode") with scalable platform architecture ("scale mode"), and translate business needs into robust technical roadmaps.
• Cross-Functional Communication: Exceptional collaboration skills with a track record of partnering effectively with non-technical business partners, GTM stakeholders, and executive leadership.

Bonus Points

• Cloudflare Developer Platform: Experience building on or integrating with Cloudflare Workers, edge computing platforms, or serverless architectures.
• GTM & Growth Systems: Background in SaaS, Product-Led Growth (PLG) motions, sales analytics, or working with CRM/marketing automation integrations (Salesforce, Marketo).
• Applied AI & MCP: Hands-on experience developing Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, LLM/AI integrations, or AI-driven developer workflow automation.
• Data Platform Scale: Experience with modern columnar databases / lakehouses (ClickHouse, DuckDB, BigQuery, Snowflake, Iceberg) or analytics engineering workflows.

Compensation

Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.

Equity

This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.

Benefits

Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family. Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun! The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.

Health & Welfare Benefits

• Medical/Rx Insurance
• Dental Insurance
• Vision Insurance
• Flexible Spending Accounts
• Commuter Spending Accounts
• Fertility & Family Forming Benefits
• On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program
• Global Travel Medical Insurance

Financial Benefits

• Short and Long Term Disability Insurance
• Life & Accident Insurance
• 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan
• Employee Stock Participation Plan

Time Off

• Flexible paid time off covering vacation and sick leave
• Leave programs, including parental, pregnancy health, medical, and bereavement leave

What Makes Cloudflare Special?

We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

Project Galileo: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.

Athenian Project: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.

1.1.1.1: We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.

Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!

Location: Wolverhampton, Staffordshire (WV1 2HS)

Position: Full-time, Permanent

Pay Rate: £14.50 per hour + Overtime x1.5 (after 45 hours)

Earning Potential: Additional daily bonuses available

Are you an experienced HGV Class 1 Driver with a valid ADR licence looking for stable, ongoing work with a leading name in waste management?

Join our team at the Wolverhampton depot (WV1 2HS) driving a modern Artic curtain-sider with a tail lift, collecting and transporting fridges for recycling across the region.

Pay & Perks

• Base Pay: £14.50 per hour
• Overtime: x1.5 after 45 hours worked per week
• Meal Allowance: £3.00 daily allowance
• Early Start Bonus: £10.00 extra per day
• Night Out Allowance: £26.50 per night (tramping – occasional/when required, not mandatory)
• Take-Home Pay: Excellent overtime and bonus potential to boost your weekly earnings

The Role & Schedule

• Hours: Monday to Friday (05:00 start until finish)
• Break: 30-minute unpaid break daily
• Vehicle: Artic curtain-sider with tail lift
• Duties: Safely loading, collecting, and transporting fridges and household electrical waste
• Route Stability: Reliable weekly working patterns with a supportive local transport team

Key Responsibilities

• Operating HGV Class 1 Artic vehicles with tail lifts safely and efficiently
• Carrying out daily vehicle checks and maintaining CPC and tachograph compliance
• Securing curtain-side loads correctly prior to transport
• Maintaining clear communication with the transport desk and site teams

Candidate Requirements

• Licence: Valid UK Category C+E licence & Driver CPC card
• ADR Licence: Current ADR licence required
• Tachograph: Valid Digital Tachograph card

Ready to Apply?

If you hold a valid Class 1 licence and ADR certification, click Apply Now with your updated CV, and our recruitment team will be in touch!

About You

About Us

We are Panda. We value waste.

We’re in the business of waste management but that doesn’t just mean collecting bins. Behind every collection is a passionate team of people finding smarter, safer, and more sustainable ways to recycle and repurpose materials that would otherwise go to waste.

Over the past 30 years, Panda has grown into a leading resource recovery business, bringing together almost 3,000 people across multiple brands, united by a shared vision and strong values. While our operations are diverse, our purpose is clear: to protect our people, support our customers, and create positive impact for the communities and environments we serve.

At Panda, people are at the heart of everything we do. We work as one team, combining different skills, experiences, and perspectives to achieve shared goals. We care for each other’s wellbeing, encourage development, and support growth because we know we’re stronger together.

We expect excellence in how we operate. High standards, bold thinking, and continuous improvement drive our passion for innovation. We challenge the ordinary, put safety first, and embrace new ideas while delivering practical, cost-effective solutions that move our business forward.

We own what we do. From day-to-day tasks to major projects, we take pride in our work and responsibility for the outcome. We don’t walk past problems we address them together. Our expertise, reliability, and care reflect who we are and the difference we make.

And above all, we act with trust and integrity. Trust is built through open communication, honesty, and accountability. It allows us to move quickly, make confident decisions, and deliver results — knowing our people are empowered to do the right thing.

Our journey depends on talented, committed people who want to make an impact.

Take the first step and join us on the journey.

Panda is committed to attracting and retaining a skilled and diverse workforce that reflects the communities in which we operate and the people we serve.

title: Head of Retail
description:
Job title: Head of Retail (UK & International)

Location: London (Hybrid)

Type: Full-time | Permanent

Salary: Up to £80,000 + bonus + share options

This one’s for someone who wants to keep growing a brand’s UK retail, take it international, and own both.

We’ve partnered exclusively with a founder-led brand that’s one of the UK’s leading names in women’s health. It’s stocked nationally across grocery, pharmacy and health retailers, and next year it goes international - starting with the Middle East, then Europe and the US.

They’re looking for a Head of Retail to own the retail channel and take it into new markets. If you’ve grown rate of sale with national retailers and want to build something bigger, this could be the one.

The role

This is a senior commercial role reporting to the Founder & CEO. You’ll own the retail and wholesale strategy and the full retail P&L, across existing and new partners in the UK and internationally. You’ll work across commercial, operations, brand and marketing, making sure retail is proactive, data-driven and aligned with the wider business.

Key responsibilities

• Own the retail P&L - revenue, contribution margin, trade investment and forecasting
• Lead JBPs, range reviews, promotions and trading terms with national grocery, pharmacy and health & beauty retailers
• Grow rate of sale, distribution and new retail wins
• Build the international go-to-market, choosing the right route for each territory, negotiating terms and owning each market’s P&L
• Work with Operations on stock forecasting, so hero SKUs stay on shelf
• Run retail launches and activation with Brand & Marketing
• Build the reporting and processes that make retail a predictable growth engine

About you

• Proven experience managing national retail accounts in consumer health, beauty or FMCG
• A track record of growing rate of sale within UK retailers
• Has launched or managed a brand in at least one international market, distributor-led or direct
• Commercially sharp: confident with forecasting, margin and trading analysis across currencies
• Sets the strategy and still enjoys doing the work
• Happy to travel internationally
• Supplements or VMS experience is a plus
• Relationships in Middle East pharmacy or health retail would be a bonus
• Arabic or a second European language would also help but not mandatory

Next Steps

Apply via the link or reach out to Dan@LT-Talent.co.uk for more information.

And remember - you can now apply with a traditional CV or a Video CV, whichever you prefer. There’s no pressure to be on camera and no disadvantage either way - it’s simply another way to introduce yourself.

Equal Opportunities & Application Process

LT Talent is an award-winning recruitment agency. We are committed to creating an inclusive and diverse workforce and encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds, ethnicities, genders, ages, sexual orientations, religions, and abilities.
