title: Senior Digital Marketing Executive
description:
About the role

Location: Essex / remote-first (hybrid, no fixed office days)

Salary: £28,000 - £35,000 depending on experience

Job type: Full-time, permanent

Reports to: Managing Director

We are looking for a Senior Digital Marketing Executive to own a portfolio of client accounts and the marketing that runs through them.

Better Agency is a full-funnel, multi-channel digital marketing agency working with established B2B businesses across logistics, construction and building materials, legal, property, technology and professional services. We cover SEO and AI search, paid search and paid social, creative and design, website builds, HubSpot and CRM.

This is a client-facing role first. You will be the named owner on your accounts from early on: setting the agenda, running the call, presenting the reporting, logging the actions and chasing them down internally. You will not be sitting behind someone else's account. You will work alongside our Managing Director, Business Development Director and Digital Marketing Manager, who are there to back you up, but the accounts are yours.

The other half of the role is delivery. We want a genuine multi-disciplinary marketer: strong copy, social, email, a working grasp of SEO and content performance, and enough breadth to know what good looks like across channels and when to pull in a specialist.

It suits someone who has worked in-house or in a smaller agency team, is used to wearing several hats and wants a portfolio of their own rather than a slice of someone else's.

What you will be doing

• Owning a portfolio of client accounts as the day-to-day point of contact
• Setting agendas, leading weekly and fortnightly status calls and owning the follow-up actions
• Presenting monthly performance reporting and talking confidently about what the numbers mean
• Planning, writing and editing marketing copy for websites, blogs, social, email and campaign assets
• Building and scheduling email campaigns in HubSpot or Mailchimp
• Supporting on-page SEO and content performance tracking
• Briefing designers, content writers and performance marketers, and keeping work moving to deadline
• Contributing ideas across integrated campaigns and spotting opportunities on your accounts
• Keeping internal trackers and client documentation up to date

About you

• 2 to 5 years' marketing experience, in-house or agency
• Confident and credible on a client call, including when something has gone wrong
• A strong writer with a solid grasp of tone of voice and messaging
• Organised and proactive, comfortable holding several accounts and deadlines at once
• Able to read a performance report and explain it without needing it translated for you first
• Familiar with CMS platforms such as WordPress
• Confident with email tools such as HubSpot, Mailchimp or Klaviyo
• Good foundational SEO knowledge and an understanding of how content drives search performance
• Comfortable using AI tools for ideation and productivity, and knowing when to check the output
• Friendly, approachable and naturally collaborative

Bonus points if you have

• Agency experience
• Familiarity with Google Analytics 4, Semrush or HubSpot
• Some exposure to paid social or paid search
• Design or Canva experience
• A portfolio of previous work or campaign examples

What we offer

• Remote-first and hybrid working, with no fixed office days
• 25 days' holiday plus bank holidays and your birthday off
• 9am to 5pm Monday to Thursday, 9am to 3pm Friday after probation
• Genuine development and progression as the agency grows
• Annual summer and Christmas parties with the whole group
• Regular team socials and meet-ups

﻿

Location and working pattern

Essex and remote-first. We work remotely day to day, but we attend client meetings and get the team together, so you need to be close enough to reach us and our clients when it matters. There are no fixed office days.

title: Head of Sales
description:
Head of Sales

W Talent Manufacturing are proud to be partnering with a leading UK manufacturing organisation to appoint an experienced and commercially driven Head of Sales. This is an exciting opportunity for an ambitious sales leader to take ownership of the UK commercial strategy and play a key role in the next phase of growth for the business. This is not simply a role focused on managing an existing sales team or maintaining established customer relationships. The successful individual will be expected to identify where the next stage of growth will come from, develop the commercial strategy to deliver it and build stronger relationships across the market to turn opportunity into revenue.

Industry experience is essential

We are specifically looking for someone who has built their career within the chimney, flue, fireplace, stove, wood-burners or a closely related heating/product sector. You will ideally already understand the UK market, including the relationships between manufacturers, distributors, wholesalers, independent retailers, fireplace specialists, installers and other routes to market. Your existing industry knowledge and network will be a significant advantage as you look to identify new opportunities, develop existing accounts and help shape the future commercial direction of the business.

The Opportunity

The business has a strong platform from which to grow and is looking for a Head of Sales who can help unlock its next phase. You will have the opportunity to take a fresh look at the UK market, understand where the greatest opportunities sit and develop a clear, commercially focused plan to deliver sustainable growth.

This will include:

• Growing revenue across existing markets and customer accounts.
• Identifying and developing new customers and routes to market.
• Strengthening relationships with key distributors, wholesalers, retailers and installers.
• Increasing the company's presence and profile within the UK market.
• Identifying opportunities for new products, markets and customer segments.
• Using market intelligence and customer insight to influence the wider business strategy.
• Developing a high-performing sales culture focused on accountability, activity and results.
• Working closely with technical, operations, product development and marketing teams to ensure the business is aligned around customer and market opportunities.

The role will combine strategic thinking with hands-on commercial leadership. We are looking for someone who is comfortable operating at senior level but who also enjoys being in front of customers, winning new business and developing relationships.

What will you be responsible for?

Commercial Strategy & Business Growth

You will take ownership of the UK sales strategy and translate the wider business objectives into a clear commercial growth plan.

This will include:

• Developing and implementing a UK sales strategy focused on sustainable revenue growth.
• Identifying target markets, sectors, customers and routes to market.
• Creating and managing sales forecasts, budgets and performance targets.
• Identifying gaps in the current market proposition and opportunities for growth.
• Monitoring competitor activity, market trends and customer behaviour.
• Using data and market intelligence to support commercial decision-making.
• Working with the senior leadership team to shape the future commercial direction of the business.

New Business Development

A major part of the role will be identifying where the next growth comes from.

You will:

• Proactively identify and develop new customer opportunities.
• Build relationships with new distributors, wholesalers, retailers, OEMs, contractors and installation businesses.
• Develop new routes to market and commercial partnerships.
• Convert opportunities into long-term, profitable customer relationships.
• Represent the business at industry events, exhibitions and customer meetings.
• Develop a strong and measurable sales pipeline.

Key Account Development

The role will also involve maximising the potential of the existing customer base.

You will build strong relationships with key customers and become a trusted commercial partner, understanding their businesses, challenges and future requirements.

You will:

• Develop strategic account plans for key customers.
• Identify opportunities to increase share of wallet.
• Understand changing customer requirements and feed this insight back into the business.
• Lead commercial negotiations and framework agreements.
• Provide technical and commercial support throughout the customer journey.
• Build relationships at multiple levels within key accounts.

Leadership & Influence

You will lead and develop the UK sales function, creating a culture that is commercially focused, customer-led and accountable for results.

You will work closely with:

• Product Development
• Technical
• Marketing
• Operations
• Customer Service
• Purchasing
• Senior Leadership
• European colleagues

The ability to influence across the organisation will be important, ensuring that customer and market opportunities are translated into action.

Who are we looking for?

This role requires genuine sector experience.

You are likely to be an experienced Sales Manager, Sales Director, Head of Sales, Business Development Manager or Senior Key Account Manager who has worked within one of the following industries:

Chimneys | Flues | Fireplaces | Stoves | Wood-burners | Heating Products | Fireplace & Stove Distribution | Related Building/Heating Products

You will ideally bring:

• A strong understanding of the UK chimney, flue, stove, fireplace or wood-burner market.
• Existing relationships across independent retailers, distributors, wholesalers, installers or related channels.
• A proven track record of delivering sales growth.
• Experience developing both existing accounts and new business.
• Strong commercial and negotiation skills.
• The ability to understand technical products and communicate their value to customers.
• A proactive, entrepreneurial approach to business development.
• The confidence to challenge existing ways of working and identify new opportunities.
• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
• The ability to operate strategically while remaining hands-on commercially.
• A full UK driving licence and willingness to travel regularly throughout the UK.
• Most importantly, you will be someone who wants to grow a business rather than simply manage a sales function.

Why this role?

This is an opportunity to join a business at an important stage of its development and have a visible impact on its future growth. You will have the freedom and responsibility to look at the market differently, develop new opportunities and help shape how the business grows across the UK. For the right person, this could be a genuinely career-defining opportunity: a chance to take ownership of a commercial growth agenda, build relationships across a specialist market and see the direct impact of your work on the success of the business.

Package

• £55,000 - £70,000
• Company car or car allowance
• Annual performance-related bonus
• Pension and company benefits
• Ongoing training and development
• The opportunity to play a key role in the continued growth of an established UK manufacturing business

title: Clinical Trainer
description:
Company Description

Established in 2019, Cherry Training Ltd provides bespoke training solutions across the health and social care sector. We work closely with individuals with disabilities and their carers, focusing on developing the essential skills and good practice care teams need to deliver safe, compliant, and person-centred support. Every client and care team has unique requirements, which is why our training packages are tailored directly to their specific needs.

Role Description

We are seeking an experienced Clinical Trainer to deliver high-quality, person-centred training for our clients, Personal Assistants (PAs), and care teams. In this freelance trainer role, you will play an essential part in delivering theory and practical clinical training and assessing clinical competence.

You will be delivering a wide range of specialist clinical topics, which may include:

- Autonomic Dysreflexia

- BiPAP Awareness

- Bowel Management

- Catheter Care

- Cough Assist

- Diabetes Awareness

- Enteral Feeding

- Epilepsy Awareness

- Medication Administration

- Suction Training

- Total Parenteral Nutrition (TPN)

- Tracheostomy Care

This list represents a small selection of our course offerings to reflect the calibre of trainer required for the position.

Please refer to our website for a full list of training courses: https://cherrytraining.org.uk/face-to-face-training/

Specialist and Complex Care training and support is typically delivered for our clients as follows:

Half Day training sessions

Full Day training sessions

Hourly Care Planning

Simulated and live competency assessment checks

Qualifications

- A Nursing Degree or equivalent, with an active registration with the NMC

- Appropriate adult teaching qualification, such as PTLLS

- UK Driving Licence

Experience Required

- Community complex care (minimum five years)

- Subject Matter Expert in healthcare

- Training health and social care workers (minimum one year)

- Proven experience in educating individuals and groups effectively

Strong communication skills with an approachable, supportive, and person-centred delivery style.

- Willingness to travel to deliver face to face training sessions to clients in their home

Other

- You must be able to prove your right to work in the UK

- Be able to provide an enhanced DBS Check (we can assist with this if required)

- You are required to provide your own training materials and equipment

What to expect from us

- Excellent communication and being part of a team

- Competitive training fees and timely payment starting from £250 for a half day session

- Full administrative support through the client’s training journey

- Access to our Certificate Creator

- Regular feedback and post training session support

Please review our website and if you feel that you could be the right fit for us and our clients, then please complete our Trainer Quality Assurance Checklist: https://cherrytraining.org.uk/vacancies/

description:
Für den Pflegedienst im Marien-Hospital am Standort Wesel suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt eine Pflegefachkraft für die Chirurgie in Voll- oder Teilzeitbeschäftigung.

Auf unseren chirurgischen Stationen versorgen Sie Patientinnen und Patienten mit unterschiedlichen Krankheitsbildern und nach operativen Eingriffen. Das Behandlungsspektrum ist vielseitig und bietet Ihnen ein abwechslungsreiches Arbeitsumfeld mit unterschiedlichen pflegerischen Herausforderungen und Einblicken in verschiedene Bereiche der Chirurgie.

Als Pflegefachkraft übernehmen Sie die eigenverantwortliche und fachkompetente Versorgung unserer Patientinnen und Patienten während des gesamten stationären Aufenthalts. Sie gestalten und evaluieren den individuellen Pflegeprozess, gewährleisten die prä- und postoperative Pflege, beurteilen den Gesundheitszustand, begleiten das Schmerzmanagement und fördern gezielt Mobilität und Selbstständigkeit. Dabei handeln Sie evidenzbasiert und arbeiten eng mit dem ärztlichen Dienst sowie dem interprofessionellen Behandlungsteam zusammen.

Die pro homine gGmbH ist ein moderner Dienstleister am Niederrhein. Wir agieren in den Bereichen Akutmedizin, Seniorenbetreuung und -pflege, Prävention und Rehabilitation. Zum Verbund gehören das Marien-Hospital in Wesel mit über 400 Betten, neun Senioreneinrichtungen mit 680 Plätzen, ein Reha-Zentrum, ein MVZ an drei Standorten und zwei Dienstleistungsgesellschaften. Mit etwa 2.500 Mitarbeitenden sind wir einer der größten Arbeitgeber und Ausbildungsbetriebe in der Region. Weitere Informationen zu unserem Verbund und das Bewerberportal finden Sie unter www.prohomine.de.

Ihre Aufgaben

• Fachgerechte Pflege und Betreuung von Patientinnen und Patienten in komplexen Pflegesituationen
• Sicherstellung einer professionellen Versorgung
• Aktive Teilnahme an Pflegevisiten und interdisziplinären Fallbesprechungen
• Mitwirkung an Qualitätszirkeln und kontinuierlicher Weiterentwicklung der Pflege
• Bereitschaft zur fachlichen Weiterentwicklung durch Fort- und Weiterbildungen

Wir bieten

• Faire Bezahlung, die ankommt: Attraktive Vergütung inklusive Urlaubs- und Weihnachtsgeld nach AVR-Caritas – transparent, zuverlässig und anerkennend.
• Zukunft? Gesichert! Wir kümmern uns um Ihre Altersvorsorge mit einer arbeitgeberfinanzierten betrieblichen Altersvorsorge.
• Clever sparen: Profitieren Sie zusätzlich von einem Arbeitgeberzuschuss zu vermögenswirksamen Leistungen.
• Mehr drin für Sie: Mit Corporate Benefits, exklusiven Rabatten und attraktiven Versicherungsangeboten verbessern Sie Ihre Lebensqualität spürbar.
• Immer alles im Blick: Mit unserer modernen Dienstplan-App haben Sie Ihren Arbeitsplan jederzeit und überall griffbereit.
• Nachhaltig mobil: Mit dem Dienstradleasing inkl. monatlichem Zuschuss bleiben Sie flexibel, fit – und schonen Umwelt und Geldbeutel.
• Wachsen und weiterkommen: Unser umfangreiches Fort- und Weiterbildungsangebot unterstützt Sie dabei, sich persönlich und fachlich weiterzuentwickeln.
• Mehr Zeit für Sie: Eine geregelte 5-Tage-Woche ermöglicht Ihnen eine gute Balance zwischen Beruf und Privatleben.
• Gesund bleiben: Nutzen Sie unsere vielseitigen Sport- und Präventionsangebote, um Körper und Geist in Bestform zu halten.
• Mehr Zeit für Sie: Eine geregelte 5-Tage-Woche ermöglicht Ihnen eine gute Balance zwischen Beruf und Privatleben.

Das suchen wir

• Abgeschlossene Ausbildung zur/m Gesundheits- und (Kinder-) Krankenpfleger/in bzw. (Kinder-) Krankenschwester/-pfleger, Pflegefachfrau/-mann

Wenn Sie Freude an der chirurgischen Pflege haben und Ihre Fähigkeiten in einem engagierten Team einbringen möchten, freuen wir uns darauf, Sie am Marien-Hospital Wesel willkommen zu heißen.

title: ERP Solution Architect (f/m/x) – Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & SCM
description:
Deine Mission

Du arbeitest in interdisziplinären Projektteams und unterstützt unsere Kund:innen dabei, die Implementierung von Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & SCM zur Erfolgsstory zu machen. Unsere Projekte sind vielfältig und betreffen Kund:innen aus unterschiedlichen Branchen. Du arbeitest mit Projektteams und Expert:innen aus verschiedenen Bereichen zusammen, um End to End Prozesse zu definieren und Dienstleistungen auf Basis fundierter technischer und fachlicher Expertise in Microsoft Dynamics 365 bereitzustellen.

Mithilfe etablierter Methoden sorgst Du für eine transparente Darstellung von Prozessen, Aufgaben und Strukturen im gesamten Projekt. Du bleibst am Puls der Zeit, indem Du dich kontinuierlich weiterbildest, neue Projekte umsetzt und in einem internationalen Umfeld mit vielfältigen Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten arbeitest. Ziel ist es, nachhaltige Lösungen zu schaffen und die ERP-Implementierung sowohl effektiv als auch effizient zu gestalten.

Was Dich Erwartet

• Strategisches Lösungsdesign

Definition und Implementierung integrierter ERP‑Lösungen mit Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & SCM, einschließlich der Gestaltung und Integration auf globale Geschäftsanforderungen zugeschnittener ERP‑Systeme sowie der Sicherstellung, dass Kundenbedürfnisse in umsetzbare, wirkungsvolle Dynamics‑365‑ERP‑Lösungen übersetzt werden. Dazu gehören die Analyse komplexer Schnittstellenanforderungen, die Anwendung moderner Architekturkonzepte und die Erstellung von Lösungsdesign‑Dokumenten für geschäftskritische Prozesse. Deine Expertise in neuesten Technologien und Trends gewährleistet die Entwicklung innovativer und effektiver ERP‑Landschaften.

• Projektleitung & Performance

Festlegung und Überwachung von Projektmeilensteinen zur Sicherstellung einer reibungslosen Teamabstimmung sowie Definition von Kennzahlen zur Bewertung der ERP‑Systemleistung und des Projekterfolgs über den gesamten Projektlebenszyklus. Als zentrale Ansprechperson unterstützt du Projektteams bei bereichsübergreifenden funktionalen Anforderungen und begleitest die Implementierung von Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & SCM, um sicherzustellen, dass sämtliche Projektaspekte höchsten Qualitätsstandards entsprechen.

• Kundenentwicklung & Beziehungsmanagement

Vorbereitung und Begleitung von Kund:innen bei der Einführung von ERP‑Lösungen sowie aktive Pflege der Kundenbeziehungen. Die Rolle umfasst die Beratung der Kund:innen, die enge Zusammenarbeit in agilen Projektteams sowie kontinuierliches Lernen und Wissensaustausch innerhalb des Business‑Bereichs. Darüber hinaus stellst du sicher, dass Kund:innen befähigt werden, ERP‑Systeme effektiv für ihre spezifischen Geschäftsanforderungen einzusetzen.

Qualifications

Was wir uns wünschen:

• Nachgewiesene Erfahrung in der Beratung, dem Design und der Integration von ERP-Systemen – mit Fokus auf Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & SCM – sowie fundiertes Prozesswissen in den Bereichen Supply Chain, Finance, Logistik, Produktion, Einzelhandel und/oder Projektmodul, um skalierbare Lösungen für unterschiedliche Geschäftsanforderungen sicherzustellen.
• Nachgewiesene Fähigkeit, Vertriebsstrategien in ERP-Projekten mitzugestalten und Erfolgskennzahlen für ERP-Systeme zu definieren und zu messen.
• Ausgeprägte Kommunikations- und Präsentationsfähigkeiten in Deutsch und Englisch (mindestens B2) sowie die Fähigkeit, komplexe Sachverhalte anschaulich darzustellen und im agilen Team zu arbeiten.
• Eigeninitiative, analytisches Denken, lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise, Dienstleistungsorientierung, Freude an neuen Herausforderungen und Bereitschaft zu projektabhängigen Reisen.
• Abgeschlossenes Studium (Bachelor/Master) in Wirtschaftsinformatik, Betriebswirtschaft oder einem verwandten Bereich.

Starte beruflich durch

Einige der Vorteile wenn du bei Avanade arbeitest:

• Die Möglichkeit, für Microsofts Global Alliance Partner des Jahres zu arbeiten (14 Jahre in Folge), mit außergewöhnlichen Möglichkeiten zur Weiterentwicklung und Schulung (mindestens 80 Stunden pro Jahr für Schulungen und bezahlte Zertifizierungen)
• Zusammenarbeit mit technisch versierten und qualifizierten Kolleg:innen weltweit
• Ein engagierter People Lead, der dich bei deinem Karrierewachstum unterstützt
• Motivierte und hilfsbereite Kolleg:innen, die wirklich an dir interessiert sind

Erfahre mehr über einige unserer Vorteile hier.

Der perfekte Ort zum Arbeiten

Über 60.000 Professionals, 26 Länder und ein Universum – das ist Avanade. Egal welche digitale Fragestellung, im Microsoft-Ökosystem finden wir die Lösung. Denn: Wir sind nicht von schlechten Eltern. Accenture LLP und die Microsoft Corporation haben uns 2000 in die Welt gesetzt. Logisch, dass wir das Beste aus beiden Welten gekonnt verbinden.

Wenn du dich dafür entscheidest, deine Fähigkeiten und individuellen Talente bei Avanade einzubringen, wirst du im Gegenzug einzigartige Erfahrungen, unbegrenzte Lernmöglichkeiten und ambitioniertes Wachstum erleben.

Und während wir auch weiterhin in unsere vielfältige und inklusive Kultur investieren, dabei noch innovativer und kreativer werden, sorgen wir dafür, dass unsere Kund:innen von unseren technischen Innovationen profitieren und es unseren Communities gut geht. Du wirst Teil eines smarten Teams, das dich unterstützt, fördert, leitet und auf deine Expertise baut. Der perfekte Start in einem Unternehmen, das gegründet wurde, um geschäftskritische, führende Technologielösungen zu implementieren und gleichzeitig die Art und Weise, wie Menschen arbeiten, interagieren und leben verbessern möchte.

Do What Matters

Wir glauben daran, dass inklusive und diverse Teams jede Challenge meistern – wer sich Herausforderungen mit Leidenschaft und Mut stellt, ist bei uns genau richtig. Deine Bewerbung ist willkommen - unabhängig deiner Herkunft, Nationalität, Glaube, Behinderung, Alter, Familienstand, Partnerschaftsstatus, sexueller Orientierung und deines Geschlechts. Bei uns darfst du einfach du sein. Vielfalt in jeder Form ist uns eine echte Herzensangelegenheit und ein fester Bestandteil der Avanade-Kultur.

title: Marketing Business Development Executive
description:
This is an excellent opportunity to join a leading and ambitious Credit Union in South Dublin with more 58,000 members and over €300 million in assets.

The Credit Union is looking to hire a dynamic Marketing and Business Development Executive with at least two years’ experience who will work closely with the Marketing Manager to implement the marketing plan and be an ambassador for the Credit Union

FUNCTION

Reporting to the Marketing Manager, the Marketing and Business Development Executive will support the delivery of Capital Credit Union’s marketing and business-development strategy. The role will include digital and traditional campaigns, community initiatives and business partnerships to strengthen brand awareness, member engagement and sustainable growth. The postholder will also assist in monitoring campaign performance, identify improvement opportunities and ensure, together with the Marketing Manager, that marketing activity meets regulatory and internal requirements.

REQUIREMENTS

The successful candidate will be a proactive self-starter with strong personal and interpersonal skills and ideally an understanding of the Credit Union ethos and values.

Essential

• A degree or equivalent qualification in marketing, communications, community or co-operative development, business, or comparable relevant experience.
• At least two years’ relevant marketing experience, including planning and delivering campaigns across digital and traditional channels.
• Excellent communication skills, verbal and written, with the ability to adapt messages for different audiences.
• Strong organisational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities, work independently and meet deadlines while remaining effective under pressure.
• Ability to work co-operatively as part of a team and manage relationships with internal stakeholders, community partners, suppliers and agencies.
• Practical experience with social media, CRM systems, email-marketing platforms, website content-management systems and digital analytics, together with strong Microsoft Office skills.
• Experience using campaign data and key performance indicators to evaluate performance, identify opportunities for innovation and recommend improvements.
• Creative and conceptual thinking, with awareness of current marketing technologies, channels and trends.
• A full clean driving licence and access to transport, as travel within the Credit Union’s catchment area will be required.

Desirable

• Experience in the Credit Union, financial-services or another regulated sector.
• Experience across community engagement disciplines, including events, public meetings, consultation, communications and reputation management.
• Knowledge of data-protection requirements, advertising standards and compliance considerations relevant to financial-services marketing.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

MARKETING

• Support the delivery of marketing and business-development campaigns, coordinating with internal and external stakeholders, monitoring results and identifying opportunities to improve performance.
• Assist in the management of digital marketing activity across social media, email campaigns, website content, SEO and digital advertising, creating targeted content with support from external partners.
• Use CRM data, member insights, campaign metrics and market research to strengthen engagement, increase product awareness, support membership growth and recommend compliant, innovative initiatives.

COMMUNITY

• Support youth and community initiatives, including the School Quiz, Higher Education Scholarship and other local programmes.
• Administer sponsorship applications and support the Community Council, volunteers and projects responding to community needs.
• Organise engaging events that strengthen Capital Credit Union’s visibility and positive impact across its catchment areas

BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT

• Promote Capital Credit Union and its mortgage and business lending products throughout the community while building relationships with local businesses.
• Collaborate with external partners to identify and develop revenue opportunities aligned with the Credit Union’s strategy, values and member focus

The role combines marketing, community engagement and business development responsibilities, with activity across all three areas contributing to stronger member engagement, brand awareness and sustainable growth.

The above summary job description is not intended to be a comprehensive list of duties and responsibilities. The post holder may be required to perform other duties as appropriate to the post which may be assigned to them from time to time. The job description may change in line with the evolving needs and objectives of the Company.

SALARY & BENEFITS

Capital Credit Union offers a generous remuneration package, including salary, pension and other benefits commensurate with the role and benchmarked against the market. Salary is negotiable, depending on experience.

CONTRACT & HOURS

This is initially a 12 month fixed term contract, with potential for extension.

The normal working week will be 37 hours per week, Monday to Friday. Flexibility in working hours will be required to attend meetings and represent the Credit Union at functions and events outside normal working hours. The role involves periodic weekend work and periodic evening work as required.

LOCATION

The role is based in South Dublin.

HYBRID/REMOTE WORKING

The role is considered by the Credit Union as unsuitable for hybrid or remote working. Thus, the requirement is to be on-site at the offices of the Credit Union or representing the credit union in various locations as required.

APPLICATION PROCESS

Please submit your CV and cover letter, outlining your suitability for the role, to recruitment@capitalcu.ie, using “Marketing & Business Development Executive” as the subject line.

Shortlisted candidates will be invited to interview and will be required to provide satisfactory references.

CLOSING DATE

The closing date for applications is 5pm, Monday the 16th November 2026.

Capital Credit Union is an equal opportunities employer and welcomes applications from suitably qualified candidates from all backgrounds.

description:

Il tuo ruolo

Siamo alla ricerca di un/a Purchasing and Planning Specialist. In questo ruolo sarai il punto di raccordo fondamentale tra la pianificazione della produzione, la gestione degli approvvigionamenti, la logistica operativa e le relazioni con i fornitori, garantendo l'efficienza della supply chain e la continuità dei nostri processi produttivi.

Cosa farai

In particolare, ti occuperai di:

1. Gestione Operativa Acquisti & Emissione Ordini

• Gestione e soddisfacimento delle Richieste di Acquisto (RDA) provenienti da tutti i reparti aziendali (acquisti diretti e indiretti).
• Inserimento, verifica e lancio formale dei Purchase Orders (P.O.) a sistema gestionale ERP.
• Gestione di ordini speciali, customizzazioni di prodotto e forniture sartoriali/su commessa.
• Gestione operativa e monitoraggio dei flussi legati al partner strategico Alpitronic.

2. Relazioni Fornitori & Vendor Management

• Attività quotidiana di pressing e follow-up proattivo sui fornitori per garantire il rispetto puntuale delle date di consegna confermate.
• Gestione della modulistica fornitore, anagrafiche e documentazione amministrativa/qualità.
• Monitoraggio delle prestazioni e dei KPI di puntualità e qualità dei fornitori.

3. Pianificazione, Backlog & Controllo Distinte

• Verifica e controllo periodico delle distinte base (Check BOM) a supporto della pianificazione acquisti e della produzione.
• Gestione e costante aggiornamento del backlog ordini con riprogrammazione tempestiva delle date di consegna a sistema.
• Supporto all'elaborazione MRP per il corretto approvvigionamento di componenti e materie prime.
• Monitoraggio dello stock di magazzino con identificazione e risoluzione delle giacenze negative.

4. Logistica, Spedizioni, Dogane & Magazzino

• Gestione completa delle pratiche di importazione e sdoganamento merci (procedure e documenti doganali).
• Organizzazione, spedizione e monitoraggio dei trasporti nazionali, europei e internazionali.
• Coordinamento della movimentazione materiali e trasferimenti stock tra i diversi magazzini aziendali.
• Monitoraggio dell'incoming materiale (accettazione merci) in coordinamento con la logistica interna.
• Gestione delle procedure di reso a fornitore e apertura/tracciamento delle non conformità materiali.

Requisiti richiesti

title: Financial Controller
location: Alphen aan Den Rijn, South Holland, Netherlands
description:
Wil jij als Financial Controller niet alleen verantwoordelijk zijn voor een strakke maand- en jaarafsluiting, maar ook actief bijdragen aan de consolidatie van meer dan 25 internationale entiteiten? Zoek je een rol in Alphen aan den Rijn waarin je veel zelfstandigheid krijgt, leiding kunt nemen in financiële processen en je jezelf verder ontwikkelt binnen Group Control bij een organisatie met een sterke circulaire missie?

Als Financial Controller kom je terecht in een internationale productie- en verwerkingsorganisatie in de regio Alphen aan den Rijn, waar finance direct verbonden is aan een operationele en snel bewegende praktijk. Je werkt aan een betrouwbare, volledige en tijdige financiële vastlegging binnen een organisatie die actief is in het verwerken en valoriseren van reststromen uit de voedingsmiddelen-, dranken- en biobrandstofsector. Dat maakt de rol inhoudelijk breder dan alleen rapporteren: je zit dicht op de business en ziet hoe financiële sturing samenkomt met productie, logistiek en internationale activiteiten.

In deze functie ben je medeverantwoordelijk voor maand-, kwartaal- en jaarafsluitingen, het analyseren en presenteren van financiële informatie en het ondersteunen van de groepsconsolidatie van meerdere Europese entiteiten. Daarnaast lever je een concrete bijdrage aan interne controles, rapportages voor verschillende bedrijfsonderdelen en het verder verbeteren van processen en AO-IC. Je schakelt daarbij met collega’s binnen accounting, control en de bredere organisatie, waardoor je werk afwisselend is en zichtbaar impact heeft.

De rol past goed bij een finance professional die zelfstandig werkt, maar ook graag samen optrekt in een middelgroot finance team met korte lijnen. Er is ruimte om je verder te ontwikkelen op het snijvlak van Finance & Control en Group Control, juist doordat je met verschillende entiteiten, rapportages en verantwoordingsprocessen te maken krijgt. Voor kandidaten die inhoudelijke verdieping zoeken, bijvoorbeeld richting een zwaardere control- of accountancyroute, biedt dit een omgeving waarin je brede ervaring opbouwt en verantwoordelijkheid krijgt.

Je komt terecht bij een organisatie met een ondernemende en duurzame focus, waar financiële beheersing belangrijk is in een internationale context. De combinatie van operationele dynamiek, samenwerking met verschillende disciplines en exposure naar groepsrapportages maakt dit een interessante stap voor een ervaren Controller die toe is aan meer eigenaarschap. Zoek je een functie waarin je niet alleen cijfers oplevert, maar ook helpt om processen en sturing verder te versterken, dan is dit een rol waarin je echt verschil kunt maken.

Dit zijn de belangrijkste taken in jouw rol

• Verzamel en analyseer financiële gegevens voor maand-, kwartaal- en jaarafsluitingen, zodat rapportages tijdig en betrouwbaar beschikbaar zijn.
• Voer financial control uit voor diverse entiteiten en afdelingen, waardoor je zelfstandig overzicht houdt en de financiële kwaliteit bewaakt.
• Ondersteun de groepsconsolidatie van Europese rapportages in samenwerking met accounting en business control, zodat besluitvorming op groepsniveau klopt.
• Verbeter AO-IC en interne controles samen met relevante stakeholders, zodat processen strakker verlopen en risico’s vroegtijdig worden beperkt.

Dit breng jij mee

• 3-5 jaar ervaring in financial control
• Hbo Accountancy of Finance & Control
• Ervaring met consolidatie en maandafsluitingen
• Zelfstandig, leidinggevend en sterk in AO-IC

Dit krijg je ervoor terug

• €3.900-€5.900 bruto per maand
• 32-40 uur per week
• 30 vakantiedagen en 8% vakantiegeld
• Pensioen bij PGB
• Reiskostenvergoeding en ziektekostenbijdrage
• Laptop en telefoonvergoeding BYOD
• Ontwikkeling richting Group Control
• Internationale finance-omgeving met veel zelfstandigheid

title: Controller
description:
Wil jij als Controller echt invloed hebben op de financiële koers van projecten én de totale P&L binnen een technische en maatschappelijk relevante omgeving? Krijg jij energie van het sparren met regiomanagers en projectleiders, terwijl je met scherpe analyses, forecasts en rapportages direct bijdraagt aan slimmer en toekomstbestendig mobiliteitsbeheer?

Als Controller krijg je hier een rol die verder gaat dan rapporteren alleen. Je bent het financiële aanspreekpunt voor een regio binnen een technische en projectgedreven organisatie die werkt aan verkeersmanagement, openbare verlichting, tunnels en andere mobiliteitsoplossingen in Nederland. Daarbij kijk je niet alleen naar de cijfers van vandaag, maar vooral naar de prestaties, risico’s en kansen binnen lopende projecten en onderhoudscontracten. Juist die combinatie van projectcontrol, forecasting en sparren met de business maakt deze functie herkenbaar voor een controller die dicht op de operatie wil zitten.

In deze functie werk je nauw samen met regiomanagers en projectleiders en ben je betrokken bij de volledige financiële sturing van de regio. Je stelt forecasts, prognoses en rapportages op, bewaakt budgetten en signaleert waar contracten of projecten bijsturing vragen. Je analyseert financiële prestaties op dossier- en projectniveau en vertaalt die naar advies waar het management direct mee verder kan. Daarmee ben je niet alleen het financiële geweten van de regio, maar ook een praktische gesprekspartner voor collega’s die dagelijks verantwoordelijk zijn voor uitvoering en resultaat.

De werkomgeving is internationaal ingebed, maar de praktijk is vooral tastbaar en Nederlands van aard: projecten voor overheden, infrastructuur en slimme mobiliteit. Je komt terecht in een organisatie met techniek, uitvoering en service als belangrijke pijlers, waar finance samenwerkt met projectmanagement, engineering en onderhoud. Dat vraagt om iemand die zich prettig voelt in een omgeving waar systemen, processen en projecten continu in beweging zijn. Voor een controller die energie krijgt van verbeteren, structureren en schakelen met verschillende stakeholders, biedt deze rol veel inhoud en invloed.

Deze positie past goed bij een professional met ervaring in control binnen bijvoorbeeld infrastructuur, installatietechniek of een andere projectmatige omgeving. Zeker als je graag werkt aan rapportages die echt gebruikt worden, financiële processen slimmer wilt inrichten en variatie zoekt in plaats van een afgebakende backofficefunctie, is dit een interessante stap. Je werkt in de regio West-Nederland binnen een organisatie met een brede nationale en internationale context, terwijl je dagelijks impact maakt op concrete projecten in de buitenwereld.

Controller - Dit zijn de belangrijkste taken in jouw rol

• Ontwikkel forecasts en prognoses voor regionale projecten en contracten, zodat het management tijdig kan bijsturen op financiële doelstellingen.
• Analyseer projectresultaten en P&L samen met regiomanagers en projectleiders, waardoor beslissingen beter onderbouwd zijn en prestaties inzichtelijk blijven.
• Bewaak budgetten en financiële prestaties binnen infrastructurele projecten, zodat risico’s en afwijkingen vroeg zichtbaar worden en resultaten voorspelbaar blijven.
• Verbeter financiële processen en rapportages met projectteams en management, waardoor stuurinformatie betrouwbaarder wordt en de regio efficiënter kan opereren.

Controller - Dit breng jij mee

• Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring als controller
• Hbo in finance of bedrijfseconomie
• Ervaring met projectcontrol en financiële rapportage
• Analytisch sterk, affiniteit met technische projectomgevingen

Controller - Dit krijg je ervoor terug

title: Core Data Engineer
description:
Flow Traders is looking for a Core Data Engineer to own the end-to-end lifecycle of our most fundamental data products, including our Security Master; our reconciled ETF Compositions; high-resolution historical market data; and records of our trades, orders, quotes, and inquiries. High-quality data is the cornerstone of Flow Traders' strategic direction - beyond reducing complexity and BAU for stakeholders across the organization, quality data is a key requirement for our growth of quantitative trading styles.

Specifically, you will craft and execute the blueprint for these products, leveraging our Data Platform to build and monitor automated pipelines which ensure that users across the organization have reliable data at their fingertips when they need it. Further, you will become an expert in these data sets, leveraging that knowledge to optimize our use of the data we have and explore new sources for additional value. Finally, you will constantly collaborate with teams across the organization to ensure that our in-house systems are designed with data in mind, streamline additional data-related workflows, and work with stakeholders to maximize the value they extract from our data.

As the architect and guardian of our most valuable data, you will have a unique opportunity to make your mark on Flow Traders. You will be accountable for delivering these data products at an exceptional level of quality, ensuring that they are not only timely and pristine, but powerful enough to drive Flow Traders' future growth. Ultimately, your work will not only provide highly visible benefits that every division feels every day, but it will also deliver one of the most important building blocks to the firm's strategic growth for the years to come.

What you will do

• Craft datasets with quants. Take an underspecified research question and turn it into the right dataset: aligned, adjusted, point-in-time correct, documented, and reproducible.
• Develop and own the end-to-end lifecycle of these data products. Build and maintain pipelines, develop quality checks, correct day-to-day operational issues, and systematize/automate manual processing steps
• Own data quality where it matters. Design the checks and alerts that catch the problems that would actually hurt a strategy, and deliberately leave out the ones that are just noise.
• Build shared foundations. Reference data, instrument identifiers, corporate actions and vendor feeds that every researcher and trading desk depends on.
• Keep critical pipelines running. Markets in several regions, and digital asset markets that never close, depend on this data. You will be part of a team that supports it across time zones.

What you need to succeed

Required

• Analytics or data engineering experience, ideally at a startup or scale-up through a growth phase
• Strong data modelling and data quality practice: tests, contracts, lineage, observability in production
• Strong proficiency in Python (ideally familiarity with another statically-typed language)
• Working proficiency with SQL and relational databases, and version control systems
• Demonstrated ability to work with large datasets and familiarity with big data solutions
• You have owned something in production, not only built it
• You enjoy working directly with the people who use your data
• Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders
• Ability to balance individual stakeholder requirements with data quality, consistency, and broad applicability
• Over 5 years experience working in data engineering

Strongly Preferred

title: Executive Personal Assistant
description:
We are seeking a highly experienced, professional and proactive Executive Personal Assistant to provide dedicated support to the Chief Financial Officer (CFO) of an established organisation based in Leicester.

This is a key position of trust, requiring an individual who has extensive experience supporting senior executives or Board-level leaders and is confident handling highly confidential and commercially sensitive information.

The successful candidate will be exceptionally organised, discreet and self-sufficient, with the ability to anticipate the CFO's needs, manage competing priorities and operate effectively within a busy and complex business environment.

We are particularly interested in candidates who have previously supported a CFO, CEO, Finance Director, Partner or other senior executive and understand the demands, responsibilities and discretion required at this level.

Key Responsibilities

• Provide comprehensive, high-level PA and administrative support to the CFO, ensuring the smooth and efficient management of their day-to-day activities.
• Manage a busy and frequently changing diary, coordinating meetings, appointments and commitments while proactively resolving scheduling conflicts.
• Act as a trusted point of contact for the CFO, managing communications and liaising professionally with senior internal and external stakeholders.
• Handle highly confidential, sensitive and commercially important information with absolute discretion and professionalism.
• Organise and coordinate senior management and Board-level meetings, including preparing agendas, collating documentation, taking minutes and following up on actions where required.
• Manage correspondence, emails and enquiries, prioritising matters appropriately and exercising sound judgement when handling sensitive issues.
• Prepare, format and proofread reports, presentations, correspondence and other executive documentation to a consistently high standard.
• Coordinate travel arrangements, accommodation, itineraries and associated logistics where required.
• Proactively anticipate the CFO's requirements, identifying potential issues and taking appropriate action before they arise.
• Monitor deadlines, follow up on outstanding actions and ensure important tasks and commitments are completed efficiently.
• Build and maintain effective working relationships across the organisation, demonstrating professionalism, diplomacy and approachability.
• Take ownership of administrative processes and continuously identify opportunities to improve efficiency and executive support.

Essential Skills and Experience

• Significant experience as an Executive PA or senior-level Personal Assistant, ideally supporting a CFO, CEO, Finance Director, Board member, Partner or equivalent senior leader.
• Demonstrable experience working in a position of considerable trust, regularly handling highly confidential and commercially sensitive information.
• Previous experience within a medium to large organisation, ideally employing at least 150–200 people, with an understanding of complex business structures and senior stakeholder relationships.
• Excellent diary management and organisational skills, including experience supporting executives with demanding and frequently changing schedules.
• Strong judgement, discretion and emotional intelligence, with the confidence to handle sensitive situations appropriately.
• A proactive and forward-thinking approach, with the ability to anticipate requirements rather than simply respond to instructions.
• Exceptional attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities, deadlines and competing demands calmly and effectively.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with confidence engaging with senior executives and external stakeholders.
• A high level of independence, initiative and personal accountability.
• Strong IT skills, particularly Microsoft Outlook, Word, Excel and PowerPoint.
• A professional, polished and diplomatic manner, combined with the ability to develop positive working relationships at all levels.

Desirable Experience

• Previous experience supporting a CFO or another senior finance executive.
• Experience within professional services, legal, financial services or a similarly structured corporate environment.
• Exposure to Board meetings, executive leadership teams and senior-level reporting.
• Experience working within a business where confidentiality, governance and commercial sensitivity are particularly important.

title: ADHD Nurse Prescriber

Non-Medical Prescriber (NMP) – ADHD Medication Initiation & Titration

• £65 per ADHD medication initiation appointment (approximately 45 minutes)
• £40 per ADHD medication titration appointment (30-minute slots)

About the Opportunity
An exciting opportunity is available for an experienced Non-Medical Prescriber (NMP) specialising in ADHD to join a growing clinical service based onsite in Salford.

The service is seeking a qualified and experienced prescriber who has demonstrable experience working with both children and adults with ADHD, particularly in relation to medication initiation and titration.

This opportunity would suit an experienced ADHD prescriber looking for flexible, session-based work within a specialist clinical environment.

Key Responsibilities

• Conduct ADHD medication initiation appointments for children and adults.
• Undertake medication titration appointments, monitoring patients' responses to prescribed medication.
• Assess patients' suitability for ADHD medication in line with clinical guidelines and prescribing protocols.
• Review medication effectiveness, tolerability and potential side effects.
• Provide appropriate clinical advice and guidance to patients and, where appropriate, their families or carers.

Essential Requirements

• Qualified Non-Medical Prescriber (NMP) with an appropriate prescribing qualification.
• Demonstrable experience prescribing ADHD medication.
• Experience working with both paediatric and adult ADHD patients.
• Experience in ADHD medication initiation and titration.
• Strong clinical assessment, decision-making and prescribing skills.
• Excellent communication and patient engagement skills.
• Ability to work onsite in Salford.

All appointments will be conducted onsite in Salford. Candidates must be able to commute to the clinic.

Interested? If you are an experienced ADHD Non-Medical Prescriber with experience supporting both children and adults, and are interested in flexible session-based work, we would love to hear from you.

Please submit your CV for consideration, highlighting your ADHD prescribing experience and availability.

title: Finance Systems Analyst
description:
Our Story

Hello there. We’re Zopa.

We started our journey back in 2005, building the first ever peer-to-peer lending company. Fast forward to 2020 and we launched Zopa Bank. A bank that listens to what our customers don’t like about finance and does the opposite. We’re redefining what it feels like to work in finance. Our vision for a new era of banking puts people front and centre — we’ve built a business that empowers everyone to aim high, every day, to move finance forward. Find out more about our fantastic offerings at Zopa.com!

We’re incredibly proud of our achievements and none of it would be possible without the amazing team here. It’s not just industry awards we’re winning, we’ve also been named in the top three UK’s Most Loved Workplaces.

If you embrace unconventional challenges, are unafraid to think differently and are driven to make an outsized impact, you’ll thrive here at Zopa, so join us, and make it count. Want to see us in action? Follow us on Instagram @zopalife

Our Finance Systems team supports the systems and data flows that Finance relies on for reporting and business change. Working across Finance, Technology and Product, the team helps turn changing requirements into practical solutions.

As we invest in a new general ledger and data platform, you’ll help keep existing systems running while contributing to the future of our finance function.

A day in the life

• Monitor finance systems, investigate alerts and help resolve issues affecting data flows and reporting.
• Carry out system administration and month-end controls, documenting access and changes.
• Investigate the root cause of data and reconciliation issues, and propose practical solutions.
• Work with Finance, data and Technology colleagues to understand requirements and agree priorities.
• Contribute to preparation and testing for the new general ledger and wider systems change.
• Support new reporting requirements and product launches, balancing interim fixes with longer-term improvements.
• Explore opportunities to automate processes, with appropriate checks and controls.

About you

• You understand finance, accounting and reporting processes and can apply that knowledge to systems or data problems.
• Enjoy investigating unclear problems and can explain your findings and recommendations.
• Approach system changes carefully, with attention to testing, documentation and controls.
• Organise competing requests and communicate clearly with a range of stakeholders.
• You take ownership, seek support when needed and are keen to learn new systems and ways of working.

Bonus points for

• Experience administering finance systems or supporting SAP.
• Working knowledge of SQL, visualisation or reconciliations across data sources.
• Exposure to financial services, regulated environments or ERP migrations.
• Experience with automation, AI, Snowflake, Python or dbt.

#LI-LK1

At Zopa we value flexible ways of working.

We value face-to-face collaboration and a good work-life balance. This hybrid role requires you to come to our London office 2-3 days a week.

You'll also have the option of working from abroad for up to 120 days a year!* But no matter where you are, we’ll make sure you’ve got everything you need to thrive, both in your work and home life, from day one.

*Subject to having the right to work in the country of choice

Diversity Statement

Zopa is proud to offer a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and backgrounds leads to better products for our customers and a unique company culture for our people. We are made up of nearly 50 nationalities, have a DE&I forum made up of Zopians wanting to make a difference and we are proud of our culture where everyone can bring their full self to work. Our approach to DE&I is reflected in our hiring process so please let us know if you require any reasonable adjustments.

Our approach to AI in interviews

At Zopa, AI isn't something we're testing out — it's part of how we work every day. As a proud partner of Jobs 2030, we're committed to building AI fluency across our workforce, and we expect Zopians to use AI as part of how they do their jobs.

Because of that, we want to be transparent about how we think about AI use during our hiring process.

Behavioural and competency-based interviews: please don't use AI. These conversations are designed to understand you — your experiences, your judgment, and how you've approached real situations. An AI-generated answer can't tell us that. What it can do is get in the way of us finding out whether we're the right fit for each other.

Technical interviews: it depends on the role. Some technical stages actively welcome AI use, others don't. Your Talent Partner will let you know what's expected at each stage. Where AI is part of the assessment, we'll be interested not just in the outcome, but in how you used it – the tools you chose, your reasoning, and the decisions you made along the way.

title: Elektroniker / Elektromonteur (m/w/d) Straßenbeleuchtung
description:
Sie wollen unsere Region mit innovativen Lösungen aktiv mitgestalten? In unserem Team bei der RhönEnergie Effizienz + Service leisten Sie mit effizienten und optimierten Lösungen für Industrie, Gewerbe, Kommunen und Privathaushalte einen wichtigen Beitrag zur Entwicklung unserer Region. Hier schaffen Sie mit Services rund um Energie, Umwelt und Technik – von der Umsetzung von Infrastrukturprojekten über die Begleitung von Fachplanern und Bauherren – die Grundstruktur unserer Region für morgen.

Hier bringen Sie sich ein

• Sie betreuen die technische Umsetzung und Installation von modernen Beleuchtungskonzepten
• Sie sind verantwortlich für die Durchführung von Wartungs-, Inspektions- und Reparaturarbeiten an Beleuchtungsanlagen (z. B. Straßenbeleuchtung, Eventbeleuchtung oder Parkplatzbeleuchtung)
• Nach erfolgreicher Einarbeitung unterstützen Sie das Team bei der Übernahme von Störungs- und Bereitschaftsdiensten für mehr als 32.000 Leuchten

Hiermit begeistern Sie uns

• Sie bringen eine abgeschlossene Berufsausbildung als Elektroniker (m/w/d) der Fachrichtung Energie-, Gebäude- oder Betriebstechnik beziehungsweise eine vergleichbare Qualifikation mit
• Idealerweise verfügen Sie bereits über erste Erfahrung im Umgang mit Licht- und Beleuchtungsanlagen sowie deren Montage, Wartung und Reparatur
• Alternativ konnten Sie als Elektroinstallateur bereits Erfahrung im Bereich der Elektroinstallation sammeln und bringen die Motivation zur Einarbeitung in die beschriebenen Aufgabenbereiche mit
• Eine gültige Fahrerlaubnis der Führerscheinklasse C1 wäre wünschenswert
• Eine eigenständige, verantwortungsbewusste und zielorientierte Arbeitsweise mit hoher Dienstleistungs- und Teamorientierung runden Ihr Profil ab

Wir bieten Ihnen Freiraum und vieles mehr

• Ein abwechslungsreiches Arbeitsumfeld in einem krisensicheren und unbefristeten Arbeitsverhältnis mit guter Einarbeitung
• Ein moderner Arbeitsplatz - ohne Montagetätigkeit - in der Region Fulda (Radius ca. 50 Km) mit guter Verkehrsanbindung - Fahrzeit ist bei uns selbstverständlich Arbeitszeit
• Eine leistungsgerechte Vergütung und weitere attraktive Rahmenbedingungen (z. B. Weihnachtsgeld/Treueprämie und Sachbezugskarte)
• 30 Urlaubstage, für Freistellung am 24.12 und 31.12 (zusammen nur ein Urlaubstag) und Sonderurlaub (z. B. bei Geburt oder Hochzeit)
• Unterstützung der Vereinbarkeit von Beruf und Familie durch flexible Arbeitszeiten + Arbeitszeitkonto
• Die Qualität der von uns angebotenen Dienstleistungen steht und fällt mit der Kompetenz unserer Mitarbeitenden – deshalb fördern wir die persönliche Entwicklung durch moderne Weiterbildungsangebote (E-Learning, Präsenzseminare etc.)
• Eine betriebliche Altersversorgung (vom Arbeitgeber mitfinanziert), Corporate Benefits, Gesundheitstage sowie unserem JobRad-Leasing-Angebot
• Kostenfreies laden des privaten Elektroautos am Arbeitsplatz
• Bei uns wird noch selbst gekocht! In unserem hauseigenen Bistro 52 wird täglich für das leibliche Wohl gesorgt und die Mitarbeitenden erhalten einen Zuschuss zum Mittagessen

Sie sind voller Energie!

Dann schicken Sie uns Ihre Bewerbungsunterlagen mit Angabe Ihrer Gehaltsvorstellung und des frühestmöglichen Eintrittstermins bitte ausschließlich über unser Online-Bewerbungsformular.

title: Pflegeexperte (m/w/d) für außerklinische Kinderintensivpflege in Dresden - jetzt 2.000 € Wechselprämie sichern!
description:
Ganzheitliche Intensivpflege für unsere Kleinsten – mit Zeit, Herz und echter Aufmerksamkeit für jedes einzelne Kind

In unserer vollstationären Kinderintensivpflege in Dresden arbeiten wir in einer Versorgungsform, die es so nur selten gibt: mit mehr Zeit, echter Beziehungsarbeit und einem Umfeld, das auf die individuellen Bedürfnisse unserer kleinen Patient:innen ausgerichtet ist.

Hier steht nicht der Klinikalltag im Vordergrund, sondern eine langfristige, ganzheitliche Begleitung – getragen von einem interdisziplinären Team, das eng zusammenarbeitet und unterschiedliche Fachkompetenzen vereint.

Zur Erweiterung unseres bestehenden Teams suchen wir für unsere Kinderintensivpflege-Einrichtung in Dresden einen Pflegeexperten (m/w/d). In dieser verantwortungsvollen Position unterstützen Sie das Pflegeteam fachlich, begleiten komplexe Versorgungssituationen und tragen maßgeblich zur Sicherstellung sowie Weiterentwicklung unserer Pflegequalität bei.

Zur Gewährleistung einer 24-stündigen Versorgung arbeiten wir dabei im 3-Schichtsystem.

Was Sie bei uns erwartet

Vergütung & finanzielle Vorteile

• Vergütung gemäß Tarifvertrag mit zwei modernen Lohnmodellen und einem Zuschlagssystem von bis zu 150 % (netto)
• Funktionszulagen für die Ausübung zusätzlicher Tätigkeiten
• Wechselprämie: 2.000 €
• Jahressonderzahlung: Zwei zusätzliche Zahlungen pro Jahr
• Mitarbeiter-werben-Mitarbeiter-Prämie: Bis zu 1.500 € (anteilig für Teilzeit)
• Vermögenswirksame Leistungen & betriebliche Altersvorsorge

Arbeitsbedingungen

• Unbefristete Anstellung in Teil- oder Vollzeit
• 30 Tage Urlaub pro Jahr
• Strukturierte, individuelle Einarbeitung durch erfahrene Kolleginnen und Kollegen
• Pflege ohne Zeitdruck dank klar geplanter Abläufe

Entwicklung & Perspektiven

• Arbeitgeberfinanzierte Fort- und Weiterbildungen

Zusätzliche Benefits

• Mitarbeiterrabatte bei über 800 Partnerunternehmen
• Betriebliches Gesundheitsmanagement mit Online-Angeboten zu Bewegung, Stressmanagement und Ernährung

Ihre Aufgaben

• Durchführung von Pflegevisiten bei Neu- und Wiederaufnahmen von Klientinnen und Klienten
• Fachliche Beratung und Anleitung der Pflegekräfte in der außerklinischen Intensivpflege, insbesondere zu Beatmung, Inhalation, Atemluftbefeuchtung, Tracheostomie, Tracheostomapflege und endotrachealem Absaugen
• Übernahme der fachlichen Rufbereitschaft für Mitarbeitende, auch an Wochenenden und Feiertagen
• Enge Zusammenarbeit mit behandelnden Fachärztinnen und Fachärzten
• Unterstützung bei der Einarbeitung neuer Mitarbeitender und Begleitung von Praktikanten und Auszubildenden
• Organisation und Durchführung von Geräteeinweisungen inklusive Sicherstellung der sachgerechten Dokumentation

Ihr Profil

• Pflegefachkraft (m/w/d) mit mindestens 3 Jahren Berufserfahrung im Beatmungsbereich und die erfolgreiche Teilnahme an einem zertifizierten Expertenkurs (mindestens 200 Stunden) zum „Pflegeexperten für außerklinische Beatmung“
• Einfühlsamer, empathischer Umgang mit unseren Patienten (m/w/d)
• Ausgeprägte kommunikative Fähigkeiten
• Herz und Leidenschaft für den Pflegeberuf

title: Associate, Institutional Sales & Client Services (M/W/D)
description:
Associate, Institutional Sales & Client Services (M/W/D)

Dimensional, a global asset manager with roughly $1 trillion in assets under management, is excited to offer a talented individual a new opportunity to join our rapidly expanding team in the heart of Munich.

The Associate will become part of the Global Client Group (GCG), which is Dimensional’s distribution arm comprising of sales channels that target a diverse client set. By putting the client first, we strive to transform the way the world invests, and our solutions are a testament to the value provided to our clients.

Reporting to the Head of Client Relationship Group, the role of the Associate is to support Dimensional’s institutional business development in the DACH region Associates across the Global Client Group provide relationship management and analytical analysis in helping to grow the existing client panel and develop new business opportunities for Dimensional.

The individual will be expected to demonstrate their interest in getting to know Dimensional’s client service and business development efforts. In return you will receive best in class on the job training across multiple skills and disciplines and be able to collaborate and contribute to a team-based and inclusive environment.

Responsibilities

• Become an expert on Dimensional’s evidence-based investment approach and its implementation across strategies and vehicle types (including funds, active ETFs and separate accounts).
• Become an integral part of the Client Relationship Group and support the institutional sales team in all client service-related aspects.
• Prepare and manage presentations and client materials on Dimensional’s strategies, research, asset allocation, ESG and other investment topics.
• Oversee and coordinate regular client reporting and answer related questions with support from internal subject matter experts.
• Maintain accurate client records using our advanced CRM system.
• Undertake a range of projects to support sales and client relationship efforts, such as researching market segments or prospective clients.
• Collaborate with colleagues across our Investment, Marketing and Events teams, providing our clients with a true Dimensional 360™ experience.
• Build relationships with colleagues across the Global Client Group and other internal departments, both locally and in our other global offices.
• Over the long term, develop and take over own client relationships.

Requirements

• Native or fluent German language skills, both verbal and written, are essential. Fluency in English is also required.
• Bachelor’s degree, or equivalent, in a relevant discipline is required.
• Robust experience working in the investment or asset management industry or related experience.
• Solid understanding of public equity markets. Knowledge of fixed income markets is a plus.
• Experience with separate accounts and KVGs is a plus.
• Excellent process management skills, handling different tasks in parallel.
• High attention to detail and comfortable working independently.
• Excellent analytical, interpersonal, verbal and written communication skills to articulate investment concepts to a variety of audience types.
• An ability to develop and sustain relationships with internal stakeholders, our clients and senior managers.
• Solid Excel and PowerPoint skills.

Associate, Institutional Sales & Client Services (m/w/d)

Dimensional, ein global tätiger Vermögensverwalter mit einem verwalteten Vermögen von rund 1 Billion US-Dollar, freut sich, einer talentierten Persönlichkeit eine neue Gelegenheit zu bieten, unser dynamisch wachsendes Team im Herzen Münchens zu verstärken.

Der bzw. die Associate wird Teil der Global Client Group (GCG) – Dimensionals Vertriebseinheit, die verschiedene Vertriebskanäle für eine vielfältige Kundschaft umfasst. Indem wir den Kunden in den Mittelpunkt stellen, verfolgen wir das Ziel, die Art und Weise, wie die Welt investiert, grundlegend zu verändern. Unsere Lösungen sind ein Beleg für den Mehrwert, den wir unseren Kunden bieten.

In direkter Berichtslinie an den Head of Client Relationship Group besteht die Aufgabe des bzw. der Associate darin, Dimensionals institutionelle Geschäftsentwicklung in der DACH-Region zu unterstützen. Associates innerhalb der Global Client Group übernehmen das Relationship Management sowie analytische Aufgaben und tragen dazu bei, den bestehenden Kundenstamm auszubauen und neue Geschäftsmöglichkeiten für Dimensional zu erschließen.

Von dem bzw. der Kandidat/in wird erwartet, ein ausgeprägtes Interesse an Dimensionals Kundenservice und Geschäftsentwicklung zu zeigen. Im Gegenzug erhalten Sie eine erstklassige Einarbeitung über verschiedene Fähigkeiten und Fachbereiche hinweg und können in einem teamorientierten und inklusiven Umfeld mitwirken und einen wertvollen Beitrag leisten.

Aufgaben

• Sie werden zum Experten für Dimensionals evidenzbasierten Investmentansatz und dessen Umsetzung über verschiedene Strategien und Anlagevehikel hinweg (einschließlich Fonds, aktiver ETFs und Separate Accounts).
• Sie werden ein integraler Bestandteil der Client Relationship Group und unterstützen das institutionelle Vertriebsteam in allen Belangen des Kundenservice.
• Sie erstellen und verwalten Präsentationen und Kundenunterlagen zu Dimensionals Strategien, Research, Asset Allocation, ESG und weiteren Investmentthemen.
• Sie steuern und koordinieren das regelmäßige Kundenreporting und beantworten – mit Unterstützung interner Fachexperten – damit verbundene Fragen.
• Sie pflegen präzise Kundendaten in unserem modernen CRM-System.
• Sie übernehmen verschiedene Projekte zur Unterstützung der Vertriebs- und Kundenbeziehungsaktivitäten, etwa die Analyse von Marktsegmenten oder potenziellen Kunden.
• Sie arbeiten mit Kollegen aus den Bereichen Investment, Marketing und Events zusammen und bieten unseren Kunden so ein echtes Dimensional 360™-Erlebnis.
• Sie bauen Beziehungen zu Kollegen innerhalb der Global Client Group sowie zu anderen internen Abteilungen auf – sowohl lokal als auch in unseren weiteren globalen Niederlassungen.
• Langfristig entwickeln und übernehmen Sie eigene Kundenbeziehungen.

Anforderungen

• Deutschkenntnisse auf muttersprachlichem oder verhandlungssicherem Niveau in Wort und Schrift sind zwingend erforderlich. Fließende Englischkenntnisse werden ebenfalls vorausgesetzt.
• Ein Bachelor-Abschluss oder eine gleichwertige Qualifikation in einem relevanten Fachgebiet ist erforderlich.
• Fundierte Berufserfahrung in der Investment- oder Asset-Management-Branche oder in einem verwandten Bereich.
• Solides Verständnis der öffentlichen Aktienmärkte. Kenntnisse der Anleihenmärkte sind von Vorteil.
• Erfahrung mit Separate Accounts und KVGs ist von Vorteil.
• Ausgezeichnete Fähigkeiten im Prozessmanagement sowie in der parallelen Bearbeitung verschiedener Aufgaben.
• Hohe Sorgfalt und die Fähigkeit, selbstständig zu arbeiten.
• Ausgezeichnete analytische, zwischenmenschliche sowie mündliche und schriftliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten, um Investmentkonzepte gegenüber unterschiedlichen Zielgruppen verständlich zu vermitteln.
• Die Fähigkeit, Beziehungen zu internen Stakeholdern, unseren Kunden und Führungskräften aufzubauen und zu pflegen.
• Solide Excel- und PowerPoint-Kenntnisse.

title: Customer Service Representative
description:
About The Company

Excelitas Deutschland GmbH is part of Excelitas, a global technology company focused on developing market-oriented solutions for original equipment manufacturers (OEMs) and end users. The company’s technologies support customers working in life sciences, advanced industrial markets, next-generation semiconductor manufacturing, and aerospace. Its areas of expertise include sensing, detection, imaging, optics, and specialty light sources.

At Excelitas, technology is shaped around real-world applications and customer needs. Teams contribute to products and solutions that help customers detect, measure, illuminate, and interpret their environments with precision. The company’s work connects scientific and engineering expertise with practical requirements across industries where performance, reliability, and innovation matter. Excelitas invites people who are motivated by technology and collaboration to help create what comes next.

About The Role

This opportunity is suited to professionals who want to contribute to the development, delivery, or support of advanced technology solutions. Depending on the specific position, your work may involve product development, engineering, manufacturing, quality, operations, customer support, or another function that helps turn customer requirements into effective outcomes. You will work with colleagues across relevant teams to support projects, solve problems, and contribute to the company’s objectives.

The exact scope, responsibilities, and qualifications will depend on the specific vacancy. Successful candidates are expected to bring a thoughtful, practical approach to their work, communicate clearly, and take ownership of their contributions. Whether you are applying your experience to an established product or supporting new ideas, you will have the opportunity to make a meaningful contribution within a global technology business.

Qualifications

Qualifications will vary according to the position and its level of responsibility. Applicants should review the requirements listed in the full vacancy and provide clear information about how their education, skills, and experience relate to the role. Relevant technical, scientific, operational, commercial, or administrative experience may be valuable, depending on the function.

Excelitas welcomes candidates who demonstrate sound judgment, curiosity, and a commitment to quality. The ability to work collaboratively, manage priorities, and communicate effectively with colleagues or customers can support success across many teams. Familiarity with relevant tools, processes, standards, or industry requirements may also be beneficial where applicable. If you are interested in the opportunity but do not meet every listed qualification, consider applying when your experience is meaningfully aligned with the role.

Responsibilities

Responsibilities will be defined in the specific job posting and may differ by team. Depending on the position, you may contribute to designing, developing, testing, producing, or supporting technologies and products. You may also help assess requirements, document work, analyze information, address technical or operational issues, and coordinate activities with colleagues and stakeholders.

Across functions, employees are expected to follow applicable procedures, maintain a focus on quality and safety, and contribute to reliable outcomes for customers. The role may involve sharing knowledge, identifying opportunities to improve processes, and adapting to changing project or business needs. Clear communication and constructive teamwork are important when working across disciplines and locations.

Benefits

Excelitas offers the opportunity to work in an international technology environment and contribute to solutions used across a range of important industries. Employees can collaborate with colleagues from different disciplines and apply their expertise to customer-focused work. Specific compensation, benefits, development opportunities, and workplace arrangements depend on the position, location, and applicable company policies. Please refer to the full vacancy or discuss these details during the recruitment process.

Equal Opportunity

Excelitas Deutschland GmbH is committed to fair and respectful hiring. Employment decisions are based on role-related qualifications, skills, experience, and business needs. We welcome applications from people with diverse backgrounds and perspectives and aim to provide an inclusive recruitment process. title: Junior Accountant
description:
Junior Accountant

Location: Dublin City Centre

Working arrangement: Hybrid – 3 days working from home per week

About the Role

We are seeking a motivated Junior Accountant to join the finance team of an established multinational retail business.

Working closely with the Financial Controller, you will support the preparation of monthly management accounts, maintain accurate financial records and help analyse performance across departments and stores.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone developing their accounting career who wants practical experience, professional study support and the opportunity to take on greater responsibility. You will gain broad exposure to a multi-site retail business and see how your work supports commercial decisions.

Key Responsibilities

• Monthly Accounts and Financial Reporting
• Prepare and post monthly journals, ensuring entries are accurate and completed within agreed deadlines.
• Maintain accruals and prepayments schedules and prepare the associated accounting entries.
• Support the month-end close and preparation of monthly management accounts.
• Complete quarterly balance sheet reconciliations, investigating differences and resolving outstanding items.
• Maintain clear supporting records for accounting entries and reconciliations.

Business Performance and Analysis

• Assist the Financial Controller in reviewing monthly profit and loss results against budget.
• Investigate significant variances and prepare clear explanations of financial movements.
• Prepare supporting schedules and analysis for the Financial Controller’s review.
• Generate departmental and store profit and loss reports once monthly results have been approved.
• Distribute reports to Department Heads and Regional Managers, helping address queries on costs, performance and variances.

Property Costs and Fixed Assets

• Review property-related invoices and arrange approval in line with internal procedures.
• Prepare monthly and quarterly property payment schedules.
• Reconcile property invoices against payments and follow up on discrepancies.
• Update the fixed asset register quarterly, accurately recording additions, disposals and other movements.

Finance Team Support

• Support ad hoc reporting, analysis and finance projects.
• Help improve the accuracy and efficiency of accounting processes and reporting.
• Work with colleagues across the business to resolve finance queries.
• Build your knowledge of the wider finance function and take on additional responsibilities as your experience develops.

About You

You will be working towards a recognised accounting qualification, such as ACCA, ACA or CIMA, or may have recently qualified and be seeking a role that broadens your practical experience.

You will bring:

• A sound understanding of accounting principles and double-entry bookkeeping.
• Strong numerical and analytical skills, with an interest in business performance.
• Good Microsoft Excel skills.
• Excellent attention to detail and an organised approach to managing deadlines.
• Clear communication skills and the ability to work with colleagues outside finance.
• A proactive attitude, willingness to learn and confidence to investigate discrepancies.
• Previous experience using an accounting or ERP system would be an advantage.

What’s on Offer

• Support towards professional accounting qualifications, including payment of ACCA examination fees.
• Direct guidance and support from the Financial Controller.
• Practical experience in management accounts, financial reporting and commercial analysis.
• Exposure to the finance operations of a multinational retail business.
• Opportunities to develop your skills and take on increasing responsibility.

Samen ondernemen en winnen

Dát is ons Jumbo DNA en daar doe jij als Vulploegmedewerker nog een schepje bovenop. Hoe? Inspelen op jouw wensen

Het meest klantvriendelijke bedrijf van de wereld zijn. Dat betekent inspelen op de wensen van de klant én onze collega’s. Als Vulploegmedewerker mag je dus ook wat van ons verwachten.
