title: Werkvoorbereider Installatietechniek Utiliteitsbouw
description:
Building a sustainable tomorrow

Wat als jij als Werkvoorbereider Werktuigbouwkunde (Installatietechniek) meebouwt aan slimme, duurzame utiliteitsprojecten in de randstad zoals in Amsterdam, Utrecht, Rotterdam en Den Haag? Bij BAM Bouw & Techniek – Projecten zorg jij dat techniek, planning en uitvoering soepel in elkaar grijpen. Je werkt aan grote projecten met impact, krijgt veel verantwoordelijkheid en je ontwikkelt jezelf in een omgeving waar samenwerking en veiligheid voorop staan.

Maak het mogelijk

ls werkvoorbereider installatietechniek maak jij het werk buiten mogelijk. Jij zorgt dat mensen, materialen en informatie op tijd klaarstaan. Je denkt vooruit, stemt af met engineers, bouwpartners en het uitvoeringsteam en houdt overzicht in een complexe projectomgeving.

In deze rol:

• maak je planningen voor de korte én lange termijn en stuur je bij waar nodig;
• schat je tijd, middelen en risico’s realistisch in en zorg je dat alles goed op elkaar aansluit;
• bewaak je veiligheid, projectafspraken en regelgeving;
• ondersteun je de projectleider en denk je mee over de volgende stappen;
• richt je het documentmanagementsysteem slim in, zodat iedereen met de juiste informatie werkt.

Een dag uit het leven van de werkvoorbereider:

07:30 – Je start de dag op de bouwplaats, bijvoorbeeld op Schiphol A-Pier of op een project in Amsterdam, Utrecht, Rotterdam of Den Haag. Je checkt de planning en stemt met de uitvoerder af wat er vandaag speelt. Je bereidt termijnbonnen voor en controleert of materialen op tijd geleverd worden.

09:00 – Er is een technisch vraagstuk, zoals een aanpassing aan cv-leidingen. Je rekent door, schakelt met het BIM-team en zorgt dat de wijziging snel en goed wordt verwerkt.

10:30 – Je loopt een ronde over de bouwplaats. Je checkt of het werk volgens plan verloopt en helpt collega’s met vragen, bijvoorbeeld over luchtbehandelingskasten.

12:00 – Lunch. Even ontspannen en bijpraten met collega’s van uitvoering en engineering. Dat helpt later op de dag om nóg beter samen te werken.

13:00 – Je werkt het documentmanagementsysteem bij en zorgt dat iedereen de juiste tekeningen en documenten heeft. Je stemt af met de projectcontroller over een bestelling en met de projectleider over de planning van de volgende bouwzone.

15:30 – Laatste check. Leveringen zijn geregeld, de planning klopt en het team weet wat er morgen nodig is. Je sluit af met een goed gevoel: vandaag heb je gebouwd aan iets dat ertoe doet.

Jouw team

Je werkt bij BAM Bouw & Techniek – Projecten aan slimme, duurzame utiliteitsbouw en technische eyecatchers in Amsterdam, Utrecht, Rotterdam en Den Haag. BAM onderscheidt zich door de integrale Bouw én Techniek aanpak. Denk aan projecten zoals Schiphol A-Pier of het nieuwe hoofdkantoor van ABN AMRO. Je werkt samen met collega’s uit werktuigbouwkunde, elektrotechniek en bouwkunde. De teamgrootte verschilt per projectfase en kan oplopen tot honderden collega’s op de bouw.

Wij bieden jou

Bij BAM geloven we in het investeren in onze medewerkers en het creëren van een positieve en inclusieve werkcultuur. Bij BAM kun je werken in een veilige innovatieve omgeving en waar je een goede balans kunt vinden tussen werk en privé. Daarnaast bieden we je:

• Een salaris tussen € 3.010 - € 5.280 per 4 weken (x13) (op basis van 40 uur, exclusief 8% vakantiegeld), afhankelijk van jouw kennis en ervaring.
• Direct een contract voor onbepaalde tijd.
• Goede arbeidsvoorwaarden volgens de cao Technisch Installatiebedrijf, inclusief 25 vakantiedagen en 13 roostervrije dagen per kalenderjaar.
• Gelet op het mobiele karakter van deze functie zal een elektrische leaseauto of een persoonlijk mobiliteitsbudget conform onze leaseautoregeling worden toegekend
• Een volledig ingerichte thuiswerkplek, laptop en iPhone.
• Opleidingen en (online) trainingen via ‘BAM Learning’ en andere cursussen en trainingen in overleg.
• Fijne extra’s, zoals korting op sport(abonnementen) en voordelen op o.a. privéverzekeringen, Microsoft Office en lease-a-bike regeling..

Hier herken jij jezelf in

Je krijgt energie van plannen, organiseren en samenwerken. Je schakelt snel, houdt overzicht en communiceert duidelijk. Je wilt graag werken aan grote utiliteitsprojecten en jezelf verder ontwikkelen binnen de installatietechniek.

• Hbo-werk- en denkniveau, bij voorkeur in een technische richting.
• Starter met interesse in de rol van werkvoorbereider in de utiliteitsbouw/installatietechniek.
• Je werkt gestructureerd en pakt werkzaamheden zelfstandig op.
• Je neemt verantwoordelijkheid en communiceert helder, mondeling en schriftelijk.

Herken jij jezelf hierin? Dan maken we graag kennis met je! Herken je jezelf niet in alles, maar spreekt de functie je wél aan? Dan moedigen we je aan om te solliciteren. Enthousiasme en de wil om te groeien vinden we minstens zo belangrijk als een compleet lijstje met diploma’s en certificaten.

Over BAM

Bij BAM geloven we dat iedereen de ruimte moet krijgen om het beste uit zichzelf te halen. We werken aan een omgeving waar iedereen zich gewaardeerd voelt. Daarom verwelkomen we mensen met diverse achtergronden, ervaringen en perspectieven. Denk aan verschillen in cultuur, religie, genderidentiteit, fysieke en mentale beperking en meer.

Het sollicitatieproces

Heb je interesse of wil je meer informatie? Neem contact op met onze corporate recruiter Ruud Welboren via telefoon of WhatsApp op +316 2520 5518 Je kunt ook mailen naar ruud.welboren@bam.com. Solliciteren kan direct via de knop op deze pagina!

Stap in en maak het mogelijk.

title: Coordinator Supply Chain
description:
Coördinator Supply Chain

Ben jij georganiseerd, praktisch ingesteld en op zoek naar een veelzijdige functie waarin je echt het verschil kunt maken? Werk je graag samen met verschillende afdelingen en zorg je ervoor dat materialen, orders en processen soepel verlopen? Dan is de functie van Coördinator Supply Chain iets voor jou!

Wat ga je doen?

Als Coördinator Supply Chain ondersteun je de afdelingen Werkvoorbereiding, Inkoop en Magazijn. Je helpt bij het coördineren van materiaalstromen, het beheren van administratieve processen en het tijdig beschikbaar maken van materialen. Met jouw inzet draag je bij aan een soepel verlopend productieproces en een efficiënte supply chain.

Je Werkzaamheden Bestaan Onder Andere Uit

Werkvoorbereiding

• Controleren, aanvullen en beheren van stuklijsten en productieorders.
• Voorbereiden en klaarzetten van materialen voor productie.
• Ondersteunen bij de productieplanning en het bewaken van de voortgang.
• Bijhouden en actualiseren van documentatie, werkinstructies en orderinformatie.

Inkoop

• Aanmaken, verwerken en opvolgen van inkooporders.
• Controleren van orderbevestigingen, levertijden en prijzen.
• Contact onderhouden met leveranciers over afwijkingen, levertijden en beschikbaarheid van materialen.
• Ondersteunen bij voorraadanalyses en besteladviezen.

Magazijn

• Verwerken van goederenontvangsten en controleren van binnenkomende leveringen.
• Bijhouden van de voorraadadministratie en signaleren van afwijkingen.
• Ondersteunen bij voorraadtellingen en cycle counts.
• Uitgeven van materialen aan productie en registreren van materiaalverbruik.

Over jou

Je bent leergierig, praktisch ingesteld en neemt graag initiatief. Je vindt het prettig om overzicht te houden, prioriteiten te stellen en samen te werken met collega's van verschillende afdelingen. Je schakelt moeiteloos tussen administratieve werkzaamheden en praktische taken en denkt graag mee over verbeteringen in processen.

Daarnaast

• Beschik je over een mbo-diploma niveau 4, bij voorkeur in de richting Logistiek, Supply Chain, Inkoop of Administratie.
• Heb je bij voorkeur ervaring met logistieke of administratieve werkzaamheden.
• Heb je basiskennis van ERP-systemen, bijvoorbeeld Ridder IQ.
• Kun je goed overweg met MS Office.
• Ben je sterk in plannen en organiseren en weet je prioriteiten te stellen.
• Communiceer je gemakkelijk met collega's en leveranciers.
• Werk je proactief en signaleer je afwijkingen voordat ze problemen veroorzaken.
• Ben je flexibel, oplossingsgericht en een echte teamspeler.
• Heb je een hands-on mentaliteit en pak je werkzaamheden zelfstandig op.

Interesse?

Wil jij een belangrijke rol spelen in het organiseren van onze supply chain en ervoor zorgen dat onze productie soepel blijft draaien? Zoek je een afwisselende functie waarin je je verder kunt ontwikkelen en betrokken bent bij werkvoorbereiding, inkoop én magazijnbeheer?

Dan maken we graag kennis met je! Solliciteer.

title: Menedżer Bezpieczeństwa Logistyki
description:
Szukasz pracy, w której zadbasz o kompleksowe bezpieczeństwo procesów w łańcuchu dostaw oraz obiektów logistycznych, w celu minimalizowania ryzyk operacyjnych, zapobiegania nadużyciom i skutecznego ograniczania strat finansowych firmy?

Chcesz zdobywać doświadczenie w dużej organizacji, która łączy handel, nowoczesne narzędzia analityczne i silną markę na rynku?

Dołącz do #teamEURO jako Manager Bezpieczeństwa Logistyki i wspólnie z nami kształtuj doświadczenia zakupowe naszych klientów!

Czym będziesz się zajmować?

• Dbaniem o bezpieczeństwo procesów i obiektów, zapewnianiem ciągłości i ochrony procesów w łańcuchu dostaw oraz w magazynach i centrach logistycznych.
• Prewencją i ograniczaniem strat, wdrażaniem rozwiązań zapobiegających nadużyciom, minimalizujących ryzyka oraz ograniczających straty finansowe.
• Audytami i kontrolowaniem procedur, tworzeniem, wdrażaniem i egzekwowaniem instrukcji bezpieczeństwa, a także przeprowadzaniem regularnych kontroli w podległych obszarach.
• Prowadzeniem postępowań wyjaśniających, reagowaniem na sytuacje awaryjne oraz analizowaniem zdarzeń naruszających zasady bezpieczeństwa.
• Nadzorem nad systemami technicznym, zarządzaniem i kontrolowaniem systemów telewizji przemysłowej (CCTV) oraz Kontroli Dostępu.
• Analizą danych i raportowaniem, rozliczaniem wyników w oparciu o kluczowe wskaźniki (KPI) i przygotowywaniem cyklicznych raportów.
• Współpracą i edukacją - bieżącym kontaktem z partnerami wewnętrznymi i zewnętrznymi oraz szkoleniem pracowników w zakresie zasad bezpieczeństwa.

Szukamy Osoby, Która

• Posiada 3–5 lat doświadczenia w obszarze szeroko pojętej logistyki (magazynowanie i/lub transport – doświadczenie w samym dziale bezpieczeństwa nie jest wymogiem koniecznym).
• Posiada wykształcenie minimum średnie (preferowane kierunki: Logistyka, Zarządzanie, Administracja, Bezpieczeństwo lub Prawo).
• Praktyczną znajomość branży logistycznej (magazynowanie i/lub transport).
• Umiejętność analizy danych, wyciągania wniosków oraz pracy na wskaźnikach efektywności (KPI).
• Posiada praktyczną znajomość zasad zarządzania kosztami i budżetem.
• Umiejętność prowadzenia szkoleń, kontroli i audytów oraz angażowania zespołów w kwestie bezpieczeństwa.
• Umiejętność wdrażania zmian w organizacji oraz doskonałą organizację czasu pracy własnej (jest to stanowisko samodzielnego eksperta).
• Posiada czynne prawo jazdy kat. B.

Mile Widziane

• Doświadczenie w branży retail lub ogólnym sektorze logistycznym.
• Doświadczenie we współpracy z agencjami ochrony fizycznej.
• Praktyka w obszarze audytu lub zarządzania procesami.

Co Oferujemy

Brzmi jak coś dla Ciebie?

O Nas

Od ponad 35 lat jesteśmy jedną z najbardziej rozpoznawalnych marek na rynku elektroniki użytkowej i AGD w Polsce. Jesteśmy właścicielami dwóch sklepów internetowych – euro.com.pl oraz oleole.pl. Posiadamy ponad 350 salonów stacjonarnych, własne Contact Center oraz rozbudowaną sieć logistyczną.

Tworzymy przestrzeń do rozwoju, realizacji odważnych pomysłów i pracy nad unikalnymi projektami, które kształtują doświadczenia zakupowe milionów klientów.

title: HR Business Partner - International Sales
description:
If you want to...

• Partner with one of Demant's most dynamic and globally connected businesses, Hearing Aids International Sales, operating across four continents and serving customers in diverse markets around the world.
• Act as a trusted advisor to senior commercial leaders, helping shape organizational effectiveness, leadership capability, talent strategy, and employee engagement.
• Drive meaningful business impact by translating commercial priorities into people, culture, and organizational initiatives that enable growth and performance.
• Support and influence leaders across Headquarters functions, international markets, and high-growth regions.
• Act as a bridge between global HR priorities and local business realities, ensuring both strategic alignment and practical execution.
• Work in a truly international environment where collaboration, diversity of thought, and continuous learning are part of everyday life.

Join us and help shape the future of international commercial excellence through people, leadership, and organizational performance.

HR Business Partner - International Sales

We are looking for an experienced and business-minded HR Business Partner to join Hearing Aids International Sales at Demant.

In this highly visible international role, you will partner closely with senior commercial leaders and contribute directly to the success of a global sales organization. Reporting to the Director, Global HRBP International Sales, you will serve as the dedicated HR Business Partner for our Sales, Training and Service organization led by Pernille Rønn Klinker, while also supporting selected High Growth Markets in close partnership with regional and local leadership teams.

This role offers a unique combination of strategic HR partnering and international market exposure. You will influence decisions related to organizational design, leadership effectiveness, talent management, employee engagement, change management, and culture, while helping ensure that global HR priorities create tangible value in local markets.

Success in this role requires curiosity, commercial acumen, strong stakeholder management, and the ability to build trusted relationships across cultures, functions, and geographies.

Your direct manager will be in Denmark – but you will not be alone. In our Warsaw office You will find colleagues in similar positions, supporting other parts of Demant organization.

What you'll be doing:

• Partner closely with leaders across Sales, Training and Service functions to drive business performance through people and organization initiatives.
• Serve as a trusted advisor on strategic workforce planning, organizational design, talent management, leadership development, and employee engagement.
• Support leadership teams in selected Markets, ensuring alignment between local business priorities and the global people agenda.
• Translate business strategy into actionable people plans that strengthen organizational capability and accelerate business results.
• Lead and support transformation, organizational change, and capability-building initiatives across international markets.
• Collaborate closely with local HR colleagues to ensure globally aligned yet locally relevant HR solutions.
• Build strong relationships across a geographically dispersed organization and create alignment among multiple stakeholders.
• Champion a high-performance culture rooted in collaboration, accountability, customer focus, and continuous improvement.

What we're looking for:

• Significant experience as an HR Business Partner in a global or international organization.
• Strong business acumen and the ability to connect people strategies to commercial outcomes.
• Experience partnering with senior leaders and influencing decisions without formal authority.
• Proven ability to navigate complex stakeholder environments and build credibility across cultures and geographies.
• Experience supporting organizational growth, transformation, and change initiatives.
• Strong facilitation, communication, and relationship-building skills.
• Ability to balance strategic thinking with pragmatic execution.
• Fluency in English and confidence working in an international environment.
• Willingness to travel internationally as part of the role.

Why join us?

This is more than an HR Business Partner position.

It is an opportunity to become part of one of Demant's most international and commercially focused organizations, working alongside leaders who are shaping the future of Hearing Aids International Sales.

You will gain exposure to senior stakeholders, complex business challenges, and diverse markets while helping create the conditions for sustainable business success. In return, you will join a company known for its strong values, collaborative culture, and commitment to developing both people and performance.

What we offer:

• A full-time position in a global and purpose-driven organization.
• Extensive learning and development opportunities.
• Hybrid work arrangements with flexibility and autonomy.
• A comprehensive benefits package.
• A Scandinavian culture characterized by trust, openness, empowerment, and work-life balance.
• The opportunity to make a visible impact on a truly international business.
• Central Warsaw office location in combination with hybrid work model – work and travels to Denmark and outside of Europe.

Travel

Travel is a regular component of this role and an essential part of successful stakeholder partnership. You can expect periodic travel to Denmark, typically 1-2 times per month, together with occasional travel to markets outside Europe.

Overall, travel is expected to amount to approximately 3-5 weeks per year.

Ready to make an impact across continents, cultures, and commercial teams?

We'd love to hear from you!

title: Sales Associate Menswear - Selfridges
description:
Profile:

For the role of Sales Associate, we are seeking a candidate who combines professional expertise and enthusiasm with courteous and helpful communication skills. A candidate who is careful to illustrate the signature quality of the workmanship and materials, in order to guide clients through the distinctive style of the brand and the seasonal proposals, while maintaining the discretion that characterises the company philosophy.

Role responsibilities:

Corresponding to a key figure within this philosophy, the Sales Associate assumes the responsibility to personally represent it in front of our customers and is concurrently responsible for presenting the philosophy in relation to the profound work which occurs from Solomeo all the way to the boutique.

The quality that we would like to offer resides, first of all, in the daily attention to personal appearance within the store, with a style that meets the standards of casual elegance and signature luxury of the brand. Furthermore, appearance signifies a polite, helpful disposition and being attentive to both customers and colleagues: group work is carried out within the boutique which, under the coordination of the Store Manager, follows all of the necessary activities to provide customers with an experience of excellence.

The elements needed to keep up-to-date with product knowledge, aesthetics and philosophy are provided each season, in order to allow the Sales Associate to competently follow and guide the customer through the collection, to trying on and the selection. It is necessary to adhere to a sales service which renders our store experience unique and which demonstrates the special attention that accompanies our business from the creation of the collection all the way to the final presentation.

Managing the working environment not only includes the appearance in the boutique, the relationship with customers and conducting sales transactions, but also provides for looking after visual displays within the store as well as the window displays, both for daily placements and for periodical dressings and amendments. Moreover, managing includes the organised administration of the warehouse and inventory, so that supply and availability respond to an orderly and clear criterion, in absolute support of communication with customers and the company.

Qualifications:

To be successful in this role, applicants should be fluent in English and have gained at least two years of previous retail experience.

The ideal candidate will complement their experience with a combination of personal effectiveness, professionalism, and team spirit. The following qualifications will be particularly valued:

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
• Strong attention to detail and high standards of professionalism.
• Proactive and collaborative approach to teamwork.
• Additional language skills and familiarity with CRM tools are considered a plus.

Selection Process:

At Brunello Cucinelli, the person is placed at the centre of every process. For this reason, each application is reviewed with genuine care and respect by a member of our Human Resources Department, as we believe in the value of human insight, guided by careful consideration rather than automated processes.

Should a professional profile resonate with the role, the candidate will take part in a clear and structured selection process, beginning with an initial telephone conversation with a member of the People & Culture team, which may be followed by an interview with the line manager; any further steps will be progressively shared.

Brunello Cucinelli is committed to ensuring equal opportunities, nurturing a working environment that embraces inclusion and honours diversity, aligned with our corporate values.

title: BMS Project Manager
description:

You’ll work closely with clients, engineers and internal stakeholders to ensure projects are delivered safely, on time, within budget and to a high standard, while also supporting future project opportunities and client relationships.

📍 St Paul’s, London – Hybrid

💰 Up to £80,000 + Benefits

What’s on Offer

title: Business and HR Administrator
description:
Title - Business and HR Administrator

Reporting to: CEO

Working Hours: Full time / Flexible options

Salary: To be negotiated, based on experience

Location: Nottingham, UK

About Nova Biochem

Nova Biochem is a climate-tech company pioneering the transformation of industrial by-products into high-value, sustainable chemicals. Using our proprietary hydrothermal depolymerisation process, we convert lignin-rich residues from pulping and agriculture into renewable aromatic building blocks used in coatings, plastics, and resins - replacing fossil inputs and cutting emissions at the source.

Our mission is to unlock a circular, low-carbon model for industrial chemistry - creating new value from waste while reducing millions of tonnes of CO₂ emissions. Based in Nottingham, we’re entering a scale-up phase, expanding lab in the UK and pilot operations in Sweden while accelerating towards firs of a kind factory.

This is a pivotal moment to join a small, mission-driven team determined to reshape the chemical industry through practical innovation.

The Role

We are seeking an HR & Business Administrator to professionalise the people operation, take the day-to-day operational and administrative load off the Founder/CEO, and establish structure, clarity, and reliability across our growing organisation. Acting as a central coordinator, you will ensure incoming requests are efficiently routed, deadlines are tracked, and essential business support processes run seamlessly.

This role bridges office management, HR administration, payroll coordination, and executive support. You will oversee general workplace logistics, manage personnel processes, streamline onboarding, and handle routine payroll operations in liaison with our HR advisor and Accountant.

This role suits an experienced administrator who takes initiative, uses sound judgement and follows work through without constant prompting. You should be comfortable learning how the business operates, identifying what needs attention and improving the way administrative work is done.

Key Responsibilities

CEO Support and Action Tracking

• Provide confidential support to the CEO, helping manage priorities, meetings and correspondence, with inbox and calendar support where delegated.
• Maintain a clear record of agreed actions, owners and deadlines; follow up progress and flag delays or decisions requiring the CEO’s attention.
• Research and summarise information, draft routine correspondence and prepare clear documents, spreadsheets and presentations to support the CEO’s work.
• Coordinate management and board meetings, including agendas, meeting papers, notes and follow-up actions, and arrange CEO travel and business visits.

HR Administration & Onboarding

• Prepare and issue standard employment documentation, including offer letters, employment contracts, right-to-work checks, probation and annual reviews.
• Maintain accurate, up-to-date and secure employee records and files in strict confidence.
• Coordinate onboarding and offboarding processes, ensuring seamless induction schedules, access checklists, and exit administration.
• Support recruitment coordination by posting vacancies, screening candidates, scheduling interviews, communicating with candidates, and managing agency relationships.
• Administer employee benefits administration, including pensions, health insurance and policy renewals.

Payroll Coordination & Operations

• Collect, validate, and track monthly payroll changes and updates to ensure accurate, timely processing.
• Liaise directly with external accountants and payroll providers to submit payroll data, handle Benefits-in-Kind (BIK), and resolve HMRC queries.
• Support the internal transition and ongoing management of payroll operations to maintain quality and compliance.

Values

At Nova Biochem, our mission, culture, and individual behaviours are fundamental to our success, guiding how we innovate, collaborate, and scale sustainably.

• Ownership: Take initiative and deliver with excellence. We act like owners, follow through on commitments, and take pride in outcomes.
• Learning: Mistakes are lessons; growth is continuous. We take smart risks, learn fast, and never repeat the same mistake twice.
• Integrity: Honesty and accountability in everything we do. We tell the truth, admit when we’re wrong, and make decisions guided by principle.
• Transparency: Openness builds trust and alignment. We share information freely - from quarterly results to daily challenges.
• Collaboration: Together we achieve more. We ask for help, always offer solutions, and rally around shared goals.
• Balance: Work hard, live well. We push for excellence while respecting time to rest, recharge, and thrive outside work.

Who You Are

You are a practical, highly organised administrative professional with exceptional follow-through, discretion, and sound judgement. You enjoy bringing order to fast-moving start-up environments and take initiative to resolve operational issues before they escalate.

You communicate with clarity, firmness, and tact, feeling comfortable holding colleagues accountable for actions while maintaining a collaborative working relationship. You respect confidentiality, understand the value of protecting executive capacity, and take pride in building scalable administrative systems that support team growth.

Essential Skills and Experience

• Strong experience in business administration, operational coordination or a comparable role involving support to managers and work acoss several business functions.
• A track record of taking ownership, prioritising competing demands and completing work independently with reliable follow-through.
• Strong written and verbal communication, including preparing clear correspondence and documents and dealing professionally with external contacts.
• Excellent organisational skills, attention to detail and practical problem-solving ability, with confidence tracking actions and deadlines.
• Discretion, integrity and sound judgement when handling sensitive business, personnel and financial information.
• Strong digital skills, including spreadsheets, document preparation, shared drives, task trackers and modern business software.
• A motivated, adaptable approach and willingness to learn new systems, including appropriate use of AI tools and simple automation to improve productivity.

Desirable Skills and Experience

• Previous HR administration experience or exposure to routine HR tasks in another role, such as recruitment, onboarding, employee records or review coordination.
• Experience working directly with a founder, CEO or senior leadership team.
• Experience in a growing start-up, clean-tech, scientific or manufacturing business.
• Experience coordinating payroll inputs, finance administration or working with external accountants; familiarity with accounting platforms such as Xero.
• Experience supporting board administration or funding reports. A relevant business administration or HR qualification, including CIPD, would be welcome.

Why Join Us?

At Nova Biochem, you’ll join a small, mission-driven team translating breakthrough science into real-world impact. As our HR & Office Manager, your work will directly enable our operational scale-up, protecting founder time and fostering a structured, supportive culture as our team expands.

You’ll have ownership, visibility, and the opportunity to build administrative frameworks that last, all within an environment that values integrity, curiosity, and balance. If you are driven by purpose, thrive on organisation, and want to see your contribution make a tangible difference, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Associate, Enforcement
description:
Please note that this role will close at 00:01 on Sunday 15 November, and therefore we advise getting your application in by no later than midnight on Saturday 14 November.

How to apply

Please submit your CV and a cover letter of no more than 2 sides that outlines how you meet the skills, knowledge, and experience required for this role. Your CV and cover letter should be uploaded as one document.

About Ofcom

As the UK’s communications regulator, we’re delivering vital work to make communications work for everyone.

Our work covers everything from phones and broadband, through to online safety, TV and radio, the postal service, and wireless devices. We need people of all backgrounds, skill sets, and experiences to help us achieve our ambitions on behalf of the British public.

About the team you’ll be part of

The Enforcement team plays a critical role in ensuring that the regulation and policy we put in place to protect consumers and citizens is effective. The Enforcement team identify and respond to non compliance affecting consumers and competition in the telecommunications, postal and broadcasting sectors. The team works with policy teams across Ofcom, carries out advocacy work with stakeholders and actively enforces the regulatory conditions that Ofcom imposes on regulated providers, as well as enforcing general consumer and competition law. We routinely monitor complaints, analyse evidence and take swift action to deal firmly and effectively where we see harm, including opening formal investigations, issuing penalties and seeking redress where appropriate.

As Ofcom's responsibilities continue to evolve, the Enforcement team is increasingly at the forefront of some of the most significant challenges facing the UK, from helping to make the online world safer to protecting the security and resilience of the communications networks and digital infrastructure that keep the country connected.

The purpose and scope of the role

Our Associate roles are key to carrying out effective and robust enforcement activity. You will help deliver enforcement projects and casework as well as supporting the team’s enforcement input to key policy projects and advocacy work to promote deterrence.

Your Key Responsibilities

Helping to deliver enforcement investigation casework and monitoring programmes, through:

• defining the scope of the work and identifying desirable outcomes;
• gathering and analysing evidence;
• producing written outputs for internal and external audiences;
• managing stakeholder relationships to represent Ofcom professionally; and
• delivering high quality work to agreed timetables.

There is also lots of scope to work with policy areas across Ofcom to support strategic outcomes by:

• influencing policy development to design enforceable regulation; and
• helping develop proactive strategies to encourage stakeholder compliance with remedies imposed

Compliance advocacy:

• developing effective working relationships with colleagues across Ofcom policy, legal and operational teams;
• maintaining fair and professional relationships with external stakeholders (including companies we may be investigating, public bodies and other stakeholders)
• being able to communicate what “good” looks like and contribute to setting out implications of non-compliance (deterrence).

The skills, knowledge and experience you’ll need for success

• Executing Plans: You will need project management skills to organise tasks and set clear goals, managing resources effectively, whilst keeping an eye on progress.
• Articulating ideas: You will need strong verbal and written communication skills. Written communication and drafting skills are important in developing clear documents addressing key issues. You will have the ability to express your ideas, thoughts, and information in a clear and concise manner, ensuring messages are understood by everyone.
• Harmonising work: You can work effectively with others, creating an honest team environment and sharing valuable information and resources. You can work collaboratively with others to deliver a specific workstream within a larger project.
• Evaluating problems: You will identify and solve issues by using well-thought-out strategies, considering different angles and potential solutions to resolve concerns.
• Forming relationships: You are able to successfully build and nurture positive relationships with people inside and outside the organisation.
• IT skills including the use of Microsoft Office products.

Inclusive hiring at Ofcom

At Ofcom, our mission is clear: to make communications work for everyone. To achieve that, our people must reflect the diversity of the UK, in background, identity and experience.

We believe innovation thrives when difference is valued and everyone feels empowered to contribute their ideas and perspectives. That’s why we welcome colleagues of all ethnicities and races, sexes, genders and gender identities, sexual orientations, ages, faiths and beliefs, and those with apparent and non‑apparent disabilities. We value socio‑economic diversity, life experience and neurodiversity too. Whether you’re a carer, a parent, a veteran, or re‑entering work after time away, your voice and perspective matter here.

Flexibility is at the heart of how we work because we want you to thrive in a way that suits you best. Most roles can therefore be adapted for part‑time hours, job shares, or other flexible arrangements. Learn more about our Rewards, Benefits and Wellbeing on our careers page.

Our recruitment process is intentionally designed to be open and accessible. If you need adjustments, information in a different format or an alternative way to apply, contact us at resourcing@ofcom.org.uk or 0330 912 1378.

As a proud Disability Confident Leader, we guarantee interviews for disabled applicants who meet the essential criteria for a role. You can read more about this commitment here.

Whoever you are, whatever your story, you belong at Ofcom.

title: Senior RFIC Design Engineer

title: Educake Marketing Director

Educake is a leading platform for revision, homework, and data-driven insight, trusted by schools across the UK and increasingly by parents at home. Consumer Growth Strategy

Data, Reporting & Insight

Essential

Desirable

title: Senior Embedded Software Engineer
description:
About OLIX

AI is growing faster than any technology in history and the explosion in demand has created a massive infrastructure gap; we can no longer build chips or power stations fast enough to keep up. The industry is still leaning on a ten-year-old hardware blueprint that has reached its limit. A new paradigm that is faster and more efficient will be the biggest economic opportunity of the next century and create the most important company of the next decade. The OLIX Decode Accelerator 1 (DX-1) is the first accelerator architected specifically for decode. Rack-scale co-design of logic, data movement, packaging, optics and interconnect enables a step change in system level performance.

The Role

As a Senior Embedded Software Engineer, you will own a component of the DX-1 platform firmware end to end, from simulation through FPGA prototypes and first silicon into production. The Embedded team builds the software that makes the platform bootable, manageable and observable: boot and update, platform management on the BMC, embedded Linux on the platform processors, real-time firmware on resource-constrained cores, and register-level control of the ASIC.

The kind of work you would own: the Linux image and update flow for a platform processor, management-plane services that collect telemetry over PLDM and expose it over Redfish, bare-metal firmware on the cores beside the ASIC, or precision-timing integration.

You will join a team of senior engineers, reporting to the Platform Architect who leads the team, and work closely with the FPGA, ASIC and Systems Software teams. Much of the work is pre-silicon, developed against simulation, FPGA prototypes and hardware-in-the-loop rigs.

Responsibilities

• Own a subsystem end to end. Design it, implement it, test it against simulation and on the hardware-in-the-loop rigs, support its bring-up on real hardware, and carry it into production, within interface specifications you help write.
• Work across the stack as needed. Boot firmware, Linux kernel and drivers, management-plane services, and bare-metal code on constrained cores, in C/C++ and Python.
• Test what you build. Firmware tests that run in the existing hardware-in-the-loop infrastructure, bench scripts that make a failure reproducible, and contributions to device models.
• Anticipate problems and finish things. Flag a risk before it blocks someone, and see your work through until it is in use.
• Lead an initiative when it takes more than one engineer. Frame the problem, split the work, and keep the FPGA or Systems Software counterparts it depends on aligned on scope and interfaces.
• Set the standard by example. Review others' work and have yours reviewed, document what you learn so the team does not relearn it, and say so when the plan is wrong.

Skills & Experience

• Strong C on bare metal and C/C++ on Linux. Depth in either bare-metal/RTOS firmware on resource-constrained cores or Linux kernel and driver development, with working competence in the other.
• Systems fundamentals. Interrupt design, synchronisation with and without atomics, memory ordering, cache maintenance for shared memory and DMA buffers, and fitting a design into fixed memory and timing budgets.
• Shipped firmware on real hardware and debugged it at the bench with an oscilloscope, logic analyser, JTAG and serial console. Bring-up of a new board, or firmware for an FPGA-prototyped ASIC, is a significant advantage.
• Embedded Linux platform work, or clear exposure to it. Yocto/OpenEmbedded or similar, U-Boot or UEFI, and device tree. An update flow that recovers from a failed update is an advantage.
• Test discipline. You have written software-in-the-loop tests against device models, or hardware-in-the-loop tests, for firmware you owned.
• A subsystem you owned from design to production. We will want to hear about it end to end: the interfaces you agreed with the adjacent teams, what broke, and what you did about it.
• Also useful: platform management, precision timing, FPGA soft cores. OpenBMC, Redfish, PLDM over MCTP, I2C/SMBus/PMBus; IEEE 1588 PTP or SyncE; soft-core targets in FPGA fabric; accelerator or data-centre hardware.

Compensation & Equity

• Competitive Salary: Commensurate with your experience, skills, and location
• Equity & Ownership: Meaningful stock options. You’re not just joining the mission; you’re owning a piece of it
• Proximity Bonus: We value your time. To minimise your commute and maximise your life, we offer an annual Living-Local Bonus if your residence is within 20 minutes of the office
• Retirement Benefits: Employer-contributed retirement plans to help you build long-term financial security.

Due to U.S. export control regulations, candidates’ eligibility to work at OLIX depends on their most recent citizenship or permanent residency status. We are generally unable to consider applicants whose most recent citizenship or permanent residence is in certain restricted countries (currently including Iran, North Korea, Syria, Cuba, Russia, Belarus, China, Hong Kong, Macau, and Venezuela). Applicants who have subsequently obtained citizenship or permanent residency in another country not subject to these restrictions may still be eligible.

title: Warehouse & Distribution Operative
description:
Role: Warehouse & Distribution Operative

Location: Lossiemouth

Duration: 12 months - initially

Role Type: Onsite

Overview:

An opportunity has arisen for an experienced Warehouse & Distribution Operative to support our globally renowned aerospace client’s Fixed Wing Supply Chain operations at Lossiemouth.

Working within a highly regulated defence aviation environment, the successful candidate will provide day-to-day warehouse, inventory and distribution support, ensuring aircraft parts and materials are received, stored, controlled and dispatched accurately and in accordance with operational priorities.

The position involves close collaboration with Supply Chain, Engineering, Quality, Platform Operations, RAF Logistics personnel, DE&S and external transport providers.

• Receive incoming aircraft parts, materials and equipment, verifying quantities and documentation for accuracy.
• Pick, pack and dispatch orders in accordance with aircraft and operational priorities.

• Conduct regular stock checks, cycle counts and inventory audits to ensure stock accuracy.
• Identify, report and escalate discrepancies and non-conformances, ensuring appropriate segregation and control.
• Operate warehouse and material-handling equipment, including forklifts and pallet trucks.
• Maintain accurate documentation and records to support traceability and audit requirements.
• Support Root Cause Corrective Action (RCCA) investigations for spares failing Required Delivery Dates (RDDs).
• Work closely with internal Supply Chain, Engineering, Quality and operational teams to ensure effective material availability and programme support.
• Maintain warehouse standards in accordance with 6S, Health & Safety, security and company procedures.
• Review working practices and identify opportunities to improve warehouse, inventory and distribution processes.
• Develop and monitor KPIs relating to warehouse and distribution performance.
• Support and mentor less experienced team members in supply chain processes and best practice.
• Participate in Continuous Improvement and cost-reduction initiatives.
• Provide additional and out-of-hours operational support where required.

Skills & Experience:

• Previous experience within warehouse, stores, logistics, distribution or supply chain operations.
• Strong understanding of inventory management, stock control and material handling processes.
• Experience receiving, storing, picking, packing and dispatching materials within a controlled environment.
• Ability to maintain accurate records and documentation to support audit and traceability requirements.
• Experience identifying and resolving inventory discrepancies or non-conformances.
• Understanding of Root Cause Corrective Action (RCCA), continuous improvement or structured problem-solving would be advantageous.
• Experience working with ERP, MRP or warehouse management systems; knowledge of SAP or GOLDMRO would be particularly beneficial.
• Knowledge of aviation, aerospace, defence, MRO or aircraft parts logistics would be highly advantageous.
• Understanding of repair, maintenance, retrofit, parts kitting and supply chain support environments would be beneficial.
• Strong organisational and prioritisation skills with the ability to respond effectively to changing operational requirements.
• Good communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work collaboratively across multidisciplinary teams.
• Safety, security, quality and customer focused, with strong attention to detail.
• Flexible and adaptable, with the ability to work shifts and provide out-of-hours support where required.

Key Competencies:

Accountability • Inventory Control • Warehouse Operations • Supply Chain • Logistics • Material Handling • Stock Accuracy • Continuous Improvement • Root Cause Analysis • 6S • Planning & Organisation • Teamwork • Customer Focus • Risk Awareness • Process Improvement • ERP/MRP Systems • Aircraft Parts & MRO Support

title: Electrical Project Manager
description:
Electrical Project Manager, Ferrybridge, U.K.

Apply Now

Mercury is the European leader in construction solutions.

We build and manage complex engineering & construction projects for the world’s leading corporations. Our solutions help deliver technologies and life changing advancements that connect people, communities, and businesses, giving them the power to achieve incredible things. Our people have the courage to be innovative. Their determination and sharp focus enable us to deliver with certainty, time and time again.

We deliver our clients’ visions through leading edge construction solutions across multiple sectors, including Enterprise Data Centres, Advanced Technology & Life Sciences, Hyperscale Data Centres, Fire Protection.

At Mercury, it is our duty to encourage and back our people to realise their vision of themselves. We place them at the heart of what we do, providing challenging opportunities to develop within a great team in a supportive environment that allows them to reach their full potential.

Key Responsibilities Of The Role

• Management of the Electrical Systems package and leadership of all electrical construction activities on site.
• Management of the OFCI / Main Capital electrical equipment and packages.
• Management of all day-to-day site operations relating to the electrical scope and interfaces with other trades.
• Ensure Mercury policies and procedures are followed closely.
• Familiarisation with Design/IFC specifications and drawings to fully understand the scope of the project works.
• Management of Site Safety in conjunction with the Project Manager and the Mercury Safety Advisor, including the setup, management and closing out of the safety file as part of the Management team.
• Ensure all work activities are planned to the required level of detail, with all documentation in line with company SOPs (RAMS, SPAs, Permits) and approved at the workface.
• Ensure all work is delivered in accordance with the permitting requirements of Mercury's Electrical Safety Rules and all applicable Safe Systems of Work.
• Ensure compliance with COHE and the Operating & Energisation Procedures for LV & MV systems, including arc flash awareness and controls.
• Oversee the room permits process and ensure contractors on site are compliant with requirements.
• Drive a focused Quality, Health, Safety and Environmental (QEHS) culture within your team and subcontractors, and drive the Mercury Engineering culture of safety and quality through the project.
• Ensure all EHS alerts are communicated effectively and understood by the team, and engage in campaigns including TBTs, stand-downs, demonstrations and safety initiatives.
• Issue weekly safety stats and project labour projections.
• Management of Site QA in conjunction with the Mercury QA Manager, including set up, management and close out of the QA file, and review of contractor QAQC documentation and site performance.
• Ensure works are installed in accordance with project specifications and to the Project QA plan (e.g. pre-agreed benchmarking).
• Review drawings and setting-out details.
• Review quality of output and foster a culture of continuous improvement, implementing corrective actions where required.
• Manage and oversee the quality inspection regime, ensuring subcontractors carry out and maintain all quality inspections, ITPs, RFTs and snag closure as part of their scope, and hold them accountable for completing and submitting these on time and in line with the Project QA plan.
• Management of the electrical design process in conjunction with the Design Manager.
• Oversee the coordination process to transform design information into full installation drawings via BIM personnel, ensuring spec compliance and schedule priority.
• Manage the generation and close-out of RFIs and technical queries, value engineering initiatives and design risk management.
• Management of the Project Schedule in conjunction with the Mercury Project Manager, Planner, consulting Engineer and Client requirements, including weekly progress updates.
• Ensure all site works are planned according to site production control requirements (Visilean or other collaborative planning).
• Drive digital collaborative planning and Lean construction processes to ensure effective coordination, efficient execution of works and timely delivery of milestones.
• Use project lookaheads to drive delivery and resource planning.
• Schedule material deliveries to correspond with the project schedule and track all deliveries.
• Management of all costs associated with your package including: Mercury Electrical Team; Sub-contractors; Material deliveries and goods receipting; Plant and Equipment; Variations; Valuations.
• Own the commercial performance of the package, ensuring timely identification, management and recovery of variations, claims and commercial risks.
• Ensure subcontractor invoicing is measured in accordance with agreed progress milestones.
• Ensure Material Take-Offs (MTOs) are completed and reviewed against subcontractor pricing returns and procurement budgets.
• Prepare Sub-contract and Supplier Tender Packages in conjunction with the Project QS.
• Ensure subcontractors used have been vetted and approved by Mercury Procurement before use.
• Issue weekly cost reports, including all orders placed, materials expected and labour levels.
• Management of sub-contractor activities including tracking progress against schedule and manpower levels. Ensure there is a weekly minuted meeting with sub-contractors.
• Monitor that subcontractors have sufficiently resourced the project to maintain programme delivery.
• Management of the Mercury "In Progress" snagging system, ensuring supervisors return weekly punch lists where applicable, and ensure all snags are distributed to and closed out by all sub-contractors.
• Maintain an active risk register and implement mitigation measures, highlighting any risk elements within Mercury's control (e.g. late deliveries).
• Implement the Mercury Project Audit Plan, review weekly audits and address open items with your team.
• Drive closure of all open audit actions within agreed timelines and communicate findings clearly to all stakeholders.
• Capture and act on lessons learned.
• Issue direct labour hours and sub-contractor hours to the time administrator for tracking centrally.
• Issue an internal weekly progress report rolled up from project supervisors' reports, highlighting percentage complete based on WBS codes and any concerns or risks within Mercury's control.
• Issue an external weekly progress report to the Project Manager, highlighting areas not available, delays, shortage of design, third-party hold-ups and percentage complete.
• Attendance at Site Meetings, Internal Project Reviews, Engineering Reviews, Planning and Co-ordination Meetings and Handover Meetings.
• Attend morning whiteboard meetings and evening planning/schedule review meetings.
• Maintain a weekly project photographic diary.
• Support and coach all the electrical team to ensure their development, which is crucial to our organisation and industry, supporting succession planning and team development.
• Set training requirements for Mercury and subcontractor staff and ensure appropriate training is available and completed.
• Direct management of the Mercury Engineering project team, including alignment of all discipline leads to the benefit of project goals.
• Drive the commissioning of all electrical equipment, taking ownership of completing the Red Tag (L2A – Installation) and Yellow Tag (L2B – Ready for Energisation) with all checklists and test documentation uploaded and approved in CxDE, then support the final commissioning levels — L3 Start-Up (Green Tag), L4 Functional Performance Testing and Integrated System Testing (IST) — ensuring the electrical team and subcontractors deliver each level on time, to the required quality, and to CxA sign-off.
• Close out of all project items including Final Account, O & M Manuals, Punch List, Safety File, QA File, Material and Plant re-locations and Project Plan – all with the support of the site Project Manager and your project team.
• All other duties associated with the role.

Essential Criteria For The Role

• Overall 10-15+ years of experience in the construction sector.
• Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Electrical, construction management, or other relevant degree.
• Minimum 5 years previous experience in Project Management
• Proven record of coordinating and managing large installation projects
• Experience dealing with Industrial Relations issues
• Knowledge of Health & Safety
• Experienced in design and build
• Good technical knowledge of both Electrical and Mechanical systems
• Excellent IT skills
• Excellent communication skills
• Ability to work well within strict deadlines
• Ability to drive a large-scale project

Mercury is an equal opportunities employer.

Apply Now

title: Recruitment Assistant
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

This full time, London based, Recruitment Assistant role, is to join a friendly, dynamic and forward-thinking HR Department. Led by the HR Director, with additional leadership from the Head of HR, the department is made up of several specialisms: People, Recruitment, Learning and Development (L&D), HR Systems and Payroll. The team of 13 provides support to c400 colleagues, across three offices.

As the Recruitment Assistant, you will be managed by and work closely with the Recruitment Manager and play a key role in helping the firm achieve its FY29 growth strategy and beyond. Due to the size of the firm, the role will provide you with exposure across our graduate, lateral, partner and work experience recruitment work-streams, as well as owning our candidate onboarding process. You will also have the opportunity to meet a wide range of people across all our internal teams and build your personal brand within a collaborative firm.

Your day-to-day tasks will be varied and span all of our recruitment workflows. Some of these tasks will include:

Lateral (experienced hire) recruitment

• Advertise positions both externally, and internally via our intranet, adhering to EDI best practices
• Work closely with agencies and internal colleagues regarding interview set-up and candidate feedback
• Be a superuser of our applicant tracking system (ATS), Workable, including exploring workflow improvements, ensuring ‘clean data’ and advocating the ATS to internal managers
• Assist with talent mapping
• Be our ‘onboarding champion’ and own the candidate pre-boarding and on-boarding journey.

Trainee (graduate) recruitment

• Liaise with candidates regarding the status of their applications and keep key business stakeholders updated on progress
• Assisting the Recruitment Manager with organising our graduate assessment days
• Assisting the Recruitment Manager/L&D team with organising our trainee induction week, including booking external/internal sessions.

Partner recruitment

• Work closely with agencies and internal stakeholders regarding interview set-up and candidate feedback
• Assisting the Recruitment Manager with the pre/onboarding process for new partner hires.

Work experience

• Assisting the Recruitment Manager with organising our diversity and social mobility initiatives working closely with organisations to organise work experience programmes.

ABOUT YOU

This is an ideal role for someone who enjoys and thrives in a high performing, people focused work environment. You will have some previous experience in a recruitment related or client facing office administration focused position, ideally in a professional services environment, with the ability to juggle multiple tasks concurrently. You will have an infectious passion for people and recognise the importance of candidate experience and wanting to provide candidates with a best-in-class recruitment experience.

In return, you will be joining a firm during an exciting period of growth and have the opportunity to work closely with an experienced Recruitment Manager and wider HR team, gaining exposure across the entire business, where ideas are championed, and we support career growth and progression.

WHY US

Winckworth Sherwood is an exciting, diverse, and growing business. We are a full-service law firm with a diverse client base, that prides itself on providing advice across a broad range of sectors and markets. Delivering a first-class service is key to everything we do.

Our clients range from some of the UK’s largest businesses and institutions, housebuilders and developers through to investors, professional partnerships, family offices, not for profit organisations and private individuals – all of which benefit from the flexible, practical approach of our lawyers.

We recognise that our people play a key part in our success and as a result we are committed to their development and well-being. We promote a healthy work-life balance and flexibility, keeping our people motivated and stimulated to deliver great things.

YOUR APPLICATION JOURNEY

Application review

Your profile will be screened by the Recruitment Manager, Ash Evans. If you CV is shortlisted, you will be invited to a first stage Teams interview.

1st interview (via Teams)

This will be with Ash Evans, who will discuss your interest in the role, what you are looking for professionally, and ask some competency/behavioural questions that relate to the key skills/behaviours needed for this position.

Every candidate who reaches this stage will be offered the chance to have a feedback call with our Recruitment Manager to understand why they weren't progressed to the next interview stage, so that you can use this feedback to help with other job applications.

2nd interview (in person at our London office)

At this stage, you will meet Ash in person, our Head of HR, our L&D Manager and also some of the wider team. We will explore your experince in more detail and also welcome any follow up quesitons you may have. We will also set some tasks so that you can showcase your expertise practically.

Every candidate who reaches this stage will be offered the chance to have a feedback call with our Recruitment Manager to understand why they weren't offered the position, so that you can use this feedback to help with other job applications.

Offer of employment

If you are successful and accept our offer of employment, we will submit your details to our background screening partner, who will conduct a series of background checks. Once these have been completed and we have separately validated your proof of right to work in the UK, a start date can be agreed, and your onboarding schedule can be planned.

description:
Data & AI Consulting – Public Sector

Cognizant’s Data & AI Consulting practice partners with government agencies and public sector organizations to modernize data ecosystems, establish trusted data foundations, and accelerate digital transformation through cloud-based data platforms, analytics, and AI solutions. Our teams help clients move beyond fragmented data landscapes by creating scalable, governed, and reusable data capabilities that enable enterprise-wide decision-making.

This role offers an opportunity to shape one of the most significant public sector data modernization programs in the UK, establishing a modern data product ecosystem on a Databricks Lakehouse platform that promotes data democratization, self-service consumption, and enterprise-wide reuse.

About The Role

As a Data Products Architect – Databricks, you will lead the design and architecture of enterprise data products that enable trusted, reusable, and scalable data consumption across the organization. You will define the standards, governance frameworks, and architectural patterns that ensure data products are built once, managed consistently, and shared across multiple business domains.

Working closely with product owners, data engineers, platform architects, governance teams, and business stakeholders, you will help establish a modern data product operating model that supports self-service analytics, data sharing, and enterprise-wide innovation while maintaining strong governance and security standards.

Key Responsibilities

Data Product Architecture & Design

• Lead the architecture and design of enterprise data products built on the Databricks Lakehouse platform
• Define and maintain standards, templates, and reference architectures that ensure data products are scalable, reusable, and interoperable
• Design data products that are discoverable, versioned, self-describing, and aligned with data mesh and product-centric principles
• Establish best practices for product design, schema management, metadata standards, lineage, and lifecycle governance
• Ensure data products are optimized for performance, scalability, reliability, and cost efficiency

This is an exciting opportunity to earn while you learn, gaining hands-on experience, recognised qualifications and the practical skills needed to build a successful career in landscaping.

Working alongside experienced Landscape Operatives, you'll learn how to plant and care for trees, maintain new green spaces and support projects that make a lasting difference to the environment.

No previous landscaping experience is needed. Just bring a positive attitude, a willingness to learn and a genuine interest in working outdoors.

Why this role?

This is more than just an apprenticeship. It's your opportunity to develop valuable skills, gain a recognised qualification and take your first steps towards a rewarding career in landscaping.

You'll receive practical training, guidance from experienced colleagues and dedicated time to complete your apprenticeship studies, all while earning a salary.

Best of all, you'll see the results of your hard work first-hand, helping create landscapes that support biodiversity and will continue to grow and thrive for generations.

What You'll Do

• Learn how to plant trees, shrubs and whips, helping create new green spaces across a major infrastructure site.
• Assist with preparing planting areas and installing stakes, guards and protective materials.

• Learn to use landscaping tools and equipment safely, including strimmer’s, brush cutters and mowers.

• Follow site health and safety procedures, keeping yourself and others safe.
• Take part in apprenticeship training, complete practical assessments and maintain your learning portfolio.

You don't need previous landscaping experience or specialist qualifications to get started. We're looking for someone with the right attitude and enthusiasm to learn.

• A genuine interest in landscaping, plants and the environment.
• A positive attitude and willingness to learn new skills.
• Enjoyment of practical, hands-on work and being outdoors in all weather conditions.
• Good communication skills and the ability to follow instructions and safety guidance.
• Reliable, punctual and able to travel to site for early starts.
• Comfortable carrying out physical work as part of a team.
• Willingness to complete apprenticeship training and assessments.
• Eligibility to work in the UK and enrol on a funded apprenticeship.

A CSCS Apprentice Card will be required before starting work on site, but Ground Control will support you in obtaining this.

Desirable, But Not Essential

• GCSEs or equivalent in English and maths.
• Previous experience of gardening, landscaping, farming or other outdoor activities.
• A full or provisional UK driving licence.

What You'll Gain

As part of your apprenticeship, you'll receive structured training and support to help you develop the skills and confidence needed to succeed.

• A recognised Level 2 qualification – work towards a Horticulture or Landscape Operative apprenticeship.
• Earn while you learn – gain practical experience while receiving a salary.
• Technical skills development – gain experience interpreting landscape construction drawings, planting plans and specifications, building your understanding of how landscaping projects are delivered.
• Fully funded training – with protected time to complete your apprenticeship studies.
• Hands-on experience – learn directly from experienced Landscape Operatives on a major infrastructure project.
• Additional qualifications – opportunities to gain certificates in equipment operation, pesticide application and first aid.
• Dedicated mentoring – regular guidance, feedback and support throughout your apprenticeship.
• Career progression – a clear pathway towards becoming a Landscape Operative, with opportunities for further development.

At Ground Control, we're passionate about creating and maintaining outdoor spaces that make a positive difference to people and the environment.

We believe in investing in our people, helping them develop new skills, build confidence and achieve their career ambitions.

title: Grid Connection Assessment Manager
description:
The role

Cellnex is seeking an experienced Grid Connections Delivery Manager for a 10m day rate contract to manage the end-to-end delivery of new Low Voltage (LV) and High Voltage (HV) electricity connections, with capacities up to 5MW, across its UK infrastructure portfolio.

The role will take responsibility once an approved site, completed feasibility assessment and DNO quotation have been formally handed over. From that point, the role will own; offer acceptance, procurement and delivery of contestable and non-contestable works, coordination with Independent Connection Providers (ICPs) and Independent Distribution Network Operators (IDNOs), and realisation of associated asset values.

The successful candidate will have strong technical and commercial experience of UK electricity distribution networks, DNO connection processes, contestable works procurement and IDNO asset adoption arrangements.

A key focus will be optimising connection costs, maximising IDNO asset values and ensuring grid infrastructure is delivered efficiently to support Cellnex's site development and build programmes.

This is a hybrid position based at our welcoming offices in Reading or Manchester, with three days in the office and two days working from home.

We welcome applications from everyone. If you require any adjustments during the recruitment process, please let us know—we’re here to support you.

Key Responsibilities

• DNO quotations: Accepted handover pack validated, selected DNO offer committed before expiry, and delivery mobilisation completed.
• Connection strategy: Clear recommendation on DNO delivery versus ICP/IDNO contestable delivery for each site.
• ICP procurement: Competitive tenders completed, evaluated and preferred suppliers appointed.
• IDNO asset values: Competitive asset adoption valuations obtained and commercially optimised.
• Delivery coordination: Effective management of the interface between ICPs, IDNOs, DNOs and Cellnex build partners.
• Programme management: Grid connections progressed to agreed milestones, including energisation.
• Financial management: Connection costs tracked and final IDNO asset values realised and reconciled with Finance.

title: Sous Chef
description:
Department: Culinary

Location: Etihad Stadium

Description

The Sous Chef is responsible for driving culinary excellence within The Residency, ensuring every dish meets the exceptional standards expected of a Michelin-inspired dining experience.

Working alongside the Chef Manager, you'll lead the kitchen during service, support the development of the brigade and maintain absolute consistency across every plate.

Whilst your primary focus is kitchen leadership, The Residency operates without traditional boundaries between kitchen and front of house. Every chef plays an active role in the guest experience, presenting dishes, sharing the story behind the menu and creating memorable moments throughout service.

This is an opportunity to be part of a unique concept where exceptional cooking and genuine hospitality come together.

Day To Day Responsibilities

Kitchen Leadership

• Lead the brigade during preparation and service, ensuring exceptional standards are maintained at all times.
• Support the Chef Manager in organising daily operations and service delivery.
• Coach, mentor and develop junior chefs, providing guidance and constructive feedback.
• Lead by example, promoting a collaborative, professional and high-performing kitchen culture.

Culinary Excellence

• Prepare and deliver dishes to Michelin-inspired standards with exceptional consistency and precision.
• Ensure every plate meets agreed presentation, quality and flavour standards.
• Support menu development, tastings and seasonal menu changes.
• Monitor quality throughout service and respond quickly to any issues.

Guest Experience

• Present dishes directly to guests with confidence and professionalism.
• Explain ingredients, techniques and the inspiration behind each course.
• Create engaging guest interactions that enhance the overall dining experience.
• Work seamlessly with the Service Lead to deliver an exceptional end-to-end guest journey.

Operational Excellence

• Support stock control, ordering and inventory management.
• Minimise waste and contribute to achieving GP targets.
• Ensure compliance with food safety, allergen and hygiene legislation.
• Maintain a clean, organised and efficient kitchen environment.
• Support the Chef Manager with training, onboarding and performance development.

Essential

Skills, Knowledge & Expertise

• Proven experience as a Sous Chef, Junior Sous Chef or Senior Chef de Partie within a premium restaurant, luxury hotel, Michelin-starred or Rosette environment.
• Experience leading a team during busy services.
• Exceptional culinary skills with meticulous attention to detail and presentation.
• Passion for delivering world-class food and hospitality.
• Confidence presenting dishes and interacting directly with guests.
• Strong coaching and people development skills.
• Excellent organisational and time management skills.
• Ability to remain calm and decisive in a fast-paced environment.
• Strong knowledge of food safety, hygiene and allergen legislation.
• Flexibility to work evenings, weekends and event days.

Desirable

• Experience within Michelin-starred or multi-Rosette kitchens.
• Experience working in chef's table, open kitchen or immersive dining concepts.
• Experience supporting menu development and seasonal menu planning.
• Knowledge of stock management, ordering and GP control.
• Formal culinary qualification (NVQ Level 3 or equivalent).
• Level 3 Food Safety qualification.
• Experience working alongside a Chef Patron or Executive Chef in a high-performance kitchen.
• Experience training and mentoring developing chefs.

Why Join Us?

• Private Medical Insurance (Vitality) – including Virtual GP access and rewards
• Group Life Assurance – 4x salary paid to your nominated beneficiary
• Birthday Day Off – an extra day to celebrate
• Complimentary Meals on Shift – breakfast, lunch, fruit and hot drinks
• Employee Assistance Programme & Wellbeing Platform – including counselling support
• Company Pension Scheme
• Generous Holiday Allowance – plus bank holidays
• Career Development Opportunities – with progression across the campus

Join us, and be part of the food revolution!

ALWAYS VISIONARY

We strive for better, we never settle, never compromise, never follow. We lead the way, blazing our own trail.

We are proud to be an inclusive employer and welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds. We celebrate individuality and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. BaxterStorey is committed to encouraging equity, diversity, and inclusion (ED&I) among our workforce and aim for our workforce to be truly representative of all sections of society, and for each employee to feel respected and able to give their best. To support our commitment to this we have set ourselves an ambition to ‘set the standard and to be recognised for having the most inclusive culture in hospitality’.

title: Data Analyst

title: Applied AI Engineer
description:
Are you a Fullstack developer curious about the world of AI? Wondering how your current skill set could open new doors in one of the fastest-growing tech fields? Here's your chance to dive into applied AI research and development - and actually shape the roadmap of multiple products across the BBM portfolio. It’s a unique opportunity to explore how diverse AI solutions can enrich real-world platforms, not just in theory, but in production - and your role will focus on integrating with AI APIs as part of a typical developer’s journey.

Our projects are always tied to the broadcast and OTT industry (online video). Implementations are based on advanced technological products, modules, or complete end-to-end solutions for companies looking to launch their own streaming platforms (like Netflix) or expand their existing online video offerings.

Why your Fullstack experience is the perfect launchpad for AI?

As someone who's built real software, you already have what it takes to thrive in AI. Here's why:

• AI is powered by data - and you're already skilled at working with databases, APIs, and data processing.
• You're a natural problem solver. That mindset is gold in AI, where experiments and edge cases are part of daily life.
• You know how to code. Your programming experience will translate easily into AI languages, and you’ll be right at home tinkering with models and workflows.
• You understand how systems fit together. Whether it's the front-end, back-end, or cloud, your holistic view is a huge advantage when building AI-powered apps.
• And when it comes to turning models into real-world tools, your experience integrating APIs and deploying cloud-based apps puts you miles ahead.

What you’ll actually be doing?

This isn’t a research lab job buried in theory. You'll be using AI tools and APIs to make real things happen:

• Building simple web apps that integrate BBM products with third-party AI SaaS tools.
• Presenting proof-of-concept results during sprint demos to internal stakeholders.
• Co-defining PoC scope and direction with the product owner.

How your time will be split?

• 60% hands-on R&D work with AI tools and APIs.
• 20% presenting results to the team and stakeholders.
• 20% refining requirements and planning next steps with the PO.

What we’re looking for?

We’re not expecting you to be an AI expert - we’ll grow that part together. But we do need someone who brings:

• At least one backend and one frontend language under your belt - preferably Python and React.
• Comfort working with cloud platforms (AWS preferred).
• Previous experience working with AI tools, APIs, or ML features.
• Independence, curiosity, and a love for solving complex problems.
• Perfect English - to read/write docs and chat with the team daily.

Bonus points if you’ve worked with .NET 6, OTT/video platforms, or speak some German.

What you’ll get in return:

• salary in the range of 12,500 - 17,500 PLN net + VAT (B2B contract)
• fully remote work with flexible working hours
• one full day per sprint for learning and development
• a choice to join MyBenefit platform (to buy a MultiSport card or other cool services)
• a choice to join our group health insurance
• access the wellbeing platform Mindgram that helps you stay in a good mental shape
• access to the language learning platform Tutlo
• company-wide quarterly meetings (which are special, because you don’t have to work on that day)
• optional (bun fun!) team activities, like joint mountain trekking trips, St. Nicolas Day event for kids, board game nights, and more.
• a welcoming office in the very heart of Poznań, if you prefer to work on-site.

If you're interested in joining our team, please submit your CV below. We’ll be glad to reach out to you!

Recruitment process:

• Chat with People Operations Specialist (30-minute online meeting to get to know each other).
• Recruitment task.
• Interview with the Chapter Leader to discuss the position, the task, and mutual expectations (approx. 1.5 hours)
• Interview with the Manager of the area you’ll be working with.
• Final decision.
