Grand Hotel Parker’s: una storia di eccellenza, una visione di futuro

Fondato nel 1870, il Grand Hotel Parker’s è il più antico albergo di Napoli e una delle dimore simbolo dell’ospitalità partenopea. Un hotel cinque stelle lusso in cui il fascino della tradizione, l’eleganza senza tempo e l’attenzione autentica all’ospite si fondono con una costante ricerca dell’eccellenza.

Dimora indipendente gestita dalla famiglia Avallone, il Parker’s custodisce una storia fatta di passione, cultura dell’accoglienza e valorizzazione del talento. Un luogo in cui l’eccellenza non è soltanto uno standard da raggiungere, ma un valore da condividere ogni giorno.

Il prestigio della struttura è riconosciuto a livello internazionale attraverso importanti selezioni e riconoscimenti:

• Chiave MICHELIN 2026 – assegnata dalla Guida MICHELIN all’eccellenza nell’ospitalità; il Grand Hotel Parker’s è il primo hotel di Napoli a ricevere questo riconoscimento.
• Relais & Châteaux – membro dell’esclusiva collezione internazionale che riunisce dimore e ristoranti d’eccellenza, accomunati dalla cultura dell’ospitalità, dall’identità territoriale e dall’arte di vivere.
• Forbes Travel Guide 2026 – Recommended – inserimento nella prestigiosa guida internazionale dedicata all’eccellenza nel settore del lusso.

George Restaurant: l’alta gastronomia nel cuore di Napoli

All’interno del Grand Hotel Parker’s, il George Restaurant è il primo ristorante di Napoli a conquistare due Stelle MICHELIN, confermate anche nella Guida MICHELIN 2026.

Il George propone una cucina gastronomica raffinata, nella quale i profumi e i colori della tradizione campana incontrano la tecnica classica, la sensibilità contemporanea e una costante ricerca creativa.

Il percorso di eccellenza del ristorante è ulteriormente valorizzato da:

• Due Stelle MICHELIN 2026, riconoscimento dell’elevatissimo livello della proposta gastronomica.
• Les Grandes Tables du Monde, prestigiosa associazione internazionale che riunisce ristoranti di alta gastronomia riconosciuti per la qualità della cucina, del servizio e dell’esperienza complessiva.

Descrizione del lavoro

Ricerchiamo uno/a Chef Pâtissier con comprovata esperienza, sensibilità estetica e una forte identità creativa, desideroso di contribuire allo sviluppo e all’evoluzione della proposta di pasticceria del George Restaurant. La figura selezionata sarà responsabile della progettazione, realizzazione dell’offerta di dessert e pasticceria del ristorante George, contribuendo a definire esperienze di gusto capaci di sorprendere, emozionare e lasciare un ricordo distintivo nell’ospite.

Responsabilità principali

• Ideare, sviluppare e realizzare dessert e creazioni di pasticceria coerenti con la filosofia gastronomica del George Restaurant, valorizzando la stagionalità, le eccellenze campane e la qualità delle materie prime.
• Contribuire allo sviluppo creativo del dessert al piatto, assicurando armonia, equilibrio e continuità con la proposta gastronomica dello Chef.
• Curare tutte le fasi della produzione, dalla ricerca e sperimentazione alla preparazione, finitura, decorazione e presentazione finale.
• Sviluppare tecniche, consistenze, temperature e abbinamenti innovativi, coniugando rigore tecnico, gusto e ricerca estetica.
• Garantire elevati standard di qualità, precisione, pulizia, sicurezza alimentare e rispetto delle procedure HACCP.
• Assicurare continuità qualitativa, puntualità e precisione durante il servizio, nel rispetto degli standard richiesti da un ristorante due Stelle MICHELIN.
• Monitorare le evoluzioni della pasticceria internazionale e proporre nuove tecniche, ingredienti e soluzioni creative in linea con l’identità del ristorante.

Qualifiche

• Esperienza comprovata di almeno 2 anni nel ruolo di Sous Chef Pâtissier, preferibilmente maturata in ristoranti stellati.
• Formazione specifica in pasticceria e arte dolciaria, preferibilmente conseguita presso scuole o istituti riconosciuti.
• Solida conoscenza delle tecniche classiche e contemporanee di pasticceria, cioccolateria e lavorazione delle principali preparazioni dolciarie.
• Creatività, sensibilità estetica, precisione tecnica e attenzione meticolosa al dettaglio.
• Capacità di sviluppare dessert identitari, riconoscibili e coerenti con una filosofia gastronomica definita.
• Ottime capacità organizzative, gestione delle priorità e rispetto delle tempistiche di servizio.
• Conoscenza delle procedure HACCP e capacità di gestire approvvigionamenti, scarti e costi.
• Flessibilità, spirito di collaborazione, curiosità professionale e autentica passione per la ricerca gastronomica

Informazioni aggiuntive

Cosa ti offriamo

• Contratto: tempo determinato della durata di 12 mesi, con prospettiva di trasformazione a tempo indeterminato.
• CCNL: Fedeturismo Confindustria ( H05B), inquadramento C1
• Retribuzione annua lorda: da € 36.000 a € 45.000, in funzione dell’esperienza, delle competenze e del profilo professionale.
• Organizzazione del lavoro: 5 giorni lavorativi a settimana, dal martedì al sabato.
• Riposi settimanali: domenica e lunedì, fissi.
• Opportunità di entrare a far parte di una realtà che valorizza la qualità del servizio, l’attenzione ai dettagli e la passione per l’ospitalità
• Formazione specifica criteri valutazione Relais & Chateaux e principali normative vigenti

All’interno del Grand Hotel Parker’s ogni dipendente si sente parte di una squadra unita da obiettivi comuni e valori condivisi. La cultura aziendale si basa sul rispetto, la trasparenza e la valorizzazione del singolo e l’atmosfera è caratterizzata da continuo scambio di idee in cui ciascuno ha la possibilità di esprimere la propria opinione e contribuire al miglioramento delle attività. Qui le risorse sono innanzitutto persone riconosciute per il loro talento, impegno e passione; infatti, la meritocrazia è il pilastro del Grand Hotel Parker’s dove i risultati vengono premiati non solo con opportunità di crescita professionale ma con riconoscimenti concreti del lavoro svolto.

By combining our Cloud Intelligence technology with Forward Deployed Engineers and deep specialization across AWS, Google Cloud, and Azure, we help tech-forward companies navigate their toughest infrastructure and cost governance challenges end to end.

The Opportunity

As an Account Executive, Strategic Deals for Attribute™, you will be at the forefront of building a brand-new region from scratch and introducing a groundbreaking solution to a fundamental business problem in modern FinOps. You will work on Strategic Deals, leveraging strategic partnerships with AWS, OpenAI, Top Private Equity firms, and our global current install base. A strong focus will be placed on co-selling and unlocking strategic deal opportunities with AWS, ISVs, and channel partners. Traditional cloud cost allocation methods rely heavily on static tagging—an approach that becomes obsolete in modern, shared cloud and AI infrastructure. When multi-tenant clusters, shared GPUs, microservices, and dynamic AI workloads dominate, organizations face severe blind spots: they cannot accurately determine the true cost-to-serve for specific applications, autonomous agents, or business teams, making it impossible to calculate true gross margins at a granular customer level.

Attribute™ solves this by taking a completely different approach. Leveraging runtime eBPF technology, Attribute™ captures real-time network traffic signals and kernel-level observability without requiring engineering teams to manually tag or instrument code. By analyzing actual runtime consumption across CPU, GPU, memory, network, and AI model API requests, it provides accurate total cost of ownership (TCO) and unit economics based on real usage. Organizations finally get precise cost governance and gross margin visibility across complex cloud and AI environments with zero developer overhead.

As an Account Executive building this region from scratch, you will establish a high-potential greenfield territory. You will drive sales end-to-end with a heavy emphasis on net-new logo acquisition, defining the regional go-to-market strategy and creating the foundational customer success stories that define this category.

You will own full-cycle deal execution across Startup, Digital Native, and Enterprise segments—prospecting new accounts, running compelling solution pitches, navigating complex technical evaluations alongside engineering partners, and closing strategic partnerships end to end.

You'll have the rest of the Cloud Intelligence portfolio behind you: 4,500 customers, AWS/Google Cloud/Azure partnerships, and Forward Deployed Engineers who solve problems other vendors walk away from. But the product you'll carry every day is Attribute™, and the market is only just learning it exists. That's the opportunity.

Expect to travel 10–15% of the time to meet customers, engage with hyperscale teams, and show up at industry events that matter.

Responsibilities

• Own the full sales cycle from first conversation to closed deal, consistently hitting and exceeding quota and pipeline targets
• Build a high-volume pipeline and establish the region from scratch with a hunter mindset, driving outbound prospecting and net-new logo acquisition across EMEA
• Build the first wave of reference customers and case studies the rest of the GTM org will run on
• Develop and execute a regional strategy that identifies high-growth opportunities and untapped markets across EMEA
• Build deep, mutually valuable relationships with AWS Sales Leaders and Partner Managers to co-sell and expand market share
• Partner with Forward Deployed Engineers and Solutions Architects to solve the toughest technical challenges prospects face
• Maintain rigorous forecast accuracy in Salesforce and ensure every proposal reflects the quality of what we actually deliver
• Guide customers from initial curiosity through contract execution, setting them up for a world-class onboarding experience
• Feed real customer signal back to product and marketing every week — in a founding team, that loop is the job
• Generate your own pipeline through prospecting, networking, and creative outreach — not just working what's handed to you

Qualifications

• Proven track record of full-cycle B2B SaaS sales experience with a strong emphasis on net-new logo acquisition and building a regional territory from scratch
• A track record of selling cloud services and understanding how consumption-based models work
• Hunting mentality: demonstrated drive to self-generate pipeline, prospect into target accounts, and close new business independently
• Experience selling to platform engineering / DevOps teams.
• Comfort selling something new — you've sold a product before there was a Gartner quadrant for it, and you preferred it that way
• Technical curiosity: you understand the cloud computing market and can hold your own in conversations about AWS, Google Cloud, or Azure products and architecture
• Genuine interest in FinOps and how engineering organisations actually consume the cloud — you don't need to be a practitioner, but you need to care
• Ability to build influential relationships across matrixed organisations and turn professional networks into real partnerships
• "Roll up your sleeves" attitude that pervades both sales and business development activities
• Prior experience at AWS, ISVs, or in strategic partnerships is a big plus

Are You a Doer?

Be your truest self. Work on your terms. Make a difference.

We are home to a global team of incredible talent who work remotely and have the flexibility to have a schedule that balances your work and home life. We embrace and support leveling up your skills professionally and personally.

What does being a Do'er mean? We're all about being entrepreneurial, pursuing knowledge, and having fun! Click here to learn more about our Life at DoiT.

Sounds too good to be true? Check out our Glassdoor reviews.

We thought so too, but we're here and happy we hit that 'apply' button.

Many Doers, One Team

DoiT unites as Many Do'ers, One Team, where diversity is more than a goal — it's our strength. Senior Influencer Manager

London, United Kingdom

Role overview Application

Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

The Community You Will Join

The Airbnb Communications team drives earned visibility and cultural relevance for the brand, delivering campaigns that support direct traffic, brand love and positive conversation. Our influencer function sits at the intersection of culture, content and community — leading social-first campaigns that inspire travel on Airbnb and strengthen its long-term reputation.

The Difference You Will Make

We're looking for a Senior Influencer Manager to lead Airbnb's influencer programme in the UK, localising regional priorities and delivering campaigns that connect the brand to culturally relevant conversations.

The role covers our full influencer remit: earned and organic creator partnerships, and influencer work running through paid media. You'll own campaigns end to end — creator sourcing, briefing, contracting, measurement and reporting — and help position influencers as both a commercial lever and a long-term driver of brand health, while collaborating with agency partners.

Sitting in the UK Communications team, you'll build influencer into campaign narratives from inception, and partner with Brand Marketing and Paid Media so creator content is designed for amplification from the outset, with usage rights, whitelisting and dark posting permissions secured up front.

This is a hands-on role for someone who knows how to turn brand objectives into content that is authentic, thumb-stopping and earns attention rather than interrupting it.

A Typical Day

• Own and scale Airbnb's influencer programme in the UK against local, regional and global priorities — timelines, creative execution and performance
• Deliver across earned, organic and paid influencer work, partnering with the regional Influencer Lead and the UK Brand Marketing and Paid Media teams on creator selection, briefing for amplification, permissions and asset delivery
• Build influencer into the core campaign narrative and press strategy from inception, with the UK Communications team
• Identify, vet and build relationships with creators across Instagram, TikTok and YouTube — emerging talent through to established partners — with inclusive, culturally relevant casting
• Write clear, strategic briefs covering objectives, key messages and content guidelines, and lead onboarding and content reviews against brand standards
• Partner with legal and agency teams on contracts: deliverables, usage rights, paid media, exclusivity and payment
• Stay plugged into culture, consumer and media trends — particularly Gen Z — bringing forward creator ideas and campaign hooks, and moving fast on reactive opportunities
• Manage logistics for influencer stays and experiences, including vetting, Host coordination and credit approvals
• Track performance across commercial and brand health metrics using CreatorIQ,Sprinklr and Airtable, optimising with the agency and reporting to the regional team
• Align plans with local Marketing, Partnerships, Affiliate and Growth teams and the global influencer team to avoid duplicated effort
• Lead day-to-day communication and program operations with our respective UK Influencer agency partners
• Identify opportunities with key opinion formers — policy, cultural and news influencers, and third-party validators — for reputation campaigns

Your Expertise

• 8+ years in communications, influencer marketing, talent partnerships or social-first content strategy
• Deep knowledge of the UK creator landscape and strong instincts on what resonates and why, across a diverse audience
• A communications mindset: a track record of building creator partnerships into integrated campaigns, connected to the earned, social and reputation storytelling around them
• End-to-end campaign experience across organic and paid environments — sourcing, briefing for amplification, dark posting, usage rights, contracting and performance analysis
• Confident negotiating with creators and managing external agencies and stakeholders across legal, marketing and comms
• Strong writing, particularly briefs and content feedback
• Familiarity with influencer tools (CreatorIQ, Sprinklr or similar tooling platforms) and reporting that quantifies brand health and sentiment, not just reach and engagement
• Able to run multiple campaigns and creators at once with high attention to detail
• Belief in influencer as a driver of long-term brand equity, not just short-term performance

Our Commitment To Inclusion & Belonging:

Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.

How We'll Take Care of You:

Our job titles may span more than one career level. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as: training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs and market demands. The base pay range shown below is annualized, is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role may also be eligible for bonus, equity, benefits, and Employee Travel Credits.

United Kingdom Annual Pay Range

£72,000—£90,000 GBP

Reasonable Accommodations: We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for applicants with disabilities. If you need assistance, or an accommodation, please let your recruiter know once you are contacted about a role.

A Note on Recruiting Scams: Scammers sometimes pose as Airbnb recruiters to get money or personal information from candidates. A few things that will always be true for Airbnb’s hiring process: our open roles are posted on Airbnb’s Career’s Page at careers.airbnb.com, and our recruiters correspond only from @airbnb.com or @ext.airbnb.com email addresses. Our recruiters will never ask for your Social Security number, bank account details, passport, or payment app information while you are interviewing. We’ll also never ask you to pay a fee, send money, deposit or cash a check, or purchase work-related equipment (such as a company laptop) during the interview process. We encourage candidates to remain vigilant of these recruiting scams and not share sensitive information if you do not believe an individual is actually affiliated with Airbnb.

Offices: London, United Kingdom

Apply Now

Airbnb, Inc. can hire employees in states where we have registered entities. Currently, employees cannot be located/live in: Alaska, Mississippi, and North Dakota. This list is continuously evolving, so please check back with us if the state you live in is on the exclusion list.

title: Quality Electrical Technician, Powertrain
description:
About Lucid

At Lucid, we are creating exceptional mobility experiences through innovation to drive the world forward. Built on Lucid’s proprietary technology and software-defined vehicle architecture, our award-winning vehicles bring our “Compromise Nothing™” approach to the global automotive market. That means refusing to choose between performance and sustainability, design and engineering, ambition and integrity. In Lucid Air and Lucid Gravity, we have designed and built vehicles that have redefined their segments, combining exceptional range, performance, design, and expansive space in a single experience.

We achieve this through deep vertical integration, with design, engineering, and production happening in-house across our global offices and manufacturing facilities. Our teams come from industries around the world, united by a shared commitment to excellence. By refusing to settle, you can help redefine what’s possible and shape the future of mobility.

The Powertrain Quality Electrical Technician supports electrical and electronic Powertrain Quality activities at Lucid Motors. Reporting to the Powertrain Quality Electrical Engineer, the technician performs standardized inspections, electrical tests, containment, verification, and Quality control activities for electrical and electronic Powertrain components, assemblies, and end-of-line test processes. The role works closely with Production, Manufacturing, Maintenance, Incoming Quality, Test Engineering, and Quality Engineering teams to identify abnormalities, protect the production line, maintain accurate traceability, and support timely corrective actions that meet engineering specifications, Lucid Quality standards, regulatory requirements, and customer expectations.

Key Responsibilities

• Follow all required safety procedures, including the use of appropriate Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) such as safety glasses, vests, shoes, and gloves.
• Maintain a safe, clean, and organized work environment in accordance with 6S standards.
• Develop technical expertise in Lucid Powertrain systems, components, and assemblies.
• Perform incoming, in-process, control point, and end-of-line inspections and tests for electrical and electronic Powertrain components and assemblies, including electric motors, inverters, power electronics, wiring harnesses, connectors, sensors, control modules, and high-voltage interfaces.
• Execute inspections and electrical tests according to approved control plans, work instructions, electrical schematics, specifications, sampling plans, reaction plans, test limits, and acceptance criteria.
• Perform continuity, polarity, grounding, connector engagement, pin integrity, insulation resistance, dielectric withstand, torque, labeling, and functional verification checks, as required.
• Use calibrated electrical test equipment, diagnostic tools, fixtures, golden samples, and approved end-of-line test systems to verify product conformity and process compliance.
• Identify, segregate, label, and document nonconforming material and support containment, sorting, re-inspection, controlled repair, software or calibration verification, and revalidation under the direction of the Powertrain Quality Electrical Engineer.
• Escalate abnormalities promptly and provide diagnostic evidence, test results, measurements, photographs, fault codes, and traceability information to support customer protection and rapid decision-making.
• Accurately record inspection, test, repair, containment, and audit results in approved Quality, MES, QMS, diagnostic, and traceability systems.
• Support root cause investigations, corrective action trials, validation builds, test-limit verification, and effectiveness checks for electrical, electronic, diagnostic, communication, and high-voltage defects related to internal failures and Field Quality feedback.
• Conduct workmanship inspections for harness routing, connector seating, terminal condition, sealing, grounding, labeling, fastener torque, damage, contamination, and assembly standards.
• Support test-equipment qualification, measurement system analysis, calibration checks, correlation studies, line trials, safe launch, launch readiness reviews, and engineering or software change implementation.
• Participate in layered process audits, product audits, compliance checks, and verification of standardized work and electrical safety controls.
• Complete required high-voltage, electrical safety, inspection, and test certifications and contribute to continuous improvement, defect prevention, lessons learned, and reduction of repeat issues.

Skills

• Ability to read and interpret electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, engineering specifications, interface requirements, process documentation, control plans, and inspection or test standards.
• Practical knowledge of digital multimeters, continuity testers, insulation-resistance testers, dielectric test equipment, diagnostic tools, torque tools, and functional test systems.
• Working knowledge of electric motors, inverters, power electronics, high-voltage components, wiring harnesses, connectors, sensors, controllers, grounding, and electrical interfaces.
• Basic understanding of high-voltage safety principles, electrical isolation, lockout/tagout requirements, and safe work practices applicable to assigned activities.
• Basic understanding of automotive Quality systems, nonconforming material control, MSA, SPC, layered process audits, and structured problem-solving methods.
• Ability to recognize and document electrical abnormalities, fault codes, intermittent conditions, connector or harness defects, and workmanship concerns.
• Strong attention to detail, disciplined execution, accurate documentation, and effective communication with the Powertrain Quality Electrical Engineer and cross-functional teams.
• Basic proficiency with Microsoft Office applications and familiarity with MES, QMS, diagnostic, digital inspection, and traceability systems.

Minimum Qualifications

• Diploma in Electrical, Electronics, Mechatronics, or a related discipline required. A high school diploma with extensive relevant experience may be considered.
• 2-4 years of experience in automotive manufacturing, electrical inspection, electrical testing, diagnostics, or a related environment.
• Ability to use electrical measurement, test, and diagnostic equipment and maintain accurate inspection and traceability records.
• Ability to work on the manufacturing floor, support shift operations and production priorities, and comply with all applicable electrical and high-voltage safety requirements.
• Good verbal and written communication skills with the ability to clearly communicate technical findings to the Powertrain Quality Electrical Engineer and cross-functional teams.

Preferred Qualifications

• Hands-on experience with EV Powertrain electrical systems, motors, inverters, power electronics, high-voltage components, harnesses, connectors, sensors, controllers, or end-of-line testing.
• Experience supporting new product launches, greenfield manufacturing, or high-volume production ramp-up.
• High-voltage awareness training or certification. Required training or certification must be completed as applicable to the assigned work scope.

Compensation & Benefits: Lucid offers a comprehensive and competitive benefits package including medical, dental, and vision insurance; life and disability coverage; paid time off; paid holidays, paid sick leave; and a 401(k) retirement plan. Hourly/non-exempt employees accrue up to 120 hours paid time off, and salaried/exempt employee accrue up to 160 hours paid time off. Eligible employees may also participate in Lucid’s equity program and/or a discretionary annual cash incentive program. Incentive and equity awards, if applicable, are determined based on individual performance, role scope, market considerations, and overall company results, in accordance with the terms of the applicable plans.

Equal Opportunity: At Lucid, we believe diversity strengthens everything we build. Lucid Motors is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and is committed to providing an inclusive workplace for all. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, national or ethnic origin, age, religion, disability, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity or expression, marital status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable state or federal laws and regulations.

Accessibility: Lucid Motors is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities. If you need any accommodation to participate in the application process, please contact us at TA-Operations <@> lucidmotors.com. To be considered for employment, all applications must be submitted through the Lucid Motors Careers website.

Candidate Data Privacy: By submitting your application, you understand and agree that your personal data will be processed in accordance with our Candidate Privacy Notice.

• Working knowledge of precision assembly, machining, castings, gears, bearings, seals, fastening, lubrication, cleanliness, and thermal-management components.

• Strong attention to detail, disciplined execution, accurate documentation, and the ability to recognize and escalate abnormal conditions.

Minimum Qualifications

• Diploma in Mechanical, Manufacturing, Mechatronics, or a related discipline required. A high school diploma with extensive relevant experience may be considered.
• 2-4 years of experience in mechanical engineering, manufacturing, Quality Operations, or a related environment.
• Ability to use mechanical measurement and inspection equipment and maintain accurate inspection and traceability records.
• Ability to work on the manufacturing floor, support shift operations and production priorities, and follow all applicable safety and high-voltage area requirements.
• Good verbal and written communication skills with the ability to clearly communicate technical findings to the Powertrain Quality Mechanical Engineer and cross-functional teams.

group: moneybox|head of corporate reporting & financial operations
title: Head of Corporate Reporting & Financial Operations
description:
About Moneybox

At Moneybox, our mission is to give everyone the means to get more out of life. We're guided by our belief that wealth isn't about the money, it's about the means to more - more freedom, opportunities, possibilities, and peace of mind. Moneybox is an award-winning wealth management platform, helping over one and a half million people build wealth throughout their lives, whether they’re saving and investing, buying their first home, or planning for retirement.

We are FCA-regulated, look after more than £23 billion of customer assets, and have grown from under £5 billion in three years, with annualised revenue in excess of £150 million. We have done this while growing profitably year on year and building a fortress balance sheet, so our ambitions are funded from a position of strength rather than dependence on the next round. The next phase includes the launch of a financial advice service and expansion into B2B, which means the finance function is scaling in complexity as well as size.

Job Brief

• Accurate financial information is paramount in ensuring Moneybox operates efficiently and profitably. Our Head of Corporate Reporting & Financial Operations will be a leader in their field, possessing exceptional technical knowledge. In addition to being a financial reporting expert they will have a deep understanding of financial operations, with a demonstrable background of delivering and assisting with large transformation projects. Working closely with other functions, they will embed best in class financial controls governance as well as developing financial literacy across the business.

What you'll do

• Being a Head of at Moneybox doesn't just mean you own and manage your function, it means you play a vital role in helping define strategy through steering committees, quarterly planning meetings, and management committees. Moneybox has thrived owing to its strong culture; as a Head of, you are core in helping maintain this culture through living and promoting the Moneybox values. A Head of at Moneybox is a senior leadership grade, equivalent to a Director-level role in most other businesses, with the accountability, visibility and expectations that implies.Scope and scaleYou will lead a team of five, including three qualified accountants, across financial reporting, financial control, financial operations and tax. The role is accountable for all group legal entities and the group consolidation, the statutory audit relationship with PwC, and the finance systems estate, which is evolving towards an AI-native stack that you will help shape. You will be a member of the Finance Senior Leadership Team, present to the Audit Committee, attend management committees, and deputise for the VP Finance where appropriate.As a key member of the Finance Senior Leadership team and a trusted advisor to the VP Finance, this role will be responsible for, but not limited to, the following:Corporate Reporting
• Lead the development and execution of the corporate reporting strategy, ensuring alignment with the overall business objectives
• Oversee the preparation and timely submission of all statutory financial reports, including annual accounts, consolidated financial statements, tax filings, and regulatory returns
• Own the relationship with our external auditors, leading the annual audit and resolving technical judgements
• Prepare and present accounting judgement papers and control-environment reporting to the Audit Committee, and represent Finance at relevant governance forums
• Own the group's legal entity structure from a reporting and tax perspective, ensuring it remains efficient, compliant and fit for the strategy, and advising on structuring for new ventures
• Drive continuous improvement in financial reporting processes, leveraging technology and best practices to enhance accuracy, efficiency, and transparency
• Ensure compliance with IFRS and other relevant accounting standards and regulatory requirements, reviewing changes in accounting standards, regulations and best practice and assessing their impact on the organisation
• Alongside the finance senior leadership team, drive forward our IPO readiness programme, with a focus on reporting and financial controls
• Deputise for the VP Finance as requiredFinance Transformation, Automation & AI
• Own the finance transformation roadmap, with a clear mandate to automate the close, reconciliations and reporting production
• Lead the adoption of AI and automation tooling across the ledger and financial operations, moving the function from manual production towards exception-based review and continuous controls monitoring
• Set the data and systems architecture for finance, ensuring that reporting, control and regulatory outputs are built on a single, well-governed source of truth
• Champion a culture where the team builds and improves its own tooling rather than waiting for itFinancial Operations
• Provide strategic leadership and oversight of all day-to-day financial operations, including accounts payable, accounts receivable, payroll, and tax
• Optimise financial operations to drive efficiency, reduce costs, and improve working capital management
• Oversee the selection, implementation, and management of financial systems and technologies
• Develop and implement financial policies, procedures, and controls to ensure the integrity of financial data
• Oversee the implementation and maintenance of a robust internal control framework to mitigate financial risks and ensure compliance with regulatory requirements

Who you are

• Focus on team; providing strong leadership and fostering a culture of excellence, collaboration, and continuous improvement
• Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively interact with senior management and external stakeholders
• Considered an expert in your field and a leader amongst your team and peers
• Exceptional analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills

Experience and skills

• Chartered accountant (ACA preferred), with a track record of leading a financial reporting and control function in a regulated financial services business; experience across both practice and industry is preferred
• Has personally owned statutory accounts, the external audit and an internal control framework at a scale comparable to Moneybox
• Experience of an IPO, IPO-readiness programme or a listed environment is strongly preferred
• In-depth knowledge of IFRS and UK GAAP and a demonstrated ability to form and defend accounting judgements with auditors and committees
• Evidence of having delivered material automation or systems change in finance, and genuine fluency with how AI changes the operating model of a finance team
• Exceptional project leadership across internal and external stakeholders, and the gravitas to influence at ExCo and Board level

Our Commitment to DE&I:

At Moneybox, we promote, support and celebrate inclusion, diversity and equity for all, so that everyone can bring their full selves to work. We believe that diversity drives innovation, and that if our team is representative of our community of customers, we can better support their needs. To ensure our recruitment processes provide an equal opportunity for all applicants to succeed, we encourage you to let us know if there are any adjustments that we can make. We are open-minded and always willing to go the extra mile to ensure all applicants can present their full self and potential

Working Policy:

We have a hybrid policy that includes 2 days from our London office and 3 from home. If the role states it is either hybrid or remote candidates must be based within the UK.

Visa Sponsorship:

At this time we cannot offer visa sponsorship for this role and we cannot consider overseas applications.

Please read before you apply!

Please note if offered a position, the offer is conditional and subject to the receipt of satisfactory pre-employment checks which we will conduct such as criminal record and adverse credit history checks. As a regulated financial business, an adverse financial history could impact your suitability for the role. If you are aware of anything that could affect your suitability for the role, please let us know in advance.

By sending us your application you acknowledge and agree to Moneybox using your personal data as described below.

We collect applicants’ personal data to manage our recruitment related activities. Consequently, we may use your personal data to evaluate your application, to select and shortlist applicants, to set up and conduct interviews and tests, to evaluate and assess the results, and as is otherwise needed in the recruitment process generally.We do not share your personal data with unauthorised third parties. However, we may, if necessary, share your personal data to carefully selected third parties acting on our behalf. This may include transfers to servers and databases outside the country where you provided us with your personal data. Such transfers may include for example transfers and/or disclosures outside the European Economic Area and in the United States of America.

If you are unsuccessful in your application, we may keep your details on file so that we can tell you about other suitable vacancies which may be of interest to you when they arise in the future.

If you would like to reach us then please email: talent@moneyboxapp.com

If you would rather we did not keep your details on file, you can contact us at: DPO@moneyboxapp.com

title: Executive Business Partner, EMEA (Strategy)
description:
About the Team

Our Executive Business Partners serve as trusted advisors and collaborators to OpenAI’s executives and leaders, bringing strong communication, sound judgment, and operational excellence to their teams. We elevate leadership impact by anticipating needs, streamlining processes, and providing comprehensive support so our leaders can focus on their highest-impact priorities. Through strong relationships and a deep understanding of business objectives, we help teams navigate complexity, achieve key milestones, and contribute to OpenAI’s growth and success.

Our leadership team reflects OpenAI’s culture and core values and is a mission-driven, kind, and thoughtful group. We take pride in creating a work environment that fosters collaboration, open communication, and authenticity, making OpenAI an excellent place to work for highly accomplished professionals.

OpenAI is expanding its presence across EMEA, building the teams and leadership needed to support our growth across the region.

In this role, you will:

Partner with our GM, UK & Nordics, our EMEA Communications leader, and a future EMEA Marketing leader. These leaders work closely with our Managing Director, EMEA, other regional GMs, and teams across Sales, Policy, Partnerships, and beyond to advance OpenAI’s presence in the region. You’ll help these leaders and their teams operate effectively by creating structure, driving coordination, and strengthening the operating cadence across markets, functions, and time zones. Working across regional business leadership, communications, and marketing, you’ll anticipate needs, manage competing priorities, and build connections that support effective collaboration and execution.

You might thrive in this role if you have:

• 5+ years experience in a cross-functional executive assistant role or similar support function.
• Successfully supported multiple leaders in the past.
• Worked in a hard tech startup or similar environment.
• Experience working across EMEA markets and collaborating with U.S.-based HQ teams.
• High cross-cultural EQ and ability to tailor communication styles for diverse stakeholders.
• Strong operational rigor — able to run cadences, track priorities, and maintain alignment across time zones.
• Comfortable supporting complex, rapid travel across international regions.
• Strong communication - being able to tailor a message appropriate to a specific audience (writing an email to a Senator vs. a Customer vs. an Exec).
• Discretion - this role will have exposure to sensitive knowledge so must be rock solid on confidentiality.
• Humility/diplomacy - this role has the potential to accrue power in a unique ways, but we want this person to be decisive and make noncontroversial decisions.

title: Senior AI Product Engineer
description:
✨ One platform, a whole world of opportunity

The best jobs have always clustered in a handful of the world's wealthiest cities. But talent is everywhere. Oyster set out to close that gap - building a global employment platform that lets companies hire, pay, and care for brilliant people anywhere.

We're proof that a high-performing culture doesn't need an office. Distributed across 60+ countries since 2020, we've built something the industry keeps noticing:

• Ranked #10 of 250 on TIME and Statista's 2026 list of America's Top WorkTech Companies
• Named one of America's Greatest Startup Workplaces 2026 by Newsweek
• A G2 Spring 2026 Leader across Employer of Record, Global Employment, Multi-country Payroll, and HR Compliance
• The only B Corp-certified global employment platform ~ independently verified since 2023

Two of those rankings measured our business impact from the outside. One measured how our own people feel about working here. They landed in the same place ~ because at Oyster, culture and performance aren't separate conversations. They're the same one.

And we're just getting started. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who care as much as you do, we'd love for you to apply.

The Opportunity

Oyster AI is our assistant for customers and team members, and we want it to be genuinely useful: accurate, fast, reliable and safe with the data it touches. In this role you’ll own complex improvements to it end to end, from defining the problem and designing the solution through evaluation, rollout and learning from production.

Your work will span agent capabilities and tools, knowledge retrieval, answer quality and infrastructure, with real trade-offs between model quality, latency, reliability and cost. This is a hands-on product engineering role, not a research-only or prompt-only position. You’ll also help other product teams build AI features well by sharing patterns, pairing with them and improving the reusable foundations they rely on.

Our backend is Ruby on Rails and our frontend is React. Strong AI engineers from other stacks are very welcome, and Rails experience is a bonus, not a prerequisite.

What You’ll Build & Own

• End-to-end AI improvements. Connect user needs to architecture, implementation, evaluation and safe rollout for complex Oyster AI work.
• Reliable agents and tools. Design clear tool contracts, robust error handling and bounded execution, with appropriate human control over consequential actions.
• Better knowledge access. Choose retrieval, embedding, indexing and freshness strategies that improve answers while respecting data access boundaries throughout retrieval and generation.
• Evaluation you can trust. Build evaluation loops with representative datasets, experiments, regression checks and, where useful, automated judges calibrated against human judgment.
• Root-cause fixes in production. Diagnose failures across prompts, retrieval, tools, models and infrastructure, fix the underlying cause and verify the fix with evidence.
• Explicit trade-offs. Choose models and system designs deliberately, and document decisions and rollout criteria.
• AI capability across teams. Support other product teams through technical guidance, code review, pairing and mentoring, so they can deliver AI features independently.

What You’ll Bring

• Senior-level engineering judgment and a track record of independently leading complex production work from design through operation and improvement.
• Hands-on experience shipping LLM-powered product capabilities to production, with clear personal responsibility for implementation and delivery decisions.
• Real depth in at least some of the following: retrieval/RAG and indexing, evaluation datasets and experiments, LLM-as-judge, or agents and tool calling.
• The ability to tell model, retrieval, tooling and application failures apart, and to validate improvements with evidence.
• Strong fundamentals in coding, debugging, testing, API integration and system design, plus willingness to work in Ruby/Rails and React.
• Sound judgment about sensitive data, access control, model limitations and operational risk.
• Clear communication of trade-offs, effective async collaboration with product and engineering partners, and practical mentoring.

Nice to have

• Production experience with Ruby on Rails, especially integrating AI capabilities into an established backend.
• Full-stack delivery of conversational or assistant experiences.
• Slack or in-app assistant integrations with clear user and permission context.
• Operating retrieval pipelines, agent tools, evaluation infrastructure, or model routing and cost controls at production scale.
• Helping multiple teams adopt reusable AI patterns while balancing shared foundations against local needs.

Why Join Us

• Real AI in production. You’ll ship to real users, and success is measured by evaluations and user outcomes, not plausible-looking demos.
• Ownership of hard problems. You’ll work across agents, retrieval, evaluation and infrastructure, where engineering judgment matters at every layer.
• Multiplier impact. Your patterns and mentoring will shape how AI is built across multiple product teams.
• Stack-agnostic hiring. We hire for AI engineering depth, and you’ll have room to grow into Rails and React.
• Thoughtful remote culture. You’ll join a fully remote, async-friendly team that values documentation and clear decision-making.

How we work together at Oyster

Our values guide the work we do, the decisions we make, and the culture that makes Oyster what it is. We make it happen—progress is our default setting. We drive change, we build and give trust, and we move as one united team.

Our mission is to create a more equal world of work: helping companies everywhere hire, pay, and care for talent anywhere. Everything we do ladders up to our mission. We embrace asynchronous, collaborative work and share how we operate in the Oyster Public HQ so other global teams can learn from us.

How YOU work

With diverse locations, cultures, and needs, we created How YOU Work; a program supporting your whole human experience at Oyster:

• Work from anywhere: Oyster has no borders or HQ. As long as work is timely, your team is supported, and you're authorized to work where you live, you can work from anywhere.
• Paid time off: Enjoy 40 days off per year (including holidays and vacation), or more if required by your country.
• Mental health support: Access Plumm, our mental well-being service.
• Wellbeing allowance: Each month, receive a wellbeing allowance in your ThanksBen wallet to spend on a wide range of options.
• Flexible parental leave: All new parents are eligible for at least three months’ paid leave, with job protection for up to 12 months or as required locally.
• WFH stipend: Receive a stipend for your laptop and home office equipment to get you set up quickly.

✨ The best jobs should be available to everyone

We embrace diverse perspectives and intentionally build our product and company with an inclusive, global mindset. We encourage you to apply, even if you don’t meet every criterion, and are committed to a trust-based, thriving environment.

Oyster is committed to ensuring equal opportunity of employment for qualified persons with disabilities and actively fosters an inclusive work environment. If you require reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process, please email jobs@oysterhr.com with the subject line: Interview Accommodations.

Our available positions are on our careers page. Our team will only contact you from an @oysterhr.com email, and we will never ask for money as part of an interview process or job offer. If you receive a suspicious email about Oyster jobs or are directed to a site other than www.oysterhr.com/careers, please report it via our Compliance and Ethics Helpline.

title: Senior Frontend Engineer, Marketing Website
description:
Synthesia is the world’s leading AI video platform for business, used by over 90% of the Fortune 100. Founded in 2017, the company is headquartered in London, with offices and teams across Europe and the US.

As AI continues to shape the way we live and work, Synthesia develops products to enhance visual communication and enterprise skill development, helping people work better and stay at the center of successful organizations.

Following our recent Series E funding round, where we raised $200 million, our valuation stands at $4 billion. Our total funding exceeds $530 million from premier investors including Accel, NVentures (Nvidia's VC arm), Kleiner Perkins, GV, and Evantic Capital, alongside the founders and operators of Stripe, Datadog, Miro, and Webflow.

The Role

As a Senior Frontend Engineer on our Website team, you'll be a co-owner of the platform behind synthesia.io: the component library, content model and rendering stack that every page on our marketing site is built from. You'll shape direction and make key technical decisions with the team, likely with a focus area of your own but context across the whole system. This is a hands-on engineering role, and your primary output is high-quality component and schema code, plus the tooling that lets others build with it.

Millions of people visit synthesia.io every month, and it is one of the main ways we win new customers. That comes with real responsibility. The decisions you make are seen at scale, and we set the quality bar accordingly.

The defining challenge of this role is composability: a marketing site that marketers, and increasingly AI agents, can build pages with, without breaking design, performance or SEO.

What You'll Do

• Build, scale and evolve our section library: the Astro components, Sanity schemas and design tokens that let us compose marketing pages consistently and accessibly.
• Own the content model. Design schemas that resist misuse, so an editor, or an agent, can build a page that is correct by construction rather than correct by review.
• Take Figma component specs all the way to production: responsive across mobile, tablet and desktop, accessible by default, matching design intent precisely.
• Extend the platform for AI-assisted development, so coding agents can generate on-brand, on-spec sections from a design spec as reliably as a person can.
• Own SEO integrity as a first-class engineering concern: canonicals, sitemaps, structured data, redirects, and no traffic cliffs on launch.
• Raise the bar on engineering standards across the website surface: thorough code review, patterns others can follow, and tests around the parts that actually break.
• Maintain and extend localisation across nine locales and a translation pipeline, so the system works for a global audience.
• Shape the technical direction of the website platform over the next 6 to 12 months, and champion its adoption with the people who publish on it.

We’d love to hear from you if you have

• At least five (5+) years as a software engineer, including three (3) at senior level, building front end for content-driven or marketing platforms.
• Real ownership of a content model in Sanity. You've designed schemas other people had to live with, and you have opinions about references vs. embedded objects, when a variant belongs in the schema versus at runtime, and how to stop a section library sprawling. GROQ and Portable Text are familiar territory.
• Deep front-end expertise: expert HTML, CSS and TypeScript, with a strong command of component API design and the developer experience of a shared library.
• You can work end to end. Comfortable owning the server side as well as the front end: SSR, serverless and edge runtimes, API routes, a SQL database, secrets and CI. You should be able to take a feature from schema to component to the route that serves it without handing off, and be happy debugging something that only reproduces in production.
• Solid understanding of responsive design, cross-browser compatibility and web performance, and comfortable building to WCAG 2.2 AA. Accessibility is part of your definition of done, not a separate pass.
• You care that marketing sites are measured, on performance, SEO, analytics events and conversion, and you're happy being accountable to those numbers.
• A strong sense of craft and attention to detail, and the judgement to balance design intent against engineering constraints.
• Strong communication and collaboration skills. You explain your reasoning, review generously, and treat levelling up the people around you as part of the job.

We’d be particularly excited if

• Prior experience working on a large SaaS marketing website, at real traffic and with real stakes attached.
• Astro, or another islands or static-site framework.
• Cloudflare Workers, or another edge or serverless platform.
• Experience with AWS Lambda.
• Tailwind CSS v4, and experience working from a token-based design system.
• Experience, or strong interest, in making component libraries and content models consumable by AI agents.
• A strong design sensibility: an eye for visual detail and the judgement to push back on and improve design decisions, not just build them.
• Experience with localisation and internationalisation at scale for a global audience.
• Analytics and tag management implementation: dataLayer events, server-side tagging, getting attribution right without hurting performance.

Location
Our preference is for this role to be based hybrid out of our London, UK office. We can also accommodate remote workers elsewhere in Europe subject to compliance and right to work checks.

group: wayve|engineering manager - compute and data platform (ai platform)
title: Engineering Manager - Compute and Data Platform (AI Platform)
description:
Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.

We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.

Here’s what this particular role covers.

🛠️ About our Engineering Teams

Behind Wayve’s embodied AI is the compute and data infrastructure that enables our ML engineers and researchers to train and run increasingly capable models. Our Compute Foundations team builds and operates the large-scale cloud infrastructure that makes this possible, spanning GPU compute, storage, workload scheduling and the platforms that support training and inference.

You’ll lead this London-based team through its next phase of growth, helping build and maintain a reliable, high-performance, multi-cloud and multi-region platform. The challenges go beyond provisioning resources: they include scheduling workloads across different GPU architectures, keeping valuable compute available, and moving data efficiently while managing costs.

You’ll lead a team working with state-of-the-art tooling to tackle infrastructure challenges found only at the world’s leading AI companies, building the platform that enables Wayve to develop its AI Driver.

🧠 Your day-to-day

People leadership will be your first priority. You’ll coach and develop engineers, set clear expectations, manage performance. You’ll build technical leadership within the team, giving engineers the support and ownership they need to grow. You will guide the growth of the team through hiring and onboarding.

Alongside this, you will own project prioritisation and roadmap planning, aligning priorities and delivery plans with stakeholders across Wayve. Your goal is to maximise the impact of the team in alignment with the department and company objectives. You will provide visibility into the state of systems you own through clear KPIs and dashboards.

Leading a highly technical team, you’ll bring the technical judgement to guide complex infrastructure decisions and turn competing needs into a clear roadmap. Working with technical leads, partner teams and cloud providers, you’ll balance reliability, performance, capacity and cost, and help the team deliver sustainably.

🧩 What you’ll be working on

• Leading and developing the team: Coach engineers through regular feedback and one-to-ones, manage performance, support career development and build a healthy, performant and accountable team.
• Hiring and building technical leadership: Lead hiring and onboarding as the team expands, and develop technical leads who can take ownership of key areas of the platform.
• Driving the roadmap and delivery: Translate training and inference needs into priorities, align commitments with available resources, and surface risks and dependencies early.
• Scaling cloud compute: Guide the evolution and operation of a multi-cloud, multi-region training and inference platform, including the adoption of new compute architectures (Nvidia Hopper, Blackwell; Qualcomm).
• Improving scheduling and availability: Oversee Kubernetes-based infrastructure and queuing and scheduling systems, enabling workloads to use the right resources across heterogeneous GPU environments.
• Planning capacity and cost: Partner with stakeholders and cloud providers on compute and storage forecasts, accounting for resource lead times, performance requirements and cost trade-offs.
• Ensuring efficient storage across clouds: Guide distributed storage and caching approaches that improve data access and reduce unnecessary duplication and cross-cloud transfer costs.

🙌 You should apply if

• You have a strong track record of managing and developing an infrastructure, platform or distributed systems engineering team, including hiring, coaching, performance management and career development.
• You have delivered through others, owning team priorities and balancing delivery with operational reliability and longer-term platform improvements.
• You have substantial experience in Kubernetes and workload queuing and scheduling systems, such as Kueue or equivalent technologies.
• You can reason about availability, capacity, performance and cost across complex cloud infrastructure, including the interaction between compute, storage and data movement.
• You understand large-scale GPU compute infrastructure for machine learning training or inference and the operational challenges of scaling beyond small GPU deployments.
• You can earn engineers’ trust through sound technical judgement without needing to be the team’s primary individual contributor. You have successfully delivered as an individual contributor in the past.
• You communicate clearly with technical teams, stakeholders and external providers, and can turn ambiguous requirements into practical priorities.
• You are able to work from our London office and lead a team based there.

The following experience would be useful but is not required:

• Operating multi-cloud or multi-region platforms for large-scale AI workloads.
• Introducing new GPU architectures or managing heterogeneous GPU fleets.
• Distributed storage, caching and data-locality strategies for data-intensive workloads.
• Capacity forecasting, cloud cost modelling and close collaboration with cloud infrastructure providers.

🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement.

More about Wayve:

🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once in a generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human driven vehicles to intelligent machines.

Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve’s mapless and hardware agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution and unlocking advanced levels of automation from L2 plus through to L4 as our core AI model scales. In a race increasingly defined by intelligence and real world learning, Wayve is taking a distinct approach, building a generalisable driving intelligence that can power any vehicle, anywhere. By combining embodied AI with scalable deployment, we are creating technology that can be shaped to each OEM brand and driver experience, accelerating the transition to a safer, more intelligent future of mobility.

How we work 💻- Locations & Flexible Working:

Our main hubs are in London, Sunnyvale, Yokohama, Herzliya, Vancouver and Leonberg. We operate a hybrid working model that combines in-person collaboration in our dedicated office spaces with focused time working remotely. This gives our teams the connection and energy of working together, alongside the flexibility to do their best work in a way that fits their lives.

🔍 The Interview Process:

Our process is clear and respectful of your time:

• Initial call / recruiter screen (30 mins)
• Competency Interviews: system design and hiring manager interview
• Deep-dive technical interviews: technical leadership, code review and people management
• Final interview: leadership, mission & values alignment

We’ll always explain the format and work around your availability.

What’s in it for you (Location dependant):

💰 Salaries benchmarked against the market annually
📈 Meaningful equity, sharing in the ownership and long term success of Wayve
✈️ Relocation support and visa sponsorship where applicable
✅ Hybrid working, core hours and the chance to work hands on in vehicle workshops and labs
📚 Learning and development budgets with support for training, conferences and growth
🩺 Comprehensive benefits including health insurance, dental, enhanced maternity and paternity leave, retirement or pension where applicable, access to therapists, wellbeing partnerships, team socials and more

A quick, honest note before you apply.

Wayve is not a mature, fully-structured place with the playbook already written. Much of how we work is still being written, and if you join, you’ll help write it. That suits people who want real ownership more than people who need a settled structure from day one.

If that sounds like the kind of problem you want to spend your time on, we’d really like to hear from you.

At Wayve we're committed to creating a diverse, fair and respectful culture that is inclusive of everyone based on their unique skills and perspectives, and regardless of sex, race, religion or belief, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, citizenship, marital, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding) or any other basis as protected by applicable law.

For more information visit Careers at Wayve. To learn more about what drives us, visit Values at Wayve

DISCLAIMER: We will not ask about marriage or pregnancy, care responsibilities or disabilities in any of our job adverts or interviews. However, we do look to capture information about care responsibilities, and disabilities among other diversity information as part of an optional DEI Monitoring form to help us identify areas of improvement in our hiring process and ensure that the process is inclusive and non-discriminatory.

title: Data Engineer (Azure Databricks)
description:
Andersen is hiring a Data Engineer (Azure Databricks) in the EU for a project enhancing a cloud-based data platform and delivering scalable data solutions for drug development.

The customer is an international company operating in the life sciences sector. It focuses on developing and commercializing specialized products and solutions, supported by research, technology, and partnerships across multiple markets.

The project is focused on developing and enhancing data products for scientific and business stakeholders within the drug development domain. It aims to strengthen the cloud-based data platform and delivery capabilities, enabling scalable data processing, reliable analytics, and effective use of data across the organization.

Responsibilities:

- Building and maintaining multi-layer pipelines (Landing → Raw → Enriched → Curated) on Azure Databricks (Spark, Delta Lake),

- Orchestrating pipelines via Databricks Jobs / Workflows: dependencies, retries, alerting.

- Implementing batch and API-based data ingestion from multiple source systems.

- Applying schema enforcement and handle schema drift; run data quality checks at ingestion.

- Working hands-on with dbt for pipeline observability and data governance tasks.

- Monitoring job failures, data freshness, and pipeline health against SLA-based delivery targets.

- Setting up alerts, logging, and retry strategies for production pipelines.

- Working within a controlled Dev/Test/Prod environment: access control, audit trails, pipeline documentation, traceability to requirements.

- Contributing to CI/CD and MLOps/AI pipelines on Databricks where the project needs it.

Requirements:
- Commercial experience in Data Engineering for 4+ years.

- Strong hands-on experience with Azure Databricks, including Spark and Delta Lake.

- Experience building and maintaining multi-layer data pipelines following the Landing → Raw → Enriched → Curated architecture.

- Experience with schema enforcement and schema-drift handling.

- Ability to implement data quality checks at ingestion.

- Experience orchestrating pipelines using Databricks Jobs / Workflows, including dependencies, retries, alerts, and failure handling.

- Experience with both batch and API-based data ingestion.

- Strong hands-on experience with dbt.

- Ability to monitor job failures, data freshness, and overall pipeline health.

- Experience delivering data in line with defined SLAs.

- Experience implementing alerting, logging, and retry strategies.

- Experience designing and maintaining access control models.

- Understanding of audit trails, data lineage, and end-to-end traceability.

- Experience with logging and evidence generation for audit and compliance purposes.

- Understanding of segregation of duties.

- Experience defining and maintaining data contracts.

- Ability to create and maintain clear pipeline documentation.

- Experience working across controlled Dev, Test, and Prod environments.

- Ability to ensure traceability between requirements and implemented data solutions.

- Level of English – from Upper-Intermediate and above.

Nice to haves:

- Experience with Databricks.

- Experience with SAP S/4HANA; Microsoft 365; Azure; SharePoint; Enterprise integrations.

- Experience with CI/CD and DevOps practices for data, including Git-based development and branching strategies.

- Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines for data workflows.

- Experience promoting code and data solutions across Dev, Test, and Prod environments.

- Ability to integrate automated testing into deployment pipelines.

- Experience with MLOps and AI pipelines on Databricks.

- Exposure to regulated domains such as GxP, clinical trials, and pharmacovigilance.

- Strong SQL engineering skills, including the development of modular and reusable dbt models, tests, and documentation at Analytics Engineer depth.

- Experience with dimensional data modeling, including star schemas, One Big Table (OBT) approaches, and curated data marts.

- Familiarity with Tabular Editor and metadata-as-code concepts.

- Experience with Power BI dataset design, performance optimization, and maintaining KPI and semantic consistency.

- Experience in the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry.

Reasons why this job would be interesting to you:

- Experience in teamwork with leaders in FinTech, Healthcare, Retail, Telecom, and others. Andersen cooperates with such businesses as Samsung, Siemens, Johnson & Johnson, BNP Paribas, Ryanair, Mercedes, TUI, Verivox, Allianz, T-Systems, etc..

- The opportunity to change the project and/or develop expertise in an interesting business domain.

- Job conditions – you can work both fully remotely and from the office or can choose a hybrid variant.

- Guarantee of professional, financial, and career growth! The company has introduced systems of mentoring and adaptation for each new employee.

- The opportunity to earn up to an additional 1,000 EUR per month, depending on the level of expertise, which will be included in the annual bonus, by participating in the company's activities.

- Access to the corporate training portal, where the entire knowledge base of the company is collected and which is constantly updated.

- Bright corporate life (parties / pizza days / PlayStation / fruits / coffee / snacks / movies).

- Certification compensation (AWS, PMP, etc).

- Referral program.

- Private health insurance and sports compensation, depending on the type of employment.

Your personal data is protected in accordance with GDPR regulations. Learn more: https://andersenlab.com/privacy-policy/pl

title: Senior Delivery Manager - Insurance
description:
Join our team as a Senior Delivery Manager and take end-to-end ownership of client engagements, from opportunity qualification through successful delivery and value realization. Acting as the primary link and orchestration point between Sales, Client Partners, Delivery, Solutions, and client leadership, you will ensure commercial commitments are transformed into high-quality execution, long-term partnerships, and sustainable account growth. This role is ideal for a senior delivery leader who can combine commercial ownership, executive client engagement, hands-on delivery governance, and technology fluency with in-depth knowledge of the insurance industry.

We are particularly seeking candidates experienced in the insurance domain, who understand the business, regulatory, and technical landscape of this sector and can apply that expertise from day one.

The position offers the opportunity to shape large-scale engagements, influence account growth, and drive AI-enabled delivery improvements across complex client environments.

Responsibilities

• Own the engagement lifecycle end-to-end — from opportunity qualification through delivery execution and stabilization — with full ownership of outcomes and P&L (revenue and profitability)
• Build trusted relationships with C-level executives (e.g., CTO, CIO), VPs or senior client stakeholders; lead governance, expectation management, and escalations
• Lead presales engagements and own RFP/RFI responses, partnering with Sales and Solution Architects to shape the engagement model, delivery approach, and feasibility
• Lead the deal-to-delivery transition, ensuring SOWs, commercial agreements and delivery plans are aligned and executable
• Manage and grow a team of Delivery/Program Managers and Tech Leads — scaling from leading a single delivery team to overseeing a group of managers
• Establish data-driven delivery governance (KPIs, reporting, escalation paths), mitigate risk and manage scope and commercial evolution
• Drive AI adoption across delivery teams to improve SDLC efficiency and translate AI-driven gains into competitive RFP and proposal narratives
• Oversee architecture governance, ensuring proposed solutions are reviewed, aligned with client requirements and constraints, and meet established quality standards

Requirements

• Minimum 8 years in IT services, consulting, or digital delivery, with a hands-on technology background (software engineering, solution architecture, or technology consulting) and visible technical focus in your management track record; technical certifications are a plus
• Practical, hands-on experience with AI in delivery — delivering AI-based solutions or driving AI adoption across the SDLC — with a native-AI mindset that strengthens RFP and proposal competitiveness
• Full ownership — not coordination — of mid- or large-scale engagements delivery, typically 40–50+ FTE and $5M+ in contract value, including full P&L accountability; experience scaling from leading one delivery team to managing a group of managers
• Proven leadership — not support — in client engagement, delivery management and pre-sales — including direct ownership of RFP/RFI responses and proposal development — across complex, multi-stream delivery
• Full ownership of MSAs, SOWs, commercial models, and delivery approaches, including scope, margin, and change management; experience with fixed-price or outcome-based models is very much desirable
• Direct, regular engagement with C-level/VP (or senior B-track) client stakeholders; strong commercial negotiation, CSAT ownership, and an account-growth mindset. From first handshake with the client to scaled delivery
• Engagement governance, delivery orchestration and structured escalation management, with systems thinking that connects sales, delivery, and operations
• Working knowledge of solution architecture fundamentals and software engineering best practices (code quality, CI/CD, testing, tooling, architecture governance)
• Basic awareness of security and compliance standards relevant to IT delivery (data privacy, ISO/ITIL-aligned practices)
• Experience delivering solutions in the insurance sector (policy lifecycle, claims, underwriting, or distribution), with familiarity with relevant regulatory frameworks (e.g., Solvency II, GDPR, local insurance authority requirements) and exposure to legacy core systems and data models
• Excellent written and spoken English (B2+ as minimum, preferably C1+)

We offer

• We gather like-minded people:
• Top tech minds driving innovation in AI, cloud and digital platform modernization
• Supportive team and agile, startup-like culture
• Hybrid by design mode and opportunity to work remotely within Poland
• Chance to work abroad for up to 60 days annually
• Business-driven relocation opportunities
• We provide growth opportunities:
• Career development programs
• Thought leadership, mentoring, soft skills and well-being programs
• Certification (Anthropic, Gemini, GCP, Azure, AWS)

• We cover it all:
• Stable pay
• Participation in the Employee Stock Purchase Plan with a 15% discount
• Benefits package (health insurance, multisport, shopping vouchers)

• Offices featuring entertainment and relaxation zones, table tennis and football, free snacks, coffee and more
