title: Revenue Accounting Manager
description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

We are hiring a Revenue Accounting Manager, ideally a candidate with a passion for systems accounting, to drive revenue recognition process, decisions, systems and reporting.

In our finance function we aspire to set the industry pace for speed and accuracy of reporting. We aim to achieve this by driving our product pricing and terms, contracting, sales processes and systems into alignment.

We are looking for a professionally qualified accounting leader with expertise in IFRS 15/ASC 606 to build scalable contract review and revenue recognition processes. This lead will work across teams including product management, legal, FP&A, sales operations and commercial business systems to align understanding and ensure that the accounting and revenue recognition treatment of contracts and products is straightforward and correct, with a very high level of automation. Perhaps unusually we prefer a leader with deep personal interest in the software and technology industry, and ideally some data analytics and software engineering experience. The Revenue Accounting Manager will ensure the proper application of revenue accounting guidance for public market scrutiny.

This is a management position which requires confidence in presentation, setting goals, and directing the work of others. We expect to grow a team focused on revenue, with a particular emphasis on systems and automation, that puts us at the top of the leaderboard for clarity, correctness, transparency and speed of reporting as a global tech company.

Location: This role is home-based in EMEA time zones, with the option to be based in our London office. It will report to our Global Financial Controller.

Key responsibilities

• Collaborate with Product Management, Sales Operations, Sales, Legal, and FP&A teams to design standard contracts
• Drive process and configuration improvements in NetSuite and related systems for end-to-end automation of the revenue life cycle
• Incorporate industry best practices and emerging technology to raise the bar for reporting speed and accuracy
• Review and evaluate the revenue recognition impact of non-standard contracts and new products
• Lead, mentor and develop a team of revenue accounting and systems accounting professionals
• Assist in month-end revenue close, including reconciliations, fluctuation analysis, and other reporting
• Develop and maintain effective internal controls over revenue transactions and reporting
• Research and write accounting memos on significant revenue recognition and other related policy matters
• Act as the primary liaison with external auditors in matters related to order-to-cash

Valued skills and experience

• An exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
• An undergraduate degree in Accounting or Finance, or a compelling narrative about your alternative chosen path
• CPA, CA or equivalent with excellent technical accounting skills and IFRS experience
• A detailed understanding of IFRS 15 and relevant rules related to SaaS and services
• Leadership or management responsibility
• A track record of going above-and-beyond expectations
• Experience of software licensing, subscription and services revenue accounting and operations
• Experience driving revenue recognition and scaling accounting processes in a high-growth environment
• Experience with ERP, Rev Rec, CRM, CPQ and other relevant software categories - NetSuite and Salesforce preferred

title: Senior Accountant
description:
At Koalafi, we believe in a world where no one has to put an important purchase on hold. That’s why we’re making it easier for more people to pay for big purchases over time.

Retailers across the country rely on us to offer flexible lease-to-own financing to their non-prime consumers, while increasing sales and strengthening customer loyalty. Their 2M+ customers love us because we provide a flexible way for them to make payments and give them an opportunity to improve their credit. Our 200+ Koalafi teammates enjoy inspiring and challenging work that accelerates their careers.

Interested in learning more about how we’re transforming the financing experience and joining our team?

About the opportunity

As Senior Accountant, you’ll play a key role in building the strong financial foundation that keeps Koalafi moving forward. You’ll take ownership of significant areas of the monthly close and help ensure the integrity of our general ledger, primarily in NetSuite. Through accurate reconciliations, thoughtful variance analysis, and day-to-day cash management, you’ll bring clarity to the numbers, improve how we work, and help our fast-growing business deliver for the people and merchants who rely on us.

What You’ll Do

Financial Reporting & Close Process

• Own assigned areas of the month-end close, including the accuracy, completeness, and timeliness of the underlying financial records
• Perform journal entries, account reconciliations, and supporting schedules
• Prepare internal and external financial statements and supporting schedules
• Analyze monthly variance and flux analysis for assigned P&L and balance sheet accounts, including written explanations of the underlying drivers
• Ensure proper application of U.S. GAAP across all assigned accounting treatments

Reconciliations & General Ledger

• Own balance sheet and income statement account reconciliations
• Investigate and resolve reconciling items and discrepancies in a timely manner
• Perform subledger-to-general-ledger tie-outs and resolve differences at the source

Treasury & Cash Management

• Support daily cash positioning and monthly bank reconciliations across all operating accounts
• Contribute to cash forecasting and monitor liquidity against operating needs
• Perform cash flow analysis and communicate findings to management
• Coordinate directly with banking partners on account activity, exceptions, and setup

Process Improvement & Systems

• Use AI tools to identify and build automations that reduce manual effort across recurring close, reconciliation, and reporting processes
• Identify and implement improvements to accounting processes, controls, and close-cycle efficiency
• Contribute to accounting system enhancements, implementations, and automation projects
• Develop and maintain documentation of accounting policies, procedures, and close checklists

Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Build and maintain strong working relationships with Operations, Legal, Product, and FP&A
• Partner with management to provide insights that support business decision-making
• Communicate accounting impacts clearly to non-accounting stakeholders
• Support interdepartmental initiatives and process improvements

Audit & Compliance

• Serve as a key point of contact for external auditors during financial statement audits
• Prepare audit schedules and respond to audit inquiries
• Correspond with multiple U.S. states regarding sales tax compliance, filings, audits, and inquiries

Additional Responsibilities

• Support ad hoc projects and analyses as assigned
• Stay current on accounting standards, regulatory requirements, and industry best practices

About You

• Bachelor's degree in Accounting or Finance
• 3–5 years of accounting experience, including at least 2 years in a corporate or in-house accounting role
• Demonstrated ownership of month-end close areas, including journal entries, account reconciliations, and close-cycle deadlines
• Hands-on general ledger experience in an ERP environment (NetSuite strongly preferred)
• Experience preparing account reconciliations and financial statements, and explaining variances to management
• Strong knowledge of U.S. GAAP
• Advanced proficiency in Excel (pivot tables, lookups, large data sets)
• Proven ability to manage multiple projects and competing priorities against a fixed close calendar
• Attention to detail in a high level of accuracy
• Ability to work independently and as part of a collaborative team
• Strong written and verbal communication skills
• Adaptability and comfort working in a dynamic, high-growth environment

Preferred

• CPA license (active or in progress)
• Demonstrated experience working with AI tools in a professional setting.
• Experience supporting or performing financial statement audits
• Familiarity with financial services, consumer finance, leasing, or lease-to-own industries
• Sales tax compliance experience across multiple states
• Experience with close management or reconciliation software

Location: Richmond, VA; Arlington, VA; or Remote (U.S.). Associates near one of our office locations may work in-office, hybrid, or remotely. Remote opportunities are available to candidates throughout the United States.

NOTE: We generally work East Coast hours but offer some flexibility

Salary Range: $84,000 - $109,000 per year (depending on experience and location)
Additional Compensation: This position will be eligible to participate in company bonus plan.

Applications will be accepted until position is filled.

Why choose Koalafi: A career at Koalafi means opportunities to tackle exciting challenges every single day. We take pride in a culture of innovation, trust, and ownership. You'll get outside your comfort zone, build meaningful relationships, and most of all, take charge of projects that ultimately help people get the things they need most.

Benefits:

At Koalafi, you will have a direct impact on our products and help shape the company’s success. We offer competitive compensation & benefits packages to keep you at your best:

title: Director of Engineering, Database Excellence
description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

As Director of Engineering, Database Excellence, you will lead the Database Excellence stage and report to the Vice President of Data Engineering, in our Engineering department. You will set the direction for the databases that support GitLab.com, self-managed GitLab, and GitLab Dedicated. Your organization owns the reliability, capacity, health, and sustainability of GitLab's application datastores, with PostgreSQL as the primary focus alongside Redis, OpenSearch, ClickHouse, and object storage.

You will be accountable for database capacity and availability on GitLab.com. You will guide long-range platform decisions while partnering with Infrastructure, Product, Distribution, Support, Security, and FinOps. The work includes reducing infrastructure costs, improving data growth controls and saturation detection, standardizing database services, rebuilding the self-managed upgrade experience, and contributing to GitLab's company-wide datastore strategy, including Cells partitioning. Learn more in the Database Excellence handbook.

What you’ll do

• Set direction and long-range plans for the database platform in line with company strategy.
• Own database capacity and availability outcomes for GitLab.com, and communicate database risk to senior leadership.
• Lead and coach three Engineering Managers and develop Staff-plus engineers into leaders.
• Drive cross-division technical decisions using data, partnering with Infrastructure, Product, Distribution, Support, Security, and FinOps.
• Partner with Product to prioritize database platform investments and make infrastructure tradeoffs in the context of product outcomes.
• Own the hiring plan, organization design, retention, and performance management for teams across regions.
• Set quarterly objectives and key results and engineering key performance indicators for the stage, and manage the database infrastructure budget with FinOps.
• Serve as an escalation point for database incidents, standardize effective processes, and keep the handbook current.
• Take part in on-call or operational support where your team’s ownership model requires it.

What you’ll bring

• Experience leading managers of managers, including coaching newer managers.
• Experience working hands-on with PostgreSQL at scale, including capacity planning, upgrades, replication, performance, and large production clusters.
• Experience using data to make strategic technical decisions and connect database platform investments and tradeoffs with product outcomes.
• Experience supporting software that customers run themselves, or working through the self-managed upgrade challenge.
• Experience leading backend engineering teams that own production infrastructure, applying site reliability engineering practices including service level objectives, on-call operations, incident management, cost management, and automation.
• Experience communicating clearly in writing in an asynchronous, handbook-first company.
• Experience leading globally distributed remote teams.
• Experience with Redis, ClickHouse, OpenSearch, object storage, Google Cloud Platform, Kubernetes, Terraform, Chef, managed database services, FinOps, AI-assisted engineering workflows, or platform and infrastructure organizations is a plus.

About the team

Database Excellence includes Database Architecture, Database Automation, and Self Managed Database. Three Engineering Managers lead these teams, alongside an Operations Manager. Our teams work across the United States, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and India. Database Architecture provides datastore guidance, data growth controls, and the database review process. Database Automation builds PostgreSQL fleet automation, upgrades, provisioning, health monitoring, and an internal managed PostgreSQL offering. Self Managed Database is rebuilding the upgrade and migration experience for self-managed GitLab. Together, we make database services more reliable, sustainable, and easier to operate across GitLab's deployment models.

The base salary range for this role’s listed level is currently for residents of the United States only. This range is intended to reflect the role's base salary rate in locations throughout the US. Grade level and salary ranges are determined through interviews and a review of education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities of the applicant, equity with other team members, alignment with market data, and geographic location. The base salary range does not include any bonuses, equity, or benefits. See more information on our benefits and equity. Sales roles are also eligible for incentive pay targeted at up to 100% of the offered base salary.

United States Salary Range

$230,400—$345,600 USD

How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees

• Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being
• Flexible Paid Time Off
• Team Member Resource Groups
• Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan
• Growth and Development Fund
• Parental Leave

Additionally, studies have shown that people from underrepresented groups are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.

Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.

Privacy Policy: Please review our Recruitment Privacy Policy. Your privacy is important to us.

GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. GitLab’s policies and practices relating to recruitment, employment, career development and advancement, promotion, and retirement are based solely on merit, regardless of race, color, religion, ancestry, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, age, citizenship, marital status, mental or physical disability, genetic information (including family medical history), discharge status from the military, protected veteran status (which includes disabled veterans, recently separated veterans, active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans, and Armed Forces service medal veterans), or any other basis protected by law. GitLab will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. See also GitLab’s EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. title: Staff Engineer - Telematics
description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role
At Samsara, we're looking for a hands-on Staff Software Engineer to help turn growing Telematics products into major businesses. Our new product bets include routing and workforce management for physical operations.
The portfolio has paying customers and early traction. You'll help shape what comes next, working directly with customers to understand their operations, test ideas and build solutions they choose to use. You'll stay close to the work through production, customer adoption and scale.
This is a technical leadership role with substantial hands-on engineering. You'll define important problems and make product and technical decisions alongside Product, Design and Engineering partners. You'll bring the judgement to move forward when requirements are incomplete, and the influence to align other teams around a clear direction.

What you will do

• Work directly with customers and customer-facing teams to understand unmet needs, test assumptions and identify opportunities worth pursuing. Agree on success measures with Product and Design before investing in a solution.
• Lead ambiguous initiatives end to end, from discovery and prototypes through production rollout, adoption and iteration. Use customer feedback and product data to decide what to improve, expand or stop.
• Write and ship code on the critical path. Work across services, APIs and customer-facing experiences as the problem requires, combining technical depth with the ability to learn unfamiliar parts of the product.
• Set technical direction for your area and align the teams needed to deliver it. Make pragmatic architecture choices that support rapid learning today and reliable growth over time.
• Own the production quality of what you build. Design for correctness, reliability and performance, plan safe rollouts, and use operational evidence to address the constraints that emerge as usage grows.
• Increase the effectiveness of the engineers around you through design and code reviews, mentoring senior engineers, and removing recurring obstacles to delivery. Share context and decisions so others can move independently.

About the role:

In this role, you will:

• Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices
• Hire, develop and lead an inclusive, engaged, and high performing team

What you will bring

• A track record of shipping customer-facing products and growing them beyond their initial launch. You can explain your contribution to measurable outcomes such as adoption, revenue growth, retention, customer efficiency or cost to serve.
• Strong product judgement. You have worked directly with customers, clarified poorly defined problems and made decisions using evidence, including changing direction when an initial idea did not work.
• Deep hands-on software engineering ability, with recent experience designing, implementing and operating production systems. You can move from a prototype to maintainable software and explain the trade-offs along the way.
• Experience scaling products and the systems behind them. You know how to identify the next constraint, balance speed with reliability, and make technical investments that support customer and business growth.
• Technical leadership across team boundaries. You have built alignment without formal authority, made other engineers more effective, and communicated difficult choices clearly to technical and business partners.

Experience that could be useful
Experience building B2B software through an early growth stage, or working on routing, workforce management or other software for physical operations. We value evidence of learning a complex customer domain and delivering results; previous industry experience is helpful, rather than essential.

What success looks like
Customers adopt the capabilities you help build and can see the benefit in their day-to-day operations. The products remain dependable as usage grows. Your technical decisions support measurable business progress, and the teams around you can deliver more effectively because of your work.

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email accessibleinterviewing@samsara.com or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

group: ge vernova|global circularity & resilience program manager
title: Global Circularity & Resilience Program Manager
description:
Job Description Summary
The Global Circularity & Resilience Program Manager is responsible for leading GE Vernova's enterprise-wide circularity strategy and 4R Circularity Program (Rethink, Reduce, Reuse, Recycle). This role will drive development, deployment, governance, and continuous improvement of circular economy initiatives across GE Vernova's businesses, functions, and global operations. The Global Circularity & Resilience Program Manager will serve as the company's subject matter expert for circular economy, critical materials, material resilience, and resource stewardship. The role will partner closely with Engineering, Product Management, Services, Supply Chain, Sustainability, and Business leadership teams to embed circularity and resilience principles into products, services, operations, and value chains.
This position will report into the Environmental Sustainability Operations Leader on the Corporate Sustainability team and support both corporate and segment sustainability priorities. The role will help accelerate circular innovation, sustainable materials adoption, product life extension strategies, critical materials recovery, supply chain resilience, and resource efficiency while creating measurable environmental and business value.

Job Description

Essential Responsibilities

• Lead the enterprise 4R Circularity Program and maintain a multi-year roadmap aligned with GE Vernova sustainability priorities and goals.
• Define circularity standards, methodologies, governance processes, and guidance for use across businesses.
• Partner with R&D, Engineering, Technology, Product Management, and Services teams to integrate circularity into New Products and Technology Introductions, product stewardship, and lifecycle management processes.
• Advance Design for Circularity priorities including durability, repairability, refurbishment, remanufacturing, reuse, recycling, and material recovery.
• Lead circular materials strategies with Sourcing and Supplier teams to accelerate recycled, renewable, and low-carbon materials adoption, material recovery, and reduced reliance on virgin materials.
• Lead resource resilience strategies to identify and mitigate risks related to critical materials, resource scarcity, supply disruptions, and geopolitical dependencies.
• Support enterprise strategies to improve long-term material availability, resource security, supply chain resilience, and critical materials recovery through circular economy approaches.
• Develop enterprise circularity KPIs, dashboards, and reporting mechanisms to track progress, support leadership reviews and MORs, and drive continuous improvement through Kaizen events.
• Support sustainability disclosures, customer requests, and regulatory requirements related to circular economy, resource use, products, and materials.
• Work closely with Digital Technology and data teams to improve circularity data quality, automation, and reporting capability.
• Facilitate communities of practice and support segment teams in identifying circularity opportunities, barriers, corrective actions, and priorities.
• Monitor circular economy regulations, customer expectations, industry trends, and external best practices.
• Represent GE Vernova in industry associations, partnerships, customer engagements, and forums.
• Identify business value opportunities through circular business models, lifecycle services, resource efficiency, and sustainable materials innovation.

Qualifications/Requirements

• Bachelor's degree in engineering, environmental science, sustainability, materials science, sourcing, business, or a related field.
• Minimum 10-years experience in sustainability, circular economy, product stewardship, Eco-design or related disciplines.
• Experience leading global, cross-functional programs in an industrial, manufacturing, energy, or technology organization.
• Strong understanding of circular economy principles, critical material flows, product lifecycle management, and sustainable product design.
• Demonstrated ability to influence stakeholders and drive change in a global matrix organization.
• Experience managing program governance, metrics, reporting, and updates.
• Understanding of resource security, material risk management, critical mineral dependencies, and resilience strategies.
• Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English.
• Team player who works effectively with others to achieve identified business outcomes.

Desired Characteristics

• Master's degree in sustainability, engineering, circular economy, environmental management, or business administration.
• Experience with Life Cycle Assessment (LCA), Product Carbon Footprint (PCF), Environmental Product Declarations (EPDs), Product Stewardship, or Design for Environment programs.
• Knowledge of ESG reporting frameworks, ESPR, CSRD, EU Taxonomy, and circular economy regulations.
• Experience with sustainable materials, recycling, life extension, refurbishment, remanufacturing, or circular services.
• Familiarity with Lean principles and continuous improvement methodologies, including Kaizen, value stream mapping, structured problem-solving, and standard work.
• Self-starter with strong execution mindset and ability to operate in a dynamic global environment.
• Strong interpersonal, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
• Ability to set and manage multiple

Additional Information

GE Vernova offers a great work environment, professional development, challenging careers, and competitive compensation. GE Vernova is an Equal Opportunity Employer. group: zillow|regional designated broker - southwest territory lead
title: Regional Designated Broker - Southwest Territory Lead
description:
About the team

Zillow is seeking a Regional Designated Broker - Southwest Territory Lead (AZ, UT, CO, NM, KS, NE, SD) to oversee brokerage operations across a defined multi-state region aligned to high-volume MLS markets.

This full-time role combines regulatory authority, operational execution, and strategic relationship management. The Territory Lead serves as both the designated broker of record and a key Zillow representative within MLSs, associations, and influential brokerages.

This role operates in close partnership with other Industry Affairs teams including Strategic Operations, Industry Operations, and Brokerage Operations to ensure alignment, speed, and execution quality across markets.

About the role

Territory Ownership & Accountability

• Serve as the designated broker of record for assigned states within a defined territory.
• Own operational performance, compliance integrity, and execution quality across the region.
• Establish clear accountability for brokerage processes and execution standards.
• Monitor territory-level workload, regulatory complexity, MLS dynamics, and broker sentiment.
• Escalate emerging risks, regulatory changes, or market shifts to leadership in a timely manner.

MLS, Association & Brokerage Relationship Management

• Foster strong, trusted relationships with MLS executives, association leaders, and state regulators.
• Build and maintain professional relationships with influential brokerages within the assigned territory.
• Represent Zillow in MLS, Association, State Commission, and industry meetings (virtual and in-person).
• Seek committee participation and leadership opportunities when aligned with company strategy.
• Serve as a visible, credible Zillow representative in local markets.
• Provide territory-level intelligence regarding MLS sentiment, regulatory trends, and brokerage dynamics.
• Build, maintain, and support relationships within the local industry.
• Maintain active MLS and association memberships to ensure continuity of data and access across required states.

Cross-Functional Industry Affairs Partnership

• Work alongside Strategic Operations, Industry Operations, and Brokerage Operations to ensure alignment on market initiatives.
• Support territory-level execution of broader Industry Affairs strategies and initiatives.
• Partner on rollout of policy updates, regulatory responses, MLS engagement efforts, and operational changes.
• Participate in structured operating rhythms including check-ins, reviews, and reporting routines.
• Regularly review and report on local MLS news, updates, and sentiment to Industry Affairs leadership.
• Address customer care complaints and provide resolution assistance, routing inquiries appropriately.

Compliance & Licensing Oversight

• Ensure full compliance with state licensing laws, MLS rules, association bylaws, and brokerage operations manuals.
• Advise licensees and internal stakeholders of regulatory or MLS rule changes within 24 hours of notification.
• Partner with Licensing for the seamless transition and maintenance of brokerage-level licenses.
• Review and monitor reports of licensees under supervision, flagging anomalies to the Licensing team as necessary.
• Perform contract reviews to ensure legal and transactional compliance (as needed).
• Act as signing authority for brokerage filings and MLS documentation, as required.
• Support the transaction team by tracking, recording, and reporting changes in co-listed properties within the territory.
• Keep current with required continuing education and maintain active state real estate licenses.

Operational Excellence & Scalability

• Execute standardized workflows and brokerage routines to improve speed, reliability, and consistency.
• Participate in cross-training and operational development initiatives to strengthen team resilience.
• Contribute insights to tooling, automation, and data improvements that reduce manual work.
• Support onboarding, paperwork transitions, and retraining efforts tied to territory realignment.
• Respond within one business day to requests from Licensing, MLS, Brokerage Operations, Industry Affairs, and other partners (internal and external).

This role has been categorized as a Remote position. "Remote" employees do not have a permanent corporate office workplace and, instead, work from a physical location of their choice, which must be identified to the Company. U.S. employees may live in any of the 50 United States, with limited exceptions.

In California, Connecticut, Maryland, Massachusetts, New Jersey, New York, Washington state, and Washington DC the standard base pay range for this role is $41.30 - $65.90 hourly. This base pay range is specific to these locations and may not be applicable to other locations.In Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maine, Minnesota, Nevada, Ohio, Rhode Island, Vermont, and Virginia the standard base pay range for this role is $39.20 - $62.60 hourly. The base pay range is specific to these locations and may not be applicable to other locations.

In addition to a competitive base salary this position is also eligible for equity awards based on factors such as experience, performance and location. Actual amounts will vary depending on experience, performance and location. Employees in this role will not be paid below the salary threshold for exempt employees in the state where they reside.

Who you are

• Active real estate broker license in at least one state within the assigned territory (required)
• Willingness to obtain and maintain broker-level licenses in additional states as needed
• Minimum 5+ years of brokerage leadership experience
• Active or former participation in REALTOR® associations or MLS governance
• Experience engaging with MLS boards, associations, and brokerage leadership
• Strong stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration skills
• Willingness to travel up to 40-50% within the assigned territory

The ideal candidate is a seasoned brokerage leader who:

About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Available Location: Bengaluru, India

What You Would Do Here:

Our focus is getting the best people to work at Cloudflare and then allowing them to do their best work. We are looking for a passionate and detail-oriented People Operations Specialist to join our team and champion this mission within the APJC region. In this vital role, you will be the first point of contact for our employees, ensuring their journey is smooth and positive. You will be instrumental in creating a seamless experience by resolving inquiries, managing data with precision, and ensuring our People processes are efficient and effective. This is an exciting opportunity to provide exceptional support to our internal teams and contribute to building a world-class employee experience as our organization expands.

Responsibilities

• Champion key employee lifecycle process: Take ownership of end-to-end employee lifecycle processes across APJC, including onboarding, internal transfers, organizational changes, and offboarding, ensuring a smooth, consistent, and positive experience for employees throughout the APJC region.
• Be a subject-matter expert for employee inquiries: Provide timely, high-quality support to employee inquiries through Zendesk. Act as a trusted liaison between employees and People/Payroll teams, resolving issues efficiently with empathy and accuracy.
• Elevate the employee experience through cross-functional collaboration: Act as a proactive liaison between employees and specialized teams such as Payroll, Benefits, and Legal to address and resolve complex issues efficiently and effectively.
• Ensure data integrity and governance: Maintain and update employee records across People/Payroll systems, performing regular and ad hoc audits to guarantee 100% data accuracy and compliance with regulatory requirements.
• Drive continuous improvement and operational excellence: Analyze employee feedback and process metrics to identify opportunities for process enhancements. Partner with regional teams to implement scalable solutions that improve the overall People Operations function across APJC.
• Support strategic HR initiatives and projects: Contribute to HR system implementations, vendor management, and regional programs such as annual performance and compensation cycles, benefits enrollment, and year-end Payroll preparation, making them easy to understand and navigate for our employees.

Skills/experience

• 5+ years in HR administration and comfortable handling sensitive employee information with discretion.
• Highly organized with strong attention to detail, excellent problem-solving abilities, and effective time management skills.
• Proficient in working with data and skilled in Excel or Google Sheets for analysis and reporting.
• Customer-focused mindset with a genuine passion for supporting colleagues and delivering exceptional service.
• Effective communicator, able to clearly articulate information both verbally and in writing to employees across the APJC region.
• Adaptable and thrives in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, with the ability to manage shifting priorities efficiently.
• Familiarity with Workday or Zendesk would be an advantage.

What Makes Cloudflare Special?

We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

Project Galileo: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.

Athenian Project: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.

1.1.1.1: We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.

Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!

Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.

All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment. About the job

Make global business travel simpler for colleagues, candidates and guests, balancing individual needs with company policy. As a Corporate Travel Coordinator in Bristol, you’ll provide hands-on support across Graphcore’s global travel operations.

You’ll help employees and guests arrange journeys through our online booking tool and offline travel agents. Well-organised travel for candidates and new joiners will help create a positive first impression of Graphcore. You’ll also coordinate group travel that brings colleagues together for company events. Day to day, you’ll answer visa questions, arrange airport transfers and manage travel expense approvals. You’ll support the Travel Manager with ad-hoc projects and initiatives.

Beyond travel, you’ll support the wider Chief Financial Officer’s team with administrative tasks. You’ll book training courses, support onboarding and help our Graphcare committee.

The team and culture

You’ll join a growing travel team, supporting colleagues through the shared Travel inbox and Slack. You’ll take ownership of requests, respond promptly and use calm judgement when priorities change.

You’ll stay informed about travel trends, policies and global mobility updates. Professional development and learning resources will help you build your skills.

What we’re looking for

• At least two years’ experience in a similar travel coordination support role in business travel and travel support.
• Calm judgement under pressure and the ability to adapt when travel plans or priorities change.
• Clear, empathetic and professional communication, with a focus on travellers’ needs.
• Strong organisation and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple priorities independently.
• Proficiency in Microsoft Office and a willingness to learn travel booking tools.
• A proactive approach to teamwork, with the confidence to make decisions and take responsibility.

title: Part Time Brand Ambassador
description:
About Lucid

At Lucid, we are creating exceptional mobility experiences through innovation to drive the world forward. Built on Lucid’s proprietary technology and software-defined vehicle architecture, our award-winning vehicles bring our “Compromise Nothing™” approach to the global automotive market. That means refusing to choose between performance and sustainability, design and engineering, ambition and integrity. In Lucid Air and Lucid Gravity, we have designed and built vehicles that have redefined their segments, combining exceptional range, performance, design, and expansive space in a single experience.

We achieve this through deep vertical integration, with design, engineering, and production happening in-house across our global offices and manufacturing facilities. Our teams come from industries around the world, united by a shared commitment to excellence. By refusing to settle, you can help redefine what’s possible and shape the future of mobility.

As a Part-Time Brand Ambassador in a Lucid Studio, your primary focus will be creating exceptional first impressions and delivering a welcoming, elevated experience for every guest who visits Lucid. As one of the first points of contact for our brand, you'll help spark curiosity, build meaningful connections, and introduce customers to the future of electric mobility. If you're passionate about delivering outstanding customer experiences and enjoy representing an innovative luxury brand, you'll excel as a Lucid Brand Ambassador.

The Opportunity

Brand Ambassadors are the first point of engagement for guests visiting a Lucid Studio. They play a critical role in delivering an elevated customer experience, creating brand connection, and supporting daily studio operations.

This is a part-time role that requires flexibility, including the ability to work evenings and weekends. Part Time Brand Ambassador can expect to work between 20-25 hours per week.

What You’ll Do

• Welcome guests, answer general inquiries, and schedule test drives

• Capture high quality customer leads and interactions in CRM (Salesforce)

• Conduct customer needs assessments (budget, preferences, timing)

• Recommend suitable vehicles based on customer needs

• Refer high potential leads to Sales Specialists

• Ensure guests are directed to the appropriate next step in their journey

• Build deep knowledge of the Lucid brand, vehicles, and services

• Explain vehicle features, specifications, and pricing to stimulate consideration

• Provide backend operational support (order paperwork, order/vehicle status clarity)

• Support studio operations, including opening/closing checklists

• Ensure test drive and showcase vehicles are clean, charged, and ready

• Assist with facility needs (refreshments, maintenance requests)

• Support day to day studio operations as needed

What You Bring

• Exceptional interpersonal and communication skills

• A passion for delivering outstanding customer experiences

• Experience in a customer facing environment (retail, hospitality, food service, etc.)

• Patience, professionalism, and adaptability in a dynamic retail setting

• Interest in electric vehicles and enthusiasm for building the Lucid brand

Qualifications

• Flexible availability including extended holiday mall hours, holidays and weekends

• 18 years old minimum

• High School diploma/GED required

• Prior experience with CRM tool such as Salesforce highly preferred

• Authorized to work in the USA (visas sponsorship not available)

• Physical requirements include the ability to twist, bend, squat, reach, and stand for extended periods of time with or without reasonable accommodation.

• Where permitted by law, successful completion of a drug test and background check including, but not limited to, criminal records are a condition of employment for Lucid sales centers

• Valid driver’s license with no suspensions within the past year. Drivers under 21 must have maintained a Driver’s License for a minimum of 3 years and successfully complete Lucid Training upon hire
• Ability to obtain appropriate state DMV licensing, where applicable

Compensation Range: The compensation range for this position is specific to the locations listed below and is the range Lucid reasonably and in good faith expects to pay for the position taking into account the wide variety of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions, including job-related knowledge; skillset; experience, education and training; certifications; and other relevant business and organizational factors.

Hourly rate: $25 giving you stable and predictable income from day one.

title: Sales Lead - Mid-Market - East
description:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

• ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.
• ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.
• ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

• High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.
• Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.
• AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.
• Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.
• Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

• Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.
• Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.
• Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.
• Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.
• Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún
• Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the Role

As Mid-Market Lead, you will be the strategic driver behind scaling and optimizing our Mid-Market AE organization in the Eastern US. You’ll own revenue outcomes and team performance across our Mid-Market segment, with a strong focus on building repeatable, high-velocity sales motions. This role blends hands-on leadership with strategic execution in a fast-growing environment.

In this role, you will:

• Define and execute the go-to-market strategy for U.S. Mid-Market accounts, including quotas, segmentation, and territory design.
• Lead, coach, and scale a team of Mid-Market AEs, owning recruiting, onboarding, enablement, and performance management.
• Own pipeline health and forecasting, driving consistency and improving conversion rates across each stage of the funnel.
• Develop and refine sales playbooks, motions, objection frameworks, and deal models tailored to Mid-Market buyers and voice AI / conversational use cases.
• Partner cross-functionally with Marketing, Product, Growth, and Customer Success to align positioning, messaging, and expansion opportunities.
• Establish feedback loops by synthesizing insights from prospects and customers to help inform GTM strategy and product roadmap decisions.

Requirements

• 7+ years of SaaS or technology sales experience, with meaningful experience leading or scaling Mid-Market AE teams.
• Demonstrated success surpassing revenue targets in a Mid-Market or velocity-oriented sales environment.
• Strong command of sales metrics, funnel optimization, forecasting, and process rigor.
• Experience selling technical, AI, or API-driven solutions to Director- and VP-level stakeholders.
• Excellent communication skills and ability to influence across teams and seniority levels.
• Comfortable operating in fast-paced, ambiguous, high-growth environments with high ownership.

Location

This role is remote-first, however the ability to operate in EST timezones is required. There is a preference for candidates to be based in New York, with the option to work out of our office.

title: Montu Pharmacy Assessment Centre
description:
Ready to start or take the next step in your pharmacy career?

At Montu, we are doing things differently, and that includes how we recruit.

We are growing, and we are looking for enthusiastic, hardworking and patient-focused individuals to join our pharmacy team in Winnersh Triangle.

Whether you are looking to take your first step into healthcare, explore a new career in pharmacy or bring your existing pharmacy experience to a rapidly growing organisation, we would love to meet you.

We are hosting a Pharmacy Assessment Centre on Monday 2 November 2026, giving you the opportunity to experience a different approach to recruitment, demonstrate your skills and learn more about what it is like to work at Montu.

You do not need previous pharmacy experience for all of our opportunities. For our entry-level positions, what matters most is your attitude, willingness to learn and genuine commitment to making a difference to patients.

Our pharmacy is busy. Really busy. It is a lively, energetic environment where things move quickly, teamwork is essential and no two days are quite the same. If you enjoy being on your feet, working alongside others and being part of a team where everyone has a role to play, you could feel right at home.

Behind every prescription we process is a patient relying on us to get things right. Whether you are packing medication, dispensing prescriptions or completing final accuracy checks, your contribution matters.

Opportunities Available

We are recruiting across several positions within our pharmacy team, with opportunities for both experienced pharmacy professionals and individuals looking to enter the industry.

Pharmacy Assistant

An excellent entry point into the pharmacy sector, with no previous pharmacy experience required.

You will support the day-to-day operations of our busy pharmacy, including preparing orders, packing medication, supporting stock management and helping ensure prescriptions are processed accurately and efficiently.

We are looking for individuals who are organised, reliable, comfortable with repetitive tasks and enjoy working in a hands-on, fast-paced environment.

Trainee Pharmacy Dispenser

Looking to develop a career in pharmacy? This could be your opportunity.

No previous dispensing experience is required. You will receive training and support as you develop the knowledge and practical skills needed to work within our dispensing team.

You will learn about prescription processing, medication handling, accuracy, pharmacy procedures and the importance of maintaining high standards of patient safety.

Pharmacy Dispenser

For individuals with an existing dispensing qualification and experience working within a pharmacy environment.

You will support the safe and accurate dispensing of prescriptions, working closely with pharmacists, technicians and the wider pharmacy team.

You will need excellent attention to detail, a strong understanding of pharmacy procedures and the ability to maintain accuracy while managing high prescription volumes.

Accuracy Checking Dispenser

We are looking for qualified and experienced Accuracy Checking Dispensers who can help maintain the high standards of accuracy and patient safety expected within our pharmacy.

You will undertake accuracy checking duties within the scope of your qualification, training and authorisation, supporting the efficient processing of prescriptions and working collaboratively with the wider team.

Accuracy Checking Technician (ACT)

For qualified Pharmacy Technicians with an accredited accuracy checking qualification and current GPhC registration.

You will play an important role in maintaining dispensing accuracy, supporting pharmacy operations and ensuring our processes meet the required professional and regulatory standards.

You will bring confidence, attention to detail and the ability to work effectively in a high-volume dispensing environment.

What Is Our Pharmacy Assessment Centre?

We know that traditional interviews do not always give people the best opportunity to demonstrate what they can do.

That is why we are taking a slightly different approach.

Our Pharmacy Assessment Centre is designed to be an engaging, practical and interactive experience where you can demonstrate your abilities, meet members of the Montu team and gain a better understanding of our working environment.

You can expect a combination of practical and team-based activities designed to assess skills relevant to working within our pharmacy, including:

• Attention to detail and accuracy
• Literacy and the ability to follow written instructions
• Working effectively with others
• Organisation and the ability to follow processes
• Speed and efficiency without compromising accuracy
• Communication and problem-solving

We are not expecting everyone to arrive with pharmacy knowledge, particularly those applying for our entry-level opportunities.

We are interested in how you approach tasks, how you work with others and whether you have the right attitude to succeed in our environment.

What happens after the assessment centre?

Candidates who successfully complete the assessment centre will be invited to attend a further on-site interview at Montu on a later date.

Please note that attendance at the assessment centre does not guarantee an interview or offer of employment.

What Are We Looking For?

We are looking for people who genuinely want to be part of a team making a difference.

Our ideal candidates will be:

• Patient-focused: You understand that the work you do has a direct impact on the people relying on our service.
• Detail-oriented: Accuracy matters, particularly when working with medication.
• Comfortable in a busy environment: You enjoy an energetic workplace and can remain focused when things get hectic.
• Reliable and hardworking: You take pride in doing your job well and supporting the people around you.
• Team players: You understand that pharmacy operations depend on people working together.
• Adaptable: You are comfortable learning new processes and responding to change.
• Eager to learn: Whether you are new to pharmacy or already experienced, you are motivated to develop your skills.

You do not need to be the loudest person in the room or have years of experience to succeed here.

What matters is your work ethic, your attention to detail and your commitment to doing things properly.

About Montu

Montu is a leading medical cannabis company working to improve access to cannabis-based medicines for patients across the UK.

Through our specialist clinical services and pharmacy operations, we support patients receiving prescribed cannabis-based medicines for a range of eligible medical conditions.

Our multidisciplinary teams bring together clinicians, pharmacists, pharmacy technicians, dispensers and operational colleagues, all working towards the same goal: delivering safe, effective and patient-centred care.

We are a rapidly growing organisation, and our pharmacy is at the heart of what we do.

Every prescription represents a patient who is depending on us. From the moment a prescription reaches our pharmacy to the moment medication is dispatched, every member of our team plays an important role in that patient journey.

We are proud to be helping shape an evolving area of healthcare, and we want people who are excited to be part of that journey.

Why Join Montu?

Joining Montu means becoming part of a growing organisation where your work has purpose and your contribution makes a difference.

We offer:

• Competitive salaries dependent on the position, qualifications and experience
• Opportunities for training and professional development
• Career progression within our growing pharmacy operations
• A supportive and collaborative team environment
• The opportunity to gain experience within a specialist area of healthcare
• The chance to be part of a growing business helping improve patient access to prescribed medication

Further information about the benefits applicable to each role will be provided during the recruitment process.

Ready to Join Us?

Assessment Centre: Monday 2 November 2026

Location: Winnersh Triangle, Berkshire

If you are looking for an opportunity to begin a career in pharmacy, develop your existing skills or take the next step within a growing healthcare organisation, we would love to hear from you.

Apply now to be considered for a place at our Pharmacy Assessment Centre.

Following an initial review of applications, shortlisted candidates will receive further information about the assessment centre, including timings, location details and what to expect on the day.

title: Security Operations Analyst
description:
Our Story

Hello there. We’re Zopa.

We started our journey back in 2005, building the first ever peer-to-peer lending company. Fast forward to 2020 and we launched Zopa Bank. A bank that listens to what our customers don’t like about finance and does the opposite. We’re redefining what it feels like to work in finance. Our vision for a new era of banking puts people front and centre — we’ve built a business that empowers everyone to aim high, every day, to move finance forward. Find out more about our fantastic offerings at Zopa.com!

We’re incredibly proud of our achievements and none of it would be possible without the amazing team here. It’s not just industry awards we’re winning, we’ve also been named in the top three UK’s Most Loved Workplaces.

If you embrace unconventional challenges, are unafraid to think differently and are driven to make an outsized impact, you’ll thrive here at Zopa, so join us, and make it count. Want to see us in action? Follow us on Instagram @zopalife

The Team

At Zopa, our Security Operations team plays an important role in protecting our banking services, systems and customers. We're a collaborative team with a mix of technical experience and professional backgrounds, working together to investigate security threats, respond to incidents and continuously improve how we operate.

Unlike traditional SOC teams focused solely on monitoring and incident response, our SecOps team also owns and manages a range of security tools and services. That means you'll have opportunities to develop experience beyond alert investigation, including vulnerability management, cloud security and other security technologies.

You'll work alongside experienced analysts who share their knowledge and support your development. You'll also collaborate with engineering, IT, fraud and customer-facing teams to understand and respond to security risks across the business.

A Day In The Life:

• Review, triage and investigate security alerts, events and incident tickets.
• Analyse security logs to identify suspicious activity, assess potential impact and determine appropriate next steps.
• Investigate common threats including phishing, malware and account compromise.
• Follow established incident response playbooks, escalating incidents and requesting support when needed.
• Maintain accurate investigation notes, ticket updates and incident documentation.
• Work within defined response and resolution expectations for security tickets.
• Collaborate with IT Services, Identity and Access Management, engineering, fraud and customer service teams.
• Develop practical experience with security technologies including Splunk, SentinelOne, Netskope and AWS security services.
• Participate in peer reviews and incident retrospectives, sharing lessons learned with colleagues.
• Support improvements to security processes and develop your understanding of vulnerability management, cloud security and security tooling.

About You:

You have practical experience in security operations or a relevant technical environment such as infrastructure, network, cloud operations or IT support, along with a blend of the following:

• Understanding of cyber security fundamentals, including phishing, malware, account compromise, vulnerabilities, threats and risks.
• Experience reviewing security alerts or analysing logs to investigate unusual activity.
• Knowledge of the incident response lifecycle and can follow documented procedures.
• Foundational knowledge of Windows, macOS, Linux and core networking concepts.
• Understand basic cloud concepts, particularly AWS services such as IAM, S3 and CloudTrail.
• You approach investigations analytically, gathering evidence and assessing potential impact before deciding what to do next.
• Communication is one of your strengths; you communicate clearly, document your findings accurately and know when to escalate.
• You can prioritise security tickets, manage your time and work within agreed service levels.
• You're curious, eager to learn, comfortable asking for support and committed to working collaboratively.

Added Bonus:

• Experience using SIEM, EDR or security tools such as Splunk, SentinelOne, Netskope, Mimecast, Tenable or AWS GuardDuty.
• Basic scripting experience using Python, Bash or PowerShell.
• Practical experience with phishing investigations or vulnerability management.
• Familiarity with the MITRE ATT&CK framework.
• Experience using Git or version control alongside engineering teams.
• Experience working in financial services, fintech or another regulated environment.
• Awareness of FCA requirements and UK GDPR.
• Security certifications such as CompTIA Security+, CySA+ or CEH, or a relevant degree.
• Experience safely using AI tools to support everyday work.

At Zopa we value flexible ways of working.

We value face-to-face collaboration and a good work-life balance. This hybrid role requires you to come to our London office 2-3 days a week.

You'll also have the option of working from abroad for up to 120 days a year!* But no matter where you are, we’ll make sure you’ve got everything you need to thrive, both in your work and home life, from day one.

*Subject to having the right to work in the country of choice

Diversity Statement

Zopa is proud to offer a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and backgrounds leads to better products for our customers and a unique company culture for our people. We are made up of nearly 50 nationalities, have a DE&I forum made up of Zopians wanting to make a difference and we are proud of our culture where everyone can bring their full self to work. Our approach to DE&I is reflected in our hiring process so please let us know if you require any reasonable adjustments.

Our approach to AI in interviews

At Zopa, AI isn't something we're testing out — it's part of how we work every day. As a proud partner of Jobs 2030, we're committed to building AI fluency across our workforce, and we expect Zopians to use AI as part of how they do their jobs.

Because of that, we want to be transparent about how we think about AI use during our hiring process.

Behavioural and competency-based interviews: please don't use AI. These conversations are designed to understand you — your experiences, your judgment, and how you've approached real situations. An AI-generated answer can't tell us that. What it can do is get in the way of us finding out whether we're the right fit for each other.

Technical interviews: it depends on the role. Some technical stages actively welcome AI use, others don't. Your Talent Partner will let you know what's expected at each stage. Where AI is part of the assessment, we'll be interested not just in the outcome, but in how you used it – the tools you chose, your reasoning, and the decisions you made along the way.

title: Fullstack Engineer
description:
The Product team builds features end-to-end. From designing our data models to implementing the subtle interaction behaviors that differentiate good software from great software. We work closely with UI designers and are supported by our infrastructure team. We aim to delight users with both large new features and smaller, daily product enhancements—thanks to our continuous deployment architecture. We want to create a superlative user experience, down to the smallest details.

Asana’s ecosystem includes a wide range of powerful apps that extend its capabilities and integrate it seamlessly into our users’ workflows. These apps help establish Asana as the shared collaboration infrastructure our customers use to get things done, spanning the full breadth of domains and departments. The Functional Integrations team in the Platform Area owns integrating Asana with the most valuable function-specific (think Operations, Marketing, or IT) tools, enabling experts on those teams to effectively share and communicate their work to the company as a whole.

We’re looking for full-stack engineers who care deeply about customers and are passionate about building products that improve the way millions of teams work together. As a member of the team developing the software of a product-led company, you won’t just code — you will be an integral part of the entire product development process, from conception to post-launch reflection.

This role is based in our Warsaw office with an office-centric hybrid schedule. The standard in-office days are Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday. Most Asanas have the option to work from home on Wednesdays. Working from home on Fridays depends on the type of work you do, and your recruiter can share more about the in-office requirements.

Our employees in Poland are employed under a contract of employment.

What you’ll achieve

• As a full-stack engineer, you get to build and own a broad swath of the product: everything from creating a compelling user interface down to creating efficient, flexible, and scalable back-end processing logic
• Participate in every step of the product development process with an open and curious team, working cross-functionally with a product manager, designer, user researcher, and data scientist
• Develop clean, beautiful code and leave it better than you found it
• Experience growth and development through opportunities to stretch and learn
• Be an early employee in our growing Warsaw office, contributing to a culture that keeps Asana's workplace balanced, performant, inclusive, transparent, and aligned with our values

About you

• 6 or more years of full-stack experience working in large, well-maintained codebases building user-facing products (integration development preferred), with professional experience in Javascript/Typescript (React and Node.js) or Scala
• Excellent communication skills for collaborating with cross-functional partners (e.g. PM, design) and cross-timezone with partner teams
• Sound autonomous judgment when balancing moving quickly with producing quality, long-term maintainable code
• Passionate about creating a superlative user experience and attentive to details
• Appreciate productivity and care deeply about helping teams collaborate more effectively and efficiently, including your own
• Excited to be a part of an inclusive culture where everyone brings the aspects of themselves to the workplace that they need to thrive
• Demonstrates curiosity about AI tools and emerging technologies, with a willingness to learn and leverage them to enhance productivity, collaboration, or decision-making.

At Asana, we're committed to building teams that include a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills, as this is critical to helping us achieve our mission. If you're interested in this role and don't meet every listed requirement, we still encourage you to apply.

What we’ll offer

For this role, the estimated base salary range is between 31,900 PLN - 36,250 PLN (gross monthly). The actual base salary will vary based on various factors, including market and individual qualifications objectively assessed during the interview process. The listed range above is a guideline, and the base salary range for this role may be modified.

In addition to base salary, your compensation package may include additional components such as equity, sales incentive pay (for most sales roles), and benefits. If you're interviewing for this role, speak with your Talent Acquisition Partner to learn more about the total compensation and benefits for this role.

We strive to provide equitable and competitive benefits packages that support our employees worldwide and include:

• Generous, transparent and fair compensation system
• Contract of Employment (and the option of 50% tax deductible costs for author’s rights usage in respect of applicable roles )
• Health insurance with dental and travel coverage (Lux Med)
• Meals reimbursement on the days that you work from the office
• Career growth budget
• Home office setup budget
• Gym/Fitness reimbursement
• Fertility healthcare and family-forming support with Carrot
• Mental Health Support in Modern Health
• Group life insurance
• MacBooks with all necessary accessories

About us

Asana is a leading platform for human + AI collaboration. Millions of teams around the world rely on Asana to achieve their most important goals, faster. Asana has been named to Fortune's Best Workplaces for 7+ years and recognized by Fast Company, Forbes, and Gartner for excellence in workplace culture and innovation. We offer an exceptional office-centric culture while adopting the best elements of hybrid models to ensure that every one of our global team members can work together effortlessly. With 13+ offices all over the world, we are always looking for individuals who care about building technology that drives positive change in the world and a culture where everyone feels that they belong.

We believe in supporting people to do their best work and thrive. Our goal is to ensure that Asana upholds an environment where all people feel that they are respected and valued, whether they are applying for an open position or working at the company. We provide equal employment opportunities to all applicants without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Join Asana’s Talent Network to stay up to date on job opportunities and life at Asana.

title: Data Analyst II
description:
Job Description

Are you passionate about transforming complex data into meaningful insights that drive better decisions?

Would you like to work with innovative data solutions that help shape the future of insurance risk?
