title: Web Developer
description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

Our mission is great open source

It is our mission to make open source software available to people everywhere. We create world-renowned software, impacting the lives of millions of people every day.

The web team works in a multi-disciplinary environment with visual designers, UX designers and other developers to bring exciting new web projects to life. We help and learn from each other and constantly strive to improve both our work and our processes.

Required skills and experience

• Demonstrable experience of work on modern web applications
• A strong understanding of HTML, CSS with SCSS and JavaScript
• Experience with Javascript components libraries
• Experience with TypeScript
• Experience with responsive user interfaces for a wide range of devices and browsers
• Experience with Git or other version control systems
• Awareness of SEO best practice
• Consideration of accessibility in all aspects of your work
• A strong understanding of web performance in complex user interfaces
• Ability to interact with UX, designers and server-side developers
• Curiosity about technology and a thirst to learn
• Based in EMEA timezones (Europe, the Middle East and Africa)
• University degree or equivalent education

Useful experience if you have it

• Familiarity with Linux desktop technologies
• Server-side languages, such as Python or NodeJS
• Experience working on a large scale React (with TypeScript) project
• A history of open source contributions
• Relevant work experience

Who you are

We want a Web Developer who loves what they do. You are passionate about web standards and keep abreast of new developments in our industry. You always look for opportunities to improve your skills. You like to show off what you’re working on and also learn from others. You have strong attention to detail and value the design of a product as much as you value the code. You have strong communication skills and maybe even blog once in a while. You’re aware of the latest CSS techniques but also know the limitations that developing for a broad audience can bring - actually, you embrace the challenge.

In this team

• You’ll create high fidelity websites and web apps using the latest incarnations of HTML, CSS (SCSS) and Javascript (React and TypeScript)
• You’ll help maintain existing projects including updating content and adding new pages
• You’ll manage incoming requests for updates and liaise with or delegate to other people as necessary
• You’ll ensure the standard of our output remains high and consistent across our whole product portfolio
• You’ll ensure new pages are published according to specification and in compliance with our web style guide
• You’ll participate in and contribute to our living style guide, Vanilla Framework.
• Work closely with UX designers and visual designers to implement exemplary user experiences.

What we offer colleagues

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

• Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
• Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
• Annual compensation review
• Recognition rewards
• Annual holiday leave
• Maternity and paternity leave
• Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
• Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
• Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

description:
Description

The Defense Sector is seeking a highly motivated Waterfront Manager within the Maritime Readiness Division.

The candidate will be responsible for managing waterfront modernization, maintenance, and repair activities for a Foreign Military Sale Navy program supporting systems upgrades, sustainment material, systems integration support, training, and other efforts related to the transfer and acquisition, operation, and maintenance of naval systems and vessels. The ideal candidate will have export experience with waterfront maintenance requirements, industrial upgrades, and shipboard electrical standards.

The Waterfront Manager will provide safe, effective, and timely execution of FOTS waterfront activities ensuring waterfront execution remains aligned with technical requirements and overall program schedules.

Primary Responsibilities.

• Lead day-to-day waterfront execution of Navy FOTS ship, submarine, and/or combat systems installation, modernization, repair, and overhaul activities.
• Serve as the primary on-site interface for waterfront activities with shipyard personnel, Government representatives, ship's force, contractors, subcontractors, and other stakeholders.
• Manage and coordinate a diverse waterfront workforce, including engineering, technical, professional, skilled trade, and industrial personnel.
• Develop, manage, and monitor waterfront production schedules, milestones, dependencies, and resource requirements to support overall program objectives.
• Coordinate shipboard installation, integration, testing, maintenance, repair, and modernization activities across multiple workstreams and trades.
• Monitor daily production progress and identify schedule, technical, material, access, resource, and sequencing issues that may affect waterfront execution.
• Lead resolution of waterfront issues and coordinate corrective actions with program management, engineering, logistics, production, shipyard, and Government stakeholders.
• Coordinate work sequencing, ship access, availability requirements, material readiness, and personnel resources to minimize production delays and schedule impacts.
• Conduct and support waterfront planning meetings, drawing/schematic reviews, production reviews, schedule reviews, and Government/customer status meetings; track actions through completion.
• Monitor contractor and subcontractor waterfront performance to ensure work is completed safely, efficiently, and in accordance with technical and contractual requirements.
• Provide program leadership with timely status on waterfront progress, schedule performance, risks, issues, and recommended mitigation actions.
• Support waterfront activities associated with Foreign Military Sales (FMS) programs and coordinate with U.S. Government and international stakeholders, as applicable.
• Ensure waterfront activities comply with applicable shipyard, local, state, national, and Navy, safety, environmental, security, quality, technical, and contractual requirements.

Basic Qualifications.

• 10+ years of prior relevant experience is required in management of complex projects involving USG ships, submarines, or combat systems
• Experience is required in naval shipbuilding and overhaul in public or private shipyard environments, including experience in managing a large and diverse group of individuals ranging from professional to industrial workers.
• Experience is required in management of schedules for large and complex projects
• Demonstrated experience with Foreign Military Sales programs
• Demonstrated experience managing logistics for geographically dispersed and/or OCONUS (Outside Continental United States) operating environments.
• Strong technical writing, editing, analytical, and information organization skills, with the ability to communicate complex, technical tasks clearly and concisely.
• Ability to work independently, manage rapidly changing priorities, and effectively lead cross-functional initiatives in a fast-paced environment.
• Willingness and ability to travel internationally and work in maritime, industrial, or forward-deployed environments, including visits onboard vessels in port.
• Active Secret clearance

Preferred Qualifications.

• Bachelor's degree
• Current PMP Certification

description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Samsara’s Enterprise Services team uses a high touch engagement methodology to guide our largest customer segment, ensuring they adopt Samsara and continuously gain business value from our products. We use data and automation to ensure all customers receive a high level of service and onboard to our platform successfully.

As the Manager of the Enterprise Implementation Consultants team, you will lead a team of Implementation Consultants who deploy Samsara’s connected operations platform — spanning hardware installation, software configuration, and system integrations — for our largest enterprise accounts. You will improve our high touch implementation motions, provide focused coaching for each team member, and be an inspiring leader who establishes an energizing team culture.

• Manage team performance
• Deliver results across team KPIs and org level OKRs
• Own executive-level stakeholder relationships and lead escalation resolution for at-risk, high-ACV accounts
• Partner cross-functionally with Sales, Solutions Engineering, Support, and Customer Success to ensure seamless handoffs, and protect renewal and expansion opportunities on these accounts
• Coach consultants through complex, multi-site technical implementations, including hardware deployment logistics and system/API integrations
• Identify and implement process-improvement opportunities; such as systems efficiency gains and leaning into data resulting in increased automation
• Lead from the front with a willingness to get hands dirty
• Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices
• Hire, develop and lead an inclusive, engaged, and high performing team

Minimum requirements for the role:

• 4+ years of experience managing as services team, including experience supporting complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise deployments
• Experience implementing Enterprise (medium/high touch) accounts or account management programs. SaaS and/or IoT/hardware implementation experience preferred.
• This is a demanding position with high internal visibility that requires strong work ethic, prioritization, and high emotional intelligence
• Experience managing escalations and executive stakeholder relationships on complex, high-value accounts
• Experience with a customer success CRM such as Gainsight and/or PSA tool
• Solutions-oriented with strong problem solving skills
• Comfort in a fast-paced, change-heavy environment
• Strong bias for action, the ability to think big, with insistence on high standards
• Project/program management experience (PMP or similar) a plus

title: IT Field Support Technician I
description:
Labcorp is a global leader in laboratory services, providing the insights and answers that help healthcare providers, patients, researchers, pharmaceutical companies and health systems make confident decisions and improve outcomes. Through our unparalleled science, data, technology and laboratory network, we advance diagnostics, accelerate innovation and help address some of the world's most important health challenges. As we shape the future of healthcare, we are leveraging advanced technologies, intelligent digital solutions and data-driven innovation across our operations to enhance how work gets done and deliver greater value to customers and patients. With our global scale and deep expertise, you'll have the opportunity to do meaningful work, grow your career and make a real impact on people's health around the world. Together, we're improving health and improving lives.

Labcorp is seeking an IT Field Support Technician I to provide remote and field-based technical support for internal teams and external clients.

Location: Arizona, Colorado, Texas, Arkansas, Oklahoma, Utah, Nevada, and Nebraska

Work Schedule: This is a full-time, non-exempt (hourly) position assigned to a First Shift schedule, with standard business hours of Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. in your local time zone. Business needs may occasionally require flexibility in work hours, including earlier, later, or additional hours, with reasonable notice provided when possible.

Work Authorization: This position requires permanent authorization to work in the United States without employer sponsorship now or in the future. Sponsorship (including H-1B, OPT/CPT, EAD, or other temporary work authorization) is not available.

Job Responsibilities

Help Desk & Technical Support

• Support the IT Help Desk phone queue and manage 30 or more inbound support calls per day.
• Provide technical support, troubleshooting, and issue resolution for hardware, software, network connectivity, and business applications.
• Resolve first-call issues whenever possible and document support activities in the ticketing system.
• Create and route tickets requiring advanced troubleshooting or specialized support teams.
• Utilize remote support tools to diagnose, troubleshoot, and resolve technical issues.

Client & End User Support

• Provide training, support, and troubleshooting assistance to internal users and external clients.
• Support Labcorp Link users through issue resolution, training, configuration assistance, and operational guidance.
• Deliver professional customer service while assisting users with technology-related questions and requests.
• Communicate technical solutions and status updates to users and stakeholders.

Systems & Infrastructure Support

• Support installation, maintenance, configuration, and troubleshooting of Labcorp hardware, software, and network systems.
• Assist with system integrations, equipment deployments, and technical implementation activities.
• Support security updates, system maintenance activities, and hardware lifecycle management initiatives.
• Track technology assets and maintain accurate documentation of support activities and equipment inventories.

Operational Support & Coordination

• Coordinate with internal IT teams to resolve technical issues and escalate incidents when appropriate.
• Maintain accurate ticket documentation, resolution notes, and service records.
• Support workflow continuity by following established IT support processes and service standards.

Field Services & System Installations

• Install, configure, maintain, and document Labcorp-owned hardware and technology assets for IOPs, PSCs, internal and client locations.
• Perform onsite system installations, troubleshooting activities, hardware replacements, and equipment upgrades.

Acquisitions, Projects & Operational Support

• Assist with divisional technology projects, which may include travel.
• Assist with technology integration activities related to acquisitions and site transitions.
• Identify recurring issues, recommend process improvements, and escalate division-wide concerns when appropriate.

Minimum Qualifications

• High school diploma
• 1 or more years of experience supporting hardware, software, and network connectivity issues.
• 1 or more years of experience utilizing ticketing systems for incident and service request management.
• 1 or more years of experience supporting Microsoft Windows operating systems and Microsoft Office applications.
• 1 or more years of experience using remote support tools for troubleshooting and issue resolution.

Preferred Qualifications

• Associate degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related technical field.
• CompTia A+ Certification
• 3 or more years of experience providing field support, help desk support, desktop support, or technical services.
• 2 or more years of experience supporting client-facing technology environments.
• 2 or more years of experience supporting laboratory, healthcare, diagnostic, or enterprise business applications.
• 2 or more years of experience supporting Labcorp Link or comparable customer connectivity platforms.
• 2 or more years of experience utilizing remote support and endpoint management tools.

Additional Job Standards

• Ability to professionally communicate and articulate technical IT information to medical professionals and non-technical audiences.
• Maintain a professional appearance and adhere to corporate dress codes while working on-site at the laboratory, internal facilities, and external client locations.
• Ability to work effectively from a remote environment while maintaining collaborative communication with leadership and remote colleagues.
• Access to a reliable personal vehicle for business travel.
• Knowledge of Labcorp business processes, systems, and operational workflows.
• Knowledge of IT security standards and technology governance practices.
• Strong customer service and professional communication skills.
• Effective problem-solving and decision-making capabilities.
• Ability to manage multiple support requests in a fast-paced environment.
• Ability to provide technical training and guidance to end users.
• Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional IT teams.
• Ability to work in client-facing environments while maintaining a professional demeanor.
• Physical ability to bend, stoop, twist, lift up to 30 pounds, and work in varying positions during equipment installation activities.

About the Role

The IT Field Support Technician I serves as a front-line technical resource responsible for delivering remote and field-based support for Labcorp systems, applications, and users. This role manages help desk activity, provides technical troubleshooting, supports Labcorp Link users, and coordinates with internal IT teams to ensure timely issue resolution. The position plays a key role in maintaining service quality, supporting operational continuity, and delivering exceptional support experiences for both internal customers and external clients.

Application Window: 11/15/2026

Pay Range: $25 - $32 per hour

All job offers will be based on a candidate's skills and prior relevant experience, applicable degrees/certifications, as well as internal equity and market data.

Benefits: Employees regularly scheduled to work 20 or more hours per week are eligible for comprehensive benefits including: Medical, Dental, Vision, Life, STD/LTD, 401(k), Paid Time Off (PTO) or Flexible Time Off (FTO), Tuition Reimbursement and Employee Stock Purchase Plan. Employees regularly scheduled to work less than 20 hours, Casual, Intern, and Temporary employees are only eligible to participate in the 401(k) Plan. title: Senior Executive Assistant
description:
Company Description

Experian is a global data and technology company, powering opportunities for people and businesses around the world. We operate across a range of markets, from financial services to healthcare, automotive, agribusiness, insurance, and many more. Experian invests in people and new advanced technologies to unlock the power of data. We have an amazing team of 25,200 people in 32 countries.

Description

We're looking for an experienced Senior Executive Assistant to partner with two Executive Vice Presidents and help turn leadership priorities into action. You'll coordinate main priorities, improve how work gets done, build partnerships, and keep critical projects moving forward.

At Experian, we believe great work happens when people come together. We're focused on attracting talent in and around our designated hub locations who are open to collaborating with colleagues in person. Aligning employees to these talent markets helps foster collaboration, strengthen team connections, and support long-term career growth within Experian.

You'll report to the Executive Vice President of Platform Delivery and the Executive Vice President of Developer Experience & AI Tooling. and reside in or near one of our collaboration hubs:

Costa Mesa, CA, San Jose, CA, Allen, TX, Austin, TX, Franklin, TN, New York, NY, Schaumberg, IL, Washington, D.C., Atlanta, GA, Boston, MA, Seattle, WA

What We're Looking For

• Strategic Executive Partnership
• Be the strategic support partner to executive leadership, maintaining a clear understanding of organizational priorities, important partners, and strategic plans.
• Plan ahead, prioritize needs, address issues early, and keep executive priorities moving forward.
• Executive Operations and Leadership Rhythm
• Manage complex executive calendars across multiple time zones, prioritizing commitments and leadership goals.
• Coordinate domestic and international travel, customer meetings, executive events, board interactions, leadership meetings, business reviews, strategy sessions, and offsite events.
• Prepare agendas, pre-read materials, and executive summaries, and track action items to ensure leaders are prepared and commitments move forward.
• Strategic Project & Program Coordination
• Coordinate interdepartmental plans, track important deliverables and timelines, and address risks with partners to keep work on track.
• Support annual planning, headcount forecasting, budget reviews, and organizational transformation plans.
• Off-Site & Event Management
• Lead the end-to-end coordination of executive and leadership off-sites, ensuring events are thoughtfully planned and seamlessly delivered.
• Partner with executive leadership to develop agendas that reflect our priorities, desired outcomes, and the right balance of discussion, governance and team engagement.
• Manage event logistics, including venues, travel, accommodations, catering, meeting spaces, technology, materials, and attendee communications.
• Stay ahead of needs, solve issues quickly, and coordinate on-site activities to provide an engaging experience for leaders and participants.
• Executive Communications
• Develop executive-ready presentations, briefing materials, strategic updates, and leadership communications.
• Combine technical, operational, and business information into clear executive-level messaging.
• Draft communications on behalf of the EVP and support presentations for executive reviews, town halls, board meetings, and industry events.
• Partner Management
• Partner with senior leaders, chiefs of staff, engineering and product leaders, and executive assistants to represent the EVP's office and lead agreement across teams.
• Experience managing confidential information.

Qualifications

• 10+ years of executive support experience partnering with senior technology leaders in large, global, matrixed organizations.
• Experience independently managing executive priorities.
• Experience leading executive-level projects, business operations, and organizational planning.

Nice to have:

• Experience supporting technology organizations and collaborating with senior engineering, product, and technical leaders.
• Knowledge of Agile and software delivery environments, with experience supporting executive planning, goal setting, business reviews, and organizational change.

Additional Information

Our uniqueness is that we celebrate yours. Experian's people first, inclusive and purpose driven culture is multi award-winning; World's Best Workplaces™ 2025 (Fortune Global Top 25), Great Place to Work™ in 26 countries to name a few. Check out Experian Life on social or explore our Careers Site to understand why.

Our compensation reflects the cost of labor across several U.S. geographic markets. The base pay range for this position is listed above. Within this range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors such as job-related skills, experience, and education. You will be also eligible for a variable pay opportunity and a comprehensive benefits package.

Experian is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer for all groups protected under applicable federal, state and local law, including protected veterans and individuals with disabilities. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know at the earliest opportunity.

Benefits/Perks:

• Great compensation package and bonus
• Core benefits including medical, dental, vision, and matching 401K
• Flexible work environment, ability to work remote, hybrid or in-office
• Flexible time off including volunteer time off, vacation, sick and 12-paid holidays

title: Transmission Line Engineer
description:
Description

Leidos is seeking a Transmission Line Engineer who will work as members of a dynamic team working in a fast-paced environment, solving challenging problems involved with electric transmission.

The Transmission Line Engineer will serve as key contributors on electric transmission line design projects for high-voltage overhead and underground systems for some of the largest utilities in the country. These employees will apply established NESC, ASCE, ACI, and other applicable standards in the engineering and design of electrical overhead and underground systems, voltage conversion projects, new capacity projects, and infrastructure replacement projects.

Additionally, they will perform engineering analyses, prepare bidding documents, draft plans and specifications, and prepare material procurement and construction documents. Engineers at this level will focus on independent execution of technical tasks using tools like PLS-CADD and PLS-POLE and will contribute to the quality control process. This will involve working with a multi-person Leidos team and supporting clients, project planning, environmental, permitting, and construction management personnel.

Work Locations: Ideal candidates will be located in Michigan, Ohio, West Virginia, Maryland, Pennsylvania, & New Jersey working a hybrid schedules. Fully REMOTE positions are available for qualified candidates. Relocation assistance will be provided to those able to relocate within a commutable distance to Walled Lake, MI or Cranberry Township, PA.

The Challenge:

• Execute technical design and engineering tasks related to high-voltage transmission lines, ensuring compliance with all applicable codes and standards.
• Prepare and review technical drawings, specifications, and calculations under the guidance of Lead Engineers or Project Managers.
• Perform engineering analyses, including PLS-CADD modeling and structure loading calculations.
• Contribute to the team's continuous improvement goals by learning and applying new technical tools, AI, and automation platforms.
• Actively communicate and coordinate project progress with the Project Manager (PM) to ensure awareness of and adherence to project schedule and budget. (This directly incorporates your PM/Schedule change.)
• Maintain strong technical proficiency in industry-standard software and Leidos design processes.

Required Education & Experience:

• Bachelor's in Civil, preferred, or Mechanical Engineering with two plus (2 +) years of relevant experience in the design of electric utility transmission systems.
• Experience using PLS-CADD and PLS-POLE.
• Work effectively in team environment; can also work independently.
• Strong interpersonal and written communication abilities, with a focus on effective collaboration across client and project teams.
• Work in client office is a possibility and/or periodic travel may be required.

Desired Experience:

• Experience with TOWER is a plus
• EIT or PE certification is desirable

An overview of this role

As an Executive Assistant in the Office of the Chief Financial Officer (CFO), you’ll support multiple senior leaders in GitLab’s Finance Group, helping them focus on their priorities through proactive calendar, travel, and expense management. Reporting to the Senior Executive Business Partner to the CFO, you’ll be part of an integrated model that gives Finance leadership balanced, consistent support. What you’ll do

• Proactively manage complex calendars across multiple time zones.

• Support the Senior Executive Business Partner in coordinating Finance leadership's recurring activities, including maintaining shared Office of the CFO resources, distribution lists, Slack channels, and shared calendars.
• Help plan team events, off-sites, and large meetings with cross-functional partners and the Senior Executive Business Partner.
• Handle highly confidential financial, personnel, and material non-public information with discretion, following GitLab's insider trading and quiet period policies.
• Provide coverage and backup for the CFO's Senior Executive Business Partner.

What you’ll bring

• Experience providing executive-level administrative support in a fast-paced environment and supporting multiple senior leaders at once, tailoring your approach to each leader while maintaining consistent support. Public company or Office of the CFO or Chief Executive Officer experience is a plus.
• Proficiency with Google Workspace, Zoom, Slack, Navan, and related tools and processes, such as purchase orders, with the ability to learn new technical tools quickly.
• Experience working independently, moving quickly between tasks, and using sound judgment to prioritize, solve problems, and anticipate executive needs, including knowing when to escalate competing vice president priorities to the Office of the CFO.
• Strong organizational and communication skills, attention to detail, and the ability to build collaborative relationships across teams, including with other Executive Business Administrators and stakeholders at all levels.
• Experience using artificial intelligence (AI) to make day-to-day operations more efficient while protecting information and maintaining confidentiality.
• Ability to work in an all-remote, distributed environment, with a willingness to help others and contribute to a positive, one-team culture.

title: Amazon Connect Developer
description:
Description

Leidos is seeking an experienced Amazon Connect Developer to design, develop, test, implement, and maintain cloud-based contact center capabilities supporting the Department of Defense (DoD) and Defense Health Agency (DHA).

The successful candidate will develop and enhance Amazon Connect functionality, including multi-level interactive voice response (IVR), intelligent call routing, conversational AI, chatbots, workforce management integrations, call recording, transcription, and contact center analytics.

The Amazon Connect environment will integrate with Salesforce Health Cloud to support healthcare contact center operations, including patient engagement, nurse advice services, care coordination, appointment scheduling, and referral management.

This position will participate in the full software development lifecycle (SDLC), working closely with developers, system administrators, cloud engineers, cybersecurity personnel, and program stakeholders to deliver secure, scalable, and reliable contact center solutions.

Primary Responsibilities

• Design, develop, test, and maintain Amazon Connect contact flows, multi-level IVR applications, inbound and outbound call routing, queues, callbacks, and automated self-service capabilities.

• Develop conversational AI solutions using Amazon Lex, including voicebots, chatbots, intents, dialog management, and automated customer interactions.

• Develop serverless application components using AWS Lambda, Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, and associated AWS services.

• Design and maintain integrations between Amazon Connect and Salesforce Health Cloud, including customer identification, screen pops, case creation, contact activity logging, and API-based data exchanges.

• Develop and maintain integrations supporting workforce management, call recording, transcription, contact analytics, and operational reporting.

• Implement secure REST APIs, event-driven processing, data transformations, authentication, and error-handling mechanisms.

• Develop and execute unit tests, integration tests, and automated validation procedures for contact center applications and integrations.

• Provide Tier 3 technical support, including troubleshooting complex IVR, call routing, chatbot, integration, and application performance issues.

• Perform root cause analysis and implement corrective actions for recurring software defects and production incidents.

• Participate in Agile development, code reviews, CI/CD processes, release planning, and production deployments.

• Maintain technical documentation, contact flow diagrams, integration specifications, and deployment procedures.

• Ensure application development follows applicable DoD/DHA cybersecurity, privacy, and information protection requirements.

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related technical discipline and 8-12 years of relevant experience, or a master's degree with 6-10 years of relevant experience. Equivalent experience may be considered in accordance with Leidos policies.

• At least 2 years of hands-on Amazon Connect development or comparable cloud contact center application development experience.

• Experience designing and implementing IVR, call routing, contact flows, or automated contact center solutions.

• Experience developing applications using Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, or comparable programming languages.

• Experience developing AWS Lambda functions and integrating cloud services with enterprise applications.

• Experience with REST APIs, JSON, authentication, and enterprise application integrations.

• Familiarity with Amazon Connect queues, routing profiles, contact flows, and contact handling concepts.

• Experience with Git-based source control, Agile development, software testing, and application deployment processes.

• Understanding of AWS security concepts, including IAM, encryption, and secure application integration.

• Strong analytical, troubleshooting, technical documentation, and communication skills.

• Ability to work independently and collaborate with developers, administrators, architects, and other technical stakeholders.

• Ability to meet applicable DoD/DHA personnel security and suitability requirements.

Preferred Qualifications

• AWS Certified Developer - Associate or AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Associate.

• Experience integrating Amazon Connect with Salesforce Health Cloud or Service Cloud.

• Experience developing conversational AI solutions using Amazon Lex, including chatbots and voicebots.

• Experience with AWS Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB, S3, EventBridge, and CloudWatch.

• Experience implementing call recording, transcription, and analytics using Amazon Connect Contact Lens, Amazon Transcribe, or comparable technologies.

• Familiarity with Amazon Connect workforce management, forecasting, scheduling, and contact center analytics.

• Experience developing applications in AWS GovCloud or other regulated government cloud environments.

• Experience supporting DoD, DHA, VA, or other federal healthcare programs.

• Knowledge of HIPAA, FedRAMP, DoD RMF, and applicable cybersecurity requirements.

• Experience with infrastructure-as-code, automated testing, and CI/CD pipelines.

• Familiarity with telecommunications concepts, SIP, PSTN connectivity, and enterprise contact center architectures.

• Experience developing integrations with healthcare systems, CRM platforms, or enterprise identity management services.

title: AI Trainer:  Mechanical Engineers CAD
location: Australia, Canada, Ireland, New Zealand, United Kingdom, United States
description:
Brunel is partnering with DataAnnotation to connect experienced Mechanical Engineers with an innovative AI training program. This opportunity brings together hands-on mechanical engineering expertise and artificial intelligence to help evaluate and improve how AI models solve real-world engineering problems. Selected experts will contribute their knowledge to the development of high-quality, technically accurate AI systems.

This opportunity is designed for practicing engineers across mechanical design and CAD, structures and materials, thermal and fluid systems, dynamics and controls, manufacturing, automotive, aerospace, HVAC, robotics, energy, and related mechanical engineering disciplines.

The models can already communicate fluently about mechanical engineering concepts. The challenge is teaching them to reliably perform the actual engineering work: sizing components against real load cases, identifying potential failure modes, evaluating CAD assemblies and clearances, analyzing design changes, and understanding downstream impacts. Your engineering judgment will help establish the benchmark against which these AI models are evaluated.

Engagement Details

Engagement
Fully remote, project-based work with a flexible schedule. Around 10 hours per week is the recommended starting point; the project prioritizes engineers who can commit 30–40 hours per week, though part-time availability is considered.

Pay Rate

$40–$125+ USD/hour, paid via PayPal

Location
United States, Canada, United Kingdom, Ireland, Australia, and New Zealand

First Step

Skills assessment (1–3 hours)

Responsibilities:

• Design challenging, closed-ended mechanical engineering problems based on your own professional experience that require genuine engineering reasoning rather than simple information lookup.
• Derive and verify the correct answers to your problems and develop clear, technically rigorous worked solutions demonstrating your methodology.
• Test engineering problems against advanced AI models and refine them to appropriately challenge the models’ reasoning capabilities.
• Evaluate AI-generated mechanical engineering analysis, designs, calculations, and technical documentation for accuracy and real-world applicability.
• Compare AI-generated solutions and determine which performs better, identifying specific strengths, weaknesses, and technical errors.
• Identify and document concrete failures, including incorrect assumptions, calculation or unit errors, unrealistic results, overlooked failure modes, improper material or component selection, and misinterpretation of engineering requirements.
• Review problems and solutions developed by other engineering contributors for technical correctness, ambiguity, rigor, and practical relevance.
• Apply your expertise across one or more mechanical engineering disciplines, including:
• Mechanical Design & CAD: geometry, clearances, tolerances, mechanisms, assemblies, and the impact of design changes.
• Structures & Materials: stress, deflection, fatigue, buckling, material selection, and failure analysis.
• Thermal & Fluids: heat transfer, thermodynamics, HVAC, pumps, piping, and fluid mechanics.
• Dynamics & Controls: vibration, kinematics, rotating machinery, and control systems.
• Manufacturing: DFM/DFA, process selection, GD&T, tolerance stack-ups, and cost and quality trade-offs.

Qualifications:

• Fluency in English, with the ability to communicate complex technical reasoning clearly in writing.
• 2+ years of professional mechanical engineering experience in design, product development, manufacturing, thermal systems, structural engineering, automotive, aerospace, HVAC, robotics, energy, or a related discipline.
• Background in Mechanical Engineering or a closely related engineering field.
• Strong engineering fundamentals, including knowledge of mechanics of materials, dynamics, thermodynamics, heat transfer, fluid mechanics, and manufacturing processes.
• Experience with tools relevant to your engineering specialty, which may include CAD platforms such as SolidWorks, Fusion 360, Onshape, Creo, NX, CATIA, or Inventor; FEA/CFD tools; or MATLAB/Python for engineering analysis.
• Ability to develop precise, technically rigorous, and unambiguous engineering problems and clearly explain the reasoning behind the correct solution.
• Ability to articulate why an engineering answer or design is incorrect, not simply identify that it is wrong.
• Strong attention to detail and the ability to identify edge cases, incorrect assumptions, and potential failure modes.
• Working comfort with AI tools, or the ability to learn and use them quickly.
• A current, in-progress, or completed Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related field.

Relevant Backgrounds:

This opportunity may be particularly relevant for professionals currently working as:

• Mechanical Engineer
• Mechanical Design Engineer
• Product Engineer
• Manufacturing Engineer
• Structural/Mechanical Engineer
• Thermal Engineer
• HVAC Engineer
• Automotive Engineer
• Aerospace Engineer
• Robotics Engineer
• Mechanical Systems Engineer

Note: Payment is made via PayPal. We will never ask for any money from you. PayPal will handle any currency conversions from USD. Only applicants based in Australia, Canada, Ireland, New Zealand, the United Kingdom, and the United States will be considered for this role.

This is an independent contractor position.

title: Sr. Data Infrastructure Engineer (Remote)
description:
As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. Since 2011, our mission hasn't changed - we're here to stop breaches, and we've redefined modern security with the world's most advanced AI-native platform. We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We're proud to work for a mission-driven company leveraging AI to transform the way we work. CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. We use an AI-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. We're always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you.

About the Role:

As a Sr. Data Infrastructure Engineer, you will be a key member of the Data Platform Operations team, responsible for building out the AWS GovCloud environment. You will design and implement the foundational infrastructure-as-code (IaC), establish database platforms, configure application access management, and create multi-environment systems to establish a secure, compliant, and reliable government cloud data infrastructure. This is a greenfield opportunity to architect and build a modern GovCloud platform aligned with FedRAMP and compliance requirements.

What You'll Do:

• Design and build AWS GovCloud infrastructure, establishing the foundational architecture, security compliance (FedRAMP, FISMA), network security, and platform operations across dev, preprod, and production environments.
• Establish PostgreSQL database infrastructure in GovCloud, including initial setup, performance optimization frameworks, backup/recovery architecture, replication strategies, high availability configuration, and security hardening standards.
• Design and implement infrastructure-as-code from the ground up using Chef, creating comprehensive cookbooks, recipes, and automation frameworks for server provisioning, configuration management, and repeatable deployments.
• Integrate application access controls and identity management systems with Google SAML integration, establishing secure authentication.
• Deploy and configure Business Intelligence infrastructure in GovCloud from scratch, including initial installation, architecture design, performance optimization, user management frameworks, and authentication system integration.
• Architect and implement multi-environment infrastructure from the ground up, following AWS best practices for network segmentation, security boundaries, environment isolation, and promotion workflows.
• Design and implement comprehensive monitoring, alerting, and observability systems for infrastructure and data pipelines, including creating runbooks, operational standards, and disaster recovery procedures.
• Provide ongoing operational support by monitoring, triaging, and resolving data pipeline and infrastructure incidents including ETL/ELT failures, database performance issues, and access problems.
• Collaborate with security, compliance, and data engineering teams to ensure infrastructure design meets government security requirements and compliance frameworks from inception.
• Partner with DevOps and data engineering teams to establish CI/CD pipelines, data pipeline orchestration, automated testing frameworks, and infrastructure deployment automation using Chef and AWS native tools
• Utilize AI technologies to enhance decision-making, streamline workflows and processes, improve efficiency and drive business outcomes.

What You'll Need:

• 6+ years of experience in infrastructure engineering and operations, with at least 3+ years of hands-on AWS experience
• Proven experience building cloud infrastructure from scratch, with demonstrated ability to take greenfield projects from design through production deployment.
• Strong PostgreSQL administration experience including performance tuning, replication, backup/recovery, security configuration, and high availability setup.
• Expertise in PostgresSQL administration for data pipeline validation, query optimization, troubleshooting data issues, and evaluating ETL/ELT processes.
• Strong Python programming skills for automation, data pipeline monitoring, troubleshooting, and operational scripting.
• Proven hands-on experience with Chef for infrastructure-as-code, including creating and maintaining cookbooks, recipes, roles, and environments in greenfield deployments.
• Experience configuring enterprise identity and access management, specifically Google SAML integration and SSO implementations.
• Proven experience administering Tableau Server or other BI application including installation, configuration, performance optimization, security, and user management.
• Strong understanding of multi-environment infrastructure design, including network architecture, security boundaries, and deployment automation from initial design through implementation.
• Proficiency in scripting languages (Bash, Ruby) for automation, monitoring, and operational tasks.
• Experience with infrastructure monitoring and observability tools (CloudWatch, Datadog, Nagios, etc.).
• Knowledge of configuration management, CI/CD platforms (Jenkins, GitLab), and version control systems (Git).
• Strong understanding of network security, firewall management, VPC configuration, and secure architecture patterns.
• Self-starter with ability to work independently on greenfield projects, make architectural decisions, and drive projects from concept to completion.
• Excellent communication and collaboration skills with ability to work with cross-functional teams including security, compliance, and engineering.
• Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Computer Engineering, or related IT discipline; or equivalent experience.
• Proven experience utilizing AI technologies to enhance decision-making, streamline workflows and processes, improve efficiency and drive business outcomes.
• Security clearance eligible or ability to obtain government security clearance.

description:
O nas

Społeczność Edge One Solutions powstała z miłości do nowych technologii. Liczymy ponad 350 ekspertów, a w Grupie Euvic, której jesteśmy częścią, jest nas już 5500. Indywidualne podejście pozwala na dopasowanie projektów do umiejętności, przez co realnie wspieramy się w rozwoju kompetencji.

O kliencie

Naszym klientem jest jeden z czołowych producentów słodyczy czekoladowych w Polsce, należący do międzynarodowej grupy kapitałowej. Firma łączy wieloletnią tradycję z rozwojem portfolio produktów obecnych na rynku krajowym i zagranicznym. Organizacja stawia na jakość, innowacje oraz doskonalenie procesów biznesowych.

O projekcie

Projekt obejmuje rozwój programu Shared Services, którego celem jest centralizacja, usprawnienie i automatyzacja procesów biznesowych, w tym wykorzystanie rozwiązań AI. Pierwszy etap zakłada realizację pięciu strumieni: AI-driven Order-to-Cash (O2C), Budget-to-Pay, automatyzacji procesów prawnych, Next-Generation Services / AI Agent Factory oraz Payroll Services Centre.

Rola łączy analizę biznesową i procesową, prowadzenie projektu oraz koordynację inicjatyw automatyzacyjnych. Jej celem jest przełożenie wyników audytu i zidentyfikowanych możliwości centralizacji na docelowe procesy TO-BE, uzasadnienia biznesowe, plany wdrożenia oraz rekomendacje wspierające decyzje projektowe.

Oczekiwane rezultaty pierwszych 12 miesięcy obejmują uzgodnione mapy AS-IS/TO-BE i wymagania, portfolio zastosowań AI i automatyzacji, business case wraz z monitoringiem korzyści, rekomendowany model centrum usług wspólnych oraz plan implementacji i dokumentację przekazania do kolejnej fazy.

Model współpracy

Świadczenie usług odbywa się w modelu hybrydowym - 3 razy w tygodniu z biura klienta w Warszawie.

Oczekiwane kompetencje

• Minimum 3 lata doświadczenia w analizie biznesowej, zarządzaniu projektami lub transformacji procesowej.
• Doświadczenie w SSC/GBS, inicjatywach AI i automatyzacji, projektach SAP lub przedsięwzięciach obejmujących wiele obszarów organizacji.
• Umiejętność analizy procesów AS-IS oraz projektowania rozwiązań TO-BE, z uwzględnieniem wymagań, danych, punktów kontroli i potencjału automatyzacji.
• Umiejętność pozyskiwania, dokumentowania i uzgadniania wymagań biznesowych oraz funkcjonalnych.
• Umiejętność prowadzenia warsztatów, facylitacji uzgodnień i współpracy z interesariuszami biznesowymi oraz technologicznymi.
• Umiejętność przygotowywania business case’ów, analiz kosztów i korzyści oraz oceny wpływu zmian na zatrudnienie w przeliczeniu na pełne etaty (FTE), produktywność i jakość procesów.
• Umiejętność definiowania KPI oraz monitorowania efektów wdrażanych usprawnień.
• Umiejętność planowania i koordynacji prac projektowych, zarządzania ryzykiem, zależnościami oraz dokumentacją projektową.
• Zrozumienie zagadnień zarządzania zmianą i wdrażania nowych procesów, narzędzi oraz sposobów pracy.
• Bardzo dobra znajomość Excela i PowerPointa.
• Znajomość Power BI oraz narzędzi do mapowania procesów.

Zakres realizowanych usług

• Koordynacja pierwszego etapu programu Shared Services ( AI-driven Order-to-Cash (O2C), Budget-to-Pay, automatyzacji procesów prawnych, Next-Generation Services / AI Agent Factory oraz Payroll Services Centre) oraz zarządzanie ich wzajemnymi zależnościami.
• Mapowanie procesów AS-IS i projektowanie TO-BE, obejmujące analizę danych, wolumenów, kosztów, FTE, punktów kontroli oraz możliwości automatyzacji.
• Prowadzenie warsztatów z właścicielami procesów i zespołami zaangażowanymi w projekt oraz dokumentowanie ustaleń i decyzji.
• Definiowanie wymagań biznesowych i funkcjonalnych dla rozwiązań cyfrowych oraz AI i uzgadnianie ich z zespołami technologicznymi.
• Przygotowywanie business case’ów uwzględniających koszty bazowe, inwestycje, potencjalne oszczędności oraz wpływ na produktywność i jakość procesów.
• Definiowanie KPI i monitorowanie korzyści, w tym poziomu automatyzacji, liczby obsługiwanych transakcji, błędów oraz interwencji manualnych.
• Opracowywanie całościowego planu projektu, roadmapy i harmonogramu oraz prowadzenie rejestrów ryzyk, założeń, problemów, zależności, działań i decyzji.
• Przygotowywanie rekomendacji i materiałów na posiedzenia komitetu sterującego.
• Koordynacja PoC, oceny gotowości, testów, wdrożenia, przejęcia procesów, wsparcia powdrożeniowego oraz przekazania rozwiązań do zespołów operacyjnych.
• Wsparcie projektowania docelowego modelu Shared Services: katalogu usług, podziału odpowiedzialności RACI, SLA/KPI, zasad zarządzania, struktury i wymaganych kompetencji.
• Wsparcie zarządzania zmianą poprzez komunikację, ocenę wpływu zmian oraz działania ułatwiające przyjęcie nowych procesów i narzędzi.

Co oferujemy w ramach współpracy

• Co zyskujesz, współpracując z Edge1S w modelu B2B?
• W Edge1S stawiamy na przejrzyste zasady współpracy oraz dostęp do różnorodnych możliwości projektowych, dopasowanych do Twojego doświadczenia, specjalizacji i preferencji.
• Opiekun kontraktu: Dedykowany Opiekun Kontraktu jest Twoim głównym punktem kontaktu w Edge1S w sprawach związanych z realizacją projektu, organizacją współpracy oraz możliwościami udziału w kolejnych projektach.
• Szkolenia, certyfikaty i konferencje: Możesz uczestniczyć w wybranych szkoleniach, certyfikacjach i konferencjach związanych z realizowanymi projektami albo zakresem współpracy. Zasady udziału i finansowania ustalamy indywidualnie.
• #SmartChange: Gdy zbliża się koniec planowanego okresu projektu Klienta albo interesuje Cię inna rola projektowa, możesz zgłosić gotowość do udziału w kolejnym procesie kwalifikacji. Przedstawiamy dostępne propozycje współpracy B2B odpowiadające Twojemu doświadczeniu, specjalizacji i preferencjom. Zakres Usług oraz warunki każdego nowego SOW uzgadniamy odrębnie.
• Społeczność Edge1S: Możesz brać udział w webinarach #edge1talks oraz innych dobrowolnych inicjatywach budujących relacje w społeczności Edge1S.
• Aktywność fizyczna: Możesz uczestniczyć w inicjatywach sportowych organizowanych przez społeczność Edge1S oraz korzystać z udostępnianych sal treningowych.
• Usługi dodatkowe: Możesz dobrowolnie korzystać z usług dodatkowych oferowanych na warunkach dostępnych dla Wykonawców Edge1S, takich jak prywatna opieka medyczna, karta sportowa, ubezpieczenie oraz wsparcie psychologiczne. Dostępność, ceny oraz zasady przystąpienia określają dokumenty dotyczące poszczególnych usług.
• Platforma kafeteryjna: Możesz korzystać z platformy kafeteryjnej i samodzielnie decydować, na jakie dostępne w niej usługi lub produkty przeznaczasz przyznane punkty. Zasady uczestnictwa, przyznawania punktów i doładowań określa odrębny regulamin.

Nie spełniasz wszystkich wymagań, ale projekt Cię zainteresował? Aplikuj. Porozmawiajmy i sprawdźmy, czy Twoje doświadczenie pasuje do tej albo innej możliwości projektowej.

title: Solution Architect
description:
Solution Architect

Tryb pracy: stacjonarnie/ hybrydowo (min. 3 dni w biurze)

Sprawdź swoją szafę!

Na pewno masz w niej choć jeden produkt marek Reserved, Mohito, Cropp, House lub Sinsay. A wiesz, że kupiłeś/aś go właśnie dzięki nam? Silky Coders od lat rozwija rozwiązania IT, e-commerce i data science dla Grupy LPP, tworząc technologie, z których każdego dnia korzystają miliony użytkowników. To również dzięki Silky rośnie satysfakcja klientów, a wolumen transakcji online pozytywnie zaskakuje nas każdego dnia.

Nasze wartości zamykają się w akronimie FAST. To nie tylko tempo pracy - to nasze DNA. Działamy zwinnie, podejmujemy szybkie i odpowiedzialne decyzje, testujemy, iterujemy i dowozimy realną wartość. Odwaga, pasja i odpowiedzialność za efekt są dla nas tak samo ważne jak jakość rozwiązań.

Pracujemy w duchu AI FIRST - aktywnie wykorzystujemy AI i nowe technologie, by usprawniać codzienną pracę i szybciej dostarczać wartość. Szukamy osób, które chcą działać odpowiedzialnie, mieć realny wpływ i wspólnie z nami rozwijać technologie dla milionów użytkowników.

O zespole

Rozwijamy systemy IT wspierające procesy logistyczne LPP w obszarze outbound: wysyłki do sklepów i klientów e-commerce, transport międzynarodowy, integracje kurierskie, dokumentację handlową, fakturowanie oraz wymianę danych z partnerami zewnętrznymi. Pracujemy w ekosystemie rozproszonym, w którym współdziałają systemy transportowe, magazynowe, fakturujące, ERP oraz warstwa integracyjna. Korzystamy z integracji REST, SOAP, ESB, brokerów wiadomości oraz baz Oracle i PostgreSQL. Duża część naszej pracy to decyzje, jak te systemy mają się komunikować i co ma się stać, gdy jedna ze stron zawiedzie.

Szukamy osoby, która najpierw pozna od środka nasze systemy i domenę, a potem będzie projektować nowe funkcje i integracje i odpowiadać za nie: od doboru wzorca i kontraktu, przez wsparcie developerów, po sprawdzenie na produkcji, czy działa tak, jak zaprojektowano.

Co będziesz robić

• projektować rozwiązania dla nowych funkcji i zmian w istniejących systemach: podział odpowiedzialności, model danych,
• dobierać sposób integracji między systemami odpowiednio do przypadku — synchronicznie lub asynchronicznie oraz projektować API,
• pracować na co dzień z agentowymi narzędziami AI (Claude, Codex, Cursor) przy analizie kodu i danych, prototypowaniu kontraktów i weryfikacji decyzji architektonicznych,
• dobierać wzorce architektoniczne do projektowanych systemów i integracji,
• uwzględniać w projekcie wymagania niefunkcjonalne,
• analizować dane i logikę systemową w Oracle i PostgreSQL na podstawie SQL, kodu i logów,
• tworzyć w Enterprise Architect diagramy opisujące logikę systemową, przepływy danych i procesy (UML, BPMN, C4) oraz dokumentować rozwiązania w Enterprise Architect i Confluence,
• przeglądać z developerami projekty i kontrakty przed implementacją, a po wdrożeniu weryfikować je na produkcji,
• uzgadniać kontrakty i wymianę danych z partnerami zewnętrznymi i zespołami innych systemów oraz współpracować z biznesem, key userami, project managerami i testerami.

Co jest dla nas ważne

• masz minimum 5 lat doświadczenia jako architekt rozwiązań, projektant systemów lub analityk systemowy blisko architektury i developmentu,
• masz doświadczenie w projektowaniu architektury i rozwiązań systemowych, które trafiły na produkcję,
• znasz wzorce integracji w systemach rozproszonych, rozumiesz REST, SOAP, ESB, kolejki i brokery wiadomości i wiesz, jak z nich korzystać w praktyce,
• projektujesz API od kontraktu i wiesz, co dzieje się z konsumentami, kiedy kontrakt trzeba zmienić,
• pracujesz z agentowymi narzędziami AI w IDE i CLI, znasz MCP i wiesz, jakich danych nie wolno im przekazać,
• dobrze znasz SQL i modelowanie danych: analizujesz dane w bazach i projektujesz zmiany modelu bez rozjeżdżania istniejących integracji,
• czytasz kod aplikacyjny i bazodanowy na tyle, żeby odtworzyć z niego działanie integracji, nawet jeśli nie programujesz na co dzień,
• modelujesz systemy w Enterprise Architect lub podobnym narzędziu: diagramy logiki systemowej, przepływów i procesów w UML i BPMN,
• piszesz czytelną dokumentację techniczną i potrafisz wyjaśnić decyzję architektoniczną developerowi i biznesowi,
• działasz samodzielnie, bierzesz odpowiedzialność za swoje decyzje i potrafisz je zmienić, kiedy dane pokazują, że były błędne,
• znasz język polski na poziomie C1 oraz język angielski na poziomie minimum B2.

Mile widziane

• doświadczenie w logistyce, transporcie, e-commerce lub systemach klasy TMS, WMS, ERP,
• dobra znajomość Oracle PL/SQL i PostgreSQL,
• doświadczenie produkcyjne z Kafka lub RabbitMQ,
• doświadczenie z architekturą mikroserwisową,
• znajomość OpenAPI, AsyncAPI lub WSDL/XSD,
• doświadczenie mentorskie lub w prowadzeniu młodszych analityków i projektantów.

Oferujemy:

• Prywatna opieka medyczna na preferencyjnych warunkach (Lux Med albo Enel Med do wyboru)
• Ubezpieczenie grupowe – możesz zabezpieczyć siebie oraz członków rodziny na preferencyjnych warunkach
• Program HeLPP – program wellbeingowy obejmujący bezpłatne i anonimowe doradztwo w obszarach: prawnym, psychologicznym i finansowym
• Program Poleceń Pracowniczych – dzięki któremu, masz wpływ na to z kim pracujesz
• Budżet rozwojowy - możliwość skorzystania z działań nakierowanych na rozwój indywidualnych kompetencji i umiejętności
• Budżet integracyjny – dbamy o to, by regularnie spotykać się z zespołem i wspólnie spędzać czas
• Godziny pracy – core hours między 9 a 15
• Parking samochodowy i rowerowy
• Kody zniżkowe-25% na zakupy w salonach marek LPP: (Reserved, Mohito, Cropp, House i Sinsay) – którymi możesz dzielić się z bliskimi, także online
• Multisport – jeśli lubisz aktywnie spędzać czas, możesz wspólnie z bliskimi skorzystać z wybranej oferty sportowo-rekreacyjnej
• Siłownia – przy ul. Łąkowej w Gdańsku 5 minut spacerem od siedziby Silky Coders
• Styl pracy oparty na zaufaniu, odpowiedzialności i autonomii – masz realny wpływ na to, jak pracujesz i co dowozisz

Proces rekrutacji:

• Spotkanie rekrutacyjne online (2h): spotkanie z rekruterką prowadzącą proces rekrutacyjny, Software Delivery Managerem oraz Engineering Managerem.
• Decyzja + feedback

group: in4ge sp. z o.o.|solution designer / solution architect
title: Solution Designer / Solution Architect
description:
Everything is possible with the right people

In4ge jest firmą rekrutacyjną, w której wierzymy, że wszystko jest możliwe dzięki odpowiednim ludziom. Naszym celem jest połączenie najbardziej utalentowanych pracowników z odpowiednimi firmami, tworząc synergiczne relacje, które przyczyniają się do wzrostu i sukcesu każdej ze stron. Uważamy, że prawdziwą wartość stanowią ludzie pracujący wspólnie w atmosferze wzajemnego szacunku i zaufania.

Poszukujemy Solution Designer / Solution Architect który weźmie odpowiedzialność za zdefiniowanie docelowej architektury (future-state) i pokieruje procesem decyzyjnym w obszarze technologii. Rola ta wymaga dużej elastyczności i umiejętności nawigowania w dynamicznym środowisku, w którym wymagania, ograniczenia oraz zależności biznesowe wciąż ewoluują.

Zakres roli:

• Definiowanie docelowej architektury rozwiązań (Solution Architecture) oraz architektury korporacyjnej (Enterprise Architecture).
• Tworzenie planów architektonicznych (blueprints) oraz skrupulatne prowadzenie dokumentacji (Architecture Decision Records - ADR).
• Analiza dostępnych opcji projektowych, ewaluacja wariantów technologicznych oraz zarządzanie kompromisami (trade-offs).
• Zapewnienie zgodności projektów z rygorystycznymi wymogami regulacyjnymi i procesami walidacyjnymi.
• Prowadzenie i facylitacja warsztatów technicznych z interesariuszami klienta (stakeholders) oraz zespołami inżynierskimi.
• Dbanie o pełną spójność wymagań biznesowych, operacyjnych, technicznych oraz tych z zakresu bezpieczeństwa.

Wymagania:

• Silne doświadczenie (i umiejętności liderskie) w obszarze Solution & Enterprise Architecture.
• Zrozumienie i praktyka w procesach nadzoru architektonicznego (Architecture Governance) oraz pełnieniu roli Design Authority.
• Praktyczna umiejętność profesjonalnego tworzenia rejestrów decyzji architektonicznych (ADRs).
• Kluczowy wymóg: Bardzo dobra znajomość procesów walidacji GxP oraz wymogów związanych z rewalidacją systemów w środowiskach regulowanych.
• Biegłość w projektowaniu architektury chmurowej (cloud-native) oraz doświadczenie w modernizacji platform danych.
• Doskonałe umiejętności komunikacyjne i dokumentacyjne - zdolność jasnego przekazywania złożonych koncepcji technicznych biznesowi.
• Praktyczna znajomość języka angielskiego na poziomie min. B2/C1 umożliwiająca swobodną komunikację pisemną i ustną (codzienna współpraca z klientami i współpracownikami anglojęzycznymi).

Proponujemy:

• Pełną wyzwań współpracę B2B przy projekcie o dużej skali i wysokim poziomie złożoności.
• Rolę o strategicznym znaczeniu, z realnym wpływem na docelowy kształt kluczowych rozwiązań klienta.
• Partnerstwo z wysokiej klasy ekspertami w obszarze chmury i danych.

💡Nie przegap dopasowanych ofert!

Mamy wiele rekrutacji, a nowe projekty pojawiają się na bieżąco. Pamiętaj, że zaznaczając zgodę na przetwarzanie danych w celu przyszłych procesów, będziemy mogli zaprosić Cię do udziału w kolejnych procesach, dopasowanych do Twojego doświadczenia i oczekiwań!

P.S Zamierzamy kontaktować się z Tobą wyłącznie wtedy, kiedy będziemy mieli dla Ciebie ciekawe projekty, bez tej zgody nie będzie to możliwe.

Jak wygląda proces rekrutacyjny in4ge?

Nasz proces rekrutacyjny jest transparentny i skoncentrowany na znalezieniu odpowiedniego kandydata dla naszych klientów. Składając aplikację, możesz liczyć na nasz obiektywizm, szacunek i pełny profesjonalizm.

title: Senior iOS Engineer
description:
If you're a Senior iOS Developer who knows BLE inside out and likes code that talks to physical things, we want to talk. You'd join us on a freelance, time & material basis: you're paid for the hours you actually work on real client projects. The first three months are about figuring out if we're a good match. When things work out, and that depends on the work itself, the project pipeline, and business timing, there's a real path to our core team with a permanent contract and full benefits.

Why intent?

We've been designing and co-creating connected devices since 2008. Wearables, smart audio, health-tech hardware for clients like Oura and BOSE, backed by investors like a16z and Founders Fund. We're 60+ people, fully remote, and AI-native since before LinkedIn influencers discovered the term. We use AI every day, in actual work, not just in company decks. If your Swift has ever made a physical device do something it couldn't do before, you already get why we love what we do.

Who this role is NOT for

If you like being told exactly what to build every morning, opening Jira, closing Jira, and logging off at 17:01, we're probably not your people. We look for engineers who ask "why" before "how", challenge assumptions, and occasionally break things because they were trying something new. We're AI-native and we expect you to treat AI as a daily multiplier, not a gimmick. What we expect: ownership of what you touch, straight talk when things get complicated, and the kind of curiosity that makes you actually care about the device on the other end of your Bluetooth connection.

What you'll do

• Build and maintain iOS apps that communicate with hardware peripherals over BLE
• Take part in specifying, planning, and estimating new modules and features
• Write and maintain unit tests (XCTest, Quick/Nimble) with a TDD mindset
• Keep CI/CD pipelines in shape (GitHub Actions, Bitrise, Travis)
• Review pull requests and give your teammates feedback that actually helps
• Share what you learn: tech talks, internal docs, pair sessions, whatever fits
• Work side by side with firmware engineers, designers, QA, and PMs
• Use AI tools as part of your daily workflow, not as a party trick

How we work

Fully remote. We have a pet-friendly office in Warsaw and a coworking space in Gdansk if walls and coffee machines motivate you, but nobody will ask why you're not there. Working hours are flexible: most of the team operates between 10:00 and 18:00 CET, and that's when most meetings happen. Evening calls with US-based clients (up to ~20:00) are part of the rhythm, sometimes a couple of times a week, always planned ahead. You'll be part of the Mobile chapter for knowledge-sharing, and at the same time on a project squad led by a PM for day-to-day delivery.

What you'll get

• 90-180 PLN/h net B2B, depending on your experience
• Truly flexible hours: you organize your day
• Fully remote, with pet-friendly Warsaw office + Gdansk cowork if you want them
• Access to our internal knowledge-sharing: tech talks, experiments, side projects
• When the first 3 months work out, and that depends on the work, the project pipeline, and business timing, there's a real path to a permanent contract with a fixed monthly salary, 26 days paid leave, 10 sick days, Saltus medical care, and a training budget

No sugarcoating: during the freelance period there's no paid leave or medical benefits. Those come with the permanent contract, and we're transparent about that upfront.

Your first weeks

We aim to give you space to ramp up before jumping into live project work, but this is a real company with real deadlines: if the project needs you sooner, we'll make sure you have the support to hit the ground running. You'll get paired with a technical buddy and tackle progressively bigger tasks, so both sides can see how the collaboration feels. Feedback comes early and often, no one waits three months to tell you something isn't working. If it's great, you'll know. If something needs adjusting, you'll hear about it while there's still time to adjust.

Recruitment process

The entire process is in English. All interviews are recorded for internal evaluation purposes.

• Application with a few screening questions
• HR call, ~45 min, casual
• Technical meeting, ~90 min, with the technical team (may include live coding)
• Final feedback within a few days

Once we're in touch, you'll hear from us fast. We don't ghost and we don't drag.

One more thing

intent is an equal opportunity employer. We care about what you can do, not where you come from. Send us your CV and a few words about why this caught your eye. Bonus points if you share something you've built that made you proud.

Job requirements

What we're looking for

• 6+ years writing production Swift
• Strong, hands-on BLE integration experience (not "I read about it once")
• Structured concurrency in Swift: you know it, you use it
