title: Learning Facilitator & Client Consultant
description:
Location: Home-based in the UK – London, Manchester or Leeds - with regular travel across the UK and internationally as required.
Salary: £38,000 - £43,000 per annum, depending on experience

Contract: Permanent, full-time

Working pattern: We offer a fully flexible working environment
Annual leave: 25 days of annual leave per annum, plus 3 additional days over Christmas
Additional Benefits: Comprehensive Employee Assistance Programme (EAP)

The role

We are looking for an experienced Learning Facilitator & Client Consultant to join the Common Purpose team.

This is a role for someone who loves people, ideas and learning, and who can work with a client to understand what they need, help shape the right learning experience, facilitate it brilliantly, and connect what happens in the programme to what needs to change afterwards.

Our programmes are experiential. Participants learn by encountering different people and perspectives, exploring real situations, having conversations that may challenge their assumptions, reflecting and reframing based on what they have experienced, and considering what it means for them and their organisation. You will be involved across that journey: from understanding the client and shaping the design, through to creating the conditions for powerful learning and helping participants and clients translate that learning into practice.

The facilitator is at the heart of making that learning happen. But this is not simply a delivery role.

You will need more than strong presentation or group-management skills. You will need to understand how people learn, how to design meaningful experiences, and how to turn those experiences into insight and action. You will need to be comfortable exploring a client's learning need, contributing to programme design, working with colleagues and clients to shape an experience, and identifying what will make the programme valuable beyond the room.

You will also need to know when to provide structure and when to get out of the way; when to challenge and when to listen; when a group needs energy and when it needs space to think. And you will need to stay curious about what happens after the programme - what participants do differently, what clients need to see change, and how our work can contribute to that.

You will work with an extraordinary range of people — from young professionals to senior leaders and C-suite executives — across different sectors, generations, cultures and contexts. You will need to connect quickly with all of them, while being equally confident in a conversation about a client's needs, a programme design, or the impact we are trying to achieve.

One day you might be helping a client make sense of a complex organisational challenge and shaping an experience around it. The next, you might be facilitating a conversation between people who have never met. Another day might involve an immersive experience outside the classroom, followed by a conversation that helps participants understand what they have seen, what it means for their own practice and what they will do differently as a result.

You will bring the personality to connect with people, the facilitation craft to hold a room, the learning and design expertise to create meaningful experiences, and the client consultancy skills to connect those experiences to real organisational needs and impact.

What you’ll be doing

• Working with clients to understand their learning needs – asking the right questions, challenging assumptions where appropriate and translating organisational needs into meaningful learning experiences
• Contributing to learning design and proposals, helping shape programme journeys, learning objectives, activities and approaches that respond to client needs
• Designing and curating learning experiences – shaping programme journeys and identifying the ideas, perspectives, organisations, places and contributors that will make them distinctive and purposeful
• Sourcing and working with contributors – building relationships with interesting people and organisations, briefing them effectively and drawing out their contribution before, during and after programmes
• Contributing confidently to client pitches - explaining the thinking behind our approach and helping clients understand how experiential learning can address their needs
• Facilitating Common Purpose programmes - both in person and online, taking ownership of the quality of the learning experience
• Creating the conditions for experiential learning – building trust, encouraging participation and creating the right balance of safety, challenge and curiosity
• Bringing learning to life - through questioning, discussion, activities, reflection and interaction with expert subject matter contributors
• Reading and responding to the room - adapting activities, pace, questions and approach according to what the group needs
• Preparing, reviewing and improving delivery – developing facilitation plans and materials, contributing to team briefings and debriefs, and sharing learning and practice with colleagues

What you’ll bring

We are looking for someone who combines excellent facilitation skills with a strong understanding of how people learn.

You will be a confident and experienced facilitator, but you will also be curious about what makes a learning experience work. You will understand that great facilitation is not about delivering content; it is about designing and creating the conditions in which people can learn through experience, reflection, conversation and challenge.

You will bring:

• Strong facilitation experience – ideally five years or more of facilitating groups, learning experiences or programmes
• Understanding of experiential learning and pedagogy – you know how people learn through experience, reflection, dialogue, challenge and application
• Learning design capability – you can see how individual experiences and activities contribute to a wider learning journey and can design with the participant experience in mind
• Learning consultancy skills – you are comfortable exploring a client’s needs, asking probing questions, challenging a brief and helping shape the problem before jumping to a solution
• Client confidence – you are comfortable presenting ideas, contributing to pitches and speaking credibly with clients and senior stakeholders
• Energy, curiosity and external orientation –
you are naturally interested in people, ideas and the world around you, and enjoy discovering perspectives and experiences that bring learning to life
• Strong interpersonal and group skills – you can read a room, listen well, ask powerful questions and bring different voices into the conversation
• Confidence with challenge and complexity – you can facilitate difficult conversations, navigate difference and create productive discomfort without losing trust
• Adaptability and judgement – you can work with a plan while knowing when to change it, improvise or take a conversation somewhere unexpected
• A reflective approach to your own practice – you actively seek feedback, learn from experience and are interested in continually improving how you facilitate, design and consult

All applicants must also

• Have excellent written English, oral communication and interpersonal skills
• Be confident facilitating both in person and online
• Be comfortable working independently while also contributing actively to a collaborative team
• Be able to manage a varied workload, multiple programmes and competing priorities in a fast-paced environment
• Be willing and able to travel within the Uk and globally for programme delivery, including occasional early mornings, evenings and short periods away from home
• Be confident and proficient in the use of Microsoft Office, Zoom and other digital collaboration tools
• Be committed to Common Purpose’s independent and non-aligned approach to programme experiences
• Be able to demonstrate your facilitation experience. This might include examples of programmes you have facilitated, participant or client feedback, testimonials, recordings of your facilitation, qualifications or other evidence of your practice

What we offer

• Purpose – the opportunity to work on programmes designed to create meaningful change for individuals, organisations and communities
• Variety – exposure to different sectors, generations, cultures, organisations and perspectives through your work
• Growth – continual development of your facilitation practice, alongside access to internal learning and development opportunities
• Responsibility – meaningful ownership of programme delivery from the outset
• Flexibility – a remote-first and flexible working environment
• A global network – the opportunity to work with colleagues, participants and partners across different countries and contexts

About Common Purpose

Common Purpose is a global non-profit organisation that develops people to navigate the complexity, influence and competing interests that shape the world around them.

Our work is built around three disciplines:

• Navigating complexity – sensing, interpreting and acting on what is changing in the world.
• Navigating influence – staying accountable to the consequences of the power you hold.
• Navigating legitimacy – having, and granting others, the ground and courage to challenge across boundaries that are not theirs to control.

We bring these disciplines to life through experiential learning. Participants encounter different perspectives, enter unfamiliar environments, engage with people and organisations beyond their usual experience, and work through real questions and situations. Our programmes create the conditions for people to test their assumptions, understand the consequences of their decisions and develop the confidence to act differently.

We bring together people from different sectors, backgrounds, generations and perspectives. Our facilitators play a critical role in creating the experiences and conversations through which this learning happens.

Over 90,000 professionals and nearly 75,000 students worldwide have taken part in Common Purpose programmes.

Next Steps

If you are an experienced facilitator who enjoys working with people, navigating complexity and creating learning experiences that stay with participants long after a programme ends, we would love to hear from you.

Please send us your CV and a cover letter explaining why you are interested in the role and what you would bring to Common Purpose.

We particularly welcome evidence of your facilitation practice, such as participant or client testimonials, examples of programmes you have delivered, relevant qualifications or a recording of you facilitating.

Common Purpose is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from people from all backgrounds and will consider candidates based on the relevance of their skills, experience and potential.

If you have any access requirements during the recruitment process, please contact us at .

Salary: £38,000 - £43,000 per annum, depending on experience

About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Available Locations: Austin, TX or New York

About the Role

Cloudflare is looking for a bright, proactive, and detail-oriented Executive Assistant to support three leaders in our Developer GTM organization. We are looking for a dynamic and dedicated candidate who is comfortable with multi-tasking and prioritization in a fast-paced, product-first environment with close attention to detail, accuracy, and timeliness.

Responsibilities

• Calendar & Conflict Management: Proactively manage complex calendars with a strong understanding of business priorities. Independently resolve scheduling conflicts and anticipate meeting requests and logistical needs before they are explicitly stated.
• Travel & Logistics: Manage and coordinate complex international and domestic travel, including visa and passport needs, as well as end-to-end logistical arrangements for executives and teams.
• Executive Support & Business Context: Develop a deeper understanding of the managers' roles, our products, and the broader market and context for Cloudflare. Serve as a trusted gatekeeper who can confidently answer routine questions on behalf of the executives.
• Expenses Meeting Coordination: Prepare and manage expense reports..
• Projects & Process Improvement: Contribute significantly to ad-hoc/special projects. Recognize where operational processes can be improved and actively suggest and implement those process improvements.
• Meetings & Event Planning: Coordinate and assist with large meetings, external stakeholders, and event planning with precision.

Requirements

• 6+ years experience as an Administrative Assistant, in Ops, or equivalent experience.
• Scope & Judgment: A seasoned professional with proven experience handling problems of diverse scope and demonstrating excellent judgment in selecting administrative and operational methods.
• Proactiveness & Autonomy: Strong sense of urgency, proactiveness, and the ability to manage your own time with limited or no supervision.
• Communication & Networking: Strong written and verbal communication skills; ability to network and build strong relationships with executives and team members.
• Organizational Skills: Exceptional organizational skills and attention to detail.
• Mindset: A "no task is too small" attitude combined with the strategic mindset needed to anticipate executive needs.

Drive: Experience working in a tech and AI-native, product-led environment.

Compensation

Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location and level.

Estimated Salary for New York: $114,000 - 157,000

Equity

This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.

What Makes Cloudflare Special?

We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

Project Galileo: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.

Athenian Project: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.

1.1.1.1: We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.

Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!

Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs. More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.

This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.

All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment. If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at hr@cloudflare.com or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.

title: Customer Value Partner, Enterprise - NHS Accounts
description:
Every team has AI. Few have mastered it. Humans were built to adapt, but AI is now moving faster than most workforces can.

Multiverse is the AI adoption layer: the missing link between the AI tools that companies have invested in and the people expected to use them.

Our ambition is to put AI capability in every worker’s hands. Apprenticeships got us started: we’ve trained over a third of the UK’s data and AI apprentices, worked with a third of the FTSE 100, and generated £2bn+ in verified ROI. Now Mastry, our new adaptive learning platform, takes that further, guiding a company’s AI workforce transformation from start to finish. Mae, our AI guide inside Mastry, is a real-time AI agent that thinks, speaks, listens and sees, working alongside the tools you already use, like Claude and Copilot.

We closed our latest fundraising round in April 2026, with $500m+ raised in total from VC partners including Index Ventures, General Catalyst, Schroders Capital and Lightspeed. With a $2.1bn valuation, we are Europe’s first EdTech double unicorn, and we are just getting started.

If you want to shape how the workforce wins in the AI era, come and join us.

At Multiverse, we are building a tech-first institution that combines work and learning to close the critical skills gap. The Customer Value Partner (CVP) is the primary architect of this transformation.

In the Enterprise segment, you are the single point of accountability for our customers from the moment a contract is signed. You will lead the end-to-end journey - ensuring every launch is flawless, every program delivers measurable business impact, and every partnership has a clear, data-backed roadmap for expansion. This is a role for an operator who is as comfortable influencing a Director-level stakeholder as they are navigating the data-driven technicalities of a program launch.

Once here, you will:

• Independently lead the end-to-end customer journey for a portfolio of Enterprise accounts, handling greater ambiguity to move customers from initial sales handover to long-term value realization and renewal.
• Build and defend credible, multi-threaded relationships across HR, executive sponsors, and business leaders; navigating internal dynamics to ensure Multiverse is logically embedded in their digital and talent strategy.
• Partner with executive sponsors to translate complex learning outcomes into specific business impact narratives, selecting and differentiating information to achieve high-level engagement from senior leadership.
• Independently build 12-month Mutual Action Plans and Discovery Workshops, establishing the clear governance, success metrics, and operating rhythms required to drive consistent momentum.
• Oversee launch excellence and the critical "First 90 Days," collaborating methodically with the central Fulfilment team to ensure technical readiness and cohort setup do not create long-term account drag.
• Lead structured Executive Business Reviews (EBRs) that move beyond data reporting to tell a compelling story of ROI, navigating difficult conversations with sensitivity and adapting responses based on customer emotion.
• Synthesize delivery outcomes into compelling proof by correlating Multiverse learner data with client-provided business KPIs to justify further strategic investment.
• Proactively identify expansion and upsell triggers, contextualizing why these opportunities matter within the customer’s specific business environment to build "ready-to-close" commercial cases.
• Methodically experiment with playbooks and templates to improve how the work is done, acting as a "source of wisdom" for the wider team and the internal voice of the customer.
• Align Delivery, Product, and Support teams to remove barriers, triangulating patterns from multiple sources to improve the overall Enterprise customer experience.

About You:

• You bring 3+ years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, or Consulting, with a proven history of managing and growing high-stakes Enterprise B2B relationships.
• You have proven experience of working within the NHS, or managing NHS accounts or contracts as a supplier or partner, with a solid understanding of how NHS organisations make decisions, buy and work with external providers
• You are a natural project leader who can leverage internal teams (such as Fulfilment and Admissions) to deliver a seamless customer experience during high-stakes implementation phases.
• You are data-fluent. You don’t just report on metrics; you interpret complex datasets and correlate Multiverse delivery data with a client’s internal KPIs to build a technical ROI case.
• You have a "commercial nose" for growth. You understand the mechanics of Net Revenue Retention (NRR) and can build "ready-to-close" expansion cases backed by value proof and mutual action plans.
• You are "Director-ready." You can hold the room during an EBR and navigate difficult conversations with a balance of empathy and data-backed logic.
• You thrive in an environment where the CRM (Salesforce) is the source of truth, maintaining high standards of data hygiene to ensure account health is always visible.

Benefits

• Time off: 27 days holiday (including 3 winter shutdown days) and bank holidays, plus 5 extra days off (1 life event, 2 volunteer days and 2 summer shutdown days).
• Health and wellbeing: Bupa private medical insurance, a medical cash back plan, therapy through Spill and gym access through Wellhub.
• Equity for all: we believe that when Multiverse wins, we all win, which is why every permanent employee receives share options.
• Financial security: life insurance at 3x salary, a workplace pension with 4% contribution from us, Cycle to Work and a Tech Scheme.
• Family support: enhanced maternity and paternity leave, adoption and shared parental leave, paid leave after pregnancy loss, and a workplace nursery scheme.
• Hybrid working: 3 days a week in the office - except for Coaches & Instructors who come into the office 1 day per month. Plus 10 days a year to work from anywhere.
• Work perks: quarterly team socials, company-wide events, happy hours, lunch delivered to the office once a week, fully stocked snack bar and a drinks fridge!

Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

We’re an equal opportunities employer. And proud of it. Every applicant and employee is afforded the same opportunities regardless of race, colour, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. This will never change. Read our Equality, Diversity & Inclusion policy here.

Our Commitment to Safeguarding

Multiverse is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of our learners. We expect all employees to share this commitment and adhere to our Safeguarding Policy, our Prevent Policy and all other Multiverse company policies. Successful applicants will be required to undertake at least a Basic check via the Disclosure Barring Service (DBS).

For roles that will involve a Regulated Activity, successful applicants must also undergo an Enhanced DBS check, including a Children’s Barred List check and a Prohibition Order check. Roles involving Regulated Activity may interact with vulnerable groups, therefore are exempt from the Rehabilitation of Offenders Act 1974 meaning applicants are required to declare any convictions, cautions, reprimands, and final warnings.

Bei Bosch gestalten wir Zukunft mit hochwertigen Technologien und Dienstleistungen, die Begeisterung wecken und das Leben der Menschen verbessern. Unser Versprechen an unsere Mitarbeiterinnen und Mitarbeiter steht dabei felsenfest: Wir wachsen gemeinsam, haben Freude an unserer Arbeit und inspirieren uns gegenseitig. Willkommen bei Bosch.

Die Robert Bosch GmbH freut sich auf deine Bewerbung!

Stellenbeschreibung

Du siehst in der Optimierung von Materialflüssen und der Digitalisierung von Logistikprozessen eine spannende Herausforderung? Dann nutze dein Praktikum bei uns, um aktiv die Effizienz von morgen mitzugestalten und unsere Materialversorgung zu revolutionieren!

• Du wirkst aktiv bei der Durchführung und Stabilisierung von Projekten zur Digitalisierung und Automatisierung des Materialflusses mit und begleitest dabei die Einführung intelligenter und autonomer Transportsysteme.
• Weiterhin wirkst du bei der Planung und Umsetzung von Optimierungsprojekten in der innerbetrieblichen Materialversorgung mit, beispielsweise bei der Auslegung von Lagerbereichen, Kanban- und Milkrun-Systemen.
• Regelmäßige Auswertungen erstellst du, um Materialflusskennzahlen wie Plan For Every Part, Mitarbeiterauslastung und Liefertreue präzise zu verfolgen und Optimierungspotenziale aufzudecken.

Qualifikationen

• Ausbildung: Studium im Bereich Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, Betriebswirtschaftslehre, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder vergleichbar mit Schwerpunkt Logistik
• Erfahrung und Know-how: idealerweise erste Erfahrungen in der Logistik
• Persönlichkeit und Arbeitsweise: du trittst freundlich und sicher auf, hast einen hohen Qualitätsanspruch, bist motiviert und teamfähig, zeichnest dich durch dein Organisationstalent aus und behältst auch in turbulenten Situationen die Ruhe und den Überblick
• Arbeitsalltag: deine Präsenz vor Ort ist erforderlich
• Sprachen: verhandlungssicheres Deutsch und gutes Englisch

Zusätzliche Informationen

Beginn: ab Februar 2027
Dauer: 6 Monate (ausschließlich Pflichtpraktikum gem. SPO)

Voraussetzung für das Praktikum ist die Immatrikulation an einer Hochschule. Bitte füge deiner Bewerbung deinen Lebenslauf, deinen aktuellen Notenspiegel, eine aktuelle Immatrikulationsbescheinigung, deine Prüfungsordnung sowie ggf. eine gültige Arbeits- und Aufenthaltserlaubnis bei.

Vielfalt und Inklusion sind für uns keine Trends, sondern fest verankert in unserer Unternehmenskultur. Daher freuen wir uns über alle Bewerbungen: unabhängig von Geschlecht, Alter, Behinderung, Religion, ethnischer Herkunft oder sexueller Identität.

description:

Facilities Coordinator

• Full-time

Company Description

Netcompany is one of Europe’s leading technology partners, with more than 9,500 colleagues delivering digital solutions for governments, critical industries and businesses across Europe. We take responsibility for the full journey, from strategy and development to daily operations. As Europe’s leader in sovereign AI, we build technology on Europe’s own terms.

Job Description

Netcompany is seeking a proactive and service-minded Facilities Coordinator to support the day-to-day delivery of effective, safe and well-functioning workplace operations. The role coordinates operational activities, suppliers, compliance documentation and financial administration in line with Group Facility Management standards, processes and templates.

You will work closely with the Facility Manager and internal stakeholders to ensure consistent colleague and client experience. The role is hands-on and coordinating in nature; significant operational, compliance, supplier and financial matters are escalated to the Facility Manager.

Key responsibilities

Workplace operations

• Coordinate day-to-day workplace operations and resolve operational issues in a timely and service-oriented manner.
• Coordinate planned and reactive maintenance and follow up on open actions through to completion.
• Liaise with landlords, managing agents, contractors and suppliers on operational matters.
• Support workplace onboarding and office events in cooperation with relevant internal stakeholders.
• Apply Group Facility Management standards, processes, templates and reporting requirements consistently.

Suppliers, service quality and finance

• Coordinate contractors and third-party suppliers and follow up on service delivery, SLAs and KPIs.
• Monitor service issues and corrective actions and escalate significant performance or commercial matters to the Facility Manager.
• Support supplier reviews, procurement activities and contract administration in line with Group Facility Management processes.
• Manage purchase orders, invoice processing and expenditure tracking, ensuring that costs are correctly documented and allocated.
• Support budget follow-up and identify opportunities to improve service quality and value for money.

Health, safety and compliance

• Coordinate day-to-day Health & Safety activities in accordance with local requirements and Group Facility Management standards.
• Coordinate contractor inductions, permits to work, workplace inspections, DSE assessments and risk assessments, where applicable.
• Support incident and near-miss investigations and monitor agreed corrective actions through to completion.
• Review and maintain relevant contractor and compliance documentation, including RAMS and statutory records, where applicable.
• Maintain accurate documentation and evidence to support internal governance, audits and relevant ISO management systems.

Reporting and stakeholders

• Maintain operational records and provide regular reporting on supplier performance, compliance, Health & Safety and expenditure.
• Prepare clear colleague communications relating to workplace operations, maintenance and Health & Safety.
• Build effective working relationships across Facility Management, HR, IT, Finance, Procurement and other business functions.

Qualifications

What we expect from you

• You are service-oriented, structured and proactive, with the ability to maintain an overview while following through on operational details. You thrive in a dynamic environment, take ownership of your tasks and make sound decisions within established processes and escalation routes.
• Relevant experience from Facilities Management, Workplace Operations, Office Management or a similar operational environment.
• Strong organisational and prioritisation skills, with a consistent focus on follow-up and completion.
• Experience coordinating contractors and third-party suppliers.
• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
• A proactive, practical and solution-oriented approach to day-to-day issues.
• Experience with purchase orders, invoice processing, expenditure tracking and operational reporting.
• Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office, including Outlook, Word, Excel and PowerPoint.
• Fluency in English; relevant local language skills may be required depending on the office location.

Desirable qualifications and experience

• Experience supporting Health & Safety compliance in an office environment.
• Experience with SLAs, KPIs, supplier reviews or contract administration.
• Experience supporting ISO management systems or internal and external audits.
• A relevant Health & Safety qualification, such as IOSH Managing Safely, or willingness to obtain one.

Additional Information

Build on your experience and keep developing

Your development continues through the responsibility you take, the projects you lead and the people you learn from. As part of a structured career model, you’ll build on the experience you already bring, supported by a personal mentor from the leadership group who can help guide your professional development, career direction and personal goals.

Be part of a shared community

Community is built through the way we work together. You’ll join teams where collaboration, trust and support are part of everyday work. We bring together colleagues with different backgrounds, identities, cultures and experiences, ensuring everyone is met with respect and has equal opportunities to develop and thrive.

Driven by responsible digitalisation

We believe digitalisation creates the most value when it is done responsibly. We build solutions that are secure, transparent, and designed to create lasting impact for people, businesses, and society. Responsibility is embedded in how we design, develop, and deliver every solution.

Benefits include

• 25 days’ holiday
• Private Medical Health care via Vitality
• Pension contribution, Life Assurance
• Professional certifications supported as part of learning and development.
• A range of retail discounts to enhance your lifestyle, encompassing restaurants, supermarkets, travel, leisure activities and health and well-being services.
• Access to our Employee Resource Groups, our groups represent diverse backgrounds and provide a platform for colleagues to connect, learn, and support one another.

Company information

At Netcompany, we pride ourselves on our entrepreneurial spirit and our capacity for doing things differently. Our culture is built on fostering low bureaucracy, emphasizing high agility and promoting flexibility, enabling everyone to contribute their best.

Our journey began in the UK with the acquisition of Hunter Macdonald in 2017. As one of Northern Europe's most accomplished IT companies, we have expanded our headcount globally to 7400+ employees and have offices in UK, Denmark, Norway, Poland, Holland and Vietnam.

Netcompany is committed to providing an inclusive and barrier-free recruitment process for anyone wishing to apply for a job with us. We operate a Disability Confident Interview Scheme which means that we offer guaranteed interviews to all applicants with a disability who meet the minimum criteria for a role. Applicants are asked to opt in, so please let us know if you wish your application to be considered under this scheme.

If you need any reasonable adjustments or extra support during the recruitment process, please contact us at [email protected].

Company Description

Netcompany is one of Europe’s leading technology partners, with more than 9,500 colleagues delivering digital solutions for governments, critical industries and businesses across Europe. We take responsibility for the full journey, from strategy and development to daily operations. As Europe’s leader in sovereign AI, we build technology on Europe’s own terms.

AI is a natural part of how we build solutions. We use it in business-critical systems through a proven delivery model where human judgement, transparency, security and accountability matter from design to daily operations. AI-related roles include roles clearly involving AI, machine learning, data science, generative AI, LLMs, AI automation, AI governance or AI architecture.

Job Description

Help shape the success of a complex data migration by investigating data quality, preparing source data and validating that what moves is complete and faithful. Working across multiple organisations, you'll turn unfamiliar datasets into clear, evidence-based findings that guide migration decisions.

Key Responsibilities

You'll join a data migration programme where your analysis informs mapping, cleansing and acceptance decisions, working alongside data engineers, data owners and client stakeholders.

• Investigate unfamiliar datasets to understand their structure, content, relationships and variation across organisations.
• Identify and explain data quality issues, trace them to source records, mappings or transformations, and quantify their impact on migration.
• Design repeatable comparisons and reconciliation checks to validate that migrated data is complete, consistent and faithful.
• Write reusable SQL and Python scripts for profiling, exception detection and validation, using Azure Databricks, Git and dbt where relevant.
• Communicate findings clearly to technical and non-technical audiences, using Excel and Power BI or Tableau to present evidence and track issues.

Qualifications

You bring a strong analytical background and a careful, evidence-based approach to working with data.

• Experience profiling unfamiliar datasets and tracing data quality issues to their root cause in a migration context.
• Strong SQL skills for complex joins, window functions, anomaly detection and source-to-target reconciliation.
• Working knowledge of Python, Azure Databricks or Spark SQL, and familiarity with Git and dbt.
• Ability to present evidence, scale and business impact clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
• A responsible approach to data management, ethics and privacy.

title: Business Analyst – Life Insurance
description:
Salary: 90 - 140 PLN per hour (B2B)

Do zespołu naszego klienta, jednej z dużych organizacji działających w sektorze ubezpieczeniowym, poszukujemy doświadczonego Business Analysta, który dobrze zna specyfikę ubezpieczeń na życie (Life Insurance).

Szukamy osoby, która nie tylko rozumie procesy biznesowe w branży ubezpieczeniowej, ale przede wszystkim brała aktywny udział w projektowaniu, budowie lub rozwoju rozwiązań IT wspierających obszar ubezpieczeń na życie.

Będziesz współpracować z zespołami biznesowymi i technologicznymi, analizując wymagania oraz wspierając rozwój systemów i procesów ubezpieczeniowych.

Co oferujemy?

• Długoterminową współpracę w oparciu o kontrakt B2B.
• Możliwość pracy hybrydowej
• Udział w projektach rozwijających rozwiązania IT dla sektora ubezpieczeniowego.
• Współpracę z doświadczonymi zespołami biznesowymi i technologicznymi.
• Realny wpływ na kształt rozwijanych systemów i procesów.
• Prywatną opiekę medyczną Lux Med oraz kartę MultiSport.

Requirements:

• Life Insurance
• Claims Management
• Policy Administration
• Underwriting
• BPMN 
• Jira
• Confluence

• Minimum 3–5 lat doświadczenia w analizie biznesowej, w tym udokumentowanego doświadczenia projektowego w obszarze Life Insurance – warunek konieczny.
• Praktycznego udziału w projektach związanych z budową, wdrażaniem lub rozwojem systemów dla ubezpieczeń na życie.
• Bardzo dobrej znajomości procesów charakterystycznych dla ubezpieczeń na życie, np.:
• obsługa cyklu życia polisy (Policy Administration),
• zawieranie i obsługa umów ubezpieczenia,
• ocena ryzyka (Underwriting),
• obsługa świadczeń (Claims Management),
• naliczanie składek i rozliczenia.
• Doświadczenia w zbieraniu wymagań i przekładaniu potrzeb biznesowych na wymagania funkcjonalne.
• Znajomości BPMN oraz umiejętności modelowania procesów biznesowych.
• Doświadczenia w pracy z dokumentacją analityczną (user stories, use cases, BRD/FRD).
• Znajomości Jira i Confluence.
• Doświadczenia we współpracy z zespołami IT w metodykach Agile/Scrum.
• Samodzielności, analitycznego myślenia i dobrej komunikacji z biznesem.

Mile widziane

• Doświadczenie w projektach transformacji cyfrowej lub modernizacji systemów ubezpieczeniowych.
• Znajomość systemów klasy Policy Administration System (PAS).
• Doświadczenie w integracji systemów ubezpieczeniowych z innymi aplikacjami.
• Znajomość UML, SQL lub podstaw analizy systemowej.
• Doświadczenie w automatyzacji procesów biznesowych w branży ubezpieczeniowej.

Nice to have:

• UML
• SQL
• Policy Administration System

Daily tasks:

• Zbieranie, analiza i dokumentowanie wymagań biznesowych oraz funkcjonalnych.
• Udział w projektowaniu i rozwoju rozwiązań IT dla obszaru ubezpieczeń na życie.
• Analiza procesów związanych z obsługą polis, zawieraniem umów, oceną ryzyka ubezpieczeniowego (underwriting) oraz obsługą świadczeń.
• Modelowanie procesów biznesowych i identyfikowanie obszarów do optymalizacji.
• Przygotowywanie specyfikacji funkcjonalnych, user stories, przypadków użycia oraz kryteriów akceptacji.
• Prowadzenie warsztatów i konsultacji z interesariuszami biznesowymi.
• Współpraca z developerami, testerami, architektami oraz Product Ownerami.
• Wspieranie zespołu w weryfikacji wdrażanych rozwiązań pod kątem zgodności z wymaganiami biznesowymi.
• Udział w testach akceptacyjnych (UAT) oraz analizie zgłaszanych zmian.

title: Google Cloud & Knowledge Catalog Engineer
description:
Xebia is a global AI-first, digital transformation, and engineering partner. With over 25 years of experience and a team of 5,000 professionals across 16 countries, we help organizations design and build scalable products, platforms, and data-driven solutions.

We specialize in Artificial Intelligence, Data and Cloud, Intelligent Automation, and Digital Products, combining deep technical expertise with a strong focus on engineering excellence and a people-first culture.

In the CEE region, we’re a team of nearly 1,000 experts delivering modern applications, data platforms, and AI solutions for clients such as Millennium, ING, Play, Edenred, Arabian Drilling, FedEx, Leroy Merlin, Truecaller, Volotea, Schmitz Cargobull, and many, many more. We work with leading technologies including AWS, Azure, GCP, Databricks, and Snowflake, and combine strong engineering culture with a consulting mindset and a continuous focus on growth and knowledge sharing.

You will be:

• Designing, configuring, implementing, and enhancing the Google Knowledge Catalog platform.
• Developing integrations supporting automated metadata acquisition and synchronization.
• Building and maintaining solutions for metadata enrichment and lifecycle management.
• Designing and implementing data lineage and impact analysis capabilities.
• Integrating the platform with enterprise access management and authorization mechanisms.
• Defining and implementing Infrastructure as Code standards and deployment automation practices.
• Developing technical solutions supporting governance processes and data products.
• Conducting technical analyses, proof of concepts, and development activities.
• Implementing monitoring, reporting, and operational control mechanisms.
• Preparing technical, operational, and maintenance documentation.
• Supporting platform handover, operational readiness, and knowledge transfer activities.
• Collaborating with business analysts, governance teams, and platform stakeholders.

Your profile:

• Experience designing and implementing solutions on Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
• Experience with platform configuration and system integration.
• Experience developing enterprise data management or metadata management solutions.
• Understanding of Data Governance and metadata management concepts.
• Experience implementing APIs and system integrations.
• Experience with Infrastructure as Code and deployment automation.
• Experience preparing technical documentation.
• Ability to perform proof-of-concept and technical analysis activities.
• Understanding of access management and authorization concepts.
• Strong problem-solving and communication skills.
• Experience working in multidisciplinary project teams.

Work from the European Union region and a work permit are required.

Nice to have:

• Hands-on experience with Google Knowledge Catalog.
• Experience implementing data lineage solutions.
• Knowledge of cloud monitoring and observability practices.
• Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices.
• Experience in regulated industries.
• Experience supporting production handover and operational readiness processes.
• Experience conducting technical training and knowledge transfer sessions.

Recruitment Process:

CV review – HR call – Interview – Client Interview – Decision

group: vistulo|senior java backend engineer (core java, trading systems)
title: Senior Java Backend Engineer (Core Java, Trading Systems)
description:
Join the Java Engineering Team at a top N. American Bank

Are you a Java engineer who enjoys working on large scale and high performance software? Do you love working with smart people on meaningful technology? Want to work in capital markets on financial trading systems? If so, read on.

The Role at a Glance

• Senior Java Backend Engineer
• Fully remote for a top N. American bank (for residents of Poland or Romania)
• Openings on multiple teams in the capital markets division (prime brokerage, platform team)
• Part of the core team - this is not a legacy support role or an outsourced B team

We’re hiring experienced backend engineers (6+ years) to join a major N. American bank — directly supporting the development of financial trading systems. This is not a legacy maintenance or support role — you’ll be part of the core product team, building highly-performant, low-latency systems used across the firm.

Are you a passionate Java developer who thrives on solving complex problems in low-latency, high-throughput trading systems? Join us and work on interesting financial system engineering problems.

Why Join Us?

• Work on a large-scale, low-latency trading system processing millions of daily transactions.
• No Legacy: Join an actively developed system — the engineers who built it originally are still on the team.
• Collaborate with a world-class team of developers across North America and Europe.
• Enjoy the stability of a long-term, fully remote role that only a bank can offer.

A successful candidate will be a very strong programmer with current Java development experience. They must also be curious, open-minded, and desire to learn new things. English proficiency is a must.

This role is for developers who excel at programming core Java from the ground up, not just integrating frameworks or APIs. If you’re fascinated by understanding systems ‘under the hood,’ this role is for you. Successful candidates enjoy geeking out about data structures and debugging application performance issues.

This is a fully remote backend Java development role for a developer in Poland or Romania. You will be working through a Polish company that will provide the support and administrative assistance to make you successful in the role. We are looking for people to join the team long-term.

Different teams have different working hour arrangements. For all roles, to ensure efficient onboarding, you’ll work in sync with the American team during US Eastern business hours for the first two months. Working this way maximizes your time overlap for answering questions, which means you can learn quickly. That means working until 21:00 CET. After that, some teams offer more flexibility your schedule can shift closer to standard Polish business hours.

Only open to residents of Poland or Romania. Citizens and legal residents with permission to work in Poland or Romania are welcome.

What we offer

• Work that matters in the financial domain: Work on a trading system at an established financial institution, processing millions of transactions daily.
• Professional growth: Collaborate with smart, highly capable developers in a supportive and challenging environment.
• Direct collaboration: You will work directly with the client team in North America and in Europe.
• 1st-tier work: This is not a technical support or legacy maintenance role. The system is functional and is actively being built and you will take part in updating it. The people who built the system are still part of the team.
• Long-term commitment: This is not a fixed-scope or fixed-term outsourcing role; we value people who want to grow and contribute long-term.
• Flexibility & remote work: Fully remote position with increasing schedule flexibility post-onboarding.
• Competitive Compensation: Above-average pay and ample time-off options.

Responsibilities

• Design and implement robust software solutions for the bank’s trading systems using core Java (versions vary from team to team, and include 8, 17 and 21).
• Understand, develop, and improve the subsystems used by other teams in the trading platform.
• Create thorough test cases to ensure software stability and reliability.
• Collaborate with operations teams regarding building new features and improving existing functionality.
• Support production issues, including root-cause analysis and diagnosis.

Requirements

Must have

• Strong understanding of programming concepts, including algorithms, complexity, and data structures.
• Good knowledge of the data structures in the Java standard library - both breadth and internals.
• Experience building distributed service-based applications based on message queues.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, to effectively diagnose production performance issues measured in microseconds.
• Open mind, curiosity, and a strong desire to learn new technologies and business domains.
• Ability to clearly explain non-trivial systems and algorithms.
• Ability to follow and understand technical conversations.
• Know when and how to ask questions that speed up learning.
• Ability to align your working schedule to US Eastern business hours.

Nice to have

• Experience with financial markets and trading systems.
• Knowledge of AWS systems.
• Experience with Spring boot (some teams).
• Experience with JVM tuning (some teams).
• Experience working remotely with North American firms.
• A computer science degree from a top school.

The recruitment process

• Submit your CV.
• Answer a few written questions and a short programming exercise which you can do at your own pace.
• Participate in a three-stage interview process:
• Discuss your experience and skills.
• Solve verbal algorithm problems (focus on clarity and understanding).
• Tackle live coding challenges (no trick questions).

No take-home assignments – we respect your time.

Successful candidates will need to pass a standard background check.

title: Senior Developer (C# .NET / Azure)
description:
We are looking for a Senior Developer to join our Global Banking team, providing technology support for the full range of Investment Banking and Capital Markets products. You will help build large-scale content management and messaging services, leveraging Azure and other Microsoft products.

Please note that working from the office 3 days per week is required.

Responsibilities

• Provide technology support for Investment Banking and Capital Markets products
• Design and build large-scale content management and messaging services
• Leverage Azure and other Microsoft products to deliver robust solutions
• Collaborate within a distributed (onshore/offshore) Agile team
• Apply object-oriented design principles (SOLID) across development tasks
• Build and deploy applications following Microsoft best-practice coding standards
• Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines for streamlined delivery
• Contribute to web front-end development across the full stack
• Participate in code reviews and ensure high-quality deliverables

Requirements

• Degree qualification in an appropriate subject, plus 5-8 years of commercial experience (Financial Services preferred)
• Background in Agile/Extreme programming and a history of working in a distributed (onshore/offshore) team
• Understanding of object-oriented design principles (SOLID)
• Expertise in C# .NET, Azure and SQL Server 2019, including ASP .NET and Microsoft best-practice coding standards
• Proficiency in building and deploying applications using Microsoft Visual Studio, GitLab Source Control and GitLab CI/CD pipelines
• Knowledge of web front-end technologies including HTML, CSS and JavaScript & Ajax
• English proficiency at B2 level or higher

Nice to have

• Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code using Terraform (or similar)
• Capability to write Unit and Automated integration tests in a TDD approach
• Background in Financial Services
• Skills in ReactJS and TypeScript

We offer/Benefits
We gather like-minded people:

• Engineering community of industry professionals
• Friendly team and enjoyable working environment
• Flexible schedule and opportunity to work remotely within Poland
• Chance to work abroad for up to 60 days annually
• Business-driven relocation opportunities

We provide growth opportunities:

• Outstanding career roadmap
• Leadership development, career advising, soft skills, and well-being programs
• Certification (GCP, Azure, AWS)
• Unlimited access to LinkedIn Learning, Get Abstract, Cloud Guru
• English classes

We cover it all:

• Stable income (Employment Contract or B2B)
• Participation in the Employee Stock Purchase Plan
• Benefits package (health insurance, multisport, shopping vouchers)
• Strategically located offices featuring entertainment and relaxation zones, table tennis and football, free snacks, fantastic coffee, and more
• Referral bonuses
• Corporate, social and well-being events

Please, note:

• The set of bonuses might vary based on the role you apply for – specifics will be discussed with our recruiter during the general interview.
• We will reach out to selected candidates exclusively.

EPAM is a leading global provider of digital platform engineering and development services. We are committed to having a positive impact on our customers, our employees, and our communities. We embrace a dynamic and inclusive culture. Here you will collaborate with multi-national teams, contribute to a myriad of innovative projects that deliver the most creative and cutting-edge solutions, and have an opportunity to continuously learn and grow. No matter where you are located, you will join a dedicated, creative, and diverse community that will help you discover your fullest potential.

title: Architekt Kotlin/Java
description:
Kim jest H2B Group?

Jesteśmy firmą konsultingową, która pomaga klientom w automatyzacji procesów biznesowych przy pomocy AI, a specjalistom IT rozwijać karierę w modelu B2B. Oferujemy projekty z branż takich jak fintech, medtech, edutech czy automatyka przemysłowa. Dzięki ścisłej współpracy wspieramy rozwój naszych klientów poprzez dostarczanie szybkich i mierzalnych efektów, jednocześnie zapewniając specjalistom IT możliwości rozwoju kariery i zdobywania cennego doświadczenia.

Dlaczego warto z nami współpracować?

Elastyczność – Wybierasz projekty dopasowane do swoich umiejętności i zainteresowań, z możliwością zmiany w ramach naszej firmy lub grupy Euvic, której jesteśmy częścią.

Przejrzystość – Masz jasne zasady współpracy i pełną transparentność wynagrodzenia oraz warunków.

Szybkość działania – Dzięki naszej efektywności szybko znajdziesz lub zmienisz projekt, który idealnie odpowiada Twoim kompetencjom.

Możliwość rozwoju – Pracujesz przy innowacyjnych projektach, rozwijając kluczowe kompetencje i zdobywając cenne doświadczenie.

Oto propozycja profesjonalnego ogłoszenia o pracę (Job Description), zredagowanego na podstawie dostarczonych informacji. Z opisu usunąłem wewnętrzne notatki rekrutacyjne (np. strategie negocjacyjne czy procesy między agencjami), przekształcając je w jasne, zachęcające, ale i stanowcze komunikaty dla kandydata.

🚀 Architekt Backendu (Java / Kotlin) – Sektor Bankowy

Lokalizacja: Hybrydowo (średnio 1 dzień w tygodniu w jednym z biur: Warszawa, Łódź, Gdańsk, Wrocław, Poznań, Kraków, Lublin lub Szczecin)

Forma współpracy: Wyłącznie B2B

Start: ASAP (projekt długoterminowy)

📌 O roli i projekcie

Dołącz do kluczowego programu transformacji cyfrowej w Banku Pekao. Szukamy doświadczonego Architekta Backendu, który weźmie na siebie odpowiedzialność za projektowanie architektury usług backendowych, integracje z systemami transakcyjnymi oraz wyznaczanie standardów technologicznych. Będziesz ściśle współpracować z biznesem i dbać o wysoką jakość rozwiązań dostarczanych przez 17-osobowy zespół inżynierów.

🛠 Twoje zadania:

• Projektowanie i rozwój architektury usług backendowych (mikroserwisy) oraz złożonych integracji z systemami core/transakcyjnymi banku.
• Podejmowanie kluczowych decyzji technologicznych, tworzenie wzorców i standardów dla zespołów deweloperskich (17 FTE).
• Prowadzenie przeglądów kodu oraz architektury (Architecture/Code Review).
• Aktywne wsparcie zespołów w rozwiązywaniu problemów związanych z wydajnością i odpornością systemów.
• Tworzenie i utrzymywanie dokumentacji architektonicznej (m.in. C4, ADR).
• Ścisła współpraca z Analitykami, Product Ownerami oraz zespołami ds. Bezpieczeństwa i Infrastruktury.

🎯 Wymagania (Must Have):

• Min. 10 lat komercyjnego doświadczenia w backendzie (Java), w tym min. 3 lata w roli Architekta lub Tech Leada. (Uwzględniamy wyłącznie doświadczenie komercyjne).
• Praktyczne i udokumentowane doświadczenie w projektach dla sektora bankowego – warunek absolutnie konieczny.
• Ekspercka wiedza z zakresu projektowania systemów rozproszonych: architektura mikroserwisowa, heksagonalna, DDD, event-driven.
• Biegła znajomość Java 11+ (aktualne LTS), Spring Framework, Spring Boot 3.x.
• Solidne doświadczenie w integracjach (REST, SOAP, Kafka) oraz we wdrażaniu wzorców integracyjnych i odporności (circuit breaker, retry, idempotencja).
• Znajomość baz danych PostgreSQL i Oracle oraz cache'owania (Hazelcast / Redis). Biegłość w JPA + Hibernate.
• Doświadczenie w pracy z konteneryzacją i orkiestracją (Docker, Kubernetes) oraz CI/CD (Jenkins, Maven).
• Dobra znajomość zagadnień bezpieczeństwa aplikacji (OAuth2 / OIDC) i specyfiki wymagań regulacyjnych sektora finansowego.
• Język angielski na poziomie umożliwiającym czytanie/tworzenie dokumentacji technicznej (min. mocne A2 / B1).

🌟 Mile widziane (Nice to Have):

• Komercyjna znajomość języka Kotlin
• Doświadczenie w bankowości detalicznej / konsumenckiej (bardzo wysoko punktowane!).
• Praktyka w integracjach z systemami typu core banking.
• Znajomość rozwiązań chmurowych (Azure / AWS / GCP) oraz narzędzi z obszaru observability (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, Dynatrace).
• Posiadanie certyfikatów architektonicznych (np. TOGAF, certyfikaty Azure / AWS Architect).

📋 Wymogi formalne i organizacyjne:

• Dostępność do podjęcia współpracy ASAP (maksymalny akceptowalny okres wypowiedzenia to 30 dni).
• Gotowość do pracy w modelu hybrydowym: obecność w biurze średnio 1 dzień w tygodniu (biura do wyboru z 8 miast w Polsce, zespoły nie są trwale przypisane do konkretnej lokalizacji).
• Etap rekrutacji wymaga formalnego podpisania zgody RODO

title: ERP Integration Engineer
description:
We are looking for an experienced Workday Integration Engineer to join Flix on a freelance/service agreement basis (B2B contract). This is a contractor engagement for a seasoned integration professional who wants to work on impactful, hands-on engineering challenges.

Scope of Services

Design, build, and maintain AWS-based integrations between our Workday HRIS and the internal and external systems within FlixTech People Enablement Stream. Work closely with HR, IT Infrastructure, various internal stakeholders, and external vendors to ensure seamless data flow and automation across platforms.

About the Engagement

• Design, build, and deploy scalable integrations on AWS connecting HR, payroll, and workforce platforms — consuming data from systems like Workday, Deel, Greenhouse, and other third-party providers
• Architect and maintain event-driven and API-based integration workflows using AWS services including EventBridge, Lambda, API Gateway, ECS/Kubernetes, SQS, and S3
• Use Python to develop integration services, automation scripts, and data transformation and mapping logic to ensure accurate and consistent data exchange between systems
• Use Infrastructure as Code, such as Terraform, to provision and maintain cloud infrastructure in a consistent and repeatable manner
• Implement CI/CD pipelines using Git and DevOps tools to streamline code versioning, testing, and deployment
• Implement secure integration pipelines using OAuth 2.0, SFTP, certificate-based authentication, AWS KMS encryption, fine-grained access controls, and PII masking to ensure GDPR compliance and protect international employee data
• Implement monitoring, logging, and error-handling mechanisms to support troubleshooting, data integrity, and reliable production operations
• Collaborate with functional teams to understand business processes and translate them into robust integration solutions
• Troubleshoot and optimize integration performance in development, testing, and production environments
• Provide technical guidance, best practices, and consulting to other developers

About You

• Experience connecting diverse HR, ATS, payroll, and EOR systems (Workday, Deel, Greenhouse, etc.), with a strong grasp of employee lifecycle events, organizational structures, and payroll cutoffs
• Experience with API-based integrations using REST, SOAP, and JSON/XML
• Experience with AWS, API Gateway, Terraform, and Infrastructure as Code
• Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, version control systems, and modern DevOps practices
• Experience with secure data exchange, including SFTP, certificate management, encryption, and API authentication
• Strong communication skills to collaborate with HR, Finance, IT, and external vendors to turn business needs into integration designs
• Fluent in English; German language skills are a welcome bonus

Preferred Skills:

• Experience with Workday Integration technologies such as Workday Studio, PECI, Core Connectors, or EIBs

Collaboration Model

• Cooperation based on a service agreement (B2B/freelance contract), not an employment contract
• You will operate as an independent contractor, responsible for delivering agreed services and submitting invoices
• Location: open for contractors based in Poland

title: Analityk systemów transportowych (k/m/x)
description:
Dołącz do zespołu rozwijającego systemy wspierające transport i logistykę!
Szukamy osoby na stanowisko Business Analyst (Transport Systems), która będzie odpowiedzialna za analizę, rozwój i optymalizację systemów wspierających procesy transportowe oraz logistyczne w naszej organizacji. To rola dla osoby, która potrafi skutecznie łączyć potrzeby biznesowe z możliwościami technologii, analizować procesy operacyjne oraz projektować rozwiązania usprawniające planowanie i realizację transportu.

Analityk systemów transportowych (k/m/x)

Twój zakres obowiązków

• analiza, zbieranie i dokumentowanie wymagań biznesowych związanych z procesami transportowymi i logistycznymi,
• modelowanie oraz optymalizacja procesów transportowych i magazynowych z wykorzystaniem BPMN 2.0,
• współpraca z użytkownikami biznesowymi w obszarze planowania transportu, dystrybucji i logistyki,
• udział w projektowaniu, wdrażaniu i rozwoju systemów wspierających zarządzanie transportem (TMS) oraz integrację z WMS i innymi systemami operacyjnymi,
• identyfikacja obszarów wymagających automatyzacji i usprawnień procesowych,
• przygotowywanie dokumentacji analitycznej, procesowej i projektowej,
• przygotowywanie scenariuszy testowych, kryteriów akceptacji oraz udział w testach systemowych i biznesowych,
• analiza zgłaszanych problemów oraz wsparcie użytkowników w zakresie funkcjonowania systemów transportowych,
• współpraca z zespołami IT i dostawcami przy rozwoju rozwiązań wspierających transport.

Nasze wymagania

• minimum 2 lata doświadczenia związane z analizą, wdrażaniem lub rozwojem procesów transportowych, logistycznych lub magazynowych,
• praktyczna znajomość procesów transportowych (planowanie tras, dystrybucja, zarządzanie zleceniami transportowymi, monitorowanie realizacji transportu),
• doświadczenie w pracy z systemami TMS, WMS lub pokrewnymi rozwiązaniami wspierającymi logistykę,
• znajomość języka angielskiego na poziomie minimum B2,
• umiejętność analitycznego myślenia i modelowania procesów biznesowych,
• doświadczenie w zbieraniu i dokumentowaniu wymagań biznesowych.
• gotowość do okazjonalnych podróży służbowych za granicę.

Mile widziane

• doświadczenie na stanowisku Analityka Biznesowego lub Analityka Systemowego,
• znajomość modelowania procesów biznesowych w notacji BPMN 2.0,
• znajomość metodyk Agile i Waterfall,
• podstawowa znajomość SQL oraz baz danych,
• doświadczenie w pracy z narzędziami do modelowania procesów (np. Adonis),
• podstawowa wiedza z zakresu infrastruktury IT i sieci komputerowych.

To oferujemy

• Pracę hybrydową w biurze ILS (Swobodnia 35, Zakroczym).
• Zatrudnienie w oparciu o umowę o pracę.
• Możliwość rozwoju zawodowego w strukturach wewnętrznych.
• Możliwość skorzystania z benefitów pozapłacowych na preferencyjnych warunkach.
• Zniżkę pracowniczą na części samochodowe grupy Inter Cars.
• Szkolenia wewnętrzne i zewnętrzne rozwijające kompetencje miękkie i techniczne.
• Dofinansowane do zajęć z języka angielskiego.

title: Senior MS Power BI Developer
description:
About us:

Talent has no borders. Proxify's mission is to connect top developers around the world with opportunities they deserve. So, it doesn't matter where you are; we are here to help you fast-track your independent career in the right direction. 🙂

Since our launch, Proxify's developers have successfully worked with 1200+ happy clients to build their products and growth features. 5000+ talented developers trust Proxify and its network to fulfill their dreams and objectives.

Proxify is shaped by a global network of supportive, talented developers interested in remote full-time jobs. Our Glassdoor (4.5/5) and Trustpilot (4.8/5) ratings reflect the trust developers place in us and our commitment to our members' success.

The Role:

We are looking for a Senior Microsoft Power BI developer for one of our clients. You are a perfect candidate if you are growth-oriented, you love what you do, and you enjoy working on new ideas to develop exciting products and growth features.

What we are looking for:

• Background with BI tools and systems such as Power BI, Tableau, and SAP
• Prior experience in data-related tasks
• Understanding of the Microsoft BI Stack
• Mastery in data analytics

title: New Business Manager
description:
Our company

Surfer is an AI Visibility Platform that helps marketing teams become the definitive answer wherever their buyers search — across Google and AI search. The platform combines data, research-backed optimization, and a user-friendly workflow to grow brand visibility through content where buying decisions start to form.

Surfer is used by content marketers, SEO specialists, agencies, and in-house marketing teams around the world to track, plan, write, and optimize content that gets ranked and cited by both search engines and LLMs.

Surfer is part of Positive Group - a fast-growing tech group specializing in B2B SaaS products that help marketing teams grow smarter. The group brings together several brands around a common ambition: to become the European benchmark in MarTech. With around 400 employees based in France, Germany, Italy, and Poland, Positive supports customers in 80+ countries.

We’re a remote-first company, but if you ever crave some in-person energy, we’ve got a cozy office in Wrocław , Poland where the magic happens (and coffee never runs out ☕).

About the role

We're looking for someone who's worked at a marketing/SEO agency or a martech company and knows what it takes to close - someone who picks up the phone without thinking twice, and who hasn't been trained out of that instinct by years of "process."

On a day-to-day basis, you'll own the new-business side end-to-end: prospecting and building your own pipeline, working the leads that come your way, qualifying them, running discovery and demos, negotiating, and closing. You'll work closely with the Customer Success team, and get support from Marketing and RevOps. This role rewards initiative - the more you build and close, the more it shows, both in your results and in what you earn.

You will be responsible for:

• Work both sides of the pipeline: reaching out to existing leads in our CRM (conference, meetup, webinar, and community signals plus records of past interest) while building a new pipeline from scratch through your own outbound prospecting.
• Prospect actively: research target accounts, identify decision-makers, and open conversations with agencies and in-house teams that haven’t reached out to us yet.
• Run multi-channel outreach on these leads across email, LinkedIn, and phone.
• Build and continuously refine ICP-aligned contact lists covering both marketing/SEO agencies and in-house SEO/marketing teams at companies.
• Qualify leads and run discovery calls, demos, and negotiations, owning the deal through to signed contract and payment.

Requirements:

• Minimum 4 years of B2B sales experience as an SDR/BDR/AE at a marketing/SEO agency, a martech company (e.g. SEO, content, analytics, or marketing automation software), or at a company selling into agencies.
• Proven track record of closing deals end-to-end, including negotiation and contracting.
• Familiarity with the SEO/content marketing space (content briefs, topical authority, SERPs).
• No hesitation picking up the phone the moment a lead is worth chasing.
• Motivated by closing deals, not just running a process. You know the satisfaction of seeing a deal through from first call to signed contract - and you want more of that.
• Outreach experience across email, LinkedIn, and phone.
• Familiarity with CRM and sales/outbound tools.
• Strong written and verbal English (C1 or above).
• Nice to have: experience selling a SaaS product (not a service); ABM (account-based marketing/sales) experience.

What we offer:

We build the team around experts and stay out of their way. That starts with the basics:

Compensation: $36,000–45,500/year base (excl. VAT, where applicable), plus a bonus system.

Contract: We work exclusively on B2B (contractor) agreements. This means you’ll need your own registered business (e.g. sole proprietorship / self-employed status in your country) and will invoice us monthly.

We take care of the things that matter outside the work itself - your health, your rest, the setup that lets you work well, and the chance to sharpen your craft. Everything else follows from how we operate: trust over control, outcomes over hours.

Location and Remote Work:

We’re a remote-first company, but if you ever crave some in-person energy, we’ve got a cozy office in Wrocław, Poland.

Your responsibilities:

• Implement and evolve both frontend and backend components
• Build modern web applications using React
• Develop backend services (Java / Spring or equivalent) supporting application functionality
• Write high-quality, well-tested, production-ready code
• Participate actively in technical design and decision-making
• Review code and contribute to shared engineering standards

• Proven experience as a Fullstack Engineer working across frontend and backend systems

• API design
• Clean code practices
• Version control and collaboration workflows

Experience with:

• Trunk-based development

• Experience working on large-scale, enterprise platforms
• Exposure to frontend performance optimization and backend scalability
• Experience with observability and reliability practices
• Familiarity with distributed systems and microservice architectures

• Strong ownership and accountability for engineering outcomes
• Ability to work across the stack without artificial boundaries
