title: Senior Accountant
description:
About Supabase

Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth.

About the Role

We're looking for a detail-oriented, driven Senior Accountant to join our Accounting team at an exciting time of growth for Supabase. As we continue to scale, we're expanding the team to add experience, spread responsibilities, and strengthen the processes that keep our financials accurate and timely. This is a hands-on role with real ownership and a lot of autonomy.

In this role, you'll support the month-end close, perform analytics on financial results, assist with external audit and tax requests, and take on ad-hoc projects. You'll collaborate across Finance and the wider company, including FP&A, People/Payroll, and Legal, and work with our external audit, tax, and technical accounting partners, while contributing to the continuous improvement of our processes and controls. This role is open to candidates based in North America.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives in async, fast-paced environments and is excited about building developer tools that scale to millions.

What You'll Be Responsible For

• Own key areas of the monthly, quarterly, and annual close within your assigned areas, preparing workpapers, journal entries, account reconciliations, flux analysis, and accruals in accordance with US GAAP
• Perform detailed analytics over financial results to confirm completeness and accuracy, and investigate and communicate discrepancies promptly
• Partner with FP&A, People/Payroll, Legal, and other teams to understand business processes, ensure proper accounting, and resolve reconciling differences
• Support external audits and tax requests, serving as a point of contact and coordinating with external partners
• Prepare ad-hoc analyses and support reporting requirements
• Take initiative to recommend and implement process improvements that simplify, standardize, and streamline how we work
• Participate in special projects, including process and system improvements
• Handle day-to-day operational accounting activities with a high level of accuracy

You Might Be a Good Fit If You

• Have 5+ years of progressive accounting experience, ideally a mix of public accounting (Big 4 preferred) and private industry
• Have a CPA or equivalent (preferred)
• Have a strong technical accounting background and solid knowledge of US GAAP
• Have ERP experience, and experience in tech or high-growth company accounting is a plus
• Are willing to roll up your sleeves and dig into the details
• Communicate clearly, both in writing and verbally, and are comfortable building relationships at all levels of the organization, including senior leadership and audit partners
• Are self-motivated and proactive in identifying problems and proposing solutions
• Are organized and able to manage multiple priorities and deadlines, and can switch gears quickly in a fast-paced, high-growth environment
• Work well both independently and collaboratively, are comfortable in async teams, and navigate ambiguity with ease
• Are energized by improving processes

We know not everyone will meet every qualification on day one. If you're excited about this role and want to grow with us, we encourage you to apply.

What We Offer

• Fully RemoteWe hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world.
• ESOPEvery team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together.
• Tech AllowanceUse this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work.
• Health BenefitsSupabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us.
• Annual Off-SitesOnce a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year.
• Flexible WorkWe operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when.
• Professional DevelopmentEvery team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth.

About the Team

Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love.

• ~400 team members
• 60+ countries
• 20+ languages spoken
• Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F)
• 540,000+ community members

We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.

title: Principal Software Architect
description:
Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.

We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.

Here’s what this particular role covers.

🛠️ About our Product Architecture and Safety Teams

Our Product Architecture and Safety teams connect Wayve’s core AI Driver with the vehicle platforms that bring autonomous driving technology to customers. Working across Engineering, Product, Safety, Validation and customer programs, we define how our software integrates with OEM and Tier 1 systems, supporting safe, reliable deployment while maintaining a consistent core product architecture.

🧠 Your day-to-day

As a Principal Software Architect, you’ll lead the technical architecture for integrating Wayve’s autonomous driving technology with automotive OEM vehicle platforms. You’ll work at the boundary between our core AI Driver and external vehicle systems, translating product ambitions and customer needs into clear interfaces, requirements and technical decisions.

Your work will span high-level architecture and implementation details, from sensors and middleware to ECU constraints, timing, diagnostics, safety assumptions, data logging and validation. You’ll bring structure to ambiguous problems, guide architecture work across teams and own key decisions across customer programs. Along the way, you’ll build alignment with engineering, product, safety, validation, program and commercial leaders.

🧩 What you’ll be working on

• Defining integration architecture: Shape how Wayve software interfaces with OEM and Tier 1 vehicle systems, balancing customer program needs with the evolution and reusability of our core architecture.
• Making ownership explicit: Turn customer and partner discussions into clear interface contracts, ownership boundaries, assumptions, dependencies and open technical decisions, including what is Wayve-owned, partner-owned, jointly defined or out of scope.
• Translating needs into requirements: Partner with Product and Engineering to develop actionable technical specifications. Establish a consistent approach to decomposing customer requirements into system and software requirements, including allocation, traceability and change control.
• Owning architecture decisions: Lead architecture reviews, maintain decision records and make the final technical call within your scope when consensus cannot be reached.
• Planning for successful delivery: Assess feasibility, integration complexity, technical gaps and risks. Identify dependencies and required partner deliverables to support customer program planning.
• Building verifiable solutions: Work with Safety and Validation teams to define safety assumptions, integration test requirements and clear evidence that customer requirements have been met.
• Representing Wayve with partners: Lead technical discussions with OEMs and Tier 1 suppliers, supported by clear interface specifications, integration guides, architecture diagrams and decision records.
• Leading across teams: Coordinate architects and engineering teams, negotiate competing priorities, resolve or escalate conflicts early, and mentor architects and senior engineers to build a shared architecture culture.

🙌 You should apply if

• You bring substantial experience in ADAS, autonomous driving, embedded software or vehicle systems, particularly at the software–vehicle interface. Typically, you’ll have 12+ years of relevant experience, including architecture ownership for a complete product or multiple programs.
• You can define clear product boundaries, ownership models and interface contracts between internal software and external vehicle systems.
• You understand vehicle electronics and embedded software constraints, including ECU integration, real-time execution, timing, diagnostics and production vehicle software environments.
• You’re familiar with automotive communication protocols and electrical/electronic architectures, such as CAN, FlexRay, Automotive Ethernet, SOME/IP or AUTOSAR.
• You’ve worked with automotive OEMs or Tier 1 suppliers and can navigate their requirements, standards and integration constraints.
• You’ve established and run requirements processes across multiple teams or programs, translating ambiguous needs into clear, traceable and verifiable system and software specifications.
• You can move confidently between system-level architecture and implementation details, making sound technical decisions under uncertainty and maintaining consistency as programs evolve.
• You’ve led architecture work across teams and influenced senior stakeholders without direct authority, building support and handling competing priorities constructively.
• You communicate complex technical ideas clearly through specifications, diagrams and reviews, and enjoy mentoring others.

🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement.

More about Wayve:

🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once in a generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human driven vehicles to intelligent machines.

Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve’s mapless and hardware agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution and unlocking advanced levels of automation from L2 plus through to L4 as our core AI model scales. In a race increasingly defined by intelligence and real world learning, Wayve is taking a distinct approach, building a generalisable driving intelligence that can power any vehicle, anywhere. By combining embodied AI with scalable deployment, we are creating technology that can be shaped to each OEM brand and driver experience, accelerating the transition to a safer, more intelligent future of mobility.

How we work 💻- Locations & Flexible Working:

Our main hubs are in London, Sunnyvale, Yokohama, Herzliya, Vancouver and Leonberg. We operate a hybrid working model that combines in-person collaboration in our dedicated office spaces with focused time working remotely. This gives our teams the connection and energy of working together, alongside the flexibility to do their best work in a way that fits their lives.

🔍 The Interview Process:

Our process is clear and respectful of your time:

• Initial call / recruiter screen
• Hiring Manager Interview
• Deep-dive technical interviews
• Final interview: mission & values alignment

We’ll always explain the format and work around your availability.

What’s in it for you (Location dependant):

💰 Salaries benchmarked against the market annually
📈 Meaningful equity, sharing in the ownership and long term success of Wayve
✈️ Relocation support and visa sponsorship where applicable
✅ Hybrid working, core hours and the chance to work hands on in vehicle workshops and labs
📚 Learning and development budgets with support for training, conferences and growth
🩺 Comprehensive benefits including health insurance, dental, enhanced maternity and paternity leave, retirement or pension where applicable, access to therapists, wellbeing partnerships, team socials and more

A quick, honest note before you apply.

Wayve is not a mature, fully-structured place with the playbook already written. Much of how we work is still being written, and if you join, you’ll help write it. That suits people who want real ownership more than people who need a settled structure from day one.

If that sounds like the kind of problem you want to spend your time on, we’d really like to hear from you.

At Wayve we're committed to creating a diverse, fair and respectful culture that is inclusive of everyone based on their unique skills and perspectives, and regardless of sex, race, religion or belief, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, citizenship, marital, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding) or any other basis as protected by applicable law.

For more information visit Careers at Wayve. To learn more about what drives us, visit Values at Wayve

DISCLAIMER: We will not ask about marriage or pregnancy, care responsibilities or disabilities in any of our job adverts or interviews. However, we do look to capture information about care responsibilities, and disabilities among other diversity information as part of an optional DEI Monitoring form to help us identify areas of improvement in our hiring process and ensure that the process is inclusive and non-discriminatory.

title: Pharmacy Dispenser
description:
At Montu, every prescription represents a patient waiting for treatment that can make a genuine difference to their quality of life.

Our pharmacy is a fast-paced, high-volume environment where accuracy, attention to detail and teamwork are essential. You will be joining a dedicated team working together to ensure prescriptions are processed safely, accurately and efficiently, helping patients access their medication without unnecessary delays.

This is a role for someone who enjoys working at pace, takes real pride in getting the detail right and understands the importance of putting patients at the heart of every decision. No two days are the same, and you will need to be adaptable, calm under pressure and ready to play your part in a growing pharmacy that is helping to improve access to cannabis-based medicines across the UK.

Working alongside our Pharmacists, Pharmacy Technicians and wider pharmacy team, you will support the safe and effective dispensing of CBPMs within our specialist private pharmacy.

What is the job?

In our pharmacy, every day is about combining pace with precision, always keeping patients at the heart of everything we do. We work in a fast-moving, agile environment where accuracy is paramount, flexibility is essential, and no two days are the same. You will be part of a dedicated team that thrives under pressure, adapts quickly, and takes pride in making a genuine difference to patients’ lives

Working as a Pharmacy dispenser supporting the supply of CMBP in a specialist Private pharmacy. This is a niche role in a growing area. The successful candidate will be working alongside specialist Clinical Pharmacists to make CMBP more accessible for all patients.

What will you be doing?

• Receiving and validating prescriptions ready for a clinical check.
• Processing patient information appropriately.
• Supporting the Responsible Pharmacist & Technicians in the daily operations of the Pharmacist.
• Being the first point of contact for any queries to the Pharmacy.
• Maintaining relevant records for the supply of CMBP.
• Maintaining stock and security of any CMBP on site.
• Maintaining communication of prescription to the Department of Health to meet Regulatory Requirements.
• Supporting governance in the Pharmacy to ensure the pharmacy is operating as safely as possible.

What do you need?

• A UK qualified Pharmacy dispenser

• Ideally Undertaken CPD-accredited medical cannabis educational programme. Through this will be provided for the successful candidate

• Self-motivated individual with high levels of attention to detail, able to work accurately, identifying errors quickly and easily
• Experience in working in the pharmacy dispensary either primary and/or secondary environment
• Has attention to detail, patience and the ability to remain calm during stressful situations
• Excellence in communication skills with staff, patients and other healthcare professionals.
• Professional, ethical and committed to providing excellent customer care
• Excellent computer literacy with good working knowledge of office applications including Word, Excel and PowerPoint

What we offer:

• Generous Leave: 25 days holiday (rising to 27 after year one and 30 after year three) + 8 bank holidays
• Pension Matching: Up to 5% employer matching contributions
• Flexibility and Wellness: Work-from-home options, cycle-to-work scheme, private healthcare and more
• Growth Opportunities: Collaborate across teams and represent Montu at events, with support to grow your skills and impact
• Enhanced Maternity & Paternity Leave

About Us

Montu UK is a leading digital health company specialising in cannabis-based medicines (CBPM), dedicated to improving patient access to safe and effective treatments. Our mission is to transform lives by combining innovative technology with high-quality clinical care, ensuring patients receive the support they need at every step of their journey.

As a fast-growing organisation, we offer a collaborative and supportive environment where talented people can develop their careers while contributing to meaningful change in healthcare. At Montu UK, your work has a direct impact on improving patients’ lives and expanding access to modern medical treatments.

title: Accuracy Checking Pharmacy Technician (Full-time)
description:
Tired of retail pharmacy?

Imagine working in a modern, technology-enabled online pharmacy where you can focus on accuracy, quality and patient safety—without standing behind a retail counter, selling OTC products or being interrupted every few minutes.

No retail counter. No walk-in patients. No OTC. Focus entirely on delivering safe, high-quality pharmacy care.

Modern pharmacy. State of the art renovated premises with onsite Free parking

title: Enterprise Account Executive - Platform Clients
description:
Tremendous is the global platform built for businesses to send thousands of payouts to anyone, anywhere, for free. We're trusted by 20,000 organizations like Atlassian, MIT, and United Way to deliver gift cards and money to millions of recipients worldwide.

Our customers (researchers, marketers, HR teams, nonprofits, and platform businesses) rave about how fast and easy Tremendous is to use. Check out our ratings on G2.

Tremendous is profitable and growing without outside investors. We're a fully remote, high-documentation, low-meeting culture, which means more time for what matters in both your professional and personal life. The team agrees: our employee NPS is in the high 80s.

About the role

As our Enterprise Account Executive, Platform Clients, you will sell to software companies that embed Tremendous into their own product so their customers can send rewards and payouts. Think employee recognition tools, loyalty and referral platforms, affiliate and creator networks. One platform integration brings dozens or hundreds of end clients onto Tremendous, which is why these are valuable and profitable deals.

This is not a rewards API sale. You are selling a partnership: a new feature for their product, a new revenue line for their business, and a payouts expert they don't have to build in-house. The buyer is usually a Product Manager, an engineering lead, or a founder, and the deal doesn't close when the contract is signed. It closes when their integration is live and their end clients are sending rewards.

Platform deals run long (6 to 18 months is normal) and then compound. Several of our best platform clients started as five-figure conversations and now run millions in annual volume. You'll own a book of these and be the quarterback for each one from first call through end client activation.

This role is roughly 70% new logo and 30% expansion. You're primarily a hunter, but every platform you land becomes an account you grow by helping them onboard more end clients.

What you'll do:

• Hunt across the platform landscape. Build a target list of software companies in our proven sub-segments and beyond, segment it by fit and end client count, and go after it deliberately with your SDR partner. Many of your best prospects don't offer payouts today; your pitch is that they should.
• Sell the partnership, not the product. Lead with the prospect's pain and their product roadmap. Size every deal by what sits behind it: how many end clients, net-new vs. migrating existing ones, what they use for payouts today. Structure economics (standard pricing first, rebates and incentives when the deal needs them) with Deal Desk.
• Work hand in hand with Partnerships and Solutions Engineering. Platform deals are a team sport. You’ll partner closely with our Partnerships team on strategy, positioning, and commercial structure, and with Solutions Engineering on scoping and the technical build. You bring them in early, keep them in the loop as the deal evolves, and make sure nothing gets lost between selling, building, and go-live. Clear communication and a genuine instinct for cross-functional teamwork matter as much here as closing skill.
• Multi-thread across business and technical buyers. Your champion may be a Head of Product; the budget may sit with a CFO; the integration lives with an engineering lead. Work all three in parallel, bring our Solutions Engineer in early, and get the prospect's engineers into a shared Slack channel.
• Own the integration window. The bottleneck on a platform deal is never your selling. It's the prospect's engineering team prioritizing the build. You stay present through the quiet months, run a disciplined cadence, remove blockers, and give their finance team reasons to push the project forward.
• Qualify well, and don't write deals off too early. A deal that sits in Qualified for six months is not dead. Know the signals that a deal is real (engineer on early calls, sandbox activity, roadmap with a timeline) and the ones that mean parking lot.
• Navigate compliance with confidence. Tremendous operates under bank partner rules, so every platform client gets vetted early. You ask the right questions on the first call (who funds the account, who the end clients are, whether payouts are the whole business), explain our KYB process without scaring anyone, and loop in Ops before promising a structure.
• Own your number. You'll carry a quota and a forecast you're accountable for. Platform deals forecast differently (don't call a same-quarter close until the integration is built and end clients are onboarding), and you'll be expected to know the difference.
• Be ambitious. Ambition isn't a dirty word at Tremendous. Platforms are the vertical we're betting on to carry us into markets we'd otherwise have to build for, which means growth in role and responsibility along with real personal upside.

What you'll bring

• 6+ years in SaaS sales, currently in a Mid-Market or Enterprise AE position
• A consistent track record of hitting quota
• Experience selling a product that required a technical integration on the customer's side: an API, a payments or fintech product, an embedded solution. Partnership sales experience is a big plus.
• Comfort talking to Product Managers and engineers, and the credibility to hold a technical room without being the engineer
• You present well and you communicate clearly and concisely
• The business acumen to size a deal, structure a partnership, and spot new use cases inside accounts you've already won
• You can self-source a meaningful share of your own pipeline, paired with an SDR, with the rest coming from inbound
• Comfort with long, multi-stakeholder cycles that go quiet for weeks, without letting your pipeline or your cadence go quiet with them

What's cool about the role

• Competitive pay and equity. The base salary for this role is $150,000 - $180,000. Total OTE is $260,000 - $300,000.
• Real benefits. 100% covered health (US), unlimited PTO, 12-16 weeks paid parental leave.
• Fully remote. Work from anywhere in the Americas.
• Great culture. Read more about how we work in our public handbook.

description:
ASOS Senior BI Engineer | SmartRecruiters

Senior BI Engineer

• Full-time

Company Description

We're ASOS, the online retailer for fashion lovers all around the world.

We exist to give our customers the confidence to be whoever they want to be, and that goes for our people too. At ASOS, you're free to be your true self without judgement, and channel your creativity into a platform used by millions.

Everyone needs some help showing up as their best self. We're Disability Confident Committed - let our Talent team know if you need any reasonable adjustments throughout the recruitment process

Job Description

We’re looking for a Senior BI Engineer to work along with our BI team in FinTech and Fashion Tech. Reporting to the Staff Engineering Lead, you will take the strategy they set and turn it into delivery, leading the team day to day and being the senior, most experienced pair of hands on the data side.

The team owns reporting and BI across all of FinTech and Fashion Tech. That covers the reports our business runs on, the reconciliations that keep our data feeds honest, and ownership of the data warehouse and the data sync between our ERP and the wider estate.

Our stack is Python, PySpark, Delta Lake and Databricks, with T‑SQL, Kimball dimensional modelling and Power BI on top, working closely with Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance and Operations data structures. We are currently reviewing whether to move from Databricks to Microsoft Fabric, so you should be comfortable working through a platform decision and the migration that may follow.

Key Responsibilities

Being Mentor to the BI Team

• Support the BI team day to day, turning the strategy set by the Staff Engineering Lead into a plan the team can deliver against.

• Support and mentor the other BI Engineers on both reports and the data side, through design reviews, pairing and code review.

• Be the senior technical voice in the team. Set the standards for how we model, build and test, and raise the bar on quality.

• Prioritise and balance the team’s work across reporting requests, reconciliations and platform work, and pick up the hardest builds yourself.

Owning the Data Warehouse and Data Sync

• Own our data warehouse, including the dimensional model, the pipelines that load it and the standards that keep it consistent as it grows.

• Own the data sync between our ERP and the warehouse, making sure data lands completely, on time and in a shape the business can use.

• Build and maintain the reconciliations that prove our feeds are complete and accurate, and investigate and fix them when they break.

Reporting and BI Delivery

• Deliver reporting our stakeholders trust, from the models underneath through to well built, performant Power BI reports.

• Design and build data pipelines in Python, PySpark and Delta Lake, and write the T‑SQL behind our models and reconciliations.

• Keep an eye on cost, performance and reliability across the platform, and keep improving what is already live.

Working with Stakeholders

• Work with stakeholders across Finance, Tech and Fashion, including our Commercial, Buying and Product colleagues, to understand what they need from their data.

• Turn reporting requests into well shaped requirements, and challenge constructively when an existing report or a different cut of the data would do the job.

• Keep stakeholders updated on progress, priorities and any risks to the data they depend on, so there are no surprises.

Working Across Tech

• Work closely with the solution, engineering and support teams across FinTech and Fashion Tech, so changes upstream in the ERP don’t break reporting downstream.

• Follow the wider ASOS delivery process, including governance, change control and release cadence, and run the team’s work through Azure DevOps.

• Work with Architecture, Security and Risk so what we build meets ASOS standards, protects sensitive financial data and stands up to audit.

Why This Role Matters

Almost every decision our Finance and commercial teams make rests on numbers this team produces, from month end close and supplier payments through to trading, stock and range performance. If the warehouse is wrong or a feed silently drops data, people make the wrong call.

This role is where that quality is set. We need someone senior enough to own the warehouse and the ERP data sync end to end, lead a team through a possible platform move, and still be close enough to the detail to build the hard things themselves.

Qualifications

Data and BI Experience

• Strong hands-on experience with Python, SQL, PySpark and Delta Lake for building scalable data pipelines.

• Experience across the Azure data stack, including Azure Data Factory (ADF), Azure Functions, Logic Apps and Azure Storage.

• Strong experience with Databricks and Microsoft Fabric, including Lakehouse and modern data engineering solutions.

• Strong SQL/T-SQL skills and experience with Kimball dimensional modelling and data warehouse design.

• Experience integrating ERP data, ideally Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations or other major ERP platforms.

• Working knowledge of Power BI, DAX and data modelling, with a focus on delivering effective business reporting.

Leadership

• Experience leading or mentoring other engineers, setting technical standards and lifting the quality of what a team produces.

• Comfortable taking a strategy someone else has set and turning it into a plan your team can deliver.

• Able to prioritise across competing requests and make a clear call on what gets done and what waits.

Stakeholder Management and Rigour

• Confident with stakeholders across Finance, Tech and the commercial teams, able to explain data simply and push back when a request doesn’t stack up.

• A genuine eye for data quality, with the patience to chase a reconciliation break until you find the root cause.

• Organised and calm under pressure, particularly around month end and peak trading.

We’d Also Love to See

• Experience of a lakehouse or warehouse migration, or of working through a platform decision such as Databricks to Microsoft Fabric.

• Knowledge of finance or supply chain processes such as procure to pay, order to cash, month end close or stock and warehouse operations.

• Experience in retail, ecommerce or fashion, particularly reporting for buying, merchandising or trading.

• Experience with CI/CD for data, testing frameworks, data observability or governance and cataloguing tools.

Why You’ll Love This Role

• You will own the data warehouse and the ERP data sync for two of the most important areas of ASOS.

• It is a rare mix. You get to lead and mentor a team, set the technical standards, and still build the hard things yourself.

• A modern stack with a genuine platform decision ahead, and a real say in where we take it.

• Broad exposure across Finance, Commercial, Buying and Product, with work that visibly shapes how ASOS makes decisions.

Additional Information

BeneFITS’

• Employee discount (hello ASOS discount!)
• Employee sample sales
• 25 days paid annual leave + an extra celebration day for a special moment
• Discretionary bonus scheme
• Private medical care scheme
• Flexible benefits allowance - which you can choose to take as extra cash, or use towards other benefits
• Opportunity for personalised learning and in-the-moment experiences that enable you to thrive and excel in your role

Regional Key Account / Project Manager

Company Description

We’re the nation’s favourite heating brand, here to warm up people’s homes, lives, and futures.

From boilers, hybrids and heat pumps to solar thermal and smart controls, we’re giving our customers plenty of choice. With cutting-edge tech and research, we’re right in the thick of the drive for a better future of home heating.

It’s not all tools and tech. People are the real heart of our company. We connect with our customers to deliver genuinely helpful support, and we care about our employees and give them enriching careers. We work hard, we work together, and we work with a cause – delivering brilliant customer support and exceptional engineering.

As an organisation of more than 1,600 employees, we also take our role in the communities we serve seriously. From giving away free heating systems for community spaces, to our charity, education, and volunteer work – we’re no strangers to rolling our sleeves up, getting stuck in, and helping out.

If that sounds like something you’d like to be a part of, we’d love to meet you.

Come and work #LikeABosch at Worcester Bosch.

Job Description

We are excited to offer you the opportunity to join our Business Digital Organisation North-West Europe team as a Regional Key Account / Project Manager!

As part of a regional team, working closely with markets and production plants across the Nordics, Belgium, the Netherlands and the UK, Business Digital Organisation North-West Europe (otherwise known as BDO NW) connects the business with Bosch’s digital capabilities. The team combines local market and plant knowledge with regional and global solutions to drive transformation and deliver tangible business value.

As Regional Key Account / Project Manager, you will work closely with different countries, plants and business functions to understand what they want to achieve and help turn those ambitions into practical, deliverable outcomes. Other key aspects of the role include but aren’t limited to:

• Facilitating requirement-gathering and discovery workshops, bringing stakeholders together to explore business challenges, desired outcomes and opportunities for improvement.
• Drawing on your broad understanding of digital and IT solutions to provide initial guidance on possible approaches, identify relevant capabilities already available and help markets avoid unnecessary duplication. You will promote the cost-effective and compliant use of digital solutions, considering total cost, licensing, support, reuse and long-term sustainability when shaping the right approach for the business. This could mean improving an ERP or CRM process, introducing a customer-facing digital service, or using data, automation or AI to solve a business problem. Therefore part of being a key account is knowing the solution portfolio.
• Where further expertise is required, you will use our structured demand management process to connect stakeholders with specialist teams across the wider Business Digital Organisation. This includes exploring solutions already available elsewhere, capabilities under development and opportunities that may be addressed through centrally managed platforms.
• For requirements involving central template systems, you will help markets engage effectively with the relevant central process and system owners, ensuring local requirements are clearly understood, prioritised and constructively represented.

Alongside this key account and consulting responsibility, you will take ownership of projects through delivery. You will plan and coordinate activities, manage stakeholders, resources, risks, budgets and timelines, and ensure agreed solutions are implemented successfully and deliver the intended business value. Depending on the initiative, you may lead projects directly or coordinate delivery across local, regional and central teams.

In short, the role connects business ambition, solution expertise and project delivery, helping our markets move from an initial idea through to a successful, sustainable and value-focused outcome.

Interested? Upload your CV and a covering letter today!

Qualifications

Education requirements:

• Degree-level education, a relevant professional qualification, or equivalent demonstrable experience.
• A formal qualification in project management, agile delivery or change management would be advantageous, but is not essential where supported by strong practical experience

Skills & Attributes:

Our ideal candidate will:

• Be a strong communicator and relationship builder, comfortable working with stakeholders across different countries, functions and levels of seniority.
• Have a consultative mindset, with the curiosity to understand what a business is trying to achieve, challenge requirements constructively and help shape the right approach.
• Be able to translate business needs into clear digital or IT requirements, without needing to be a technical specialist in every solution.
• Have proven project management capability, with the confidence to take ownership of projects and manage scope, stakeholders, resources, risks, budgets and timelines through to successful delivery.
• Be commercially and cost aware, considering business value, total cost, reuse and long-term sustainability when evaluating solutions.
• Have an appreciation of governance, compliance and responsible use of technology, balancing local requirements with wider organisational standards.
• Be comfortable navigating a broad digital landscape, for example ERP, CRM, supply-chain solutions, customer-facing applications, data and analytics, automation and AI.
• Be a confident facilitator, able to lead workshops, bring different perspectives together and turn discussion into clear requirements, decisions and actions.
• Be proactive, pragmatic and self-motivated, able to work independently while drawing effectively on expertise from regional and global teams.
• Enjoy working in an international environment, building networks and connecting people, ideas and existing capabilities across organisational boundaries.

Most importantly, we are looking for someone who combines the curiosity and relationship skills of a Key Account Manager, the structured thinking of a consultant and the delivery discipline of a Project Manager.

Additional Information

Please note, we reserve the right to close this vacancy at any time so we encourage candidates to submit their applications as soon as possible.

• Eligibility for our Company Performance Bonus

• Access to the Perkbox and My Benefits platforms giving access to discounts, group income protection and death in service benefits

• Cycle to work scheme with discounts on push-bikes, e-bikes and accessories
• Policy to support growing families
• Access to self-service training platform containing over 200 Bosch approved programmes
• Networking opportunities across Bosch UK including a mentoring programme

• And more!

Descripción de la empresa

Devoteam es una consultora europea líder especializada en estrategia digital, plataformas tecnológicas, ciberseguridad y transformación empresarial a través de la tecnología.
La tecnología forma parte de nuestro ADN y creemos en ella como una palanca capaz de impulsar un cambio positivo, manteniendo un equilibrio que nos permite ofrecer a nuestra cartera de clientes herramientas tecnológicas de primer nivel, pero siempre con la cercanía y la profesionalidad de un equipo que actúa como guía a lo largo del camino.
Devoteam lleva más de 30 años comprometida con la tecnología al servicio de las personas. Contamos con más de 11 000 empleados en el grupo, repartidos por 25 países de Europa, Oriente Medio y África.

Descripción del empleo

Buscamos un/a Ingeniero/a de Seguridad Edge & CDN para unirse a nuestro equipo de infraestructura y ciberseguridad. En esta posición serás el responsable directo de garantizar la protección, disponibilidad y rendimiento óptimo de nuestras aplicaciones web y APIs en la capa perimetral (Edge).

Trabajarás optimizando políticas de seguridad perimetral, gestionando el enrutamiento de tráfico global y resolviendo incidencias complejas de tráfico web en entornos de alta concurrencia.

Responsabilidades principales

• Administrar y afinar políticas de seguridad en el Edge: WAF, Bot Management y mitigación de ataques DDoS.
• Gestionar la infraestructura de DNS distribuido (Edge DNS) y balanceo de tráfico global (GTM / Global Traffic Management) para asegurar alta disponibilidad.
• Realizar diagnóstico y resolución avanzada (troubleshooting) de incidencias de tráfico web: análisis de cabeceras HTTP/HTTPS, códigos de respuesta, negociación TLS/SSL, errores de origen y análisis de logs en tiempo real.
• Supervisar y optimizar la secuencia completa de ejecución perimetral: desde la resolución DNS y la inspección de seguridad hasta las reglas de caché, cabeceras y reenvío a los orígenes.
• Brindar soporte operativo continuo al entorno web y participar en guardias o resolución de incidencias críticas si aplica.

Requisitos

Requisitos indispensables

• Experiencia en Seguridad Edge: Entre 3 y 5 años trabajando con plataformas CDN de alto tráfico, preferiblemente Akamai (App & API Protector / Kona Site Defender, Bot Manager, Prolexic) o Cloudflare.
• Ciberseguridad Web: Conocimientos sólidos de OWASP Top 10 y despliegue de reglas de seguridad en la capa perimetral.
• Troubleshooting y Redes Web: Dominio en el análisis de trazas de red, peticiones HTTP/S, certificados SSL/TLS y diagnóstico de fallos entre cliente, Edge y servidores de origen.
• DNS y GTM: Experiencia en administración de DNS autoritativo distribuido y balanceo global de tráfico para arquitecturas multi-origen / multi-cloud.

Requisitos deseables

• Automatización e Infraestructura como Código (IaC) mediante Terraform (muy valorable terraform-provider-akamai).
• Manejo de herramientas de automatización de plataforma (Akamai CLI o API de Cloudflare).
• Conocimiento operativo de nubes públicas, especialmente AWS.

title: Service Coördinator
description:
InPost Service Coördinator | SmartRecruiters

• Google Chrome
• Microsoft Edge
• Apple Safari
• Mozilla Firefox

Service Coördinator

• Voltijds
• Vergoeding: EUR 2700 - EUR 3800 - per maand

Beschrijving van het bedrijf

Wij zijn een van de snelst groeiende logistieke spelers van Europa.

InPost Group is geen gewone logistieke dienstverlener. We zijn een van de grootste out-of-home bezorgnetwerken van Europa en actief in 9 landen. Met meer dan 61.000 pakketautomaten en ruim 1,4 miljard leveringen per jaar hebben we een stevige positie in Europa opgebouwd. Daarnaast opereren we binnen een internationaal consortium met aanzienlijke slagkracht.

In Nederland staan we aan het begin van een volgende groeifase. Vanaf 1 januari 2027 gaan we volledig verder onder de naam InPost. Een belangrijke stap in de verdere ontwikkeling van onze Nederlandse organisatie en merkpositionering.

Terwijl InPost in Europa al een gevestigde naam is, ligt er in Nederland nog een wereld aan mogelijkheden. En daar hebben we jou bij nodig!

Functieomschrijving

Als Service Coordinator ben jij de spil tussen storingen, monteurs en servicepartners. Jij zorgt ervoor dat problemen aan onze pakketautomaten zo snel mogelijk worden opgelost en dat onze servicewerkzaamheden soepel verlopen.

Een storing komt binnen. Jij duikt erin. Kun je het probleem op afstand oplossen? Mooi. Lukt dat niet? Dan schakel je de juiste monteur of servicepartner in. Vervolgens houd jij de voortgang in de gaten en zorg je dat iedereen weet wat er moet gebeuren.

Dispatching en servicecoördinatie zijn een belangrijk onderdeel van je werk. Op drukke momenten kunnen er meerdere meldingen tegelijk binnenkomen. Jij stelt prioriteiten, houdt het overzicht en zorgt dat de juiste mensen op het juiste moment in actie komen.

Je stuurt geen team aan, maar werkt dagelijks samen met monteurs, servicepartners en collega's binnen verschillende teams van InPost.

Wat ga je doen?

• Je analyseert binnenkomende storingsmeldingen van onze pakketautomaten en probeert problemen waar mogelijk op afstand op te lossen.
• Je bepaalt wanneer een monteur of servicepartner nodig is en zet de juiste actie uit.
• Je maakt en beheert de planning voor service- en onderhoudswerkzaamheden.
• Je coördineert meerdere serviceopdrachten tegelijkertijd en bewaakt de voortgang.
• Je stemt met monteurs en servicepartners af over lopende opdrachten, wijzigingen en eventuele vertragingen.
• Je controleert of werkzaamheden goed zijn uitgevoerd en verwerkt servicerapporten.
• Je houdt betrokken collega's op de hoogte van de status van storingen en reparaties.
• Je werkt samen met collega's van Service & Maintenance, Expansion, Deployment, IT en het magazijn.
• Je signaleert terugkerende storingen, knelpunten en verbeterpunten in de serviceplanning.
• Je denkt mee over hoe we onze serviceprocessen slimmer, sneller en efficiënter kunnen maken.

Functie-eisen

Voor deze functie vinden we het vooral belangrijk hoe jij werkt en problemen aanpakt. Een specifiek aantal jaren ervaring is daarom niet nodig.

Je:

• hebt ervaring in een dienstverlenende, coördinerende, plannende of probleemoplossende rol;
• kunt snel prioriteiten stellen wanneer meerdere zaken tegelijk spelen;
• blijft rustig en houdt overzicht wanneer de druk oploopt;
• bent communicatief sterk en weet monteurs, servicepartners en collega's duidelijk te woord te staan;
• vraagt door en stopt niet voordat je weet wat er nodig is;
• werkt nauwkeurig en vindt het prettig om met digitale systemen en verschillende soorten informatie te werken;

title: Deployment Engineer / Technisch Projectcoördinator
description:
InPost Deployment Engineer / Technisch Projectcoördinator | SmartRecruiters

• Google Chrome
• Microsoft Edge
• Apple Safari
• Mozilla Firefox

Deployment Engineer / Technisch Projectcoördinator

• Voltijds
• Vergoeding: EUR 2900 - EUR 4200 - per maand

Beschrijving van het bedrijf

Wij zijn een van de snelst groeiende logistieke spelers van Europa.

InPost Group is geen gewone logistieke dienstverlener. We zijn een van de grootste out-of-home bezorgnetwerken van Europa en actief in 9 landen. Met meer dan 61.000 pakketautomaten en ruim 1,4 miljard leveringen per jaar hebben we een stevige positie in Europa opgebouwd. Daarnaast opereren we binnen een internationaal consortium met aanzienlijke slagkracht.

In Nederland staan we aan het begin van een volgende groeifase. Vanaf 1 januari 2027 gaan we volledig verder onder de naam InPost. Een belangrijke stap in de verdere ontwikkeling van onze Nederlandse organisatie en merkpositionering.

Terwijl InPost in Europa al een gevestigde naam is, ligt er in Nederland nog een wereld aan mogelijkheden. En daar hebben we jou bij nodig!

Functieomschrijving

Een Parcel Locker plaatsen klinkt misschien eenvoudig. In de praktijk komt er behoorlijk wat bij kijken.

Is er voldoende stroom? Is de fundering geschikt? Kunnen installateurs goed bij de locatie komen? Kloppen de tekeningen? Is het grondwerk goed uitgevoerd? En staat de Locker uiteindelijk precies zoals afgesproken?

Jij zorgt dat het antwoord op al die vragen ja is.

Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de technische coördinatie en kwaliteitsbewaking van nieuwe Locker-installaties. Je houdt overzicht over meerdere locaties en projecten en schakelt continu tussen voorbereiding, uitvoering en nazorg.

Concreet betekent dit dat je:

• Het volledige deploymentproces van nieuwe Parcel Locker-locaties coördineert, van voorbereiding tot oplevering.
• Deployment- en werkschema's opstelt, bewaakt en waar nodig bijstuurt.
• Nieuwe locaties technisch beoordeelt op onder andere stroomvoorziening, fundering, bereikbaarheid en bouwkundige eisen.
• Technische tekeningen, locatierapportages en installatiespecificaties opstelt en controleert.
• Installateurs, aannemers, nutsbedrijven en andere externe partners aanstuurt en met elkaar afstemt.
• Toeziet op de kwaliteit van geplaatste Parcel Lockers en aanvullende werkzaamheden, zoals elektra en grondwerk.
• Technische problemen en afwijkingen snel analyseert en zorgt voor een praktische oplossing.
• Corrigerende en herstelmaatregelen bepaalt en de uitvoering daarvan bewaakt.
• Potentiële kwaliteitsproblemen zoveel mogelijk voorkomt voordat ze daadwerkelijk problemen worden.
• Het expansion team ondersteunt bij technische vraagstukken en collega's binnen andere netwerkafdelingen meeneemt in technische kennis en processen.
• Periodieke voortgangsrapportages opstelt over lopende deployments en projecten.
• Verantwoordelijkheid neemt voor voorraadbeheer, spare parts, bestellingen en de bijbehorende administratie, binnen de financiële richtlijnen.

Kort gezegd: jij zorgt ervoor dat een nieuwe locatie niet alleen op papier klopt, maar ook buiten op straat.

Functie-eisen

Je bent technisch sterk, maar hoeft niet de hele dag achter een bureau te zitten. Je vindt het juist interessant om techniek, planning en uitvoering bij elkaar te brengen.

Je bent iemand die ziet wat er moet gebeuren, het organiseert en niet loslaat totdat het geregeld is.

Daarom zoeken we iemand die:

• MBO+ of HBO werk- en denkniveau heeft, bij voorkeur richting bouwkunde, civiele techniek, elektrotechniek of een vergelijkbare technische richting.
• Ervaring heeft als werkvoorbereider, technisch projectcoördinator, assembly coördinator, technisch adviseur of in een vergelijkbare functie.
• Bij voorkeur minimaal 3 jaar relevante werkervaring heeft.
• Technische tekeningen, bestekken en technische specificaties kan lezen en interpreteren.
• Ervaring heeft met het coördineren van werkzaamheden en externe partners.
• Praktisch en oplossingsgericht is: als iets niet volgens plan loopt, zoek jij uit hoe het wél kan.
• Een scherp oog heeft voor kwaliteit en veiligheid.
• Goed kan plannen en prioriteiten kan stellen wanneer meerdere locaties en projecten tegelijkertijd lopen.
• Bereid is regelmatig op locatie te werken en beschikt over een geldig rijbewijs B.
• De Nederlandse en Engelse taal goed beheerst. Spreek je daarnaast Frans of Pools? Dan is dat mooi meegenomen.

Aanvullende informatie

Omdat je niet instapt in een organisatie die vooral wil beheren wat er al staat.

Je komt terecht in een organisatie die aan het bouwen is.

Nederland is voor InPost Group volop in ontwikkeling. Dat betekent dat je niet alleen uitvoert wat al jaren op dezelfde manier gebeurt, maar ook meedenkt over hoe we deployments slimmer, sneller en kwalitatief beter kunnen organiseren.

Je krijgt veel verantwoordelijkheid en ziet direct het resultaat van je werk. De locaties waar jij aan hebt meegebouwd, verschijnen daadwerkelijk in het Nederlandse straatbeeld.

Daarnaast werk je in een internationale omgeving met collega's, partners en projecten die verder gaan dan Nederland.

Wat krijg je ervoor terug?

• Een salaris tussen €2.900 en €4.200 bruto per maand, afhankelijk van kennis en ervaring.
• Een bonusstructuur waarin goede prestaties worden beloond.
• Een rol met veel verantwoordelijkheid en ruimte om zelf initiatief te nemen.
• De mogelijkheid om mee te bouwen aan een snelgroeiend Europees logistiek netwerk.
• Een internationale werkomgeving met veel ruimte voor ontwikkeling.
• Een afwisselende functie waarin je zowel technisch inhoudelijk als organisatorisch bezig bent.
• De mogelijkheid om deels vanuit huis te werken wanneer de werkzaamheden dat toelaten.
• Een vaste basis op ons HQ in Vianen. Voor deze functie rekenen we als richtlijn op ongeveer 4 dagen per week op kantoor, omdat je veel samenwerkt met collega's en partners.

Klaar om mee te bouwen?

Misschien vink je niet ieder punt van deze vacature af. Dat hoeft ook niet.

We zoeken geen perfect cv, maar iemand die technisch sterk, ondernemend en oplossingsgericht is. Iemand die verantwoordelijkheid pakt, nieuwsgierig is en energie krijgt van een omgeving waarin niet alles al vastligt.

Lijkt het je interessant om mee te bouwen aan het logistieke netwerk van de toekomst?

Solliciteer dan als Deployment Engineer / Technisch Projectcoördinator bij InPost Group.

title: Compliance Engineer
description:
About Playson

Playson builds premium casino games and platform solutions for operators worldwide. Our products reach millions of players across regulated markets, and we ship frequently - which means our certification and compliance evidence has to be as well-engineered as the games themselves.

We are hiring a Software Developer, Compliance, to own that engineering: a pipeline that lets us ship faster and safer, and a defence of the platform and the games that holds up in front of a lab, an ISO assessor, and a future SOC 2 auditor.

About the role

You are a software developer sitting inside compliance. You will build and continuously evolve a secure compliance pipeline so we can ship games and platform changes faster and safer - and you will be the technical person who defends what we shipped when an auditor, a certification lab, or a regulator asks.

The scope is not games alone. You will stand in front of game certification labs, and you will also defend the platform: ISO certification of our systems and the evidence work that leads into a future SOC 2 audit. In every case, the job is the same. You produce the proof. You walk the auditor through it. You answer the question that was asked, with the evidence that was requested, and you stop there.

You will own the technical side of game certification. You take a game math package from the review channel to the lab, you produce the evidence the lab needs - build hashes, PAR sheets, configuration snapshots, version manifests - and you answer the lab's technical questions yourself, without a developer sitting next to you. When a certificate comes back, you are the person who confirms every deficiency is closed before the game is allowed past the pre-release gate.

Between lab submissions, you treat the pipeline as a product. Manual evidence collection, one-off screenshots, and tribal knowledge are the things you replace. You automate controls, tighten the audit trail, and shorten the path from "ready to ship" to "ready to show an auditor" without weakening the bar. Faster and safer at the same time is the point of this role - not one at the expense of the other.

What we're looking for

• You are a developer first. 3+ years writing production code, comfortable reading someone else's codebase and forming your own opinion about what it does. You are not a documentation coordinator who learned some technical words
• Strong Node.js and TypeScript. Our game math packages, engine integration, rules and bets migrations, test suites, and compliance automation are all JavaScript-side. You will read game math code and verify that what it does matches what we told the lab it does - and you will write the tooling that makes that check repeatable
• You know what it takes to build certified products. You have worked for an iGaming game provider, a lottery, or another business where products require certification. You understand how that shapes development, testing, and releases, and why the code and supporting evidence need to stay aligned.
• You build pipelines, not checklists. You have taken a manual, high-stakes process and turned it into something engineered: automated evidence, versioned artefacts, gates that fail closed
• You can read data and write queries. SQL against a production analytics store, log investigation, understanding a metrics pipeline well enough to tell a real control failure from a broken dashboard
• Composure in front of an auditor. In a lab session, an ISO assessment, or a future SOC 2 walkthrough, you answer the question that was asked with the evidence that was requested. You communicate with auditors and certification labs precisely and factually. You provide complete evidence for the question or control being assessed, avoid speculation, and escalate regulatory interpretations to the Head of Compliance
• You know where your authority ends. When a question moves from technical fact to regulatory interpretation or commercial consequence, you route it to the Head of Compliance instead of improvising
• You write clearly and permanently. Compliance evidence is read years later by people who were not in the room. Your documentation has to survive that
• You are comfortable saying no. You will be the person telling a squad, under release pressure, that their change does not pass the gate. That conversation needs to be calm, specific, and final
• Precise by temperament. You check the version number rather than remembering it. You are not bored by an audit trail

Nice to have

• Direct dealings with a certification lab (GLI, BMM, eCOGRA, iTech Labs, or similar) or a gaming regulator
• Hands-on evidence work for ISO 27001, SOC 2, or an equivalent information-security audit
• Understanding of RNG, RTP mathematics, and how statistical certification evidence is produced
• Familiarity with multi-jurisdiction licensing (UKGC, MGA, and regulated EU and LatAm markets)
• Observability and alerting tooling - Datadog or equivalent, including building automation on top of it rather than just reading dashboards
• Experience with change-management controls, audit trails, and segregation-of-duties models
• Incident response experience, particularly where the incident had a regulatory or audit dimension

What you can expect on this role

• A role with real authority: you hold gate sign-off, and a release does not go past you without it
• Genuine engineering work - you own the compliance pipeline as a product, not a pile of checklists with a technical title
• Direct exposure to certification labs, ISO assessors, and the path to SOC 2 - rare and portable experience
• Close collaboration with math, QA, platform, and SRE across games and the platform
• A compliance function that is being built up deliberately, with room to shape how it works

What we offer

• Competitive Salary
• Quarterly Bonuses
• Unlimited Paid Time Off
• Unlimited Paid Sick Leave
• Remote & Flexible Working
• Private Medical Insurance
• Financial Support for Life Events
• Professional Development Budget
• International Exposure
• Regular Company Events

*Benefits may vary depending on location and contractual agreement

Join us today!

title: Content Manager
description:
About the Role

Playson is a leading online gaming supplier with worldwide recognition which was founded in 2012. We offer complete gaming solutions based on the latest technologies and detailed market analysis for the leading iGaming operators. We are looking for a Senior Content Manager. You’ll be part of a passionate, collaborative team that plays a key role in ensuring successful releases. No micromanagement, no endless bureaucracy, just meaningful creative work, ownership, and reach.

Key Responsibilities

• Write compelling and accurate texts for game previews and game rules in English.
• Implement the rules for the game clients.
• Work with structured file types (XML/JSON) to implement visual and textual content elements in a product.
• Oversee translation of the game rules and documentation through platforms like Crowdin, ensuring consistency and adherence to layout and character limitations.
• Collaborate with a cross-functional development team to polish and verify in-game content.
• Plan and manage content delivery according to game development milestones and market launch schedules.
• Create documentation that is compliant with market requirements and international legal regulations.
• Create names for games, game families, and built-in features, and review their accessibility by researching market trends and trademark databases.

Requirements

• iGaming experience, with a strong grasp of game mechanics and player engagement loops in slots or casino-style products.
• Organisational strength - tracking feedback, syncing with multiple stakeholders, and keeping documents and content tidy.
• Logical and structured thinking with the skill to organise information in a concise and easy-to-understand way.
• Ability to simplify complex mechanics into engaging, digestible explanations for a non-technical audience.
• Strong written English - grammar perfect, typo-averse, and able to write both crisply and cleverly.
• Experience producing user-friendly content for product and marketing use (UI description, previews, help info, or launch comms).
• A mind for naming - capable of creating titles, features, and hooks that feel fresh, bold, and aligned with the product.
• Comfort working with text files and structured formats (XML/JSON).
• Practical experience using AI tools (ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude), with the ability to critically evaluate their output and apply it appropriately.
• Proactive, reliable, and adaptable, with a strong sense of ownership and the flexibility to respond to changing priorities, resolve issues quickly, and continuously look for ways to improve processes and efficiency.
• Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across teams, maintain clear communication throughout the game development process, and reliably deliver work on time.

Nice to Have

• Prior exposure to slot mechanics, mobile games, or casino-style content.
• Basic proficiency with Photoshop - navigating layers, updating fonts, and exporting polished visuals
• Familiarity with Crowdin or similar translation/localisation management platforms.
• Experience working in IDEs (e.g., VSCode, WebStorm, Cursor) for light content verification or JSON editing.

What We Offer

• Competitive Salary: We offer a competitive salary, subject to annual performance reviews
• Quarterly Bonuses: Benefit from a transparent and systematic quarterly bonus system
• Flexible Schedule: We offer a flexible work schedule to accommodate your needs
• Remote Work Option: Choose to work remotely, providing greater flexibility and comfort
• Medical Insurance: Receive comprehensive medical insurance for both you and a significant other
• Financial Support for Life Events: We provide financial support during special life events
• Unlimited Paid Vacation: Enjoy unlimited paid vacation leave, including Ukrainian bank holidays
• Unlimited Paid Sick Leave: Take unlimited paid sick leave whenever necessary
• Professional Development: Get reimbursement for professional development courses and training

Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.

OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves.

Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er. OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.

About the Opportunity

We are seeking an experienced Product Manager with expertise in blockchain risk control, anti-money laundering (AML), and security protection to build a secure and compliant Web3 product ecosystem. You will conduct in-depth analysis of on-chain transaction risks, design risk management strategies, and collaborate with security, compliance, and engineering teams to develop highly secure Web3 wallets and DApp interaction products, ensuring the safety of user assets.

What You’ll Be Doing

• Risk Control & Security Product Planning
• Design risk control, AML, and security protection frameworks for Web3 products, and formulate risk management strategies.
• Research on-chain fraud patterns (e.g., phishing attacks, authorization hijacking, money laundering transactions) to optimize risk identification and interception mechanisms.
• Design and implement transaction security features, such as risk transaction alerts, malicious address blocking, and token contract security detection. Compliance & Anti-Money Laundering (AML)
• Monitor global blockchain compliance policies to ensure Web3 products meet regulatory requirements.
• Optimize AML risk control rules to improve suspicious transaction identification and interception capabilities, reducing compliance risks.
• Collaborate with legal and compliance teams to establish user AML processes and refine risk control review mechanisms. Security Product Design
• Research security risks such as smart contract vulnerabilities, wallet security, and private key management, and propose security solutions.
• Design security features to prevent phishing and authorization abuse, enhancing asset protection for users.
• Work with the security team to optimize on-chain transaction monitoring systems and improve abnormal transaction detection rates. Data Analysis & Strategy Optimization
• Analyze on-chain transaction data to identify potential risk patterns and continuously refine risk control models.
• Monitor industry security incidents (e.g., hacking attacks, fraud techniques) and rapidly iterate risk control strategies.

What We Look For In You

• Essential Qualifications
• 5+ years of product management experience, with at least 3 years in blockchain/Web3, and familiarity with DeFi, smart contracts, and wallet security.
• Strong understanding of blockchain risk control, AML, and security mechanisms, with knowledge of common fraud methods (e.g., MEV attacks, phishing scams, money laundering).
• Solid data analysis skills, capable of identifying risks through on-chain data (e.g., transaction graphs, address behavior).
• Familiarity with mainstream risk control technologies (e.g., rule engines, machine learning models), with prior product design experience preferred.
• Strong stress tolerance and ability to handle sustained high-intensity workloads. Excellent cross-team collaboration skills to work effectively with security, engineering, and compliance teams

Nice to Haves

• Prior experience in risk control or security products at exchanges, wallet providers, or security firms is a plus.
• Knowledge of blockchain and exchange compliance policies is preferred.
• Understanding of smart contract auditing, zero-knowledge proofs (ZKP), and other security technologies is a plus.

Perks & Benefits

• Competitive total compensation package
• L&D programs and Education subsidy for employees' growth and development
• Various team building programs and company events
• Wellness and meal allowances
• Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants
• More that we love to tell you along the process!

title: Digital Marketing Specialist
description:
PIB Group

The Role – Digital Marketing Specialist

Join PIB Group’s growing Specialty Marketing team, working across a varied portfolio of brands in insurance, employee benefits and risk management. You’ll deliver campaigns, improve websites and support lead generation in a role where your work will have a visible impact.

This is a hands-on delivery role across multiple PIB brands. The Digital Lead will set priorities and standards; you’ll turn agreed briefs into completed work across email, websites, landing pages, SEO, paid media, tracking and reporting. It is not a purely strategic, single-channel or agency-management role.

This role is available on a UK-based remote basis, with occasional travel for team meetings, conferences and other essential in-person activity. Candidates who prefer hybrid working may also work from a suitable PIB office.

While we don't expect you to be an expert in every area of Digital Marketing, we are looking for someone who specialises in Paid Search, Website Builds & Migrations, or Tracking & Analytics.

What you’ll be doing:

• Build, test and deliver email campaigns and automated email journeys or flows across multiple PIB brands.
• Support the ongoing development and improvement of our website portfolio, including website rebuilds, page building, content migration, SEO checks, quality assurance and launch activity.
• Build, manage and optimise paid search and paid social campaigns, including setup, landing pages, conversion tracking, reporting and lead generation for Sales teams.
• Deliver on-page and technical SEO improvements, and use GA4, Google Tag Manager and campaign tracking to measure performance and produce clear, actionable reporting.
• Take a proactive, responsible approach to AI: use approved tools to improve digital delivery, identify opportunities to adopt new capabilities as they become available, and work within PIB’s AI, data protection and regulatory policies.

description:
introduction

Location: Remote (UK, Ireland or Spain) Must be based in one of these countries with full right to work.

IAM Cloud builds software that simplifies IT management in the cloud. We are a fully employee owned, bootstrapped company - which means we answer to our customers and our team, not investors. With around 35 employees, we serve more than 3,500 organisations worldwide.

Being employee owned shapes how we work. Decisions are long-term, the culture is collaborative, and the people who build the company share in its success. This role is suited to a strong engineering-minded problem solver who can analyse difficult problems and connect the dots across the platform of our products, design robust solutions and deliver high quality software. • Design, develop, test and maintain high quality software throughout the full development lifecycle.

• Collaborate with product, engineering and leadership teams to deliver strategic initiatives.
• Analyse, diagnose and resolve difficult production and performance issues.
• Apply clean code, object-oriented design and software engineering best practices.
• Support technical decision making, code reviews and knowledge sharing across the team.

• Identify opportunities to improve systems, processes, scalability and reliability.

what we're looking for

• Strong professional experience developing software with C# and modern .NET.
• Excellent understanding of software engineering fundamentals, algorithms, system design and problem solving.
• Experience with ASP.NET Core, Web APIs, Entity Framework Core and SQL Server.
• Experience working with Azure services including web applications, functions, databases, event hubs and storage.
• Strong understanding of testing practices, version control and Agile delivery methodologies.
• Strong understanding of UI development, React-based applications, and static sites.
• Ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
• C1 level English proficiency or native-level fluency.
• STEM / Computer Science degree or equivalent evidence of advanced engineering capability and analytical problem-solving skills.
• Ability to work effectively in a fully remote environment.

• Azure DevOps and CI/CD pipelines.
• REST API documentation, Swagger/OpenAPI.

• Source generation in .NET.
• Full-stack development.

What Success Looks Like
The successful candidate will demonstrate exceptional technical competence, strong communication skills, the ability to break down and solve complex challenges, intellectual curiosity, and a proactive approach to delivering meaningful outcomes for customers and colleagues.

How we Work

• Fully remote across the UK, Ireland or Spain. We meet in person a few times a year for team events, but day-to-day work is remote.
• Small, senior team. You will work directly with engineering leadership and have real input into technical decisions.

why us?

Our Offer

Guaranteed £2,000 (or local equivalent) pay rise every year you're with us, separate from any merit or promotion increases.

Time off and flexibility

• 26 days holiday plus public holidays, with the option to swap public holidays for days that are more meaningful to you.

title: Senior Payroll Data Migration Specialists
description:
Salary: 36 - 43 EUR per hour (B2B)

Project Description:

We are looking for experienced Payroll Data Migration Specialists to join an international HR & Payroll transformation project.

The role focuses on coordinating and overseeing payroll data migration activities across multiple countries, ensuring data accuracy, consistency, and compliance with global migration standards.

The engagement is scheduled to begin in January/February 2027 on a full-time basis. The initial duration is a minimum of 6 months, with the possibility of extension.

About Spyrosoft

Spyrosoft is an authentic, cutting-edge software engineering company, established in 2016. In 2021 and 2022, we were among the fastest growing technology companies in Europe, according to the Financial Times. We were founded by a group of tech experts with established backgrounds in software engineering, who created an ‘engineer-to-engineer’ workplace, powered by enthusiasm, fairness and authentic relationships. Having a unique offering, which bridge the gap between technology and business, we specialise in technology solutions for industry 4.0, automotive, geospatial, healthcare & life sciences, employee experience & education and financial services industries.

Requirements:

• Data migration
• Data structures
• Data mapping
• ETL
• Project management
• Security

Required Qualifications:

• Hands-on experience with Workday – mandatory.
• Business-fluent English, both written and spoken.
• Proven experience in complex, preferably international, data migration projects.
• Strong understanding of HR and payroll data structures, processes, and dependencies.
• Practical experience with data mapping, data cleansing, data validation, and reconciliation.
• Good understanding of ETL processes and data migration methodologies.
• Experience in stakeholder coordination and project management.
• Ability to work effectively with international teams and country-level stakeholders.
• Understanding of data protection and security principles related to sensitive personnel and payroll data.
• Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
• Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities in a global project environment.

Nice to Have:

• Previous experience in global Workday implementations or payroll transformation programmes.
• Experience coordinating multi-country payroll migrations.
• Familiarity with payroll compliance requirements across different countries.
• Experience with migration readiness assessments, cutover planning, and post-migration validation

Daily tasks:

• Coordinate payroll data migration activities across multiple countries, ensuring alignment with the global migration methodology.
• Ensure migration documentation, deliverables, and supporting evidence are complete, consistent, and traceable.
• Consolidate migration progress, track key milestones, and provide status updates across participating countries.
• Assess migration readiness, identify potential risks, and provide recommendations to the Global Project Manager and Programme Manager.
• Define and oversee data cleansing strategies to ensure data quality and migration readiness.
• Monitor Extraction, Transformation & Loading (ETL) processes from legacy HR/payroll systems into the target environment.
• Establish reconciliation frameworks to validate the accuracy and completeness of migrated data.
• Perform or coordinate payroll data reconciliations, including headcount, salary totals, tax configurations, and other critical payroll elements.
• Collaborate with international stakeholders, local country teams, and technical teams to resolve migration-related issues.
• Ensure compliance with data protection, confidentiality, and security requirements when handling sensitive employee information.

title: Specjalista/ka ds. Ochrony Środowiska
description:
Salary: 8500 - 10000 PLN per month (permanent)

Twoja przyszła firma

Dla Naszego klienta, międzynarodowej firmy produkcyjnej z obszaru FMCG, poszukujemy Specjalisty/ki ds. Ochrony Środowiska.

Oferta

• Umowę o pracę
• Wynagrodzenie podstawowe + premię roczną
• Pracę od poniedziałku do piątku w godzinach 8-16.
• Pakiet benefitów: m.in. prywatna opieka medyczna, dofinansowanie do karty sportowej, ubezpieczenie na życie, dofinansowanie do wypoczynku, punkty na platformie kafeteryjnej, paczki świąteczne i firmowe gadżety
• Rozwój zawodowy – szkolenia, możliwość podnoszenia kwalifikacji i zdobywania doświadczenia w praktyce

Requirements:

• MS Office
• MS Excel

• Doświadczenie zawodowe związane z ochroną środowiska zdobyte w branży produkcyjnej – min. 1 rok - WARUNEK KONIECZNY
• Gotowość do pracy w 100% stacjonarnej
• Znajomość teoretyczna oraz praktyczna systemów związanych z ochroną środowiska
• Wykształcenie wyższe – kierunek Ochrona Środowiska lub pokrewne – WARUNEK KONIECZNY
• Znajomość języka angielskiego – poziom min. B1
• Praktyczna znajomość programów MS Office, w szczególności MS Excel

Daily tasks:

• Bieżące aktualizowanie wewnętrznej dokumentacji dotyczącej gospodarki odpadami, ochrony środowiska oraz normy ISO 14001.
• Prowadzenie wymaganej sprawozdawczości środowiskowej, w tym raportowania do KOBiZE, przygotowywania kwartalnych zestawień dotyczących zużycia wody oraz prowadzenia ewidencji i naliczania opłat za korzystanie ze środowiska.
• Przygotowywanie dokumentacji niezbędnej do uzyskania pozwoleń i decyzji środowiskowych we współpracy z podmiotami zewnętrznymi oraz aktywne uczestnictwo w prowadzonych postępowaniach administracyjnych.
• Nadzór nad prawidłową realizacją procesów związanych z gospodarką odpadami, w tym obsługa i prowadzenie wymaganej dokumentacji w systemie BDO.
• Realizacja okresowych audytów środowiskowych oraz monitorowanie zgodności działalności z obowiązującymi wymaganiami.
• Współpraca z firmami zewnętrznymi odpowiedzialnymi za odbiór, transport i zagospodarowanie odpadów.
• Współpraca z laboratoriami oraz innymi podmiotami realizującymi badania, pomiary i monitoring dotyczący stanu środowiska.
