title: WMS Consultant with French
description:
We are looking for an experienced WMS Functional Consultant fluent in French to drive Warehouse Management System (WMS) implementation, rollouts, and functional enhancements. In this role, you will act as the key liaison between operational logistics teams and technical delivery squads, ensuring supply chain processes in manufacturing, distribution, and warehousing are translated into scalable, efficient WMS solutions.

Key Responsibilities

• Business Analysis & Gathering Requirements: Lead functional discovery workshops with French-speaking business stakeholders and warehouse operations teams to capture end-to-end supply chain requirements.
• Functional Solution Design: Map and design core warehousing processes (Inbound/Outbound, Putaway, Picking, Packing, Inventory Management, VAS) within the target WMS platform.
• Implementation & Rollouts: Support functional implementation, configuration, deployment, and localized rollout activities for international warehouse sites.
• Testing & Quality Assurance: Design test scenarios, coordinate User Acceptance Testing (UAT), and validate business workflows against target solution architecture.
• Training & Change Management: Prepare functional documentation, user guides, and deliver training sessions to warehouse operational teams and end-users.
• Hypercare & Support: Provide functional expertise, root-cause analysis, and process optimization during post-go-live stabilization phases.

Requirements & Qualifications

• WMS Expertise: Proven experience as a Functional Consultant working with enterprise Warehouse Management Systems (e.g., Manhattan Associates, Blue Yonder, SAP EWM, Generix, Reflex WMS, or Infor WMS).
• Domain Knowledge: Solid understanding of supply chain, logistics, distribution, or manufacturing environment operations.
• Consulting Background: Previous experience in client-facing consulting, system integration, or end-to-end software deployment projects.
• Language Skills: French (B2+/C1 level) with the ability to lead meetings and produce functional documentation in French; professional English for internal coordination.
• Stakeholder Management: Strong communication and facilitation skills to bridge business needs with technical delivery teams.

Nice to Have

• Experience with warehouse automation systems (MHE, WCS/WES integration, RF scanning, voice picking).
• Basic knowledge of integration protocols (EDI, REST APIs, Flat files) between WMS and ERP systems (e.g., SAP, Dynamics 365).

title: Senior Insurance Technology Consultant
description:
We're looking for a Senior Insurance Technology Consultant to join our team in Gdańsk, Katowice, Kraków, Łódź, Poznań, Wrocław, or Warsaw, Poland, in a hybrid working mode.

As part of EPAM's growing Insurance Business Unit, you will work in a high-visibility, client-facing role that drives AI and cloud transformation programs for leading insurance organizations. This position offers the opportunity to influence business outcomes, deliver strategic technology solutions and shape EPAM’s presence in the Polish and European insurance markets. By joining EPAM, you will access a global network of experts, continuous learning resources and career growth opportunities in a collaborative environment.

Responsibilities

• Engage C-level stakeholders to define technology and AI transformation strategies for insurance clients across Europe
• Lead executive workshops, architecture reviews and strategic advisory sessions
• Translate complex technical concepts into clear business-value narratives for diverse audiences
• Validate and shape AI-powered solution strategies on enterprise cloud platforms
• Drive AI transformation initiatives, including adoption of GenAI tooling and developer productivity solutions
• Recommend cloud architecture patterns aligned with regulatory requirements such as GDPR, DORA and Solvency II
• Enable internal AI capabilities, including GenAI enablement programs and ROI measurement frameworks
• Support business development activities and identify new opportunities in European and Polish insurance markets
• Collaborate with EPAM teams on proposals, client interviews and growth strategies

Requirements

• 8+ years of industry or consulting experience, including 5+ years working with major cloud platforms (Azure, AWS or GCP)
• Expertise in AI strategy and GenAI/LLM-based solutions, with hands-on understanding of enterprise deployment
• Solid knowledge of cloud-native architecture patterns (microservices, event-driven design, DevSecOps, CI/CD)
• Familiarity with AI lifecycle in SDLC environments, including prompt engineering and governance frameworks
• Strong understanding of the insurance value chain in P&C, Life and Reinsurance, and related regulatory landscapes
• Understanding of EU and Polish compliance frameworks (GDPR, DORA, Solvency II, KNF)
• Proven consulting experience, including RFP support, business case design and executive workshop facilitation
• Excellent communication skills and ability to influence C-level stakeholders
• Fluent English; Polish language is an advantage
• Willingness to travel across Europe (up to 30–40%)

Nice to have

• Microsoft Certified: Azure AI Engineer Associate (or equivalent AWS/GCP certifications)
• Experience in platform engineering, Team Topologies or Domain-Driven Design (DDD) in an insurance context

We offer

• We gather like-minded people:
• Top tech minds driving innovation in AI, cloud and digital platform modernization
• Supportive team and agile, startup-like culture
• Hybrid by design mode and opportunity to work remotely within Poland
• Chance to work abroad for up to 60 days annually
• Business-driven relocation opportunities
• We provide growth opportunities:
• Career development programs
• Thought leadership, mentoring, soft skills and well-being programs
• Certification (Anthropic, Gemini, GCP, Azure, AWS)
• English classes
• We cover it all:
• Stable pay
• Participation in the Employee Stock Purchase Plan with a 15% discount
• Benefits package (health insurance, multisport, shopping vouchers)
• Referral bonuses up to $2,000
• Offices featuring entertainment and relaxation zones, table tennis and football, free snacks, coffee and more
• Corporate, social and well-being events
• Please, note:
• Benefits listed above are available to employees only
• We are open for working with Contractors. Terms of B2B cooperation agreements are agreed individually
• We will reach out to selected candidates exclusively

EPAM is global leader in AI transformation engineering and integrated consulting, serving Forbes Global 2000 companies and ambitious startups. With over thirty years of expertise in custom software, product and platform engineering, we empower our clients to become AI-Native enterprises, driving measurable value from innovation and digital investments.

title: Power Platform Solution Architect & Developer
description:
Want to make an impact? We offer that

Due to continued growth, we are hiring an experienced Power Platform Solution Architect & Developer who combines enterprise architecture expertise with hands-on development capability. The role involves designing and delivering new business applications, enhance and modernise existing solutions, and ensure that all implementations align with enterprise architecture, security, data, integration, governance, and application lifecycle management standards.

The successful candidate must demonstrate current, in-depth knowledge of established and emerging Power Platform capabilities and be able to select appropriate technologies based on business requirements, security, scalability, maintainability, supportability, licensing, and cost.

Key Responsibilities:

• Design scalable, secure, and maintainable Power Platform solution architecture.
• Lead discovery and technical design workshops to capture functional and non-functional requirements, assess constraints and dependencies, evaluate solution options, and translate agreed requirements into scalable, secure, supportable, and maintainable solution designs.
• Provide technical leadership and mentoring to developers, consultants, and business analysts.
• Ensure adherence to security, compliance, and data governance standards.
• Establish development standards, conduct design, code, configuration, security, and release-readiness reviews to ensure solutions are testable, supportable, documented, and suitable for controlled deployment into production.
• Collaborate with stakeholders across business, delivery teams, and leadership.
• Create new enterprise-scale Power Platform solutions.
• Operate within the organisation’s architecture and delivery governance processes, presenting designs for review and working with enterprise architecture, data, security, integration, infrastructure, and operational support teams to resolve design decisions and delivery risks.
• Assess existing Power Platform solutions and lead their upgrade or modernisation, including remediation of technical debt, deprecated features, unsupported components, performance issues, security weaknesses, and gaps in documentation, monitoring, testing, or ALM.

Requirements:

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or equivalent experience.
• Microsoft certifications such as Power Platform Solution Architect Expert (PL-600), Power Platform Developer Associate (PL-400), and Power Platform Functional Consultant Associate (PL-200), or others.
• 5+ years of hands-on experience delivering Microsoft Power Platform solutions, with demonstrated experience in both solution architecture and development within complex or enterprise environments.
• Proven experience designing, configuring, developing, testing, monitoring, and optimising Canvas Apps, Model-Driven Apps, Power Automate cloud flows, and Azure Logic Apps, applying best practices in user experience, accessibility, security, performance, delegation, error handling, maintainability, concurrency, retry policies, exception handling, secure connection management, service protection limits, and operational support.
• Experience in Power Platform security and governance, including environment strategy, Microsoft Entra ID groups, Dataverse security roles and teams, business units, field-level security, sharing, application access, service principals, service accounts, managed identities, and data loss prevention (DLP) policies.
• Strong knowledge of database design, data modelling, and data integration patterns, with hands-on experience in Dataverse, SharePoint, Power Pages, Power BI, standard and premium connectors, business process flows, classic workflows and their modernisation, Synapse Link, and enterprise integration solutions.

description:
IMPORTANT: after you apply, please check your email. We sendyou a link to complete your application — it is not considered until that laststep is done. If you do not see it, check your spam folder.

This is a fully remote position, open to candidates based in 55 countries, including United States, United Kingdom, Canada, Germany, India, France, Netherlands, Singapore.

Pay: $40–$90/hr

Role Title: Senior Mechanical Design Engineer

Role Type: Contractor (~15hrs/week)

Location: Remote

We are engaging Senior Mechanical Design Engineers to contribute to a customer's project involving complex CAD assembly exploration and AI advancement. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required — your domain knowledge is what matters.

Scope of Work

• Analyze and dissect multi-part mechanical assemblies to identify critical design decisions, constraints, and potential failure points that challenge expert reasoning.
• Formulate challenging, non-obvious technical questions that test real-world mechanical design judgment, ensuring relevance and difficulty beyond junior-level understanding.
• Validate and document defensible, exact answers directly from CAD models, ensuring clear traceability and accuracy.
• Review AI-generated outputs, pinpoint breakdowns or inaccuracies in mechanical reasoning, and suggest targeted improvements.
• Flag ambiguous, trivial, or unanswerable questions, refining or sharpening them for clarity and precision.
• Thoroughly document edge cases and sources of disagreement within answers to maintain strict verifiability.
• Communicate findings and reasoning in clear, professional written and verbal form to support continuous project improvement.

Preferred Qualifications

• 5+ years of professional experience creating and overseeing multi-part mechanical assemblies from concept, not just from existing drawings.
• Mastery in at least one major parametric CAD tool (SolidWorks, Creo, NX, CATIA, Inventor, Fusion, Onshape, or Solid Edge).
• Demonstrated experience in teaching, mentoring, or leading — whether through formal instruction, leading design reviews, or coaching engineering teams.
• Expertise in design intent, assembly reasoning, mechanism and kinematic analysis, and robust GD&T/tolerance judgment.
• Background in at least one discipline: industrial machinery and automation, robotics, automotive and heavy equipment, aerospace and defense, medical devices, consumer products, or tooling and fixture design.
• Exceptional written English communication skills — your documentation directly influences project deliverables.
• Bonus: Experience with FreeCAD, advanced GD&T/tolerance analysis, or formal design review leadership.

title: Junior Product Manager
description:
Kim jesteśmy? 🚚💨

Tworzymy innowacyjny produkt z obszaru logistyki i transportu, rozwijany przy wsparciu brytyjskiego kapitału. Nasz cel jest prosty: chcemy, żeby transport był prostszy, szybszy i bardziej cyfrowy.

Budujemy platformę, która rozwiązuje realne problemy użytkowników — i właśnie dlatego szukamy Product Designera, który pomoże nam rozwijać ją dalej.

Szukamy osoby na początku swojej drogi produktowej, która chce szybko się rozwijać, brać odpowiedzialność za realne problemy użytkowników i mieć bezpośredni wpływ na rozwój produktu.

Co będziesz robić?

🔎 Odkrywać prawdziwe potrzeby użytkowników
Będziesz prowadzić discovery, rozmawiać z użytkownikami, analizować feedback i dane, definiować problemy oraz przekładać je na konkretne rozwiązania produktowe.

🎯 Brać ownership za fragmenty produktu
Od zrozumienia problemu i postawienia hipotezy, przez priorytetyzację i określenie scope’u, aż po wdrożenie i sprawdzenie efektów. Nie chodzi o samo tworzenie ticketów — chcemy, żebyś rozumiał/a dlaczego coś budujemy i jaki problem rozwiązujemy.

🤝 Pracować blisko z zespołem
Na co dzień będziesz współpracować z developerami i zespołem produktowym. Będziesz doprecyzowywać rozwiązania, podejmować decyzje produktowe i pilnować, żeby dobre pomysły faktycznie trafiały do użytkowników.

💡 Inicjować, a nie czekać na brief
Jeśli widzisz problem, działasz. Organizujesz warsztat, robisz research, zbierasz ludzi do burzy mózgów albo przychodzisz z pierwszą propozycją rozwiązania.

✅ Doprowadzać tematy do końca
Walidujesz hipotezy, pilnujesz delivery i sprawdzasz rezultaty po wdrożeniu. Zależy nam na osobach, które nie zostawiają tematów w połowie.

🤖 Wykorzystywać AI w codziennej pracy
AI traktujemy jak normalne narzędzie pracy. Wykorzystujemy je do researchu, analizy feedbacku, syntezy informacji, przygotowywania materiałów produktowych czy szybkiego testowania pomysłów.

Kogo szukamy? Może właśnie Ciebie ✨

Nie oczekujemy kilku lat doświadczenia. Bardziej interesuje nas to, jak myślisz i jak rozwiązujesz problemy.

Szukamy osoby, która:

• jest na początku kariery produktowej (Junior / Early Career) i potrafi pokazać swoje myślenie na konkretnych przykładach — mogą to być case studies, side projecty, doświadczenie startupowe albo projekty z poprzednich ról;
• potrafi zrozumieć problem użytkownika, postawić hipotezę i dojść do sensownego rozwiązania;
• regularnie korzysta z AI i potrafi wykorzystać je do przyspieszania swojej pracy;
• lubi rozwiązywać łamigłówki i nie boi się skomplikowanych systemów — a logistyka potrafi być naprawdę złożona;
• bierze odpowiedzialność za swoje tematy: dopytuje, szuka odpowiedzi i wraca z propozycją rozwiązania, a nie tylko listą problemów;
• jest dobrze zorganizowana i potrafi skutecznie współpracować z innymi;
• jasno komunikuje swoje decyzje i potrafi wytłumaczyć, dlaczego dane rozwiązanie ma sens;
• zna angielski na poziomie pozwalającym na swobodną komunikację i pracę z materiałami produktowymi.

Doświadczenie w logistyce lub transporcie będzie dodatkowym atutem, ale nie jest wymagane. Jeśli po prostu ciekawi Cię ta branża — również chętnie Cię poznamy.

Co oferujemy?

🚀 Realny wpływ na produkt
Nie będziesz jednym z wielu trybików. Od początku będziesz pracować nad problemami, których rozwiązania trafiają do użytkowników i wpływają na rozwój platformy.

📈 Szybką ścieżkę rozwoju
Będziesz pracować blisko zespołu produktowego i technologicznego, ucząc się product managementu na realnych problemach, a nie wyłącznie w teorii.

🤖 Nowoczesne narzędzia i AI
Eksperymentujemy, automatyzujemy i szukamy sposobów na szybszą oraz mądrzejszą pracę. Dostaniesz przestrzeń do testowania nowych narzędzi i podejść.

🎓 Inwestycję w Twój rozwój
Kursy, szkolenia i warsztaty branżowe — jeśli coś pomoże Ci stać się lepszym Product Managerem, chcemy Ci w tym pomóc.

🙌 Zespół, z którym dobrze się pracuje
Stawiamy na otwartą komunikację, współpracę i dużą samodzielność. Pomysły mogą pochodzić od każdego — liczy się przede wszystkim ich jakość.

🏢 Świetne biuro blisko Warszawy Zachodniej
Pracujemy razem z biura 4 dni w tygodniu, w nowoczesnej i komfortowej przestrzeni, która sprzyja współpracy, wymianie pomysłów i kreatywnej pracy (jestesmy flexible - oczywiscie w zaleznosci od sytuacji, mozemy sie dostosować do Twoich preferencji dotyczacych pracy hybrydowej)

🏋️ Dodatkowo:
trener personalny, siłownia, masaże oraz pakiet medyczny Enel-Med.

Jak wygląda rekrutacja?

1. CV + krótka rozmowa online
Poznajmy się i sprawdźmy, czy wzajemnie pasują nam oczekiwania.

2. Spotkanie w naszym biurze + case produktowy (~3h)
Poznasz zespół i wspólnie przejdziemy przez problem produktowy. Nie szukamy jednej „poprawnej” odpowiedzi — chcemy zobaczyć, jak analizujesz problem, zadajesz pytania, priorytetyzujesz i dochodzisz do rozwiązania.

3. Rozmowa z założycielem firmy

Jeśli lubisz rozwiązywać problemy, chcesz szybko rozwijać się w product managemencie i zależy Ci na pracy, w której naprawdę zobaczysz efekty swoich decyzji — odezwij się do nas. 🚚🚀

title: QA Engineer Python
description:
Wspólnie z naszym Partnerem, amerykańskim producentem sprzętu fitness, poszukujemy osoby do świadczenia usług jako QA Engineer (Python).

Projekt dotyczy budowy zaawansowanej platformy treningowej nowej generacji, integrującej sztuczną inteligencję, dane z urządzeń wearable oraz spersonalizowane plany zdrowotne.

• Logowanie, śledzenie i retestowanie defektów w Jira oraz utrzymywanie przypadków testowych w TestRail z mapowaniem wyników automatycznych.
• Integrowanie suit testowych z pipeline'ami CI/CD jako bramki jakości dla wydań, w tym uruchamianie testów cross-device na iOS i Android.
• Tworzenie i utrzymywanie narzędzi do zarządzania danymi testowymi, inicjowanie, seedowanie i teardown za pomocą helperów API.
• Projektowanie, budowanie i utrzymywanie automatycznych suit testowych obejmujących testy mobilne E2E, API oraz regresję.

🔍 WYMAGANE KOMPETENCJE:

• Minimum 3 lata doświadczenia w QA, w tym 1+ rok w automatyzacji testów API na systemach produkcyjnych, z wykorzystaniem Python, pytest i fixtures oraz doświadczenie w tworzeniu i utrzymywaniu kodu testowego.
• Praktyczna znajomość contract testingu z Pact (consumer-driven contracts) oraz testowania bezpieczeństwa API, w tym authorization boundaries, token handling, malformed/hostile input.

• Doświadczenie w testowaniu rozwiązań AI/LLM, w tym praca z datasets, golden sets, quality metrics, prompt engineering, ocena regresji, hallucinations i prompt injection oraz definiowanie kryteriów dla niedeterministycznych wyników.
• Znajomość backendu (logi, database queries), Git (branches, pull requests, code reviews) oraz TestRail (test cases, run tracking).
• Doświadczenie w pracy z produktami mobilnymi Android/iOS.
• Bardzo dobra znajomość j. angielskiego (min. C1).

Mile widziane:

• Znajomość Langfuse, LangSmith lub Phoenix, praca z traces i dołączanie ewaluacji.
• Doświadczenie z LangGraph, testowanie agentów jako grafów stanów, zarówno pojedynczych węzłów, jak i pełnych przepływów.
• Znajomość Python z Appium, automatyzacja testów mobilnych jako uzupełnienie testów API.

Kluczowym obszarem będzie również zabezpieczanie zależności, procesów buildowania i deploymentu, w tym wykorzystanie SBOM, dependency management, vulnerability management oraz automatycznych kontroli bezpieczeństwa w CI/CD.

Zakres obowiązków:

• Automatyzacja procesów build, test i secure deployment

• Udział w threat modeling oraz security design reviews

title: Senior DevOps Engineer, OpenStack Team
description:
Mirantis Senior DevOps Engineer, OpenStack Team | SmartRecruiters

• Google Chrome
• Microsoft Edge
• Apple Safari
• Mozilla Firefox

Senior DevOps Engineer, OpenStack Team

• Full-time

Company Description

About Mirantis

Mirantis is the Kubernetes-native AI infrastructure company, enabling organizations to build and operate scalable, secure, and sovereign infrastructure for modern AI, machine learning, and data-intensive applications. By combining open source innovation with deep expertise in Kubernetes orchestration, Mirantis empowers platform engineering teams to deliver composable, production-ready developer platforms across any environment—on-premises, in the cloud, at the edge, or in sovereign data centers. As enterprises navigate the growing complexity of AI-driven workloads, Mirantis delivers the automation, GPU orchestration, and policy-driven control needed to manage infrastructure with confidence and agility. Committed to open standards and freedom from lock-in, Mirantis ensures that customers retain full control of their infrastructure strategy.

Job Description

We are looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer to join the MOSK (Mirantis OpenStack for Kubernetes) product team, working at the intersection of OpenStack, Kubernetes, and product engineering. In this role, you will help design, validate, and evolve a cloud-native OpenStack platform that enables customers to build and operate enterprise-grade private clouds at scale.

As a senior engineer, you will act as a technical authority on OpenStack and MOSK behavior, contribute to architectural decisions, support complex customer scenarios, and help ensure stable, high-quality product releases.

Key Responsibilities

Feature Design & Development

• Contribute to Product Roadmap: Actively influence the MOSK roadmap and backlog by providing technical input on feature feasibility, architectural scalability, and long-term maintainability. Evaluate incoming customer requests for specific features by analyzing upstream OpenStack code, specifications, blueprints, and community documentation to assess feature maturity, stability, limitations, and operational caveats.
• Lifecycle Management Engineering: Design, implement, and document lifecycle management for OpenStack on Kubernetes — a core MOSK capability — with emphasis on non-disruptive upgrades, patching, scaling, rollback strategies, and feature compatibility across upgrades.
• Feature Validation & Integration: Drive validation of enabled features by defining test scenarios, validating upstream code behavior in simulated or production-like deployments, and then integrating feature support into MOSK’s lifecycle management.
• Technical Design Reviews: Review and refine product designs, APIs, and implementations to ensure robustness, security, and a high-quality developer experience.
• Engineering Leadership: Lead design discussions, planning sessions, and retrospectives; help the team to uphold high standards for software quality, architectural rigor, and operational readiness.

Product Engineering & Automation

• Frameworks & Tooling Development: Design, implement, and maintain core frameworks, libraries, and internal tools that underpin MOSK development, testing, and lifecycle operations.
• Advanced Automation: Build and evolve automation for deploying and managing complex OpenStack-on-Kubernetes environments used in development, testing, and validation.
• CI/CD Architecture: Design, build, and maintain CI/CD pipelines and integrations with external systems to streamline build, test, validation, upgrade, and release workflows.

Operational Reliability

• Tier-3 Escalation Support: Debug and resolve complex issues in customer production environments involving Kubernetes, OpenStack, networking, storage, and distributed systems.
• Upstream Troubleshooting & Contributions: Investigate issues in OpenStack services, analyze root causes at the code level, and propose or contribute minor fixes upstream to improve product stability and supportability.
• Performance & Scalability Analysis: Identify and analyze performance bottlenecks across hardware and software layers; provide fixes, optimizations, and tuning recommendations.
• Operational Readiness: Manage and improve development, staging, and validation environments that closely mirror customer deployments to ensure release stability.
• Product Knowledge Authority: Act as an authoritative technical source for MOSK and OpenStack behavior, providing accurate, engineering-level input to documentation, field, and enablement teams to ensure correctness and consistency of product documentation and guidance. Participate in technical reviews, demos, and knowledge-sharing sessions to support engineering and other customer-facing teams.

Qualifications

Experience & Education

• At least 5 years of practical administration experience in Linux (CentOS, Ubuntu, RHEL) as a server platform.
• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.
• Experience in software development, Systems Administration, or SRE role.

Technical Skills

• Operating Systems: Deep understanding of the OS, ability to debug and tune underperforming systems, and troubleshoot software and hardware issues.
• Networking: Strong knowledge of networking technologies, including protocols, firewalls, and VPNs. Experience with managing and configuring networking equipment.
• Automation Tools: Practical experience with SaltStack, Puppet, Ansible, or Chef for medium and large environments.
• Infrastructure as Code: Practical experience with Terraform.
• Containerization: Be an expert in Docker and Kubernetes in production environments. Thorough understanding and practical experience with Kubernetes operators and Helm.
• CI/CD: Strong experience with Jenkins and building dependable build/release pipelines.
• Familiarity with code-review systems
• Cloud Platforms: Understanding of principles of working in cloud environments such as OpenStack, AWS, GCP, or Azure.
• Scripting & Programming: Strong scripting skills in Bash, Groovy, and Python (at least one is required). Mid-level experience with Go or C is valuable.

Preferred Qualifications (Will be a plus)

• Deep understanding of OpenStack architecture and experience with running it in production.
• Knowledge and experience with SDN (Software Defined Networking) solutions - Open Virtual Network, Open vSwitch.

description:
Job Title: Clinical Monitoring Excellence Lead - FSP EMEA

Job Location: Reading, Berkshire, United Kingdom

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

Clinical Monitoring Excellence Lead

Job Overview

The Clinical Monitoring Excellence Lead is a global leadership role responsible for the ownership, governance, optimization, and continuous improvement of end-to-end site management and monitoring processes across the clinical development portfolio. The role ensures that monitoring practices are globally harmonized, efficient, inspection-ready, and compliant with ICH-GCP, applicable regulatory requirements, quality standards, and evolving industry expectations.

The Clinical Monitoring Excellence Lead drives strategic process innovation, operational excellence, and organizational change management across functions, regions, CRO partners, and vendor organizations. This individual serves as the organization's subject matter expert for site management and monitoring processes, ensuring scalable and sustainable solutions that support high-quality clinical trial execution.

Key Responsibilities

• Own and govern global site management and clinical monitoring processes, standards, procedures, controls, roles, responsibilities, and escalation pathways.
• Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on process simplification, standardization, automation, and operational excellence across the monitoring ecosystem.
• Lead implementation of modern clinical trial delivery models, risk-based monitoring approaches, and innovative technologies to improve performance and quality.
• Ensure global processes remain compliant with ICH-GCP, ICH E6(R3), Quality by Design principles, risk-based quality management frameworks, and applicable international regulations.
• Establish and oversee key performance indicators (KPIs), key quality indicators (KQIs), and operational metrics to identify trends, risks, and improvement opportunities.
• Provide strategic leadership for inspection readiness initiatives and support internal audits, health authority inspections, and quality reviews.
• Partner with Clinical Operations, Quality Assurance, Data Management, Regulatory Affairs, CROs, and other stakeholders to drive consistent process execution globally.
• Lead cross-functional process transformation and change management initiatives to ensure successful adoption of new ways of working.
• Develop and maintain process documentation, guidance materials, training curricula, job aids, and best practices.
• Serve as the subject matter expert for site management and monitoring processes, providing consultation and strategic recommendations to senior leadership.
• Evaluate emerging industry trends, technologies, and regulatory developments to inform future-state monitoring strategies.
• Support vendor oversight and partnership models to ensure alignment with process standards and quality expectations.
• Promote a culture of quality, continuous improvement, operational excellence, and knowledge sharing across global teams.

Qualifications

Required Experience

• Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Nursing, Pharmacy, or a related discipline. Advanced degree preferred.
• Minimum 12 years of experience in clinical research, clinical development, or clinical operations.
• Significant experience in clinical monitoring, site management, or operational excellence within global clinical trials.
• Demonstrated experience leading global process improvement, operational transformation, or quality-focused initiatives.
• Strong expertise in ICH-GCP, ICH E6(R3), risk-based monitoring, Quality by Design, and quality management systems.
• Experience working within global, matrixed organizations and collaborating across multiple regions and cultures.
• Proven track record of driving organizational change and influencing stakeholders at multiple levels.
• Experience supporting regulatory inspections, audits, and inspection readiness programs.
• Prior people leadership, mentoring, or matrix leadership experience strongly preferred.

Skills & Competencies

• Strong strategic thinking and process optimization capabilities.
• Advanced analytical and data-driven decision-making skills.
• Deep understanding of clinical trial monitoring methodologies and site management best practices.
• Expertise in process governance, risk assessment, and quality management.
• Strong change management and stakeholder engagement capabilities.
• Ability to identify operational inefficiencies and implement scalable improvements.
• Excellent problem-solving, critical-thinking, and decision-making skills.
• Strong leadership and influencing abilities across global, cross-functional teams.
• Outstanding presentation, communication, and facilitation skills.
• High level of cultural awareness and ability to work effectively across geographies.
• Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and complex initiatives simultaneously.
• Self-motivated, proactive, and comfortable operating in a highly dynamic environment.
• Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications and clinical technology platforms.
• Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.

Preferred Background

Candidates may come from roles such as:

• Clinical Monitoring Excellence Lead
• Director, Clinical Monitoring
• Associate Director, Clinical Operations Excellence
• Head of Monitoring
• Monitoring Process Excellence Lead
• Director, Site Management
• Clinical Quality and Compliance Lead
• Global Clinical Operations Excellence Manager
• Risk-Based Monitoring Lead
• Clinical Process Improvement Lead

This role provides the opportunity to shape and continuously improve the future of global clinical monitoring and site management, driving operational excellence, quality, compliance, and innovation across the clinical development portfolio.

title: Assistant Site Manager - Events (Bristol)
description:
Hey there!
We’re Fever, the world’s leading tech platform for culture and live entertainment.

Our mission? To democratize access to culture and entertainment. With our proprietary cutting-edge technology and data-driven approach, we’re revolutionizing the way people engage with live entertainment.

Every month, our platform inspires over 300 million people in +55 countries (and counting) to discover unforgettable experiences while also empowering event creators with our data and technology, helping them scale, innovate, and enhance their events to reach new audiences.

Our results? We’ve teamed up with major industry leaders like Netflix, F.C. Barcelona, and Primavera Sound, presented international award-winning experiences, and are backed by several leading global investors! Impressive, right?

To achieve our mission, we are looking for bar-raisers with a hands-on mindset who are eager to help shape the future of entertainment!

Ready to be part of the experience?

Now, let’s discuss this role and what you will do to help achieve Fever’s mission.

Assistant Site Manager - VR Concept Venue

Location: Bristol
Contract: Freelance, September 2026 – March 2027 (potential to extend)
Pay: £16 per hour
Working Pattern: Full-time (job share considered); requires evenings, weekends, and public holiday availability. Shift pattern arranged to overlap with, and to cover for, the Event Manager (Site Manager) as needed.
Reports to: Charlotte Potter, Producer – Fever (day-to-day line management from the Event Manager / Site Manager)
Manages: Front-of-house staff (agency and in-house); full management responsibility for all staff, including cleaners and front-of-house teams, when covering for the Event Manager during periods of leave

Role Overview
We're looking for a proactive and technically confident Assistant Site Manager to support the day-to-day running of our immersive VR experience in a high-footfall Bristol venue. Working closely with the Event Manager, you'll help keep the visitor experience running smoothly, staff well supported, and systems fully
operational.

This role also acts as key holiday and absence cover for the Event Manager (Site Manager), stepping up to take full responsibility for the venue — technical, operational, and people management — whenever they are away. You'll need the confidence to run the site independently at short notice, alongside your regular assistant duties.

Key Responsibilities

🔧 Technical & Operational Delivery
● Support daily setup and shutdown of the VR experience, ensuring all systems, hardware, and software are fully operational.
● Carry out pre-opening checks (hardware calibration, environment readiness, content testing) alongside or in place of the Event Manager.
● Troubleshoot first-line IT and technical issues on-site (VR headsets, PCs, networking, displays), escalating to tech support partners where needed.
● Monitor experience performance throughout the day, resolving disruptions or resets promptly.
● Maintain stock of consumables (e.g., sanitisation wipes, headset liners) and uphold hygiene protocols.
● Assist in keeping technical documentation up to date and support training of team members on troubleshooting procedures.

🏛 Venue Operations (Ground Floor)
● Help ensure the ground floor VR experience space is clean, safe, and visitor-ready at all times.
● Coordinate cleaning and reactive maintenance for the VR zone, including public and back-of-house areas.
● Support queue management, timed entry, and visitor flow, particularly during peak periods.

👥 Team Support & Holiday Cover
● Assist in line managing front-of-house staff, including agency team members, day to day.
● Support daily staff briefings, rota coordination, and shift cover.
● Model high standards of customer service and professionalism for the wider team.
● Help train new team members on VR-specific procedures, safety, and technical protocols.
● Take full ownership of team management, rotas, and briefings during any period covering for the Event Manager, ensuring continuity of standards and cover.

🛡 Health & Safety
● Support daily safety and cleanliness walkarounds of the VR area.
● Act as a trained first aider for the venue, leading incident response (first aid, equipment malfunctions, or guest complaints), including full responsibility for this when covering for the Event Manager.
● Help keep risk assessments for the VR zone up to date and log incidents or near misses.
● Ensure staff are trained in relevant H&S procedures, including emergency evacuations and manual handling (if required).

📣 Customer Experience
● Help maintain a welcoming, engaging, and inclusive atmosphere for all guests.
● Act as a point of escalation for visitor queries or complaints, and the main escalation point when covering for the Event Manager.
● Support customer feedback mechanisms and feed insights back to the Producer and Event Manager.

📝 Communication & Reporting
● Provide handovers to the Event Manager (or, during cover periods, directly to the Producer) covering technical issues, visitor numbers, and operational highlights.
● Maintain accurate logs: staff attendance, incident reports, daily checklists, and maintenance tickets.
● Ensure a clean handover back to the Event Manager after any period of holiday cover, flagging anything requiring follow-up.

Ideal Candidate Profile
● Current, valid First Aid at Work certification is required for this role.
● Experience in live event, visitor attraction, or venue operations — preferably in immersive or tech-driven environments.
● Working knowledge of VR hardware/software and basic IT troubleshooting (e.g., Windows PCs, networks, Wi-Fi, device calibration).
● Experience supporting or managing teams, including casual/agency staff, in high-traffic public settings.
● Comfortable stepping up to run a site independently at short notice, with strong organisational skills and a calm, solutions-focused approach under pressure.
● Confident communicator and team player who thrives in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.
● Working knowledge of health & safety regulations and customer service best practices.

Additional Info
● Flexibility is essential: early starts, late finishes, and public holidays are part of the standard schedule.
● Some Mondays/Tuesdays may be required for maintenance, special events, or staff training.
● Holiday cover for the Event Manager should be expected on a periodic basis throughout the contract; specific dates to be agreed and scheduled in advance where possible.

Business Development Manager - New Verticals

London, United Kingdom

Apply

Our Global Structure

Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Field Based Business Development Manager: New Verticals - London

Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation, and growth drives everything we do. Our Commercial team sits at the centre of Deliveroo’s marketplace—shaping how we serve grocers, and new verticals worldwide. From negotiating key partnerships to unlocking new revenue streams and crafting data-led growth strategies, we take on big challenges that move the business forward. If you thrive in fast-paced, commercial environments and want to influence the future of a global brand—this is the team for you.

We’re looking for a Field based business development manager to join our London team. This is a hybrid role. In this role, you’ll help us build relationships with new retail grocery partners across the region, improving our proposition for customers and identifying ways to continue our fast growth.

Get to know our Commercial team — what drives us, how we work, and what you can expect.

What You’ll Be Doing

You’ll be joining the Regional UK and Ireland team. The Regional UK and Ireland team drives Deliveroo's performance across local markets, focusing on signing the best grocery retail selection and expanding our footprint within the region.

Here’s what your day-to-day might look like:

• Drive regional grocery retail acquisition: Map, prospect, pitch, and close high-value grocery retail partners across the London region to expand our local market selection.
• Execute strategic business development: Engage with independent retail grocery partners via physical visits, emails, calls, and social platforms to demonstrate the commercial value of Deliveroo’s technology.
• Own the commercial onboarding journey: Oversee the end-to-end partner onboarding process to ensure it is fast, efficient, and seamless for new partners.
• Secure early partner success: Actively support and monitor new retail grocery performance within their first eight weeks on the platform to maximise their long-term growth.
• Act as a local territory expert: Build deep insight into the regional food scene, travelling across London and surrounding areas to identify key brands that local customers crave.

What You’ll Need to Thrive

Essential

• Proven new business acquisition: Demonstrated sales experience with a track record of actively targeting new business, hunting out hidden gems, and delivering against demanding targets.
• Commercial negotiation skills: Strong commercial acumen with the ability to handle negotiations, understand marketplace economics, and structure profitable, sustainable deals.

title: Senior HRIS Specialist – Workday Lead

Candidate Profile

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Information Systems, HR, Business Administration, Computer Science or equivalent experience
• Minimum 5+ years of hands-on functional configuration experience in live enterprise Workday tenants
• Proven track record in at least one full end-to-end Workday deployment lifecycle or major Phase 2 global rollout

• Deep knowledge of role-based security, domain permissions and business process security policies

• System Configuration & Architecture: Configure and optimize Core HCM, Advanced Compensation, BPF workflows and cross-module touchpoints (Recruiting, Payroll, Time Tracking)

For You

• Flexible working hours and a hybrid working model (option to work remotely up to 2 days per week)
• Access to advanced AI tools and Google Workspace.
• Private healthcare (Allianz) with access to specialists and diagnostics for you and your family

• Cafeteria system - you can choose full funding for a Multisport card or allocate funds for culture, leisure, sports and shopping
• Friendly working atmosphere in tight-knit teams, fostered through integration events and joint initiatives for local communities
• Opportunities to participate in campaigns and events promoting an active lifestyle

title: Associate Project Manager
description:
About hyperexponential (hx)

At hyperexponential, we’re building the AI-powered platform that enables the world’s most critical decisions in a $7 trillion industry - which risks to take, and how to price them. These are the decisions that shape real-world outcomes: whether rockets successfully launch into space, autonomous vehicles make it to market, or communities recover after major storms.

Until now, insurers have been making billion-dollar decisions using outdated tools. We’re changing that. Our platform brings together data, AI, and human expertise to give insurers the fastest path from submission to decision - helping them move faster, act smarter, and take on more risk with confidence.

Backed by a16z, Highland Europe, and Battery Ventures, we’re scaling globally - already trusted by nearly 50 of the world’s largest insurers, with close to zero churn and billions in premiums flowing through hx.

What began as a single product in one market has rapidly evolved into a multi-product, multi-territory platform powering every stage of pricing and underwriting. AI is at the core of what we do - from building the world’s first domain-specific AI peer programmer for insurance (think GitHub Copilot with a PhD in actuarial science) to shaping agentic workflows that reinvent how this industry operates.

What makes hx different is the people who build it. Here, impact isn’t tied to title or tenure; it’s defined by the challenges you take on and the discipline you bring. Surrounded by peers who stretch you, you’ll do the best, hardest work of your life in a company engineered to endure.

If that sounds like you, join us in building what comes next.

About the Project Management team

The Project Management team takes hx customers from signed contract to live in production. We work in cross-functional pods alongside delivery engineers and solution architects, and we own the customer relationship day to day: the plan, the budget, the risks and the conversations that go with them. We work with some of the most sophisticated insurers in the world, including Lloyd’s syndicates, Tier 1 carriers, reinsurers and MGAs. We are moving to a shared, AI-first way of working, where one set of skills is used and improved by the whole team, and we are looking for people who want to help build it.

What you’ll be doing

• Run a customer project from kick-off to go-live, keeping budget, timeline and project hygiene on track.
• Be the day-to-day contact for your customer, and tell them early when something is slipping.
• Work with delivery engineers and solution architects in your pod to turn what the customer needs into a plan the team can deliver.
• Use our shared delivery skills and AI tools to cut manual project admin, and flag where they fall short.
• Learn from your delivery lead and bring proposed answers, not just questions.
• Help us improve how we run projects as you learn what works.

What you’ll need to have done

• Delivered something to a deadline with other people depending on you (work, university or a side project), and be able to say exactly what you did.
• Used AI in your work or studies day to day, and be able to explain what it produced and how you checked it.
• Taken feedback and changed how you work, with an example.
• Gone beyond the surface of a problem to find out what was really going on.

You’re unlikely to thrive here if

• You’d prefer a long runway of shadowing before taking on real responsibility. You’ll own a customer project early, with coaching alongside you.
• You’re uncomfortable being the person customers turn to when something goes wrong or when there is hard news to deliver.
• You wait for direction rather than forming a view and bringing it to the team.

If reading our Culture Document leaves you feeling neutral rather than energised, hx may not be the place where you’ll do your best work. We’re building something that asks for commitment and conviction, and we want you to feel excited by the opportunity to grow with us.

Compensation

At hx, we’re committed to salary transparency. You’ll always have clarity on pay early in the process - our Talent Partner will share details with you during initial conversations - and we’re working towards publishing salary information for all roles globally.

Because we’re building at the intersection of technology/SaaS and insurance, our roles don’t always map neatly onto traditional benchmarks. Our approach is to design compensation that’s competitive in the market, fair across teams, and aligned with the impact our people make.

Benefits

• £5,000 training and conference budget for individual and group development.
• 25 days of holiday plus 8 bank holidays (33 days total).
• Company pension scheme via Penfold.
• Mental health support and therapy via Spectrum.life.
• Individual wellbeing allowance via Juno.
• Private healthcare insurance through AXA.
• Income protection and Life Insurance.
• Cycle to Work Scheme

Additional perks

• Top-spec equipment (laptop, screens, adjustable desks, etc.).
• Regular remote and in-person hackathons, lunch and learns, socials, and game nights.
• Team breakfasts and lunches, snacks, drinks fridge, and a fun office at The Ministry.
• Exceptional opportunities for personal development and growth as we build something remarkable together.

Interview process

• Initial call with our Talent team - 30 minutes
• Manager Interview - 60 minutes
• Skills presentation - 60 minutes
• Values Interview - 60 minutes
• Meet the CEO - 30 minutes

Our commitment to Diversity

hxer’s are at the centre of everything we build. We know that progress depends on diverse perspectives, and we are committed to creating an environment where everyone can thrive, grow, and make an impact. We recognise there is always more to do, and we take responsibility for shaping a workplace that is not only diverse but genuinely inclusive.

Diversity is not just the right thing to do, it is key to solving the complex challenges we choose to take on. By welcoming people from all backgrounds and experiences, we strengthen our ability to question assumptions, push boundaries, and design solutions that endure. If you’re energised by complexity and motivated to grow, we encourage you to apply and join our global team.

Next steps

If this opportunity resonates with you, we encourage you to apply or share it with your connections! Our dedicated talent team reviews all applications, and we promise to provide feedback regardless of the outcome.

For more information about applying and to view other opportunities, you can visit our careers page.

Please note that background checks will be conducted as part of the hiring process to ensure compliance with our governance policies. We handle all background checks sensitively and in full compliance with relevant regulations. All applicant data will be processed in accordance with data protection regulations and our privacy policy.

title: Senior C# Trading Systems Engineer
company: Vistulo (for a major N. American bank)
description:
Salary: 250 - 280 PLN per hour (B2B)

Want to work on FX electronic trading systems at a top N. American Bank?

This isn’t just another dev role. It’s your chance to engineer the core of global trading.

We’re talking ultra-low-latency architectures, real-time market data, and speedy electronic trading, all in an environment where milliseconds matter, and billions move. You’ll work on building FX (forex) electronic trading systems.

If you thrive on complexity, love solving performance challenges under pressure, and want to collaborate directly with traders and product teams at the sharp edge of financial technology, this is your arena.

The Role at a Glance

• Senior C# .NET Backend Engineer
• Building a trading systems, including high-performance backend services for market data and electronic trading
• Fully remote for a top N. American bank (for residents of Poland or Romania)
• Part of the core team - this is not a legacy support role or an outsourced B team

This role requires experience building trading systems, and an understanding of financial markets. An ideal candidate will have worked on FX trading systems.

If you enjoy working on low-latency, high-throughput trading systems, join us and build the next generation of high-performance capital markets solutions.

Why Join Us?

• Work on a large-scale, low-latency trading system.
• No Legacy: Join an actively developed system. The engineers who built it originally are still on the team.
• Collaborate with a world-class team of developers across North America and Europe.
• Enjoy the stability of a long-term, fully remote role that only a bank can offer.

A successful candidate will be a very strong programmer with current C# development experience. They must also be curious, open-minded, and desire to learn new things. English proficiency is a must. If you’re fascinated by understanding systems ‘under the hood,’ this role is for you. Successful candidates enjoy geeking out about data structures and debugging application performance issues.

This is a fully remote role for a developer in Poland or Romania. You will be working through a Polish company that will provide the support and administrative assistance to make you successful in the role. We are looking for people to join the team long-term.

Only open to residents of Poland and Romania. Citizens and legal residents with permission to work in Poland or Romania are welcome.

What we offer

• Work that matters in the financial domain: You’ll be building a high-performance trading system at an established financial institution.
• Professional growth: Collaborate with smart, highly capable developers in a supportive and challenging environment.
• Direct collaboration: You will work directly with the client team in North America and in Europe.
• 1st-tier work: This is not a technical support or legacy maintenance role. The system is functional and is actively being built and you will take part in updating it. The people who built the system are still part of the team.
• Long-term commitment: This is not a fixed-scope or fixed-term outsourcing role; we value people who want to grow and contribute long-term.
• Flexibility & remote work: Fully remote position based in Poland or Romania.
• Competitive Compensation: Top pay and ample time-off options.

Requirements:

• Algorithms
• Multi-threading
• Low-latency
• Trading systems
• .NET
• C#

Must have

• 7+ years of professional C# .NET development experience, with a strong understanding of programming concepts, including algorithms, complexity, and multi-threading, and Java’s language capabilities and standard libraries.
• Good knowledge of the data structures: familiarity with the .NET collections library, depth of understanding of the commonly used data structures, and intuition on what to use when.
• Proven experience building backend services for front-office trading systems.
• Deep understanding of front-office workflows and electronic trading platforms (any asset class).
• Built or contributed to the development of an electronic trading system (any asset class).
• Expertise in multi-threading, event-driven systems, and performance tuning.
• Ability to break down complex workflows into maintainable, high-quality solutions.
• Strong communication skills and comfort working in high-stakes, trader-facing environments.
• Knowledge that is required for building low-latency (measured in microseconds) trading systems.
• Familiarity with the FIX protocol.
• Ability to align your work with a 6-hour overlap with US Eastern business hours.

Nice to have

• Familiar with Broadway FX.
• Familiar with Java.
• A computer science degree from a top Polish school.

Nice to have:

• FX Trading systems
• Java
• Computer Science Degree

Daily tasks:

• Design and implement robust software solutions for FX trading systems using C# .NET.
• Collaborate with other teams to research and implement changes to the trading system.
• Create thorough test cases to ensure software stability and reliability.
• Collaborate with operations teams regarding building new features and improving existing functionality.
• Support production issues, including independently completing root-cause analysis and diagnosis.
• Process business requirements with minimal guidance, derive implementation proposals, and implement them with a team or individually.
• Mentor junior developers.

description:
Bring more to life.

Are you ready to accelerate your potential and make a real difference within life sciences, diagnostics and biotechnology?

At Masimo, one of Danaher’s 15+ operating companies, our work saves lives—and we’re all united by a shared commitment to innovate for tangible impact.

You’ll thrive in a culture of belonging where you and your unique viewpoint matter. And by harnessing Danaher’s system of continuous improvement, you help turn ideas into impact – innovating at the speed of life.

Masimo is a global medical technology company that develops and produces a wide array of industry-leading monitoring technologies, including non-invasive measurements, sensors, patient monitors, and automation and connectivity solutions. Our mission is, Masimo innovations empower clinicians to transform patient care. When you join our team, you’ll be part of a culture that’s driven by passion, challenging the status quo, and making an impact in the lives of others.

Learn about the Danaher Business System which makes everything possible.

The Clinical Specialist (d/f/m) is responsible for providing clinical expertise and support to healthcare professionals using Masimo’s non-invasive patient monitoring technologies. Working closely with customers and the Sales team, you will support the implementation of Masimo solutions, provide clinical education and training, and help develop solutions tailored to individual customer needs. You will also provide ongoing clinical support and represent Masimo technologies at workshops, trade fairs and congresses.

This position reports to the Regional Manager and is part of the German Sales Team. The position is remote and covers North Rhine-Westphalia, primarily Cologne and Düsseldorf area.

In this role, you will have the opportunity to:

• Support the implementation and use of Masimo’s non-invasive patient monitoring technologies directly at customer sites.
• Develop and implement tailored solutions for customers in collaboration with the Sales team and provide continued support following implementation.
• Train clinical and nursing staff on Masimo technologies, either at customer sites or in the Masimo training center.
• Present Masimo technologies at workshops, trade fairs and congresses.
• Document and communicate customer feedback through the CRM system.
• Collaborate with national and international teams, including Customer Service, Marketing and Technical Service.

The essential requirements of the job include:

• Medical qualification, for example as a registered nurse, cardiac technician, or comparable healthcare professional; specialized clinical training is an advantage.
• Strong clinical expertise and a good understanding of hospital processes and patient monitoring technologies.
• Confident and personable communication style when interacting with customers and healthcare professionals.
• Ability and motivation to develop customer solutions collaboratively as part of a team.
• Fluent German and good working knowledge of English.

Travel, Motor Vehicle Record & Physical/Environment Requirements:

• Ability to travel approximately 60% of the time within the assigned territory, including customer visits and occasional overnight stays.

• Must have a valid driver’s license and an acceptable Motor Vehicle Record.

Masimo, a Danaher operating company, offers a broad array of comprehensive, competitive benefit programs that add value to our lives, such as: acompany car, 30 days of holidays, company pension plan and regular national and international team events.

Join our winning team today. Together, we’ll accelerate the real-life impact of tomorrow’s science and technology. We partner with customers across the globe to help them solve their most complex challenges, architecting solutions that bring the power of science to life.

title: Senior Manager, Paid Social
location: Germany - Berlin; London, England, United Kingdom; Spain - Madrid
description:
Job Application for Senior Manager, Paid Social at Quince

Back to jobs

New

Senior Manager, Paid Social

Germany - Berlin; London, England, United Kingdom; Spain - Madrid

Apply

ABOUT QUINCE

Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.

What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.

OUR CULTURE

Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before.

• We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA. Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place.
• Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths.
• Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member - no matter their level - has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory.

If you’re someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you.

THE ROLE

Senior Manager, Paid Social

We are seeking a Senior Manager, Paid Social to join our growing team.

Paid social is one of the main ways Quince finds new customers, and this role sits at the centre of it. As Senior Manager, Growth Marketing (Paid Social), you will own strategy, execution and optimisation across Meta and other social platforms for a set of Quince departments, turning business goals into efficient media investment and steady, scalable growth.

This is a hands-on, analytical role. You will manage significant media budgets against clear efficiency targets (ROAS, CAC and NC MTA ROAS), work out what is really driving performance, and work closely with creative, merchandising and analytics colleagues so that targeting and creative keep getting better. The role is critical to scaling our paid social acquisition engine.

Responsibilities

Paid social strategy and investment (the main focus of the role)

• Own paid social strategy and delivery for selected Quince departments across Meta, TikTok and emerging social channels.
• Manage and optimise significant paid media budgets to meet customer acquisition and efficiency targets.
• Monitor performance across campaigns, audiences and creative, and act quickly on what you find.
• Run a continuous programme of testing across audience segmentation, creative formats, messaging, bidding and budget allocation.
• Scale the campaigns that work, and deal with underperformance promptly.
• Adjust spend quickly in response to performance signals and changing product priorities.

Performance analysis and optimisation

• Analyse campaign results across different attribution frameworks.
• Identify what drives incremental customer acquisition and revenue growth, and turn those findings into practical campaign and creative decisions.
• Build and maintain dashboards, reporting frameworks and performance analyses.
• Work with our analytics team to improve the accuracy of measurement and attribution.

Creative and testing collaboration

• Work closely with the Creative, Studio and Production teams to shape creative that performs.
• Develop ways of working that make sure creative suits each platform.
• Keep testing volume high enough to support growth targets, with a steady supply of new creative.

Cross-functional collaboration

• Work with Merchandising and Product to agree priority categories and launches.
• Partner with Analytics and Data on attribution and measurement.
• Present performance insights and growth opportunities to leadership.

Growth experimentation and channel development

• Find opportunities to expand into new paid social surfaces and formats.
• Test new growth approaches, including audience expansion, creator-led ads and performance creative formats.
• Keep improving our testing frameworks so we can run more experiments and learn more from each one.

What success looks like

In this role, you will:

• manage and optimise significant paid social spend for your departments against clear targets for ROAS, CAC and NC MTA ROAS;
• drive scalable customer acquisition through testing, experimentation and analysis;
• find new audience, creative and bidding opportunities that unlock incremental growth;
• build a high-performing creative pipeline in partnership with the creative teams;
• use data and attribution models to guide budget allocation and channel strategy; and
• respond quickly, and sensibly, to what the numbers are telling you.

Qualifications Required:

• six or more years of experience in performance marketing or paid social growth;
• deep experience managing Meta Ads (Facebook and Instagram) at scale, with real ROAS and CPA pressure;
• experience managing TikTok, Pinterest, YouTube and other paid social channels;
• strong analytical skills, with experience of attribution models and performance data;
• a proven record of managing and optimising large paid media budgets;
• experience of running performance creative tests and working closely with creative teams;
• a data-led mindset, together with strong operational discipline; and comfort working in a fast-moving, high-growth environment.

WHY QUINCE?

Joining Quince means being part of a mission-driven team reshaping retail. You will work alongside talented colleagues, tackle meaningful challenges, and contribute to building a more sustainable, accessible future for customers and partners alike.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & HIRING INTEGRITY

Quince provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applications for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran or military status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.

Quince is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation to complete your application or to perform the essential functions of a role at Quince, please let us know by completing this accommodation form. We review all requests individually and will work with you to determine appropriate accommodations on a case-by-case basis.

Employment is contingent upon successful completion of a background check. Quince will conduct background checks in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local laws.

Security Advisory: Beware of Frauds

At Quince, we're dedicated to recruiting top talent who share our drive for innovation. To safeguard candidates, Quince emphasizes legitimate recruitment practices. Initial communication is primarily via official Quince email addresses and LinkedIn; beware of deviations. Personal data and sensitive information will not be solicited during the application phase. Interviews are conducted via phone, in person, or through the approved platforms Google Meets or Zoom—never via messaging apps or other calling services. Offers are merit-based, communicated verbally, and followed up in writing. If personal information is requested to initiate the hiring process, rest assured it will be through secure and protected means.

title: Data Scientist - Junior/Mid/Senior - ICH Europe
description:
Job Description

About the Intelligent Consulting Hub

Intelligent Consulting Hub is a part of Europe Strategy & Consulting practice, pulling together multinational and cross-cultural professionals based at key locations across Europe. No matter what business, no matter where in the world, our unrivaled industry and function experts help our Clients to shape the future creating clearly defined, measurable value. We are delivering on the promise of technology and human ingenuity. Our Poland part of ICH Consulting Hub is located in Warsaw, Kraków, Wrocław, Łódź and Gdańsk. Your impact will be truly global as you will leverage an unmatched network of people, knowledge, tools and technologies and work alongside some of the best thinkers in the market. “Join our world class capabilities and experience unique opportunities to grow your skills with us.” – Małgorzata Nasiłowska, ICH Consulting Hub Lead

Join our AI Centre of Excellence in Poland, part of a global team of 9,000+ AI experts and data scientists. We partner with leading tech providers (AWS, GCP, Microsoft, Databricks, Snowflake, SAS) to build scalable AI solutions that drive real business impact.

• Contribute to cutting-edge AI initiatives by applying your creativity, critical thinking, and analytical skills.
• Design and implement scalable AI/ML solutions using cloud, generative, and agentic AI technologies.
• Work in agile, cross-functional teams combining technical, business, and data science expertise.
• Your accountability, responsibility, and autonomy will grow with your experience and seniority - we are looking for specialists with various experience levels.

Qualifications

HERE’S WHAT YOU’LL NEED:

Education & Experience Requirements (Cumulative):

• Minimum Bachelor's degree in discipline like Informatics, Physics, Mathematics, Quantitative Methods.
• At least 2 years of experience applying data-driven approaches to business scenarios, including the design and deployment of advanced analytics and machine learning algorithms.
• At least 1 year of experience in delivering analytical projects with top Cloud platforms such as GCP, Azure, AWS.

Technical Skills:

• Proficient in at least one of programming and query languages like Python, PySpark, SQL.
• Solid understanding of machine learning and data science techniques including:
• Clustering, regression, classification, forecasting
• Neural networks, hyperparameter optimization
• Natural Language Processing (NLP), Large Language Models (LLMs)

Other Skills:

• Ability to translate complex business requirements into robust, data-driven solutions.
• Strong appetite for continuous learning and skill development in emerging AI technologies.
• Professional working proficiency in English.

Research indicates that some candidates, especially the most diverse ones, may hesitate to apply for positions if they don't meet all

requirements. If you believe you possess the necessary skills, even if not meeting every requirement, we wholeheartedly encourage you to submit your application.

Bonus Points If You Have:

🧠 Advanced Technical Expertise

• Experience with frameworks like XGBoost, lgbm, Prophet, Hyperopt, Keras, PyTorch, TensorFlow, sklearn, LangChain, CrewAI, Open AI API, Hugging Face Transformers or Google ADK.
• Experience with generative AI or agentic AI technologies

⚙️ Tools & Platforms

• Hands-on experience with Databricks
• Familiarity with MLOps tools and practices such as MLflow, Kubeflow, or Airflow

📜 Cloud and AI certifications such as:

• Azure Data Science Associate
• Azure AI Engineer
• Google Cloud Professional Data Engineer
• Google Cloud Data Analytics Professional
• Databricks ML Professional

Working Conditions:

• Location: Our headquarters is in Warsaw, with an additional office in Kraków.
• Flexibility: While most of our work is delivered remotely, our consulting model - through Intelligent Consulting Hub Europe (ICH) - also involves on-site collaboration. You should be willing and able to travel to client locations across Europe (and occasionally beyond) for short or long-term engagements, depending on project needs.
• Hybrid Collaboration: We value in-person time for learning, relationship-building, and team collaboration. As an employer, we aim to be as flexible as possible to support your individual work-life balance and preferences.

WHAT WE OFFER:

🚀 Career Development

• Permanent employment contract
• Individual support from a dedicated People Lead
• Personalized professional development path
• Access to coaching sessions
• Extensive training package including:
• Soft skills, technical, and language training
• E-learning platforms
• Gallup strengths assessment
• GenAI training
• Cloud certification programs

🧘 Well-being & Support

• Employee Assistance Program offering legal, financial, and psychological consultations
• Private medical care and life insurance coverage
• Access to the MyBenefit platform, including a wide range of products and services (e.g., Multisport card)

💼 Perks & Incentives

• Paid employee referral program
• Eligibility for quarterly dividends through the Employee Share Purchase Plan (for employees who own company shares)

WHAT WE BELIEVE:

Accenture does not discriminate employment candidates on the basis of race, religion, colour, sex, age, disability, national origin, political beliefs, trade union membership, ethnicity, denomination, sexual orientation or any other basis impermissible under Polish law. All our leaders are committed to building a better, stronger and more durable company for future generations to create positive, long-lasting change. Inclusion and diversity are fundamental to our culture and core values. Our rich diversity makes us more innovative and creative, which helps us better serve our clients and our communities. Our position as partner to many of the world’s leading businesses, organizations and governments affords us both an extraordinary opportunity and a tremendous responsibility to make a difference. Sustainability is one of our greatest responsibilities, which we embed it into everything we do and for everyone we work with.
